able.tip_zh: able 常被唸成「欸波」：字尾的 [ḷ] 不見了，或在 [b] 後面多加一個「歐」的母音。正確是 [b] 之後直接接成音節的暗 L：雙唇一放開，舌尖馬上頂住上排牙齒後方，舌根同時往後抬，不另加母音。開頭的 [e] 要從「欸」滑向「伊」，整個字和 table 的後半部唸法一樣。
able.tip_en: able is often said like “ay-bo”: the final [ḷ] disappears, or an extra “o” vowel is added after [b]. Correctly, [b] goes straight into a syllabic dark L: as soon as the lips open, the tongue tip presses behind the upper teeth while the back of the tongue lifts, with no added vowel. The opening [e] glides from “eh” toward “ee”; the whole word sounds like the second half of table.

examples.en: I am able to swim across the pool now.
examples.zh: 我現在能游過整個游泳池了。

examples.en: Will you be able to come to my party?
examples.zh: 你能來參加我的派對嗎？

about.tip_zh: about 常被唸成「阿抱特」：開頭唸得太重，字尾 [t] 後面又多加一個母音。重音在第二音節 [baʊt]，第一個 [ə] 輕輕帶過就好。[aʊ] 要從張大嘴的「啊」滑到嘴唇收圓，最後舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方停住 [t]，不要送出「特」。可以先唸 out，再在前面加上輕輕的 [ə] 和 [b]。
about.tip_en: about is often said like “ah-bao-te”: the start is too strong and an extra vowel follows the final [t]. The stress is on the second syllable [baʊt]; the first [ə] is just a light touch. [aʊ] glides from an open “ah” to rounded lips, and the tongue tip then stops against the ridge behind the upper teeth for [t], without releasing a “te”. Try saying out first, then add a light [ə] and [b] in front.

examples.en: This book is about a brave little cat.
examples.zh: 這本書是關於一隻勇敢的小貓。

examples.en: We talked about our weekend plans.
examples.zh: 我們聊了週末的計畫。

above.tip_zh: above 的 o 不唸 [o]，第二音節是短而放鬆的 [ʌ]，和 love、glove 同一個母音；照拼字容易唸成「阿波夫」。字尾 [v] 要上排牙齒輕碰下唇、喉嚨同時震動，常見錯誤是唸成無聲的 [f]，或在後面多加一個母音。重音在第二音節 [bʌv]，開頭的 [ə] 輕而短。
above.tip_en: The o in above is not [o]; the second syllable has the short, relaxed [ʌ], the same vowel as love and glove. Following the spelling leads to “ah-bo-fu”. The final [v] needs the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip with the throat buzzing; common mistakes are a voiceless [f] or an extra vowel after it. The stress is on the second syllable [bʌv]; the opening [ə] is light and short.

examples.en: The clock is above the classroom door.
examples.zh: 時鐘在教室門的上方。

examples.en: Birds are flying above the trees.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在樹的上方飛。

above.spelling_zh: o 唸 [ʌ]，字尾 e 不發音
above.spelling_en: The o says [ʌ], and the final e is silent.

abroad.tip_zh: abroad 的 oa 不像 road 唸 [o]，而是嘴巴張開、略帶圓唇的 [ɔ]。另一個常見問題是在 [b] 和 [r] 中間多塞一個母音，變成「阿-波-若的」。[b] 一放開就直接捲舌接 [r]，重音落在第二音節 [brɔd]，字尾 [d] 輕輕停住，不要加成「的」。
abroad.tip_en: The oa in abroad is not the [o] of road; it is [ɔ], with the mouth open and lips slightly rounded. Another common problem is squeezing a vowel between [b] and [r], making “ah-bo-ro-de”. As soon as [b] releases, curl straight into [r]. The stress is on the second syllable [brɔd], and the final [d] just stops lightly, without becoming “de”.

examples.en: My uncle studies abroad in Canada.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在加拿大留學。

examples.en: Have you ever traveled abroad with your family?
examples.zh: 你曾經和家人出國旅行過嗎？

abroad.spelling_zh: oa 唸 [ɔ]，不像 road 的 [o]
abroad.spelling_en: The oa says [ɔ], not the [o] of road.

across.tip_zh: across 的第二音節 [krɔs] 是 [k] 和 [r] 黏在一起的子音串，不要唸成「阿-可-肉斯」多出一拍。舌根頂住軟顎準備 [k]，放開時舌頭已經捲好 [r]。母音是嘴巴張開的 [ɔ]，不是圓唇的 [o]；字尾 [s] 是輕輕的氣音，後面不再加母音。它和 cross 押韻，先唸 cross，再在前面加輕輕的 [ə]。
across.tip_en: The second syllable of across, [krɔs], has [k] and [r] stuck together; don't say “ah-ke-ro-s” with an extra beat. Raise the back of the tongue for [k], and by the time it releases the tongue is already curled for [r]. The vowel is the open [ɔ], not the rounded [o]; the final [s] is a light hiss with no vowel after it. It rhymes with cross: say cross, then add a light [ə] in front.

examples.en: The library is across the street from our school.
examples.zh: 圖書館在我們學校對面。

examples.en: Let's swim across the lake together.
examples.zh: 我們一起游過這座湖吧。

act.tip_zh: act 只有一個音節，字尾卻有 [k] 和 [t] 兩個子音，常被唸成「欸可特」三拍，或乾脆把 [t] 吞掉。[æ] 要嘴巴往下、往兩邊拉開，比「欸」更大。接著舌根頂住軟顎做 [k]，不放開聲音，舌尖馬上碰上排牙齒後方完成 [t]。也別跟 ant 搞混：act 的尾巴是 [kt]，ant 是 [nt]。
act.tip_en: act has only one syllable but ends in two consonants, [k] and [t]. It is often said as three beats, “eh-ke-te”, or the [t] is swallowed. For [æ], open the mouth down and stretch it sideways, wider than “eh”. Then lift the back of the tongue for [k] without releasing, and move the tongue tip straight to the ridge behind the upper teeth for [t]. Don't confuse it with ant: act ends in [kt], ant in [nt].

examples.en: Tom will act in the school play.
examples.zh: 湯姆會在學校的話劇裡演出。

examples.en: Helping the old man was a kind act.
examples.zh: 幫助那位老先生是一個善良的舉動。

action.tip_zh: 第一音節 [æk] 常被唸成 [ɛk]，嘴巴張得太小；[æ] 要把下巴往下拉、嘴角往兩邊開，像說 apple 的開頭。第二音節 [ʃən] 的 [ʃ] 不是注音的ㄒ，要把嘴唇嘟出去、舌頭往後收一點。字尾 [n] 要用舌尖頂住上排牙齦收尾，不要唸成 [ŋ]。
action.tip_en: The first syllable [æk] is often said as [ɛk], with the mouth too closed; for [æ], drop the jaw and spread the corners of the mouth, like the start of apple. In the second syllable [ʃən], [ʃ] is not Mandarin ㄒ: push the lips forward and pull the tongue back a little. Finish [n] with the tongue tip pressed on the upper gum ridge; don't turn it into [ŋ].

examples.en: Our class took action to save water at school.
examples.zh: 我們班採取行動，在學校節約用水。

examples.en: We need to take action and clean up the park.
examples.zh: 我們需要採取行動，把公園打掃乾淨。

actor.tip_zh: 字尾的 -or 不是唸 [ɔr]，而是輕輕的 [tɚ]，舌頭往後捲、不碰任何地方。另一個常見問題是在 [k] 後面多加一個母音，變成三個音節。[k] 只要舌根頂一下就直接接 [t]，兩個子音緊緊相連，整個字只有 [æk] 和 [tɚ] 兩拍，重音在 [æk]。
actor.tip_en: The final -or is not said [ɔr] but as a light [tɚ]: curl the tongue back without touching anything. Another common problem is adding a vowel after [k], which makes three syllables. The back of the tongue only taps for [k] and goes straight into [t], two consonants tightly joined, so the word has just two beats, [æk] and [tɚ], with the stress on [æk].

examples.en: My cousin wants to be an actor someday.
examples.zh: 我表哥以後想當演員。

examples.en: The actor waved to the kids after the show.
examples.zh: 表演結束後，那位演員向小朋友揮手。

actress.tip_zh: actress 重音在第一音節 [æk]，嘴巴要張大唸 [æ]。最難的是中間 [k]、[t]、[r] 三個子音連在一起，常被拆成「愛-克-特-瑞斯」四拍。[k] 只要舌根頂一下、不出聲，接著 [t] 和 [r] 連成一個動作：舌尖碰齒齦後立刻往後捲。第二音節 [trəs] 輕而短，字尾 [s] 不加母音。
actress.tip_en: actress is stressed on the first syllable [æk], with the mouth open wide for [æ]. The hard part is the three consonants [k], [t], [r] in a row, which often get split into four beats, “ai-ke-te-rui-s”. For [k], just touch the back of the tongue up without releasing a sound; then do [t] and [r] as one movement: the tongue tip touches the ridge and immediately curls back. The second syllable [trəs] is light and short, and the final [s] has no vowel after it.

examples.en: My sister wants to be an actress someday.
examples.zh: 我姊姊將來想當女演員。

examples.en: The actress smiled and waved to her fans.
examples.zh: 那位女演員微笑著向粉絲揮手。

actually.tip_zh: 常見的錯誤是每個音節都唸得一樣重，或把重音放錯在第二音節 [tʃʊ]。這個字只有第一音節 [æk] 重讀，嘴巴張大；後面的 [tʃʊəlɪ] 要又輕又快地帶過。[tʃ] 要把嘴唇嘟出去，跟 chew 的開頭一樣，不是注音的ㄑ。
actually.tip_en: A common mistake is giving every syllable the same weight, or wrongly stressing the second syllable [tʃʊ]. Only the first syllable [æk] is stressed, with the mouth open wide; the rest, [tʃʊəlɪ], should be light and quick. For [tʃ], push the lips forward as at the start of chew; it is not Mandarin ㄑ.

examples.en: Actually, I like math more than art.
examples.zh: 其實，比起美術我更喜歡數學。

examples.en: The test was actually easier than I thought.
examples.zh: 考試其實比我想的還簡單。

actually.variant_en: In fast speech it often shrinks to [ˈæktʃəlɪ] or [ˈækʃəlɪ].
actually.kk_flag: The secondary-stress mark before tʃu is unusual: General American actually has only the primary stress on the first syllable, [ˈæktʃuəlɪ].

afraid.tip_zh: afraid 的重音在第二音節 [fred]。[f] 要上排牙齒輕碰下唇吹氣，不要把嘴唇圓起來唸成「呼」；[f] 和 [r] 之間也不加母音，避免變成「阿-佛-瑞的」。[e] 要從「欸」滑向「伊」，最後舌尖頂住齒齦停在 [d]，不要唸成「的」。它和 grade 押韻，可以先唸 grade 練韻腳。
afraid.tip_en: afraid is stressed on the second syllable [fred]. For [f], the upper teeth touch the lower lip and air blows through; don't round the lips into a “hu” sound. No vowel goes between [f] and [r], so avoid “ah-fo-rui-de”. [e] glides from “eh” toward “ee”, and the tongue tip finally stops on the ridge for [d] instead of saying “de”. It rhymes with grade, so practise the ending with grade first.

examples.en: Don't be afraid of the dark.
examples.zh: 不要怕黑。

examples.en: My little brother is afraid of big dogs.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很怕大狗。

after.tip_zh: 美式發音的 [æ] 要把嘴巴張大，學生卻容易唸成英式的 [ɑ] 或太扁的 [ɛ]。[f] 是上排牙齒輕碰下唇吹氣，吹完直接接 [t]，中間不要多一個母音，否則會變成三個音節。字尾 [tɚ] 舌頭往後捲，不要唸成沒有捲舌的「特」。
after.tip_en: American [æ] needs a wide-open mouth, but learners tend to say British-style [ɑ] or a too-flat [ɛ]. For [f], the upper teeth touch the lower lip lightly and blow; then go straight into [t] with no vowel in between, or the word turns into three syllables. In the ending [tɚ], curl the tongue back; don't say an un-curled 特.

examples.en: We play basketball after school.
examples.zh: 我們放學後打籃球。

examples.en: Please wash your hands after you eat.
examples.zh: 吃完東西後請洗手。

afternoon.tip_zh: 因為 after 的重音在前面，學生常把 afternoon 的重音也放在第一音節。其實主要重音在最後的 [nun]，要唸得最長、最響；[æf] 只是次重音，中間的 [tɚ] 輕輕帶過。結尾的 [n] 舌尖要頂住上排牙齦停住，不要變成 [ŋ]。
afternoon.tip_en: Because after is stressed at the front, learners often stress afternoon on the first syllable too. In fact the main stress is on the last syllable [nun], which should be the longest and loudest; [æf] only gets secondary stress, and the middle [tɚ] is passed over lightly. For the final [n], hold the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; don't let it become [ŋ].

examples.en: We have art class on Monday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們星期一下午有美術課。

examples.en: My grandma takes a nap every afternoon.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天下午都會睡午覺。

again.tip_zh: again 的 ai 最常唸短短的 [ɛ]，和 ten、when 押韻，不必照拼字拉長成「欸伊」。重音在第二音節 [gɛn]，前面的 [ə] 輕輕帶過。字尾 [n] 要舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方收住，常見錯誤是舌根往後縮，唸成 [ŋ]，結尾變得像 [gɛŋ]。可以先唸 ten，再把 [t] 換成 [g]，前面加上 [ə]。
again.tip_en: The ai in again is most often a short [ɛ], rhyming with ten and when; there is no need to stretch it into “eh-ee” because of the spelling. The stress is on the second syllable [gɛn], and the [ə] before it is light. The final [n] ends with the tongue tip pressed behind the upper teeth; a common mistake is pulling the tongue back to [ŋ], so the ending sounds like [gɛŋ]. Say ten, swap [t] for [g], and add [ə] in front.

examples.en: Can you say that again, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你再說一次嗎？

examples.en: We will play together again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天會再一起玩。

again.variant_zh: 也有人唸 [əˈgen]，和 rain 押韻
again.variant_en: Some speakers say [əˈgen], rhyming with rain.

age.tip_zh: age 只有一個音節：[e] 加上字尾的 [dʒ]。常見問題是在 [dʒ] 後面多唸一個母音，變成「欸居」；或是 [dʒ] 沒有讓聲帶震動，結果聽起來就像字母 H [etʃ]。[dʒ] 要嘴唇微微往前嘟、舌面貼上顎再放開，同時喉嚨震動，放開後就停。它和 page 押韻；也別跟 eight [et] 搞混。
age.tip_en: age has just one syllable: [e] plus a final [dʒ]. A common problem is adding a vowel after [dʒ], making “eh-ju”; another is saying [dʒ] without voicing, so it sounds like the letter H [etʃ]. For [dʒ], push the lips slightly forward, press the tongue's front against the roof of the mouth and release it while the throat buzzes, then stop. It rhymes with page; also keep it apart from eight [et].

examples.en: My cousin and I are the same age.
examples.zh: 我表哥和我同年紀。

examples.en: Children start school at the age of six.
examples.zh: 孩子六歲開始上學。

age.spelling_zh: g 唸 [dʒ]，字尾 e 不發音
age.spelling_en: The g says [dʒ], and the final e is silent.

ago.tip_zh: ago 的重音在第二音節 [go]，第一個 [ə] 只是輕輕的弱音，不要唸成清楚又用力的「阿」。[go] 的 [o] 要嘴唇從半圓慢慢收得更圓，尾巴往 [u] 的方向滑。ago 常放在時間後面，例如 two days ago，練習時把 days 和 ago 連起來唸：[z] 直接接到 [ə]，中間不要停頓。
ago.tip_en: ago is stressed on the second syllable [go]; the first [ə] is only a light, weak sound, not a clear, forceful “ah”. In [go], the lips go from half-round to rounder, with the end gliding toward [u]. ago usually follows a time phrase, as in two days ago; practise linking days and ago, with [z] running straight into [ə] and no pause.

examples.en: We moved to Taipei two years ago.
examples.zh: 我們兩年前搬到台北。

examples.en: I saw that movie a long time ago.
examples.zh: 我很久以前看過那部電影。

agree.tip_zh: agree 的重音在第二音節 [gri]，而且 [g] 和 [r] 中間沒有母音，不要唸成「阿-格-瑞」三拍。舌根頂住軟顎放出 [g] 的同時，舌頭就要往後捲成 [r]，接著嘴角往兩邊拉唸長的 [i]。開頭的 [ə] 很輕，比 [gri] 短很多。它和 tree、free 押韻，可以把 tree 的 [t] 換成 [g] 來練。
agree.tip_en: agree is stressed on the second syllable [gri], and there is no vowel between [g] and [r], so don't make three beats like “ah-ge-rui”. As the back of the tongue releases [g], the tongue already curls back into [r], then the lips spread for a long [i]. The opening [ə] is light and much shorter than [gri]. It rhymes with tree and free; practise by swapping the [t] in tree for [g].

examples.en: I agree with you about the new game.
examples.zh: 關於那個新遊戲，我同意你的看法。

examples.en: Mom and Dad agree that we can get a puppy.
examples.zh: 爸媽都同意我們可以養一隻小狗。

ahead.tip_zh: ahead 的 ea 唸短的 [ɛ]，和 head、bread 同音，不要照拼字唸成長音 [i]。中間的 [h] 只是輕輕吐一口氣，不像中文「喝」那樣用喉嚨後面摩擦。重音在第二音節 [hɛd]，最後舌尖頂住齒齦停在 [d]，不多加「的」。先唸 head，再在前面加輕短的 [ə]，就是 ahead。
ahead.tip_en: The ea in ahead is the short [ɛ], as in head and bread; don't read it as a long [i]. The [h] in the middle is just a light breath, not the scrape at the back of the throat used in Mandarin 喝. The stress is on the second syllable [hɛd], ending with the tongue tip stopped on the ridge for [d], with no extra “de”. Say head, then add a short, light [ə] in front.

examples.en: Go ahead and open your present.
examples.zh: 去吧，打開你的禮物。

examples.en: Our team is ahead by two points.
examples.zh: 我們隊領先兩分。

ahead.spelling_zh: ea 唸 [ɛ]，和 head 一樣
ahead.spelling_en: The ea says [ɛ], as in head.

air.tip_zh: air 只有一個音節 [ɛr]，常被唸成「愛兒」，把開頭變成 [aɪ]，或拆成「欸-兒」兩拍。開頭是 bed 的 [ɛ]，嘴巴半開，然後舌尖往後捲成 [r]，中間不停頓。也要和 ear [ɪr] 分清楚：air 的嘴巴開得比較大，ear 開頭比較接近 [ɪ]。它和 hair、chair 押韻。
air.tip_en: air is a single syllable, [ɛr]. It is often said like “ai-er”, turning the start into [aɪ], or split into two beats, “eh-er”. It starts with the [ɛ] of bed, mouth half open, then the tongue curls back into [r] with no break. Also keep it apart from ear [ɪr]: air opens the mouth wider, while ear starts closer to [ɪ]. It rhymes with hair and chair.

examples.en: Let's open the window for some fresh air.
examples.zh: 我們打開窗戶透透新鮮空氣吧。

examples.en: The air is cool in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上的空氣很涼爽。

airplane.tip_zh: airplane 的主重音在第一音節 [ɛr]，第二音節 [plen] 是次重音，不要把兩邊唸得一樣重。[p] 和 [l] 之間不加母音，避免變成「欸兒-波-蕾」；雙唇一放開，舌尖已經頂在上排牙齒後方做 [l]。結尾的 [n] 要用舌尖收住，不要唸成舌根的 [ŋ]。
airplane.tip_en: airplane has its main stress on the first syllable [ɛr]; the second syllable [plen] has secondary stress, so don't make both equally strong. Add no vowel between [p] and [l], avoiding “eh-er-po-lei”: as the lips open, the tongue tip is already behind the upper teeth for [l]. The final [n] closes with the tongue tip, not with the back of the tongue as [ŋ].

examples.en: We took an airplane to Japan.
examples.zh: 我們搭飛機去日本。

examples.en: Look, there's an airplane in the sky!
examples.zh: 你看，天空中有一架飛機！

airport.tip_zh: airport 的兩個音節都有捲舌 [r]：[ɛr] 和 [pɔrt]。常見問題是第二音節唸成「波特」，[r] 不見了，或字尾多出一個母音。唸 [pɔr] 時嘴巴先張開略圓，舌頭再往後捲，維持捲舌讓舌尖往上碰齒齦做 [t]，停住就好。重音在第一音節 [ɛr]，第二音節稍輕。
airport.tip_en: Both syllables of airport have a curled [r]: [ɛr] and [pɔrt]. A common problem is saying the second syllable like “bo-te”, losing the [r] or adding a vowel at the end. For [pɔr], open the mouth with slightly rounded lips, then curl the tongue back; keeping that curl, lift the tongue tip to the ridge for [t] and just stop. The stress is on the first syllable [ɛr]; the second is a bit lighter.

examples.en: Grandpa picked us up at the airport.
examples.zh: 爺爺到機場接我們。

examples.en: The airport is busy before the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假前機場很忙碌。

all.tip_zh: all 常被唸成「歐」，字尾的暗 L 不見了；或唸成「歐嘍」，多出一個母音。[ɔ] 要嘴巴張開、下巴放低，不是嘴唇圓圓的 [o]。接著舌尖往上頂住上排牙齒後方，舌根同時往後抬，聲音從舌頭兩側出來，這就是字尾的暗 [l]。它和 tall、small、wall 押韻，可以一起練。
all.tip_en: all is often said as just “o”, losing the final dark L, or as “o-lo” with an extra vowel. [ɔ] needs an open mouth and lowered jaw; it is not the rounded [o]. Then lift the tongue tip behind the upper teeth while the back of the tongue rises, letting the sound flow around the sides: that is the final dark [l]. It rhymes with tall, small and wall, so practise them together.

examples.en: All my friends came to my birthday party.
examples.zh: 我所有的朋友都來參加我的生日派對。

examples.en: Did you eat all the cookies?
examples.zh: 你把餅乾全部吃光了嗎？

allow.tip_zh: allow 的 ow 不唸 [o]，不像 low、slow；它唸 [aʊ]，和 cow、how 押韻。照拼字唸成「阿漏」是最常見的錯誤。第二音節 [laʊ] 先用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方發 [l]，再張大嘴唸「啊」並滑向圓唇的 [ʊ]。重音在第二音節，雖然拼字有兩個 l，只唸一個 [l]，開頭的 [ə] 輕輕帶過。
allow.tip_en: The ow in allow is not [o] as in low or slow; it is [aʊ], rhyming with cow and how. Reading it from the spelling as “ah-lou” is the usual mistake. For the second syllable [laʊ], press the tongue tip behind the upper teeth for [l], then open wide for “ah” and glide to rounded [ʊ]. The stress is on the second syllable; the double l is a single [l], and the opening [ə] is light.

examples.en: My parents allow me to watch TV after homework.
examples.zh: 爸媽允許我寫完功課後看電視。

examples.en: Does your teacher allow phones in class?
examples.zh: 你們老師允許上課用手機嗎？

allow.spelling_zh: ow 唸 [aʊ]（像 cow），不是 low 的 [o]
allow.spelling_en: The ow says [aʊ] as in cow, not the [o] of low.

almost.tip_zh: almost 的 l 要唸出來，不像 walk 的 l 不發音；第一音節 [ɔl] 結尾舌尖要碰到上排牙齒後方。重音在第一音節。第二音節 [most] 結尾是 [s] 和 [t] 兩個子音，常被唸成「摸斯特」多出一拍，或把 [t] 吞掉。[s] 吹完氣後舌尖往上一頂就停，不再送出母音。
almost.tip_en: The l in almost is pronounced, unlike the silent l in walk; at the end of the first syllable [ɔl], the tongue tip must touch behind the upper teeth. The stress is on the first syllable. The second syllable [most] ends in two consonants, [s] and [t], and is often said as “mo-s-te” with an extra beat, or the [t] is swallowed. After the [s] hiss, just lift the tongue tip to stop for [t], with no vowel after it.

examples.en: It's almost time for lunch.
examples.zh: 差不多該吃午餐了。

examples.en: I almost forgot my homework today.
examples.zh: 我今天差點忘了帶作業。

along.tip_zh: along 的字尾是 [ŋ]：舌根抬起頂住軟顎，讓聲音從鼻子出來就結束，後面不要再彈出一個 [g]，唸成「阿龍格」。也不要把它換成舌尖的 [n]。[lɔŋ] 的 [ɔ] 嘴巴要張開，比中文「龍」的母音開得更大。重音在第二音節，和 long、song、belong 押韻。
along.tip_en: along ends in [ŋ]: the back of the tongue lifts against the soft palate, sound comes out of the nose, and that's the end; don't pop out an extra [g] like “ah-long-ge”. Don't swap it for the tongue-tip [n] either. The [ɔ] in [lɔŋ] needs an open mouth, wider than the vowel in Mandarin 龍. The stress is on the second syllable; it rhymes with long, song and belong.

examples.en: We walked along the river after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們沿著河邊散步。

examples.en: Can my little sister come along?
examples.zh: 我妹妹可以一起來嗎？

already.tip_zh: already 是一個字，重音在第二音節 [ˈrɛ]，和 ready 押韻；學生常把重音放在開頭，聽起來像兩個字 all ready（全都準備好）。第一音節 [ɔl] 要短一點、輕一點。[rɛ] 的母音是 [ɛ]，跟 red 的母音一樣，不要唸成會滑動的 [e]，像 rain 那樣。
already.tip_en: Already is one word stressed on the second syllable [ˈrɛ], and it rhymes with ready; learners often stress the start, which makes it sound like the two words all ready (all prepared). Keep the first syllable [ɔl] shorter and lighter. The vowel in [rɛ] is [ɛ], the same as in red; don't say the gliding [e], as in rain.

examples.en: I already finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我已經寫完功課了。

examples.en: It's already eight o'clock, so let's go.
examples.zh: 已經八點了，我們走吧。

also.tip_zh: also 的重音在第一音節 [ɔl]，其中的 l 要唸出來：張嘴唸 [ɔ] 後，舌尖往上頂住上排牙齒後方，再接 [s]。常見錯誤是省掉 [l]，變成「歐搜」。中間的 s 是無聲的 [s]，不要唸成有聲的 [z]。第二音節 [so] 較輕，[o] 結尾嘴唇要收圓。
also.tip_en: also is stressed on the first syllable [ɔl], and its l is pronounced: after the open [ɔ], lift the tongue tip behind the upper teeth, then go into [s]. A common mistake is dropping [l], making “o-sou”. The s in the middle is a voiceless [s], not a voiced [z]. The second syllable [so] is lighter, and its [o] ends with rounded lips.

examples.en: I like apples, and I also like bananas.
examples.zh: 我喜歡蘋果，也喜歡香蕉。

examples.en: My dad is also a teacher.
examples.zh: 我爸爸也是老師。

always.tip_zh: always 的字尾 s 唸有聲的 [z]，喉嚨要震動，常被唸成無聲的 [s]。第一音節 [ɔl] 的 l 也不能省：舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方之後，嘴唇馬上收圓做 [w]，兩個動作要連起來。重音在第一音節，第二音節較輕。手放在喉嚨上唸結尾，摸得到震動就對了。
always.tip_en: The final s in always is a voiced [z], with the throat buzzing; it is often said as a voiceless [s]. The l in the first syllable [ɔl] can't be dropped either: right after the tongue tip touches behind the upper teeth, the lips round for [w], and the two moves should link up. The stress is on the first syllable; the second is lighter. Put a hand on your throat while saying the ending: if you feel the buzz, it's right.

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.
examples.zh: 我睡前一定會刷牙。

examples.en: Grandma always makes soup on Sundays.
examples.zh: 奶奶每個星期天都會煮湯。

always.variant_en: The second syllable is often reduced: [ˈɔlwɪz].

america.tip_zh: 受中文「美國」影響，學生常把 [mɛ] 唸成「美」那樣的 [me]，嘴型太扁還會滑動。KK 是 [ɛ]，跟 men 的母音一樣，短而不滑。重音在第二音節 [ˈmɛ]，開頭的 [ə] 只是輕輕一聲，不要唸成響亮的「阿」；最後的 [kə] 也要放輕，不要唸成重重的 [kɑ]。
america.tip_en: Influenced by the Chinese 美國, learners often say [mɛ] like 美, i.e. [me], too flat and gliding. The KK is [ɛ], the vowel of men, short and steady. The stress is on the second syllable [ˈmɛ]; the opening [ə] is just a light sound, not a loud ah, and the last [kə] stays light too, not a heavy [kɑ].

examples.en: My uncle lives in America.
examples.zh: 我叔叔住在美國。

examples.en: We learned about North America in class today.
examples.zh: 我們今天上課學了北美洲。

american.tip_zh: 字尾的 [kən] 常被唸成響亮的 [kæn]，聽起來像 can，或是收成 [kəŋ]。這個字的重音在 [ˈmɛ]，[kən] 是最輕的一拍：[ə] 幾乎一帶而過，最後舌尖頂住上排牙齦收 [n]，不要讓舌根抬起變成 [ŋ]。開頭的 [ə] 也要輕，不要唸成「阿」。
american.tip_en: The ending [kən] is often said as a loud [kæn], like can, or closed as [kəŋ]. The stress is on [ˈmɛ], and [kən] is the lightest beat: pass over [ə] almost instantly, then finish [n] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; don't let the back of the tongue rise into [ŋ]. The opening [ə] is light too, not a full ah.

examples.en: Our new teacher is American.
examples.zh: 我們的新老師是美國人。

examples.en: We ate American pancakes for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我們早餐吃了美式鬆餅。

and.tip_zh: and 在句子裡通常唸弱讀的 [ənd]，母音輕而短，說快時 [d] 甚至會很輕。常見問題是每次都用力唸成「安的」，在 [d] 後多加母音。[n] 和 [d] 都是舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方，舌頭不用移動，只要把從鼻子出來的聲音停掉，就完成 [d]。練習 bread and butter 這類片語，把 and 輕輕夾在中間。
and.tip_en: In a sentence, and is usually the weak [ənd], with a light, short vowel, and in fast speech the [d] may be very light. A common problem is saying it forcefully every time, like “an-de”, adding a vowel after [d]. Both [n] and [d] use the tongue tip behind the upper teeth; the tongue doesn't move, you just stop the sound coming through the nose and [d] is done. Practise phrases like bread and butter, tucking and lightly in the middle.

examples.en: I have a cat and a dog.
examples.zh: 我有一隻貓和一隻狗。

examples.en: Mom and I baked cookies together.
examples.zh: 媽媽和我一起烤了餅乾。

and.variant_en: When stressed it is [ænd], with the mouth open wide.

angle.tip_zh: angle 常和 angel（天使）搞混，被唸成 [ˈendʒəl]。angle 的 [æ] 嘴巴要張大，接著舌根抬起發 [ŋ]，再直接接 [g]，是硬的 [g]，不是 [dʒ]。字尾 [ḷ] 舌尖要頂住上排牙齦，不要在 [g] 後面加一個像 [o] 的母音。重音在第一音節，[gḷ] 輕輕收尾。
angle.tip_en: Angle is often confused with angel (天使) and said as [ˈendʒəl]. In angle, open the mouth wide for [æ], lift the back of the tongue for [ŋ], and go straight into [g], a hard [g], not [dʒ]. For the final [ḷ], put the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; don't add an [o]-like vowel after [g]. The stress is on the first syllable, and [gḷ] closes the word lightly.

examples.en: Use your ruler to draw an angle.
examples.zh: 用你的尺畫一個角。

examples.en: Let's take a photo from a different angle.
examples.zh: 我們換個角度拍照吧。

angle.spelling_zh: angle 和 angel 只差 l、e 的順序，發音卻完全不同。
angle.spelling_en: Angle and angel differ only in the order of l and e, but sound completely different.

angry.tip_zh: angry 常和 hungry 搞混。angry 是 [ˈæŋgrɪ]，開頭沒有 [h]，母音是嘴巴張大的 [æ]；hungry 則是 [ˈhʌŋgrɪ]。另外 [ŋ] 後面要接一個清楚的 [g]，再馬上接捲舌的 [r]，[g] 和 [r] 中間不要加母音，整個字只有兩拍。練習時可以先說 hungry，再拿掉 [h]，把嘴巴張大換成 [æ]。
angry.tip_en: Angry is often confused with hungry. Angry is [ˈæŋgrɪ], with no [h] and the wide-open vowel [æ]; hungry is [ˈhʌŋgrɪ]. Also, after [ŋ] there must be a clear [g], followed at once by a curled [r]; don't put a vowel between [g] and [r]. The whole word has only two beats. To practice, say hungry, then drop the [h] and open the mouth wide to switch to [æ].

examples.en: My little brother gets angry when he loses a game.
examples.zh: 我弟弟輸了遊戲就會生氣。

examples.en: Please don't be angry with me.
examples.zh: 請不要生我的氣。

animal.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [ˈæ]，嘴巴張大；中間的 [nə] 要輕而短，不要唸成清楚的 [ni]。最難的是結尾 [mḷ]：雙唇閉起來發 [m] 之後，舌尖直接頂到上排牙齦發 [ḷ]，中間不要多加一個像「歐」的母音，舌頭也不要整個放掉。
animal.tip_en: Stress the first syllable [ˈæ] with the mouth wide open; the middle [nə] is light and short, not a clear [ni]. The hardest part is the ending [mḷ]: close the lips for [m], then put the tongue tip straight up on the upper gum ridge for [ḷ]. Don't add an oh-like vowel in between, and don't let the tongue drop away.

examples.en: My favorite animal is the panda.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的動物是貓熊。

examples.en: What animal can you see in this picture?
examples.zh: 你在這張圖裡看到什麼動物？

another.tip_zh: [ð] 常被換成 [d]、[z] 或 [l]。發 [ð] 時舌尖輕放在上下牙齒之間，喉嚨要振動，讓氣從舌頭旁邊出來。another 就是 a 加上 nother，和 mother 押韻；重音在 [ˈnʌ]，[ʌ] 嘴巴微開、短促，不要唸成 [ɑ]。字尾 [ðɚ] 舌尖從牙齒間收回，再往後捲。
another.tip_en: [ð] is often replaced with [d], [z], or [l]. For [ð], rest the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth and make the throat vibrate, letting the air pass beside the tongue. Another is a plus nother, rhyming with mother; the stress is on [ˈnʌ], and [ʌ] is short with the mouth slightly open, not [ɑ]. For the ending [ðɚ], pull the tongue tip back from the teeth and curl it.

examples.en: Can I have another cookie, please?
examples.zh: 我可以再吃一塊餅乾嗎？

examples.en: We will read another story tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天會再讀另一個故事。

answer.tip_zh: 拼字裡的 w 不發音，學生卻常把它唸出來，變成「安斯威爾」。answer 只有兩個音節：[æn] 嘴巴張大，舌尖頂住上排牙齦收 [n]，再接 [sɚ]。它和 dancer [ˈdænsɚ] 押韻，把 dancer 去掉 [d] 來練就對了。字尾 [ɚ] 要捲舌，重音在第一音節。
answer.tip_en: The w in the spelling is silent, yet learners often pronounce it, saying something like an-swi-er. Answer has only two syllables: [æn] with the mouth wide open and the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n], then [sɚ]. It rhymes with dancer [ˈdænsɚ]; practice by saying dancer without the [d]. Curl the tongue for the final [ɚ]; the stress is on the first syllable.

examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
examples.zh: 如果你知道答案，請舉手。

examples.en: Can you answer this question?
examples.zh: 你可以回答這個問題嗎？

answer.spelling_en: The w is silent; sw is pronounced just [s].

ant.tip_zh: ant 的 [æ] 要嘴巴往下、往兩邊張開，不能唸成較窄的 [ɛ]。字尾 [nt]：舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方發 [n]，舌頭不動，直接把氣擋住變成 [t]，不要多唸一個「特」。另外要和 act 分清楚：ant 的尾巴有鼻音 [n]，act 是舌根的 [k]。在美式英語裡，aunt 也常唸得和 ant 一樣。
ant.tip_en: The [æ] in ant needs the mouth open down and stretched sideways; it can't be the narrower [ɛ]. For the final [nt], press the tongue tip behind the upper teeth for [n], keep it still, and simply block the air to make [t], with no extra “te”. Also keep it apart from act: ant ends with the nasal [n], act with the back-of-tongue [k]. In American English, aunt is often said exactly like ant.

examples.en: A tiny ant is carrying a crumb.
examples.zh: 一隻小螞蟻正在搬一塊碎屑。

examples.en: Look at the ant on the leaf!
examples.zh: 你看葉子上的螞蟻！

any.tip_zh: any 的 a 不唸 [æ]，而是 [ɛ]，跟 many 一樣；照拼字唸成「安尼」是最常見的錯誤。第一音節 [ɛ] 嘴巴半開，比 [æ] 小，舌尖接著頂住上排牙齒後方發 [n]。重音在第一音節，第二音節 [nɪ] 短而放鬆，不要拉長成 [i]。
any.tip_en: The a in any is not [æ] but [ɛ], just like many; reading it from the spelling as “an-ni” is the most common mistake. The first syllable's [ɛ] is half open, smaller than [æ], and then the tongue tip presses behind the upper teeth for [n]. The stress is on the first syllable; the second syllable [nɪ] is short and relaxed, not stretched to [i].

examples.en: Do you have any questions?
examples.zh: 你有任何問題嗎？

examples.en: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡一點牛奶都沒有。

any.spelling_zh: a 唸 [ɛ]，和 many 一樣
any.spelling_en: The a says [ɛ], just like many.

anyone.tip_zh: 看到開頭的 a，學生常唸成 [æ]，但 any 的 a 唸 [ɛ]，跟 penny 去掉 [p] 一樣。後半的 one 唸 [wʌn]，拼字雖然沒有 w，開頭卻要先圓唇發 [w]；[ʌ] 短而放鬆，不要唸成像「萬」的 [wɑn]。重音在第一音節 [ˈɛ]。和 everyone、someone 一樣，結尾的 one 都唸 [wʌn]，舌尖頂住上排牙齦收 [n]。
anyone.tip_en: Seeing the a at the start, learners often say [æ], but the a in any is [ɛ], like penny without the [p]. The second half, one, is [wʌn]: there is no w in the spelling, but you start by rounding the lips for [w]; [ʌ] is short and relaxed, not the [wɑn] of 萬. The stress is on the first syllable [ˈɛ]. As in everyone and someone, the final one is [wʌn], ending with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n].

examples.en: Does anyone have an extra pencil?
examples.zh: 有人有多的鉛筆嗎？

examples.en: Did anyone see my blue jacket?
examples.zh: 有人看到我的藍色外套嗎？

anyone.spelling_zh: any 的 a 唸 [ɛ]；one 沒有 w，卻唸 [wʌn]。
anyone.spelling_en: The a in any is [ɛ]; one has no w but is said [wʌn].

anything.tip_zh: 第三音節的 [θ] 常被唸成 [s]，anything 就變成 anysing。發 [θ] 時舌尖伸到上下牙齒之間，只吹氣、喉嚨不振動。字尾 [ŋ] 是舌根貼住軟顎、讓氣從鼻子出來，不要換成 [n]，也不要在後面多加 [g] 或 [k]。和 everything 一樣，重音在第一音節。
anything.tip_en: The [θ] in the third syllable is often said as [s], turning anything into anysing. For [θ], put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and just blow air, with no throat vibration. The final [ŋ] is made with the back of the tongue against the soft palate and air through the nose; don't swap it for [n] or add a [g] or [k] after it. Like everything, it is stressed on the first syllable.

examples.en: Do you need anything from the store?
examples.zh: 你需要從店裡買什麼東西嗎？

examples.en: I can't find anything in my messy bag.
examples.zh: 我在亂七八糟的包包裡什麼都找不到。

apartment.tip_zh: 重音在第二音節 [ˈpɑrt]，學生常把重音放錯在開頭。[ɑrt] 要先把嘴巴張大發 [ɑ]，再往後捲舌。[t] 接 [m] 的地方，舌尖碰一下上排牙齦就直接閉唇發 [m]，中間不要加母音。字尾 [mənt] 輕輕帶過，[n] 和 [t] 的舌尖位置一樣，舌頭不用移動。
apartment.tip_en: The stress is on the second syllable [ˈpɑrt]; learners often wrongly stress the beginning. For [ɑrt], open the mouth wide for [ɑ], then curl the tongue back. Where [t] meets [m], the tongue tip just touches the upper gum ridge and the lips close straight into [m], with no vowel in between. The ending [mənt] is light; [n] and [t] use the same tongue-tip position, so the tongue doesn't move.

examples.en: We live in an apartment on the fifth floor.
examples.zh: 我們住在五樓的公寓。

examples.en: Her apartment is next to the park.
examples.zh: 她的公寓就在公園旁邊。

appear.tip_zh: appear 的重音在第二音節 [pɪr]，雖然拼字有兩個 p，只唸一個 [p]。[ɪr] 是一個音節：短的 [ɪ] 之後舌頭直接往後捲，常見錯誤是唸成「阿-皮-兒」，把 [ɪ] 拉長成 [i] 又多出一拍。它和 near、year 押韻，可以先唸 near，再把 [n] 換成 [p]，前面加上輕輕的 [ə]。
appear.tip_en: appear is stressed on the second syllable [pɪr]; the double p is a single [p]. [ɪr] is one syllable: after a short [ɪ], the tongue curls straight back. A common mistake is “ah-pi-er”, stretching [ɪ] into [i] and adding a beat. It rhymes with near and year: say near, swap [n] for [p], and add a light [ə] in front.

examples.en: Stars appear in the sky at night.
examples.zh: 晚上星星出現在天空中。

examples.en: A rainbow may appear after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨後可能會出現彩虹。

apple.tip_zh: 常見的錯誤是把結尾唸成「阿婆」那樣，在 [p] 後面加一個像「ㄛ」的母音。正確的 [pḷ] 是發完 [p] 後，舌尖立刻頂住上排牙齦，讓聲音從舌頭兩側出來。開頭的 [æ] 嘴巴要張得比「ㄟ」大，下巴往下拉、嘴角往兩邊開。
apple.tip_en: A common mistake is ending the word like 阿婆, adding an ㄛ-like vowel after [p]. For a correct [pḷ], right after [p] raise the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge and let the sound flow out past the sides of the tongue. For the opening [æ], open the mouth wider than ㄟ: drop the jaw and spread the corners of the mouth.

examples.en: I eat an apple every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃一顆蘋果。

examples.en: This apple is red and sweet.
examples.zh: 這顆蘋果又紅又甜。

april.tip_zh: April 的重音在第一音節 [e]，要從「欸」滑向「伊」，不要照 apple 唸成 [æ]。接著 [p] 和 [r] 緊緊連在一起，中間不加母音。第二音節 [rəl] 很輕，結尾的暗 [l] 要讓舌尖碰到上排牙齒後方，常見錯誤是唸成「欸普若」，[l] 不見了。月份名稱的第一個字母要大寫。
april.tip_en: April is stressed on the first syllable [e], which glides from “eh” toward “ee”; don't use the [æ] of apple. Then [p] and [r] are joined tightly with no vowel between them. The second syllable [rəl] is very light, and the final dark [l] needs the tongue tip to touch behind the upper teeth; a common mistake is “ay-pu-ro”, where the [l] disappears. Month names start with a capital letter.

examples.en: My birthday is in April.
examples.zh: 我的生日在四月。

examples.en: It often rains in April in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣四月常常下雨。

area.tip_zh: area 有三個音節，重音在第一音節 [ˈɛ]。學生常照著拼字用 [ɑ] 開頭，或把 [ɛr] 唸成不捲舌的 [e]。其實開頭聽起來就是 air [ɛr]，接著是輕輕的 [ɪ]，最後是非常弱的 [ə]。可以先說 air，再接上 [ɪə]，三拍一重兩輕。
area.tip_en: Area has three syllables, stressed on the first, [ˈɛ]. Learners often follow the spelling and start with [ɑ], or say [ɛr] as an un-curled [e]. In fact the start sounds just like air [ɛr], followed by a light [ɪ] and finally a very weak [ə]. Say air first and then add [ɪə]; the three beats go strong, weak, weak.

examples.en: This area of the park is for picnics.
examples.zh: 公園的這一區是野餐用的。

examples.en: Our library has a quiet reading area.
examples.zh: 我們的圖書館有一個安靜的閱讀區。

arm.tip_zh: arm 是一個音節：張大嘴唸 [ɑ]，舌頭往後捲成 [r]，最後雙唇閉上發 [m]。常見錯誤是捲舌不見，唸成「阿姆」，或閉嘴之後又多出一個母音。[m] 只要嘴唇合起來、讓聲音從鼻子出來就結束。它和 farm 押韻；和 art 只差最後一個音：[m] 閉唇，[t] 是舌尖頂齒齦。
arm.tip_en: arm is one syllable: open wide for [ɑ], curl the tongue back into [r], and finally close the lips for [m]. Common mistakes are losing the curl, making “ah-mu”, or adding a vowel after closing the lips. For [m], just close the lips and let the sound come through the nose, then stop. It rhymes with farm; it differs from art only in the last sound: [m] closes the lips, [t] puts the tongue tip on the ridge.

examples.en: Raise your arm if you know the answer.
examples.zh: 知道答案的話就舉手。

examples.en: She carried the books under her arm.
examples.zh: 她把書夾在手臂下。

around.tip_zh: 開頭的 [ə] 又輕又短，學生常唸成響亮的「阿」，或乾脆省略。重音在後面的 [ˈraʊnd]：舌頭先捲好發 [r]，嘴巴再從 [a] 張大，滑到圓唇的 [ʊ]，和 round、sound 押韻。字尾 [nd] 舌尖先頂住上排牙齦發 [n]，原地輕輕放開帶出 [d]，不要多加一個「的」的母音。
around.tip_en: The opening [ə] is light and short; learners often make it a loud ah or drop it. The stress is on the second part [ˈraʊnd]: curl the tongue for [r] first, then open wide for [a] and glide to rounded [ʊ]; it rhymes with round and sound. For the final [nd], press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n], then release it in place for [d]; don't add a vowel like 的.

examples.en: We walked around the lake after dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐後繞著湖散步。

examples.en: There are trees all around our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校四周都是樹。

around.kk_flag: Taiwan KK dictionaries write [əˈraʊnd], with r starting the stressed syllable; this CMU-derived [ɚˈaʊnd] puts the r in the unstressed syllable. The sound is nearly the same, but the split ɚ·aʊnd may look odd to teachers.

arrive.tip_zh: 結尾的 [v] 常被唸成 [f] 或 [b]，或在後面多加一個母音。發 [v] 時上排牙齒輕碰下唇，喉嚨要振動，像蜜蜂嗡嗡的聲音，振動結束就收尾。重音在後面的 [ˈraɪv]，和 five、drive 押韻；開頭的 [ə] 輕輕帶過就好。
arrive.tip_en: The final [v] is often said as [f] or [b], or followed by an extra vowel. For [v], rest the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip and make the throat vibrate, like a buzzing bee, and stop when the buzz ends. The stress is on [ˈraɪv], which rhymes with five and drive; the opening [ə] is passed over lightly.

examples.en: The bus will arrive at seven.
examples.zh: 公車七點會到。

examples.en: What time did you arrive at school today?
examples.zh: 你今天幾點到學校？

arrive.kk_flag: Taiwan KK dictionaries write [əˈraɪv]; this CMU-derived [ɚˈaɪv] puts the r in the unstressed syllable instead of starting the stressed one, so the split ɚ·aɪv may look odd to teachers.

art.tip_zh: art 常被唸成「阿特」：中間的捲舌 [r] 不見了，字尾又多出一個母音。正確做法是張大嘴唸 [ɑ]，舌頭往後捲成 [r]，保持捲舌時讓舌尖往上碰上排牙齒後方，停住就是 [t]。它和 heart、part、start 押韻，最後的 [t] 可以只輕輕擋住氣，不必用力爆開。
art.tip_en: art is often said like “ah-te”: the curled [r] in the middle disappears and an extra vowel appears at the end. Instead, open wide for [ɑ], curl the tongue back into [r], and while it is curled lift the tongue tip to the ridge behind the upper teeth; stopping there is [t]. It rhymes with heart, part and start, and the final [t] can just block the air lightly without a strong burst.

examples.en: Art is my favorite class.
examples.zh: 美術是我最喜歡的課。

examples.en: We made paper masks in art today.
examples.zh: 我們今天在美術課做了紙面具。

as.tip_zh: as 和 at 只差最後一個音。[z] 要讓喉嚨振動，學生常唸成無聲的 [s]，聽起來像「ㄟ斯」。練習時把手放在喉嚨上，要感覺到振動。[æ] 嘴巴要張大，不要唸成 [ɛ]。在句子裡 as 常常輕讀，但結尾的 [z] 一樣要有振動。
as.tip_en: As and at differ only in the last sound. [z] needs a vibrating throat; learners often say a voiceless [s], something like ehs. When practicing, put a hand on your throat and feel the vibration. Open the mouth wide for [æ], not [ɛ]. In sentences as is often said lightly, but the final [z] must still vibrate.

examples.en: My brother is as tall as my dad.
examples.zh: 我哥哥跟我爸爸一樣高。

examples.en: Run as fast as you can!
examples.zh: 用你最快的速度跑！

as.variant_zh: 在句子中不強調時，常弱讀成 [əz]，例如 as tall as。
as.variant_en: When unstressed in a sentence it is often reduced to [əz], e.g. as tall as.

ask.tip_zh: ask 的字尾 [sk] 是兩個子音連在一起，常被唸成「愛斯克」，在 [s] 和 [k] 後面都多出母音。[æ] 要嘴巴張大，嘴角往兩邊拉；接著舌尖靠近上排牙齒後方吹出 [s]，舌根馬上往上頂住軟顎做 [k]，輕輕放開就結束。它和 mask 押韻，可以先練 mask，再把 [m] 拿掉。
ask.tip_en: ask ends in [sk], two consonants together, and is often said like “ai-s-ke”, with vowels added after both [s] and [k]. Open the mouth wide with the corners stretched for [æ]; then bring the tongue tip near the ridge behind the upper teeth to hiss [s], and immediately raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate for [k], releasing it lightly to finish. It rhymes with mask: practise mask, then drop the [m].

examples.en: You can ask me for help anytime.
examples.zh: 你隨時都可以請我幫忙。

examples.en: Ask your teacher if you don't understand.
examples.zh: 如果你不懂，就問老師。

at.tip_zh: at 單獨唸是 [æt]，嘴巴要張大，否則容易和 it [ɪt] 搞混。字尾 [t] 只要舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方擋住氣，不要唸成「欸特」。在句子裡 at 常輕讀，例如 at home、at school 都輕輕帶過；[t] 後面接母音時要和下一個字連在一起，像 at eight 中間不要停頓。
at.tip_en: On its own, at is [æt], with the mouth open wide; otherwise it is easily confused with it [ɪt]. For the final [t], just block the air with the tongue tip behind the upper teeth; don't say “eh-te”. In sentences at is usually light, as in at home and at school. When a vowel follows [t], link it to the next word, as in at eight, with no pause.

examples.en: Let's meet at the park at three.
examples.zh: 我們三點在公園見。

examples.en: My mom is at work now.
examples.zh: 我媽媽現在在上班。

attack.tip_zh: attack 的重音在第二音節 [tæk]，雖然拼字有兩個 t，只唸一個 [t]，而且因為在重音節開頭，要送出明顯的氣。[æ] 嘴巴張大，最後舌根頂住軟顎停在 [k]，不要唸成「客」。常見錯誤是把重音放在第一音節，或把 [æ] 唸成較窄的 [ɛ]。它和 back、black 押韻。
attack.tip_en: attack is stressed on the second syllable [tæk]. The double t is a single [t], and since it starts the stressed syllable, it needs a clear puff of air. Open wide for [æ], then stop with the back of the tongue against the soft palate for [k], without saying “ke”. Common mistakes are stressing the first syllable or narrowing [æ] into [ɛ]. It rhymes with back and black.

examples.en: Our soccer team will attack from the left side.
examples.zh: 我們的足球隊會從左邊進攻。

examples.en: The cat jumped up to attack the toy mouse.
examples.zh: 貓咪跳起來撲向玩具老鼠。

august.tip_zh: August 的 au 不唸 [aʊ]，而是嘴巴張大的 [ɑ]，照拼字常被唸成「凹-咕斯特」。重音在第一音節，第二音節 [gəst] 的母音要輕而短，不要唸成清楚的「咕」。結尾 [st] 兩個子音緊連，[s] 吹完氣舌尖往上一頂就停，不要多加母音。月份名稱的第一個字母要大寫。
august.tip_en: The au in August is not [aʊ] but the open [ɑ]; following the spelling, it is often said like “ao-gu-s-te”. The stress is on the first syllable, and the vowel in the second syllable [gəst] is light and short, not a clear “gu”. The final [st] is two consonants together: after the [s] hiss, lift the tongue tip to stop, with no extra vowel. Month names start with a capital letter.

examples.en: School starts again at the end of August.
examples.zh: 八月底又要開學了。

examples.en: We went to the beach in August.
examples.zh: 我們八月去了海邊。

august.variant_en: Some say [ˈɔgəst], with slightly rounded lips.

aunt.tip_zh: 因為拼字有 au，學生常唸成 [ɔnt]，像 August 的開頭那樣。美式發音最常見的是 [ænt]，和 ant（螞蟻）完全同音，嘴巴要張大。結尾 [nt] 舌尖頂住上排牙齦先發 [n]，舌頭不移動，直接放出 [t]，不要加一個「特」的母音。
aunt.tip_en: Because of the au spelling, learners often say [ɔnt], like the start of August. The most common American pronunciation is [ænt], exactly the same as ant (螞蟻), with the mouth open wide. For the final [nt], put the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n], then release [t] without moving the tongue; don't add a vowel like 特.

examples.en: My aunt lives in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨住在台中。

examples.en: We visit my aunt every Chinese New Year.
examples.zh: 我們每年過年都會去拜訪阿姨。

aunt.variant_zh: 也有美國人唸 [ɑnt]，但 [ænt] 最常見。
aunt.variant_en: Some Americans say [ɑnt], but [ænt] is the most common.
aunt.spelling_zh: au 在這裡不唸 [ɔ]，aunt 和 ant 同音。
aunt.spelling_en: Here au is not [ɔ]; aunt sounds the same as ant.

autumn.tip_zh: 結尾的 n 不發音，autumn 只唸到 [təm] 為止，學生卻常把 n 也唸出來。最後的 [m] 一定要雙唇閉緊，不要唸成嘴巴開著的「恩」。開頭的 [ɔ] 嘴巴張開、稍微圓唇，不要唸成嘴型很小的 [o]。重音在第一音節，[təm] 輕輕帶過。
autumn.tip_en: The final n is silent; autumn ends at [təm], yet learners often pronounce the n as well. The final [m] must be made with the lips firmly closed, not an open-mouthed 恩. For the opening [ɔ], open the mouth and round the lips slightly; don't use the small-mouthed [o]. The stress is on the first syllable; [təm] is light.

examples.en: The leaves turn red and yellow in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天時，樹葉會變紅、變黃。

examples.en: Autumn is my favorite season.
examples.zh: 秋天是我最喜歡的季節。

autumn.spelling_zh: 字尾 mn 的 n 不發音，和 column 一樣。
autumn.spelling_en: The n in the final mn is silent, as in column.

away.tip_zh: away 的重音在第二音節 [we]，第一個 [ə] 只輕輕帶過。[w] 要先把嘴唇嘟圓再快速張開，不能省掉直接唸成「阿-欸」。[e] 從「欸」滑向「伊」，嘴角慢慢往兩邊拉。片語 far away、go away 中，前面的字要和 away 連起來唸，不要停頓。它和 day、play 押韻。
away.tip_en: away is stressed on the second syllable [we]; the first [ə] is just a light touch. For [w], round the lips first and open them quickly; don't skip it and say “ah-eh”. [e] glides from “eh” toward “ee” as the lips spread. In phrases like far away and go away, link the word before to away with no pause. It rhymes with day and play.

examples.en: My grandparents live far away.
examples.zh: 我的爺爺奶奶住得很遠。

examples.en: Please put your toys away.
examples.zh: 請把你的玩具收好。

baby.tip_zh: baby 的重音在第一音節 [be]，[e] 要從「欸」滑向「伊」；第二音節 [bɪ] 短而輕，不要拉長或加重，唸成前後一樣重的兩拍。兩個 [b] 都是雙唇緊閉再放開，第二個 [b] 夾在母音中間，喉嚨要持續震動，不要停頓。也注意和 maybe 分開：maybe 的第一音節是 [me]。
baby.tip_en: baby is stressed on the first syllable [be], where [e] glides from “eh” toward “ee”; the second syllable [bɪ] is short and light, not stretched or stressed into two equal beats. Both [b] sounds close the lips tightly and release them; the second [b] sits between vowels, so the throat keeps buzzing with no pause. Also keep it apart from maybe, whose first syllable is [me].

examples.en: The baby is sleeping, so please be quiet.
examples.zh: 寶寶在睡覺，所以請安靜。

examples.en: My aunt just had a baby girl.
examples.zh: 我阿姨剛生了一個女寶寶。

back.tip_zh: back 的 [æ] 要嘴巴張大，嘴角往兩邊拉，不能唸成 [ɛ]，更不能拉長成 bake 的 [e]。它和 bake 只差母音：back 短而開，bake 要滑向「伊」。字尾 [k] 是舌根頂住軟顎把氣擋住，輕輕放開或停住都可以，不要唸成「貝客」多出一個母音。它和 black、snack 押韻。
back.tip_en: The [æ] in back needs a wide-open mouth with the corners stretched; it can't be [ɛ], and certainly not the long [e] of bake. back and bake differ only in the vowel: back is short and open, bake glides toward “ee”. The final [k] blocks the air with the back of the tongue against the soft palate; release it lightly or just stop, but don't say “bei-ke” with an extra vowel. It rhymes with black and snack.

examples.en: Please sit in the back of the bus.
examples.zh: 請坐在公車的後面。

examples.en: I'll be back in five minutes.
examples.zh: 我五分鐘後回來。

bad.tip_zh: bad 和 bed 最容易搞混：bad 的 [æ] 嘴巴要張得更大，下巴往下，嘴角往兩邊拉；bed 的 [ɛ] 開得比較小。字尾 [d] 有聲，前面的母音因此會稍微拉長一點，不要唸成短促的 [t]，也不要加成「貝的」。它和 sad、glad 押韻，可以三個字一起練。
bad.tip_en: bad and bed are the easiest pair to mix up: the [æ] in bad opens the mouth wider, jaw down and corners stretched, while the [ɛ] in bed is smaller. The final [d] is voiced, so the vowel before it is a little longer; don't cut it short as [t], and don't add a vowel like “bei-de”. It rhymes with sad and glad, so practise all three together.

examples.en: Don't worry, it's not that bad.
examples.zh: 別擔心，沒有那麼糟。

examples.en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果對牙齒不好。

badminton.tip_zh: 學生常把開頭唸成 [bɛd] 或 [bɑd]，其實 badminton 的開頭就是 bad [bæd]，嘴巴張大，[d] 也要保留。重音只在第一音節，[mɪn] 輕輕帶過。結尾 [tṇ] 不要唸成像「頓」的 [tən] 或 [tɑn]：舌尖頂住上排牙齦發 [t] 後不放開，直接讓氣從鼻子出來發 [ṇ]。
badminton.tip_en: Learners often start the word with [bɛd] or [bɑd], but badminton begins exactly like bad [bæd]: open the mouth wide and keep the [d]. Only the first syllable is stressed; [mɪn] is passed over lightly. Don't end with a [tən] or [tɑn] like 頓: put the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [t], keep it there, and let the air out through the nose for [ṇ].

examples.en: We play badminton in the park on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我們星期天在公園打羽毛球。

examples.en: My sister is really good at badminton.
examples.zh: 我姊姊羽毛球打得很好。

bag.tip_zh: bag 的字尾是有聲的 [g]，喉嚨要震動，常被唸成無聲的 [k]，聽起來就變成 back。[æ] 嘴巴要張大，否則會和 big [ɪ]、bug [ʌ] 混在一起。[g] 是舌根頂住軟顎後放開，而母音在有聲子音前會稍微拉長，所以 bag 的 [æ] 比 back 的長一點，最後也不要加成「格」。
bag.tip_en: bag ends in a voiced [g], with the throat buzzing; it is often said as a voiceless [k], which turns it into back. Open wide for [æ], or it blurs with big [ɪ] and bug [ʌ]. [g] is the back of the tongue pressing the soft palate and releasing, and vowels get a little longer before voiced consonants, so the [æ] in bag is slightly longer than in back. Don't add a “ge” vowel at the end.

examples.en: Put your books in your school bag.
examples.zh: 把書放進你的書包裡。

examples.en: This bag is too heavy for me.
examples.zh: 這個袋子對我來說太重了。

bake.tip_zh: bake 的 a 唸 [e]，要從「欸」滑向「伊」，嘴角慢慢拉開；常見錯誤是唸成又短又開的 [æ]，就變成 back。字尾 e 不發音，[k] 只用舌根頂住軟顎停住，不要唸成「貝克」多出一個母音。它和 cake、make、take 押韻，可以用 bake a cake 這個片語一起練。
bake.tip_en: The a in bake says [e], gliding from “eh” toward “ee” as the lips spread; a common mistake is a short, open [æ], which turns it into back. The final e is silent, and [k] just stops with the back of the tongue against the soft palate, without an extra vowel like “bei-ke”. It rhymes with cake, make and take; practise with the phrase bake a cake.

examples.en: Let's bake cookies this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們今天下午來烤餅乾吧。

examples.en: My dad likes to bake bread on weekends.
examples.zh: 我爸爸週末喜歡烤麵包。

bake.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，讓 a 唸 [e]
bake.spelling_en: The final e is silent and makes the a say [e].

bakery.tip_zh: bakery 就是 bake 加上 -ry，第一音節和 bake 一樣是 [be]，學生卻常唸成短促的 [bɛ]。[e] 是會滑動的母音，嘴型從 [e] 微微滑向 [ɪ]，嘴角往兩邊拉。重音在 [ˈbe]；後面的 [kərɪ] 要輕：[kə] 輕輕帶過，再把舌頭往後捲，唸短短的 [rɪ]。
bakery.tip_en: Bakery is just bake plus -ry; the first syllable is [be], the same as in bake, but learners often say a short [bɛ]. [e] is a gliding vowel: the mouth moves slightly from [e] toward [ɪ], with the lip corners pulled back. The stress is on [ˈbe]; keep the following [kərɪ] light: pass over [kə] quickly, then curl the tongue back for a short [rɪ].

examples.en: The bakery near my school sells yummy bread.
examples.zh: 我學校附近的麵包店賣好吃的麵包。

examples.en: Let's buy a birthday cake at the bakery.
examples.zh: 我們去麵包店買生日蛋糕吧。

bakery.variant_zh: 說快時常縮成兩個音節 [ˈbekrɪ]。
bakery.variant_en: In fast speech it often shrinks to two syllables, [ˈbekrɪ].

balcony.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [bæl]，不是 bal-CO-ny。[æ] 嘴巴要張大、嘴角往兩旁拉，不要唸成 [ɛ]。學生常把 [l] 吞掉，聽起來像 back-ony；唸完 [æ] 後，舌尖要先頂住上排牙齒後方的牙齦，停一下再接 [k]。後面的 [kə] 和 [nɪ] 都輕輕帶過，不要每個音節一樣重。
balcony.tip_en: The stress is on the first syllable [bæl], not bal-CO-ny. For [æ], open the mouth wide and pull the lip corners sideways; don't say [ɛ]. Students often swallow the [l], so it sounds like 'back-ony'; after [æ], press the tongue tip on the gum ridge behind the upper teeth, hold it briefly, then go to [k]. The following [kə] and [nɪ] are both said lightly — don't make every syllable equally strong.

examples.en: Grandma grows flowers on her balcony.
examples.zh: 奶奶在她的陽台上種花。

examples.en: Our cat likes to sleep on the balcony.
examples.zh: 我們家的貓喜歡在陽台上睡覺。

banana.tip_zh: 重音在中間的 [næ]，不是第一個音節。學生常唸成三個一樣重、嘴巴都張很大的「巴娜娜」。正確唸法：頭尾兩個 [ə] 都很短，嘴巴放鬆、幾乎不用力；中間的 [næ] 唸得又長又響，嘴巴張大、嘴角往兩旁拉。可以邊拍手邊練習：小、大、小。
banana.tip_en: The stress is on the middle [næ], not the first syllable. Students often say 'ba-na-na' with three equally strong, wide-open syllables. The right way: the [ə] at the start and at the end are both very short, with a relaxed mouth and almost no effort; the middle [næ] is long and loud, with the mouth wide open and the lip corners pulled sideways. Practice while clapping: small, BIG, small.

examples.en: I eat a banana with my breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃早餐時都會配一根香蕉。

examples.en: The monkey is holding a yellow banana.
examples.zh: 那隻猴子拿著一根黃色的香蕉。

band.tip_zh: band 的字尾 [nd] 兩個子音都要有：舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方發 [n]，舌頭不動，把鼻音停掉就成了 [d]。常見錯誤是只唸到 [n]，聽起來像 ban，或在最後多加「的」。[æ] 嘴巴要張開，嘴角往兩邊拉，不要唸成「班」那樣較窄的母音。它和 hand、stand 押韻。
band.tip_en: band needs both final consonants [nd]: press the tongue tip behind the upper teeth for [n], keep it still, and stop the nasal sound to get [d]. Common mistakes are stopping at [n], so it sounds like ban, or adding a “de” at the end. Open the mouth with the corners stretched for [æ], not the narrower vowel of Mandarin 班. It rhymes with hand and stand.

examples.en: My brother plays drums in a band.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在樂團裡打鼓。

examples.en: The school band played a happy song.
examples.zh: 學校樂隊演奏了一首快樂的歌。

bank.tip_zh: bank 的 n 在 [k] 前面要唸成 [ŋ]，也就是舌根抬起頂住軟顎發鼻音，不是用舌尖的 [n]。舌根頂好之後不用移動，直接把鼻音停住就成了 [k]，最後不要多唸一個「克」。[æ] 要嘴巴張大。它和 thank、blank 押韻，練 thank 時用到的舌根動作，也適用於 bank。
bank.tip_en: In bank, the n before [k] is said [ŋ]: the back of the tongue rises against the soft palate for a nasal sound, rather than using the tongue tip for [n]. Once the tongue is in place it doesn't move; just stop the nasal sound and you have [k], with no extra “ke”. Open wide for [æ]. It rhymes with thank and blank, and the same back-of-tongue move used in thank works for bank.

examples.en: Mom went to the bank to get some money.
examples.zh: 媽媽去銀行領錢。

examples.en: I keep my coins in a piggy bank.
examples.zh: 我把硬幣存在小豬撲滿裡。

bank.spelling_en: The n before k is said [ŋ].

baseball.tip_zh: baseball 由 base 和 ball 組成，中間的 [s] 和 [b] 連在一起時，不要多加母音變成「貝斯-波」。base 的 [e] 要從「欸」滑向「伊」，而且 [s] 是無聲的，不要唸成 [z]。後半 [bɔl] 嘴巴張開唸 [ɔ]，結尾的暗 [l] 要舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方、舌根抬起，常見錯誤是唸成「波」，[l] 不見了。
baseball.tip_en: baseball is made of base and ball. Where [s] meets [b], add no vowel, avoiding “bei-s-bo”. The [e] in base glides from “eh” toward “ee”, and its [s] is voiceless, not [z]. In the second half [bɔl], open the mouth for [ɔ]; the final dark [l] needs the tongue tip behind the upper teeth with the back of the tongue raised. A common mistake is saying just “bo”, with the [l] gone.

examples.en: We play baseball after school on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我們星期五放學後打棒球。

examples.en: My favorite sport to watch is baseball.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡看的運動是棒球。

baseball.kk_flag: Given KK ˌbesˈbɔl puts primary stress on 'ball'; as a compound noun, General American baseball is stressed on the first syllable: ˈbesˌbɔl. Tip avoids any stress claim.

basket.tip_zh: basket 的重音在第一音節 [bæs]，嘴巴張大唸 [æ]，不要唸成「巴」那樣的 [ɑ]。[s] 和 [k] 中間不加母音，[s] 吹完氣，舌根馬上頂住軟顎。第二音節 [kət] 很輕，母音短到幾乎聽不見，不要唸成清楚的「凱特」。結尾 [t] 只擋住氣就好。
basket.tip_en: basket is stressed on the first syllable [bæs], with a wide-open [æ], not the [ɑ] of Mandarin 巴. No vowel goes between [s] and [k]: right after the [s] hiss, the back of the tongue presses the soft palate. The second syllable [kət] is very light, its vowel so short it is barely heard; don't say a clear “kai-te”. The final [t] just blocks the air.

examples.en: There are three apples in the basket.
examples.zh: 籃子裡有三顆蘋果。

examples.en: Please put the dirty clothes in the basket.
examples.zh: 請把髒衣服放進籃子裡。

basketball.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [bæs]，[æ] 嘴巴張大，不要唸成 [ɛ]。中間 [kət] 的 [t] 後面緊接著 [b]，舌尖頂住牙齦就好，不要多唸出一個「特」。最後的 [bɔl] 學生常只唸成「波」，把 [l] 漏掉；唸完 [ɔ] 舌尖要往上頂住上排牙齦，這個字才算唸完。
basketball.tip_en: The stress is on the first syllable [bæs]; open the mouth wide for [æ] and don't say [ɛ]. In the middle part [kət], the [t] is followed right away by [b]: just press the tongue tip on the gum ridge, without adding an extra 'tuh'. Students often say the last part [bɔl] as just 'bo' and leave out the [l]; after [ɔ], lift the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge — only then is the word finished.

examples.en: My brother plays basketball after school.
examples.zh: 我哥哥放學後會去打籃球。

examples.en: Can you throw the basketball to me?
examples.zh: 你可以把籃球丟給我嗎？

bat.tip_zh: bat 的母音 [æ] 嘴巴要張大，若開得太小會變成 bet，太放鬆又像 but [ʌ]。字尾 [t] 只用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方擋住氣，不必爆開，更不要加成「貝特」。和 bite [aɪ]、boat [o] 也要分清楚，這幾個字只差中間的母音。它和 cat、hat 押韻。
bat.tip_en: The [æ] in bat needs a wide-open mouth: too small and it becomes bet, too relaxed and it sounds like but [ʌ]. The final [t] just blocks the air with the tongue tip behind the upper teeth; it needn't burst, and don't add a vowel like “bei-te”. Keep it apart from bite [aɪ] and boat [o] too: these words differ only in the vowel. It rhymes with cat and hat.

examples.en: A bat sleeps upside down during the day.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠白天倒掛著睡覺。

examples.en: He swung the baseball bat and hit the ball.
examples.zh: 他揮動球棒，擊中了球。

bath.tip_zh: 字尾的 [θ] 是這個字最難的地方。學生常唸成 [s]，變成 [bæs]，或唸成 [f]。中文沒有這個音：舌尖輕輕伸到上下牙齒中間，用力吹氣，喉嚨不震動。前面的 [æ] 嘴巴要張大，不然聽起來會像人名 Beth。唸完 [θ] 就停，不要再多加一個母音。
bath.tip_en: The final [θ] is the hardest part of this word. Students often say [s], making it [bæs], or say [f]. Mandarin has no such sound: put the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth and blow air, with no vibration in the throat. Open the mouth wide for the [æ] before it, or it will sound like the name Beth. Stop right after [θ] — don't add another vowel.

examples.en: I take a bath before I go to bed.
examples.zh: 我睡覺前會洗澡。

examples.en: Our dog doesn't like to take a bath.
examples.zh: 我們家的狗不喜歡洗澡。

bathroom.tip_zh: 難點在中間 [θ] 緊接著 [r]。學生常把 [θ] 唸成 [s] 或 [f]，或在兩個音中間多加一個母音。練法：先把舌尖放在上下牙齒之間吹氣發 [θ]，再把舌頭往後縮、舌尖捲起來接 [r]，中間不要停頓。第一音節 [bæ] 是重音，嘴巴要張大。
bathroom.tip_en: The hard part is the [θ] followed right away by [r] in the middle. Students often turn [θ] into [s] or [f], or add an extra vowel between the two sounds. Practice: put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and blow air for [θ], then pull the tongue back and curl the tip up for [r], without pausing in between. The first syllable [bæ] carries the stress — open the mouth wide.

examples.en: Please wash your hands in the bathroom before dinner.
examples.zh: 吃晚餐前請先去浴室洗手。

examples.en: Mom is cleaning the bathroom this morning.
examples.zh: 媽媽今天早上在打掃浴室。

bathroom.variant_zh: room 也常唸成短一點的 [rʊm]，[ˈbæθrʊm] 一樣正確。
bathroom.variant_en: room is also often said with the shorter [rʊm]; [ˈbæθrʊm] is just as correct.

be.tip_zh: be 和 bee 唸法完全一樣，都是 [bi]：雙唇閉緊後放開發有聲的 [b]，再把嘴角往兩邊拉成 [i]。要小心別唸成 by [baɪ]，兩者差在母音：[i] 從頭到尾嘴形不變，[aɪ] 則從張大嘴滑到「伊」。在句子裡 be 常輕輕帶過，例如 will be、can be，母音會變短。
be.tip_en: be sounds exactly like bee: both are [bi]. Close the lips, release them for a voiced [b], then spread the lips for [i]. Be careful not to say by [baɪ]; the difference is the vowel: [i] keeps the same mouth shape throughout, while [aɪ] slides from a wide-open mouth to “ee”. In sentences be is often light, as in will be and can be, and its vowel gets shorter.

examples.en: Please be quiet in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館裡請保持安靜。

examples.en: I want to be a teacher when I grow up.
examples.zh: 我長大想當老師。

beach.tip_zh: beach 的 [i] 要唸得長而緊，嘴角往兩邊拉；如果唸成短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，就不是 beach 了，所以這個母音要拉長、唸飽滿。字尾 [tʃ] 嘴唇微微往前嘟，舌面頂住上顎後放開，只送出一小口氣就結束，不要加成「去」。它和 peach、teach 押韻。
beach.tip_en: The [i] in beach must be long and tense, with the lips spread; if it becomes the short, relaxed [ɪ], it no longer sounds like beach, so stretch this vowel and say it fully. For the final [tʃ], push the lips slightly forward, press the front of the tongue to the roof of the mouth and release it with a small puff of air, then stop; don't add a “chu” vowel. It rhymes with peach and teach.

examples.en: We built a sandcastle at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海灘上堆了一座沙堡。

examples.en: Let's go to the beach this summer.
examples.zh: 我們今年夏天去海邊吧。

bean.tip_zh: bean 的 [i] 要拉長、嘴角往兩邊拉，若唸成短的 [ɪ] 就變成 bin（垃圾桶）。字尾 [n] 用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方收住，常見錯誤是舌根往後抬成 [ŋ]，像中文「冰」的尾音。最後不要再加母音。它和 green、clean 押韻，可以一起練長 [i] 加 [n]。
bean.tip_en: The [i] in bean is long, with the lips spread; if it becomes the short [ɪ], the word turns into bin (a trash can). The final [n] closes with the tongue tip behind the upper teeth; a common mistake is raising the back of the tongue to [ŋ], like the ending of Mandarin 冰. Don't add a vowel at the end. It rhymes with green and clean, good for practising long [i] plus [n].

examples.en: I planted a bean in a paper cup.
examples.zh: 我在紙杯裡種了一顆豆子。

examples.en: Grandma makes sweet red bean soup.
examples.zh: 奶奶會煮甜甜的紅豆湯。

bear.tip_zh: bear 的 ear 不唸 [ɪr]，而是 [ɛr]，和 air、hair、chair 押韻；照拼字唸成 [bɪr] 就變成 beer（啤酒）。[b] 放開後嘴巴半開唸 bed 的 [ɛ]，再把舌頭往後捲成 [r]，整個字只有一拍，不要拆成「貝-兒」。分辨 bear 和 beer 的關鍵在開頭嘴巴開多大：[ɛ] 比 [ɪ] 開得大。pear、wear 也是同樣的拼法和唸法。
bear.tip_en: The ear in bear is not [ɪr] but [ɛr], rhyming with air, hair and chair; reading it from the spelling as [bɪr] turns it into beer. After releasing [b], half-open the mouth for the [ɛ] of bed, then curl the tongue back into [r]. The whole word is one beat; don't split it into “bei-er”. The key to telling bear from beer is how wide the mouth opens at the start: [ɛ] is more open than [ɪ]. pear and wear share this spelling and sound.

examples.en: We saw a big brown bear at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻大棕熊。

examples.en: My teddy bear sleeps next to me.
examples.zh: 我的泰迪熊睡在我旁邊。

bear.spelling_zh: ear 唸 [ɛr]，不是 ear 這個字的 [ɪr]
bear.spelling_en: The ear here says [ɛr], not the [ɪr] of the word ear.

beautiful.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [bju]，記得 [b] 後面有 [j]，不是 [bu]。中間的 [t] 美國人常唸成很快的輕 d 音，舌尖在牙齦上輕彈一下就好，不要唸成重重的「特」。最後的 [fḷ] 學生常唸成「佛」，把 [l] 漏掉：上排牙齒碰下唇發 [f]，接著舌尖往上頂住牙齦，中間不要另外加母音。
beautiful.tip_en: The stress is on the first syllable [bju]; remember there is a [j] after [b] — it's not [bu]. Americans often say the middle [t] as a quick, light d sound: just flick the tongue tip once on the gum ridge, not a heavy 'tuh'. Students often say the last part [fḷ] like 'fo' and drop the [l]: touch the upper teeth to the lower lip for [f], then raise the tongue tip to the gum ridge, without adding a vowel in between.

examples.en: The flowers in the park are beautiful today.
examples.zh: 今天公園裡的花好漂亮。

examples.en: My sister drew a beautiful picture of our house.
examples.zh: 我妹妹畫了一張很漂亮的圖，畫的是我們家。

because.tip_zh: because 的重音在第二音節 [kɔz]，第一個 [bɪ] 短而輕。au 唸嘴巴張開的 [ɔ]，不要唸成嘴唇圓圓的 [o]，變成「逼摳斯」。字尾的 s 是有聲的 [z]，喉嚨要繼續震動，常見錯誤是唸成無聲的 [s]。練習時可以把最後的 [z] 拉長一點，像蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲。
because.tip_en: because is stressed on the second syllable [kɔz]; the first part [bɪ] is short and light. The au is the open [ɔ], not the rounded [o] that makes it sound like “bi-kou-s”. The final s is a voiced [z], with the throat still buzzing; a common mistake is a voiceless [s]. When practising, stretch the final [z] a little, like a bee's buzz.

examples.en: I'm happy because it's Friday.
examples.zh: 我很開心，因為今天是星期五。

examples.en: We stayed inside because it was raining.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，我們待在室內。

because.variant_zh: 口語常說 [bɪˈkʌz] 或更輕的 [bɪkəz]
because.variant_en: In speech it is often [bɪˈkʌz] or a lighter [bɪkəz].

become.tip_zh: become 的 o 不唸 [o]，第二音節 [kʌm] 和 come 完全一樣，母音是短而放鬆的 [ʌ]。重音在 [kʌm]，前面的 [bɪ] 輕輕帶過。字尾 e 不發音，最後雙唇閉上發 [m] 就結束，常見錯誤是閉唇後又多出一個母音，或嘴唇沒有合起來。它和 come、some 押韻。
become.tip_en: The o in become is not [o]; the second syllable [kʌm] is exactly like come, with the short, relaxed [ʌ]. The stress is on [kʌm], and [bɪ] before it is light. The final e is silent; close the lips for [m] and stop. Common mistakes are adding a vowel after closing the lips, or not closing them at all. It rhymes with come and some.

examples.en: Little tadpoles become frogs in spring.
examples.zh: 小蝌蚪在春天變成青蛙。

examples.en: I want to become a doctor someday.
examples.zh: 我將來想成為醫生。

become.spelling_zh: o 唸 [ʌ]，字尾 e 不發音（和 come 一樣）
become.spelling_en: The o says [ʌ] and the final e is silent, like come.

bed.tip_zh: [ɛ] 嘴巴半開，比 [e] 張大一點、比 [æ] 小一點；張太大就會變成 bad。字尾的 [d] 是另一個難點：中文沒有子音結尾，學生常把它吞掉，或多唸成「貝德」。唸完 [ɛ] 後舌尖頂住上排牙齦、喉嚨震動，短短收住就好。[d] 前面的 [ɛ] 可以拉長一點，才不會聽起來像 bet。
bed.tip_en: For [ɛ], the mouth is half open — a little wider than [e] and a little smaller than [æ]; open too wide and it becomes 'bad'. The final [d] is the other hard part: Mandarin has no consonant endings, so students often swallow it, or add a vowel and say 'beh-duh'. After [ɛ], press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge with the throat vibrating, and close it off short. The [ɛ] before [d] can be a little longer, so it doesn't sound like 'bet'.

examples.en: It's nine o'clock, time for bed!
examples.zh: 九點了，該上床睡覺囉！

examples.en: I make my bed every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都會整理床鋪。

bedroom.tip_zh: bedroom 由 bed 和 room 組成，重音在第一音節。中間的 [d] 和 [r] 連在一起時，不要多加母音變成「貝得-入姆」，也不要把 [d] 吞掉；舌尖碰一下齒齦後就往後捲成 [r]。bed 的 [ɛ] 要短，room 的 [u] 嘴唇收圓、拉長，最後閉唇發 [m]。
bedroom.tip_en: bedroom is made of bed and room, stressed on the first syllable. Where [d] meets [r], don't add a vowel (“bei-de-ru-mu”) and don't swallow the [d]: the tongue tip taps the ridge and then curls back into [r]. The [ɛ] of bed is short; the [u] of room has rounded lips and is long, ending with closed lips for [m].

examples.en: My bedroom is next to the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我的臥室在浴室旁邊。

examples.en: Please clean your bedroom before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前請整理好你的房間。

bedroom.variant_en: The room part is also often [rʊm]: [ˈbɛdˌrʊm].

bee.tip_zh: bee 的 ee 唸長而緊的 [i]，嘴角往兩邊拉，像在微笑，和 be 的唸法完全一樣。常見錯誤有兩種：一是母音太短太鬆，變成 [ɪ]；二是嘴形在結尾滑開，聽起來像 buy [baɪ]。唸 [bi] 時從頭到尾嘴形不動。片語 busy bee、honey bee 可以拿來練習。
bee.tip_en: The ee in bee is a long, tense [i], lips spread as if smiling; it sounds exactly like be. There are two common mistakes: a vowel that is too short and loose, becoming [ɪ], or a mouth that slides open at the end, so it sounds like buy [baɪ]. Keep the mouth shape still throughout [bi]. Practise with the phrases busy bee and honey bee.

examples.en: A bee is flying around the flowers.
examples.zh: 一隻蜜蜂在花朵旁邊飛來飛去。

examples.en: The bee makes honey in its hive.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在蜂巢裡釀蜂蜜。

beef.tip_zh: beef 的字尾 [f] 要上排牙齒輕碰下唇，讓氣從縫隙吹出來，吹完就停，不要變成「必夫」多一個母音，也不要把 [f] 省掉，否則就像 bee。前面的 [i] 要拉長，嘴角往兩邊拉。和 beach、bean 比較時，三個字的開頭一樣，只差最後一個子音：[f]、[tʃ]、[n]。
beef.tip_en: For the final [f] in beef, the upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip and air blows through the gap; then stop. Don't turn it into “bi-fu” with an extra vowel, and don't drop [f], or it sounds like bee. The [i] before it is long, with the lips spread. Compared with beach and bean, all three start the same and differ only in the last consonant: [f], [tʃ], [n].

examples.en: We had beef noodles for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐吃牛肉麵。

examples.en: Do you want beef or chicken?
examples.zh: 你要牛肉還是雞肉？

before.tip_zh: before 的重音在第二音節 [fɔr]，開頭的 [bɪ] 短而輕。[f] 要上排牙齒碰下唇吹氣，不要唸成嘴唇圓起來的「呼」。[ɔr] 先張嘴、嘴唇微圓，再把舌頭往後捲，常見錯誤是捲舌不見，變成「逼佛」。它和 for、four、door 押韻，先唸 four，再在前面加 [bɪ] 就對了。
before.tip_en: before is stressed on the second syllable [fɔr]; the opening [bɪ] is short and light. For [f], the upper teeth touch the lower lip and air blows out; don't round the lips into “hu”. For [ɔr], open the mouth with slightly rounded lips, then curl the tongue back; a common mistake is losing the curl, making “bi-fo”. It rhymes with for, four and door: say four, then add [bɪ] in front.

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
examples.zh: 吃東西前要洗手。

examples.en: I finished my homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 我在晚餐前寫完了功課。

begin.tip_zh: begin 的重音在第二音節 [gɪn]。兩個母音都是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，不要拉長成 [i]，也不要把第一音節唸成清楚的「逼」。字尾 [n] 是常見問題：舌尖要頂住上排牙齒後方收住，若舌根往後抬，就會變成 [gɪŋ]。它和 win、pin 押韻，可以先唸 win，再換成 [gɪn]。
begin.tip_en: begin is stressed on the second syllable [gɪn]. Both vowels are the short, relaxed [ɪ]; don't stretch them into [i], and don't make the first syllable a clear “bi”. The final [n] is the usual problem: the tongue tip must close behind the upper teeth; if the back of the tongue rises instead, it becomes [gɪŋ]. It rhymes with win and pin: say win first, then change it to [gɪn].

examples.en: Class will begin at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 八點開始上課。

examples.en: Let's begin with a song.
examples.zh: 我們先唱一首歌開始吧。

behind.tip_zh: behind 的 i 唸 [aɪ]，和 kind、find 押韻，不要唸成短的 [ɪ]。重音在第二音節 [haɪnd]，[h] 只是輕輕吐氣。字尾 [nd] 兩個子音都要有：舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方發 [n]，舌頭不移動，直接把鼻音停住變成 [d]。常見錯誤是省掉 [d]，或多唸一個「的」。
behind.tip_en: The i in behind says [aɪ], rhyming with kind and find; it is not the short [ɪ]. The stress is on the second syllable [haɪnd], and [h] is just a light breath. Both final consonants [nd] are needed: press the tongue tip behind the upper teeth for [n], keep it still, and stop the nasal sound to get [d]. Common mistakes are dropping [d] or adding a “de”.

examples.en: The cat is hiding behind the sofa.
examples.zh: 貓咪躲在沙發後面。

examples.en: Please stand behind the yellow line.
examples.zh: 請站在黃線後面。

believe.tip_zh: believe 的字尾 [v] 是有聲的：上排牙齒輕碰下唇，喉嚨同時震動。常見錯誤是唸成無聲的 [f]，聽起來就變成名詞 belief；或在後面多加一個母音。第二音節 [liv] 是重音，ie 唸長的 [i]，舌尖先頂住上排牙齒後方發 [l]。這個音節和 leave 的唸法一樣。
believe.tip_en: The final [v] in believe is voiced: the upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip while the throat buzzes. A common mistake is a voiceless [f], which makes it sound like the noun belief, or adding a vowel after it. The second syllable [liv] is stressed; ie says a long [i], with the tongue tip first pressing behind the upper teeth for [l]. That syllable sounds just like leave.

examples.en: I believe you can do it!
examples.zh: 我相信你做得到！

examples.en: Do you believe in Santa Claus?
examples.zh: 你相信有聖誕老公公嗎？

believe.spelling_zh: ie 唸 [i]，字尾 e 不發音
believe.spelling_en: The ie says [i], and the final e is silent.

bell.tip_zh: bell 的字尾 [l] 是暗 L，常被唸成「貝歐」，或乾脆省掉，只剩 [bɛ]。[ɛ] 嘴巴半開，接著舌尖往上頂住上排牙齒後方，舌根同時往後抬，讓聲音從舌頭兩側出來，舌尖一定要碰到。它和 tell、well、smell 押韻；和 boil、bowl 比較時，差在中間的母音。
bell.tip_en: The final [l] in bell is a dark L. It is often said like “bei-o” or dropped entirely, leaving just [bɛ]. Half-open the mouth for [ɛ], then lift the tongue tip behind the upper teeth while the back of the tongue rises, letting the sound flow around the sides; the tip must actually touch. It rhymes with tell, well and smell; compared with boil and bowl, the difference is the vowel.

examples.en: The school bell rings at noon.
examples.zh: 學校的鐘中午會響。

examples.en: Ring the bell when you get to the door.
examples.zh: 你到門口時按一下門鈴。

belong.tip_zh: belong 的重音在第二音節 [lɔŋ]，開頭的 [l] 要用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方、讓聲音從舌頭兩側流出，不要讓氣從鼻子出去而變成 [n]。[ɔ] 嘴巴張大、略圓。字尾 [ŋ] 用舌根頂住軟顎發鼻音就停，不要再彈出一個 [g]。前面加輕輕的 [bɪ]，它和 long、song 押韻。
belong.tip_en: belong is stressed on the second syllable [lɔŋ]. Its [l] uses the tongue tip behind the upper teeth with the sound flowing around the sides; don't let air go through the nose, or it becomes [n]. [ɔ] is open with slightly rounded lips. The final [ŋ] is a nasal made with the back of the tongue on the soft palate, then stop, without popping out a [g]. Add a light [bɪ] in front; it rhymes with long and song.

examples.en: These crayons belong to my sister.
examples.zh: 這些蠟筆是我妹妹的。

examples.en: Where do these books belong?
examples.zh: 這些書應該放在哪裡？

below.tip_zh: below 的 ow 唸 [o]，和 low、slow 押韻；不要和 allow 搞混，allow 的 ow 是 [aʊ]。重音在第二音節 [lo]，所以 below 唸起來就像在 low 前面加輕輕的 [bɪ]。常見錯誤是把重音放在第一音節，唸成前重後輕。[o] 結尾嘴唇要收得更圓，往 [u] 的方向滑。
below.tip_en: The ow in below says [o], rhyming with low and slow; don't mix it up with allow, where ow is [aʊ]. The stress is on the second syllable [lo], so below sounds like low with a light [bɪ] in front. A common mistake is stressing the first syllable instead. At the end of [o], round the lips more, gliding toward [u].

examples.en: Write your name below the picture.
examples.zh: 把你的名字寫在圖片下面。

examples.en: The temperature fell below ten degrees.
examples.zh: 氣溫降到十度以下。

belt.tip_zh: belt 的難點在字尾 [lt]：唸完 [ɛ] 後，舌尖要先頂住上排牙齒後方做 [l]，舌根同時抬起，接著在同一個位置擋住氣變成 [t]。常見錯誤是省掉 [l]，聽起來就變成 bet；或唸成「貝歐特」多出音節。舌尖從 [l] 到 [t] 幾乎不用移動，只差有沒有把氣擋住。
belt.tip_en: The hard part of belt is the final [lt]: after [ɛ], the tongue tip presses behind the upper teeth for [l] with the back of the tongue raised, then blocks the air in the same spot for [t]. Common mistakes are dropping [l], so it sounds like bet, or saying “bei-o-te” with an extra syllable. The tongue tip barely moves from [l] to [t]; the only change is blocking the air.

examples.en: Don't forget to wear your seat belt.
examples.zh: 別忘了繫安全帶。

examples.en: Dad bought a new brown belt.
examples.zh: 爸爸買了一條新的咖啡色皮帶。

bench.tip_zh: bench 的 e 唸 [ɛ]，嘴巴半開，不要張太大變成 [æ]。字尾 [ntʃ] 是先用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方發 [n]，舌頭再往後一點、嘴唇微嘟放出 [tʃ]。常見錯誤是省掉 [n]，或在最後多加一個母音，唸成「班去」。結尾只送出一小口氣就停。
bench.tip_en: The e in bench says [ɛ], mouth half open; don't open so wide that it becomes [æ]. For the final [ntʃ], first press the tongue tip behind the upper teeth for [n], then move the tongue slightly back and push the lips forward a little to release [tʃ]. Common mistakes are dropping [n] or adding a vowel at the end, like “ban-chu”. Finish with just a small puff of air.

examples.en: Let's sit on the bench and eat lunch.
examples.zh: 我們坐在長椅上吃午餐吧。

examples.en: There is a bench under the big tree.
examples.zh: 大樹下有一張長椅。

beside.tip_zh: beside 的重音在第二音節 [saɪd]，s 唸無聲的 [s]，不要唸成 [z]。[aɪ] 從張大嘴的「啊」滑到「伊」，最後舌尖頂住齒齦停在 [d]，不要加成「的」。它和 side、ride 押韻，等於在 side 前面加輕輕的 [bɪ]。注意 beside 是「在旁邊」，多一個 s 的 besides 意思是「此外」。
beside.tip_en: beside is stressed on the second syllable [saɪd], and its s is a voiceless [s], not [z]. [aɪ] slides from an open “ah” to “ee”, ending with the tongue tip stopped on the ridge for [d], without adding “de”. It rhymes with side and ride: it is side with a light [bɪ] in front. Note that beside means “next to”, while besides, with an extra s, means “in addition”.

examples.en: Come and sit beside me.
examples.zh: 過來坐在我旁邊。

examples.en: The lamp is beside the bed.
examples.zh: 檯燈在床的旁邊。

between.tip_zh: between 的重音在第二音節 [twin]，[t] 和 [w] 要黏在一起：唸 [t] 的同時嘴唇就已經嘟圓準備 [w]，中間不要多出母音變成「逼-特-威恩」。[i] 拉長，嘴角往兩邊拉。字尾 [n] 用舌尖收住，不要變成 [ŋ]。它和 green、queen 押韻。
between.tip_en: between is stressed on the second syllable [twin], and [t] and [w] are stuck together: while saying [t], the lips are already rounded for [w], with no vowel in between (“bi-te-wei-en”). Stretch [i] with the lips spread. The final [n] closes with the tongue tip, not [ŋ]. It rhymes with green and queen.

examples.en: The bank is between the bakery and the park.
examples.zh: 銀行在麵包店和公園之間。

examples.en: Don't eat snacks between meals.
examples.zh: 兩餐之間不要吃零食。

bicycle.tip_zh: 學生知道 cycle 唸 [saɪ]，就把第二音節也唸成 [saɪ]，甚至把重音移到後面。其實 bicycle 只有第一音節 [baɪ] 是重音，第二音節是短短的 [sɪ]，嘴巴不要再張開滑成 [aɪ]。最後的 [kḷ] 不要唸成「扣」：舌根發完 [k] 後，舌尖直接往上頂住牙齦接 [l]。
bicycle.tip_en: Students know 'cycle' is said with [saɪ], so they say the second syllable as [saɪ] too, and even move the stress back. In fact, only the first syllable [baɪ] of bicycle is stressed; the second syllable is a short [sɪ] — don't open the mouth again and glide into [aɪ]. Don't say the last part [kḷ] like 'ko': after the back of the tongue makes [k], raise the tongue tip straight to the gum ridge for [l].

examples.en: I ride my bicycle to school.
examples.zh: 我騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: Dad bought me a new red bicycle.
examples.zh: 爸爸買了一台新的紅色腳踏車給我。

bicycle.spelling_zh: 中間的 cy 唸短的 [sɪ]，跟 cycle 的 [saɪ] 不一樣。
bicycle.spelling_en: The cy in the middle is a short [sɪ], not the [saɪ] of 'cycle'.

big.tip_zh: big 的 [ɪ] 短而放鬆，嘴巴比 [i] 開一點，常見錯誤是唸成長而緊、嘴角拉很開的 [i]。字尾 [g] 有聲，舌根頂住軟顎、喉嚨震動，不要唸成 [k]，也不要加成「格」。和 bag [æ]、bug [ʌ] 比較，三個字只差中間的母音。它和 pig、dig 押韻。
big.tip_en: The [ɪ] in big is short and relaxed, with the mouth a little more open than for [i]; a common mistake is a long, tense [i] with the lips stretched wide. The final [g] is voiced: the back of the tongue presses the soft palate while the throat buzzes. Don't say [k], and don't add a “ge”. Compared with bag [æ] and bug [ʌ], the three words differ only in the vowel. It rhymes with pig and dig.

examples.en: An elephant is a very big animal.
examples.zh: 大象是一種很大的動物。

examples.en: We have a big garden behind our house.
examples.zh: 我們家後面有一個大花園。

bird.tip_zh: [ɝ] 是整個母音都要捲舌的音，學生常唸成「伯」，或只發 [ə] 沒捲舌，聽起來像 bud。練法：舌尖往上捲但不碰到上顎，嘴唇微微噘起，[b] 一放開就開始捲舌，一直維持到最後。字尾的 [d] 要收住，舌尖頂住牙齦，不要變成「伯德」。可以和 bed、bad 對照練習。
bird.tip_en: [ɝ] is a vowel with the tongue curled the whole way through. Students often say it like 'bo', or just say [ə] without curling, so it sounds like 'bud'. Practice: curl the tongue tip up without touching the roof of the mouth and round the lips slightly; start curling the moment [b] opens and hold it to the end. Close off the final [d] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge — don't make it 'bo-duh'. Practice it against 'bed' and 'bad'.

examples.en: A little bird is singing in the tree.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥在樹上唱歌。

examples.en: Look! That bird has blue feathers.
examples.zh: 你看！那隻鳥有藍色的羽毛。

birthday.tip_zh: 第一音節 [bɝθ] 連著兩個難音：先捲舌的 [ɝ]，再把舌尖伸到上下牙齒中間吹氣發 [θ]。學生常把 [θ] 唸成 [s] 或 [f]，變成 burs-day，或者根本沒有捲舌。練法：捲舌唸 [ɝ]，接著舌頭往前伸出牙齒，再把舌尖收回頂住牙齦接 [d]。第二音節 [de] 是次重音，母音要唸完整。
birthday.tip_en: The first syllable [bɝθ] has two hard sounds in a row: first the curled [ɝ], then the tongue tip out between the teeth, blowing air for [θ]. Students often turn [θ] into [s] or [f], making it 'burs-day', or don't curl the tongue at all. Practice: curl for [ɝ], then push the tongue forward past the teeth, then pull the tip back onto the gum ridge for [d]. The second syllable [de] has secondary stress, so say its vowel fully.

examples.en: Today is my best friend's birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是我最好的朋友的生日。

examples.en: We made a card for Mom's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們為媽媽的生日做了一張卡片。

bite.tip_zh: bite 的 i 唸 [aɪ]，要從張大嘴的「啊」滑到「伊」，字尾 e 不發音。常見錯誤是唸成短的 [ɪ]，就變成 bit；或嘴巴張不夠大。字尾 [t] 只用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方擋住氣，不要唸成「拜特」多一拍。它和 kite、night、light 押韻。
bite.tip_en: The i in bite says [aɪ], sliding from an open “ah” to “ee”, and the final e is silent. Common mistakes are the short [ɪ], which turns it into bit, or not opening the mouth enough. The final [t] just blocks the air with the tongue tip behind the upper teeth; don't say “bai-te” with an extra beat. It rhymes with kite, night and light.

examples.en: Can I have a bite of your sandwich?
examples.zh: 我可以咬一口你的三明治嗎？

examples.en: Don't bite your nails.
examples.zh: 不要咬指甲。

bite.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，讓 i 唸 [aɪ]
bite.spelling_en: The final e is silent and makes the i say [aɪ].

black.tip_zh: black 開頭的 [b] 和 [l] 要黏在一起：雙唇放開時，舌尖已經頂在上排牙齒後方準備 [l]，不要唸成「布-萊克」多出一拍。中間的 [æ] 嘴巴張大、嘴角往兩邊拉；若唸成 [ɑ] 就變成 block。字尾 [k] 輕輕停住。它和 back、snack 押韻，只是多了一個 [l]。
black.tip_en: In black, the opening [b] and [l] are stuck together: as the lips release, the tongue tip is already behind the upper teeth for [l]; don't add a beat like “bu-lai-ke”. The [æ] in the middle has a wide mouth with the corners stretched; if it becomes [ɑ], the word turns into block. The final [k] stops lightly. It rhymes with back and snack, just with an added [l].

examples.en: My cat has black and white fur.
examples.zh: 我的貓有黑白相間的毛。

examples.en: She is wearing black shoes today.
examples.zh: 她今天穿黑色的鞋子。

blackboard.tip_zh: 開頭的 [bl] 中間不能加母音，學生常唸成「布萊克」；嘴唇閉起來發 [b] 的時候，舌尖就要先頂好牙齦，一放開就是 [l]。[æ] 嘴巴要張大。[k] 後面直接接 [b]，舌根把氣堵住就好，不必放出聲音。結尾的 [rd] 先捲舌，再讓舌尖頂住牙齦，不要只唸到「波」就停。
blackboard.tip_en: No vowel may go between the [b] and [l] at the start; students often say 'buh-lack'. While the lips close for [b], the tongue tip should already be on the gum ridge, so the release goes straight into [l]. Open the mouth wide for [æ]. The [k] is followed directly by [b]: just block the air with the back of the tongue, without releasing a sound. For the final [rd], curl the tongue first, then put the tip on the gum ridge — don't stop at 'bo'.

examples.en: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師把日期寫在黑板上。

examples.en: Can I help clean the blackboard?
examples.zh: 我可以幫忙擦黑板嗎？

blank.tip_zh: blank 有兩個子音串：開頭 [bl] 中間不加母音，結尾的 n 在 [k] 前要唸 [ŋ]。常見錯誤是把 n 唸成舌尖的 [n]，再加一個「克」。正確做法是唸完 [æ] 後，舌根直接抬起頂住軟顎，先發鼻音 [ŋ]，再在同一個位置擋住氣變成 [k]。考卷上常見的 fill in the blank 可以拿來練。
blank.tip_en: blank has two consonant clusters: no vowel inside the opening [bl], and the n before [k] at the end is said [ŋ]. A common mistake is a tongue-tip [n] followed by an extra “ke”. Instead, after [æ] raise the back of the tongue straight to the soft palate for the nasal [ŋ], then block the air in the same spot for [k]. The test instruction fill in the blank is good practice.

examples.en: Write the answer in the blank.
examples.zh: 把答案寫在空格裡。

examples.en: Fill in each blank with the correct word.
examples.zh: 在每個空格填入正確的字。

blank.spelling_en: The n before k is said [ŋ].

blanket.tip_zh: 第一音節 [blæŋ] 的 n 其實是 [ŋ]，因為後面接著 [k]：舌根往上頂住軟顎，跟 pink、thank 的鼻音一樣，不要用舌尖發 [n]。開頭的 [bl] 中間別加母音。第二音節 [kət] 很輕，結尾的 [t] 舌尖頂住牙齦就收，不要唸出「特」。重音在第一音節。
blanket.tip_en: The n in the first syllable [blæŋ] is really [ŋ], because [k] follows: raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate, the same nasal sound as in 'pink' and 'thank', instead of making [n] with the tongue tip. Don't put a vowel between [b] and [l] at the start. The second syllable [kət] is very light; close the final [t] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, without saying 'tuh'. The stress is on the first syllable.

examples.en: It's cold tonight, so I need a warm blanket.
examples.zh: 今晚很冷，所以我需要一條暖和的毯子。

examples.en: My little sister sleeps with her pink blanket.
examples.zh: 我妹妹都蓋著她的粉紅色毯子睡覺。

blanket.spelling_zh: n 在 k 前面唸 [ŋ]，不是 [n]。
blanket.spelling_en: The n before k is said [ŋ], not [n].

blind.tip_zh: blind 的 i 唸 [aɪ]，和 find、kind 押韻，不唸短的 [ɪ]。開頭 [bl] 要連在一起，不要唸成「布-賴恩的」。結尾 [nd] 常被省成只有 [n]：唸完 [n] 時舌尖已經頂在齒齦上，只要把鼻子的氣關掉，就自然出現 [d]，不必再加母音。
blind.tip_en: The i in blind says [aɪ], rhyming with find and kind, not the short [ɪ]. The opening [bl] is joined; don't say “bu-lai-en-de”. The final [nd] is often cut down to just [n]: when you finish [n], the tongue tip is already on the ridge, so simply shut off the air through the nose and [d] appears naturally, with no extra vowel.

examples.en: A guide dog helps the blind man cross the street.
examples.zh: 導盲犬幫助那位盲人過馬路。

examples.en: The blind girl reads books with her fingers.
examples.zh: 那位盲人女孩用手指讀書。

block.tip_zh: block 的 o 唸嘴巴張大的 [ɑ]，下巴往下放，像看醫生時說「啊」；常見錯誤是嘴唇圓起來唸成 [o]，聽起來像「布漏克」。和 black 比較：black 的 [æ] 嘴角往兩邊拉，block 的 [ɑ] 嘴巴往下開。字尾 ck 只唸一個 [k]，它和 clock、rock 押韻。
block.tip_en: The o in block is the wide-open [ɑ], with the jaw dropped as if saying “ah” at the doctor's; a common mistake is rounding the lips into [o], which sounds like “bu-lou-ke”. Compared with black: the [æ] of black stretches the lips sideways, while the [ɑ] of block opens the mouth downward. The final ck is a single [k]. It rhymes with clock and rock.

examples.en: We live on the same block.
examples.zh: 我們住在同一個街區。

examples.en: The baby is playing with a toy block.
examples.zh: 寶寶在玩積木。

blow.tip_zh: blow 的 ow 唸 [o]，嘴唇從半圓慢慢收得更圓，和 snow、slow 押韻，不要唸成 cow 的 [aʊ]。也要和 blue 分清楚：blue 的 [u] 嘴唇一開始就嘟得很圓很緊，blow 則是從較開的嘴形往圓唇滑動。開頭 [b] 和 [l] 連在一起，中間不加母音。
blow.tip_en: The ow in blow says [o], with the lips going from half-round to rounder, rhyming with snow and slow; it is not the [aʊ] of cow. Also keep it apart from blue: the [u] of blue starts with the lips already tightly rounded, while blow slides from a more open shape toward rounded lips. The opening [b] and [l] are joined with no vowel between them.

examples.en: Blow out the candles and make a wish!
examples.zh: 吹熄蠟燭，許個願吧！

examples.en: The wind will blow the leaves away.
examples.zh: 風會把葉子吹走。

blue.tip_zh: blue 只有一個音節，但常被唸成「布-魯」兩拍，[b] 後面多出一個母音。雙唇閉緊後放開時，舌尖要已經頂在上排牙齒後方，直接滑進 [l]，再把嘴唇嘟圓唸長的 [u]。ue 只唸 [u]，e 不另外發音。它和 true、glue、shoe 押韻。
blue.tip_en: blue has only one syllable but is often said as two beats, “bu-lu”, with an extra vowel after [b]. As the closed lips release, the tongue tip should already be behind the upper teeth, sliding straight into [l]; then round the lips for a long [u]. The ue is just [u]; the e is not said separately. It rhymes with true, glue and shoe.

examples.en: The sky is so blue today.
examples.zh: 今天的天空好藍。

examples.en: My favorite color is blue.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是藍色。

boat.tip_zh: boat 的 oa 唸 [o]，嘴唇從半圓慢慢收圓、往 [u] 滑過去，不要唸成嘴巴張開的 [ɔ]，否則會像 bought。字尾 [t] 只用舌尖頂住上排牙齒後方擋住氣，不要唸成「波特」多一拍。和 but [ʌ]、bat [æ] 比較，這幾個字也只差中間的母音。它和 coat、goat 押韻。
boat.tip_en: The oa in boat says [o]: the lips go from half-round to rounder, gliding toward [u]. Don't use the open [ɔ], or it sounds like bought. The final [t] just blocks the air with the tongue tip behind the upper teeth; don't say “bo-te” with an extra beat. Compared with but [ʌ] and bat [æ], these words also differ only in the vowel. It rhymes with coat and goat.

examples.en: We took a boat to the little island.
examples.zh: 我們搭船去那座小島。

examples.en: Grandpa likes to fish from his boat.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在他的船上釣魚。
