office.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [ɔ]，開口大、嘴唇微圓。-ice 是短而輕的 [ɪs]，不要唸成 ice [aɪs]。中間的 [f] 上齒碰下唇吹氣，學生常唸成「歐飛斯」三個一樣重的拍子；應該是前重後輕的兩個音節。
office.tip_en: Stress the first syllable [ɔ], mouth open, lips slightly rounded. The -ice is a short, light [ɪs], not ice [aɪs]. For the middle [f], top teeth touch the lower lip and blow. Learners often say 'o-fei-si', three equal beats; it should be two syllables, strong then weak.

examples.en: My mom works in an office.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在辦公室上班。

examples.en: Please go to the school office.
examples.zh: 請到學校辦公室去。

officer.tip_zh: officer 重音在第一音節 [ɔ]，嘴巴張開成圓的 [ɔ]，後面 [fə] 和 [sɚ] 都要輕。台灣學生常把 office 的部分唸成「歐飛斯」，再加上 er 變成四拍，或把重音放到 fi 上。正確是三個音節、重－輕－輕：[ɔ] 用力，[fə] 輕而短，最後 [sɚ] 舌頭往後捲，不要拆成「斯」和「兒」兩拍。
officer.tip_en: officer is stressed on the first syllable [ɔ], with the mouth open and rounded for [ɔ]; the following [fə] and [sɚ] are both weak. Taiwanese students often say the office part as 'ou-fei-si' and then add er, making four beats, or put the stress on fi. It is three syllables, strong–weak–weak: [ɔ] strong, [fə] light and short, and the final [sɚ] with the tongue curled back; don't split it into two beats like 'si' plus 'er'.

examples.en: The police officer helped us find our way.
examples.zh: 警察幫我們找到了路。

examples.en: A friendly officer stood at the school gate.
examples.zh: 一位親切的警察站在學校門口。

often.tip_zh: often 最常見的唸法是 [ˈɔfən]，t 不發音；台灣學生常照拼字把 t 用力唸出來，變成「歐夫疼」。重音在第一音節 [ɔ]，嘴巴張開成圓形。接著上齒碰下唇發 [f]，直接連到輕而短的 [ən]，中間不加母音。字尾 [n] 舌尖頂住上齒齦，不要收成 [ŋ]。
often.tip_en: The most common pronunciation of often is [ˈɔfən], with a silent t; Taiwanese students often pronounce the t hard from the spelling, making it sound like 'ou-fu-teng'. Stress the first syllable [ɔ] with an open, rounded mouth. Then touch the upper teeth to the lower lip for [f] and go straight into a light, short [ən], with no vowel in between. For the final [n], press the tongue tip to the ridge behind the upper teeth; don't end with [ŋ].

examples.en: I often ride my bike to school.
examples.zh: 我常常騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: How often do you visit your grandparents?
examples.zh: 你多久去看一次爺爺奶奶？

often.variant_zh: 也有人會唸出 t：[ˈɔftṇ]，兩種都常聽到。
often.variant_en: Some people do pronounce the t: [ˈɔftṇ]; both are common.
often.spelling_zh: 最常見的唸法中，t 不發音。
often.spelling_en: In the most common pronunciation, the t is silent.

oil.tip_zh: [ɔɪ] 從圓唇的 [ɔ] 滑到 [ɪ]，接著舌尖往上頂到上牙齦、舌根抬高，發字尾暗 L。學生常把 l 省掉，只剩 [ɔɪ]，或唸成三拍「歐伊歐」。也別只唸 all 的 [ɔ] 而忘了往 [ɪ] 滑。oil 和 boil 同韻，整個字只有一個音節，要一口氣唸完。
oil.tip_en: [ɔɪ] glides from a rounded [ɔ] to [ɪ]; then the tongue tip goes up to the gum ridge and the back of the tongue rises for the dark L. Learners often drop the l, leaving just [ɔɪ], or make it three beats ('o-yi-o'). Don't stop at the [ɔ] of all and forget the glide to [ɪ]. Oil rhymes with boil; it is one syllable, said in one go.

examples.en: Mom cooks eggs with a little oil.
examples.zh: 媽媽用一點點油煎蛋。

examples.en: Put some oil in the pan.
examples.zh: 在鍋子裡放一點油。

ok.tip_zh: OK 就是唸兩個字母 O 和 K 的名稱，重音在第二音節 [ke]；學生常把重音放在前面，或唸成平平的兩拍。[o] 嘴唇收圓並滑向 [u]，[ke] 的 k 要送氣，[e] 要往 [ɪ] 滑，句尾語調可以往下收。
ok.tip_en: OK is just the names of the letters O and K, with stress on the second syllable [ke]; learners often stress the first or say two flat, equal beats. Round the lips for [o] and glide toward [u]; give the k of [ke] a puff of air and let [e] glide toward [ɪ]. At the end of a sentence the pitch can fall.

examples.en: Is it OK if I sit here?
examples.zh: 我可以坐這裡嗎？

examples.en: Don't worry, everything is OK.
examples.zh: 別擔心，一切都沒問題。

ok.spelling_zh: 也常寫成 okay，發音相同。

old.tip_zh: [o] 嘴唇收圓並滑向 [u]，接著字尾是暗 L 加 [d]：舌尖頂上牙齦發 l 後不要離開，直接放出 d。學生常省掉 l 唸成 [od]，或丟掉 d 只剩「歐」。cold、hold 結尾都是 [old]，可以一起練。
old.tip_en: Round the lips for [o] and glide toward [u], then the ending is a dark L plus [d]: put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for l and, without lifting it, release the d. Learners often drop the l ([od]) or the d, leaving just 'o'. Cold and hold end the same way, [old]; practice them together.

examples.en: How old are you?
examples.zh: 你幾歲？

examples.en: My grandpa has an old bicycle.
examples.zh: 我爺爺有一台舊腳踏車。

on.tip_zh: on 只有一個音節 [ɑn]，下巴要放低、嘴巴張大，像看醫生時說「啊」。常見錯誤是嘴唇嘟得太圓、太緊，聽起來像 own [on]；或把字尾唸成後鼻音 [ŋ]，變成「昂」。收尾時舌尖要頂住上排牙齒後面的牙齦，讓聲音從鼻子出來，才是清楚的 [n]。
on.tip_en: on has just one syllable, [ɑn]: drop the jaw and open the mouth wide, like saying "ah" at the doctor's. A common mistake is rounding the lips too much and too tightly, so it sounds like own [on]; another is ending with the back nasal [ŋ], turning it into "ang". To finish, press the tongue tip on the gum ridge behind the upper teeth and let the sound come out through the nose — that is a clean [n].

examples.en: Your pencil is on the floor.
examples.zh: 你的鉛筆在地板上。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping on my bed.
examples.zh: 貓咪正在我的床上睡覺。

on.variant_zh: 有些美國人唸 [ɔn]，嘴唇稍微圓一點，也是對的。
on.variant_en: Some Americans say [ɔn], with slightly rounder lips; that is also correct.

once.tip_zh: once 拼字以 o 開頭，卻是從 [w] 開始：嘴唇先噘圓，再打開成短的 [ʌ]。學生常照拼字唸成 [ons] 或 [ɑns]。字尾 -ce 唸無聲 [s]，前面的 [n] 要舌尖頂上牙齦。開頭和 one 一樣是 [wʌn]。
once.tip_en: Once is spelled with o but starts with [w]: round the lips first, then open into a short [ʌ]. Learners often follow the spelling and say [ons] or [ɑns]. The -ce at the end is a voiceless [s], with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for the [n] before it. It starts just like one, [wʌn].

examples.en: I visit my grandma once a week.
examples.zh: 我每個星期去看奶奶一次。

examples.en: Once upon a time, there was a little bear.
examples.zh: 很久很久以前，有一隻小熊。

once.spelling_zh: o 開頭卻唸 [w]，和 one 一樣。
once.spelling_en: Begins with o but is said with [w], like one.

one.tip_zh: one 唸 [wʌn]，母音是短而放鬆的 [ʌ]，嘴巴半開，和 fun、run 押韻。常見錯誤是唸成「萬」，嘴巴張太大、聲調往下掉；或字尾變成後鼻音 [ŋ]，聽起來像「旺」。先把嘴唇嘟起來發 [w]，馬上放鬆成 [ʌ]，最後舌尖頂住上牙齦收 [n]。
one.tip_en: one is [wʌn]; the vowel is a short, relaxed [ʌ] with the mouth half open, and it rhymes with fun and run. A common mistake is saying it like Mandarin 萬 (wàn), with the mouth too wide and a falling tone; another is ending with the back nasal [ŋ], so it sounds like 旺 (wàng). Round the lips for [w], relax right away into [ʌ], then finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n].

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個姊姊。

examples.en: Can I have one more cookie, please?
examples.zh: 我可以再吃一塊餅乾嗎？

one.spelling_zh: one 裡沒有 w 這個字母，開頭卻要發 [w] 的音。
one.spelling_en: one has no letter w, but it starts with a [w] sound.

only.tip_zh: 第一音節 [on] 嘴唇收圓並滑向 [u]，學生常唸成短的 [ɔn]，或在 [n] 和 [l] 之間多加母音變成三拍。發完 n 舌尖不動，直接放下舌頭兩側發 l，最後的 [lɪ] 輕而短。only 和 lonely 結尾同韻。
only.tip_en: In the first syllable [on], round the lips and glide toward [u]; learners often say a short [ɔn] or add a vowel between [n] and [l], making three beats. After n, keep the tongue tip still and just drop the sides of the tongue for l; the final [lɪ] is short and light. Only rhymes with the end of lonely.

examples.en: I have only one sister.
examples.zh: 我只有一個姊姊。

examples.en: Only two students were late today.
examples.zh: 今天只有兩個學生遲到。

open.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [o]，嘴唇收圓並滑向 [u]。第二音節 [pən] 很輕，母音是弱的 [ə]；學生常唸成清楚的 [pɛn]，聽起來像 pen。字尾 [n] 舌尖頂上牙齦收住，不要變成 [ŋ]。
open.tip_en: Stress the first syllable [o], lips rounding toward [u]. The second syllable [pən] is very light with a weak [ə]; learners often say a clear [pɛn], which sounds like pen. Close the final [n] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, not [ŋ].

examples.en: Please open your books to page ten.
examples.zh: 請把書翻到第十頁。

examples.en: The library is open until five.
examples.zh: 圖書館開到五點。

or.tip_zh: or 唸 [ɔr]：先把嘴唇稍微圓起來發 [ɔ]，接著舌尖往後捲、不碰到上顎，帶出 [r]。常見錯誤是只唸「歐」就停住，少了捲舌，聽起來像 oh；也有人把 [ɔ] 唸成會滑動的 [o]。可以用押韻的 door、for、floor 一起練，每個字的結尾都要捲舌。
or.tip_en: or is [ɔr]: round the lips slightly for [ɔ], then curl the tongue tip back without touching the roof of the mouth to add [r]. A common mistake is stopping at "oh" with no curl, so it sounds like oh; some also turn [ɔ] into the gliding [o]. Practice with the rhymes door, for and floor — every one of them ends with the curl.

examples.en: Do you want milk or juice?
examples.zh: 你要牛奶還是果汁？

examples.en: Is your birthday in May or June?
examples.zh: 你的生日在五月還是六月？

or.variant_zh: 在句子中常弱讀成 [ɚ]，例如 tea or coffee。
or.variant_en: In sentences it is often reduced to [ɚ], as in "tea or coffee".

orange.tip_zh: orange 只有兩個音節，重音在第一音節 [ɔ]。常見錯誤是唸成「歐蘭吉」三個音節：第二音節開頭用了 [l]，母音唸得太飽滿，字尾 [dʒ] 後面又多加一個「ㄧ」。第二音節要用捲舌的 [r]，輕輕帶過成 [rəndʒ]；最後的 [dʒ] 嘴唇往前噘，跟 juice 開頭的音一樣，發完就停，不要再加母音。
orange.tip_en: orange has only two syllables, stressed on the first, [ɔ]. A common mistake is saying it as three syllables, like "o-lan-ji": the second syllable starts with [l], its vowel is too full, and an extra "ee" is added after the final [dʒ]. Start the second syllable with a curled [r] and keep it light, [rəndʒ]; for the final [dʒ], push the lips forward — the same sound that starts juice — and stop there, with no extra vowel.

examples.en: I eat an orange every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃一顆柳橙。

examples.en: Would you like some orange juice?
examples.zh: 你想喝點柳橙汁嗎？

orange.variant_zh: 美國東北部常唸 [ˈɑrəndʒ]，第一個母音嘴巴張得更大。
orange.variant_en: In the US Northeast it is often [ˈɑrəndʒ], with the mouth opening wider on the first vowel.

order.tip_zh: order 有兩個捲舌音：第一音節 [ɔr] 和字尾 [ɚ]，學生常兩個都省掉，唸成「歐德」。重音在 [ɔr]，嘴唇先圓再捲舌。中間的 [d] 舌尖輕快碰一下上牙齦就好，接著馬上再捲舌收在 [ɚ]。
order.tip_en: Order has two r-colored sounds, the first syllable [ɔr] and the final [ɚ]; learners often drop both and say 'o-de'. Stress [ɔr]: round the lips, then curl the tongue. For the middle [d], just tap the gum ridge quickly with the tongue tip, then curl again to finish on [ɚ].

examples.en: Are you ready to order?
examples.zh: 你準備好點餐了嗎？

examples.en: Put the numbers in order from small to big.
examples.zh: 把數字從小到大排好。

other.tip_zh: other 的重點在第二音節 [ðɚ]。常見錯誤是把 [ð] 唸成 [d] 或 [z]，變成「阿德」或「阿惹」。舌尖輕輕放在上下門牙之間，喉嚨同時要震動，再把舌頭往後捲成 [ɚ]。開頭的 o 唸短短的 [ʌ]，跟 mother、brother 的第一個母音一樣，不要唸成「歐」。
other.tip_en: The key is the second syllable, [ðɚ]. A common mistake is turning [ð] into [d] or [z], so it sounds like "a-der" or "a-zer". Rest the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower front teeth with the throat vibrating, then curl the tongue back for [ɚ]. The first o is a short [ʌ], the same as the first vowel in mother and brother — not "oh".

examples.en: Where is my other shoe?
examples.zh: 我的另一隻鞋子在哪裡？

examples.en: Some kids like cats, and other kids like dogs.
examples.zh: 有些小朋友喜歡貓，其他小朋友喜歡狗。

other.spelling_zh: 開頭的 o 在這裡唸 [ʌ]，不唸 [o]。
other.spelling_en: The first o here is said [ʌ], not [o].

out.tip_zh: [aʊ] 從大開口的 [a] 滑到圓唇的 [ʊ]，再用舌尖頂住上牙齦停住發 [t]。學生常省掉 t，或加母音唸成「凹特」兩拍。後面接母音時，美式 t 會變成輕快的彈舌音，例如 get out of 連起來說。
out.tip_en: [aʊ] glides from a wide-open [a] to rounded [ʊ]; then stop with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [t]. Learners often drop the t or add a vowel ('ao-te', two beats). Before a vowel, the American t becomes a quick flap, as when get out of is said smoothly.

examples.en: Let's go out and play.
examples.zh: 我們出去玩吧。

examples.en: The cat ran out of the room.
examples.zh: 貓跑出了房間。

outside.tip_zh: 單獨說時主重音在第二音節 [saɪd]，第一音節 [aʊt] 是次重音。[t] 碰到 [s] 時舌尖輕頂一下就滑進 [s]，學生常加母音唸成「凹特賽德」四拍。字尾 [d] 要有聲帶振動，不要唸成 [t]。
outside.tip_en: Said alone, the main stress is on the second syllable [saɪd], with secondary stress on [aʊt]. Where [t] meets [s], the tongue tip just touches lightly and slides into [s]; learners often add vowels and make four beats ('ao-te-sai-de'). The final [d] is voiced, not [t].

examples.en: Let's play outside after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後我們去外面玩吧。

examples.en: It's cold outside, so wear a coat.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，穿件外套吧。

over.tip_zh: over 常被唸成「歐佛」或「歐窩」：[v] 變成沒有聲音的 [f]，或嘴唇沒碰到牙齒，變成 [w]。發 [v] 時上排牙齒輕碰下嘴唇，喉嚨要震動，像蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲。結尾的 [ɚ] 舌頭往後捲，不要停在「佛」。開頭的 [o] 嘴唇先圓，再慢慢收小。
over.tip_en: over is often said like "o-fo" or "o-wo": [v] becomes the voiceless [f], or the lips miss the teeth and it becomes [w]. For [v], rest the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip and let the throat vibrate, like a buzzing bee. For the final [ɚ], curl the tongue back instead of stopping at "fo". For the opening [o], start with round lips and let them close a little.

examples.en: The game is over. Let's go home.
examples.zh: 比賽結束了，我們回家吧。

examples.en: Summer vacation is almost over.
examples.zh: 暑假快要結束了。

own.tip_zh: 拼字 ow 在這裡唸 [o]，不是 now 的 [aʊ]：嘴唇收圓並滑向 [u]，接著舌尖頂上牙齦收 [n]。學生常和 on [ɑn] 混淆：on 下巴往下、嘴巴張大、不圓唇；own 嘴唇要圓。字尾 n 也不要變成 [ŋ]。my own room 裡的 own 要唸清楚。
own.tip_en: Here ow is [o], not the [aʊ] of now: round the lips and glide toward [u], then close on [n] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge. Learners often confuse it with on [ɑn]: on drops the jaw and opens wide without rounding; own needs rounded lips. Don't let the final n turn into [ŋ]. Say own clearly in 'my own room'.

examples.en: I have my own room.
examples.zh: 我有自己的房間。

examples.en: She made her own birthday card.
examples.zh: 她自己做了生日卡片。

pack.tip_zh: pack 的母音是 [æ]，學生常唸成較窄的 [ɛ]，聽起來像 peck；字尾 [k] 也常多加一個母音，變成「配克」。發 [æ] 時下巴要拉低、嘴角往兩邊拉開，嘴巴比 pen 張得更大；結尾舌根頂住上顎就停，不要再送出「ㄜ」。
pack.tip_en: The vowel in pack is [æ]; students often say the narrower [ɛ], so it sounds like peck, and they add a vowel after the final [k], making it 'pei-ke'. For [æ], drop the jaw and spread the lips, opening wider than for pen; at the end, press the back of the tongue up for [k] and stop, with no extra 'uh'.

examples.en: Please pack your bag for the school trip.
examples.zh: 請為校外教學打包好你的背包。

examples.en: I bought a pack of colored pencils.
examples.zh: 我買了一盒彩色鉛筆。

package.tip_zh: package 重音在第一音節 [ˈpæk]，[æ] 下巴要拉低。第二音節是弱讀的 [ədʒ]，學生常照拼字唸成 age 的 [edʒ]，或在 [dʒ] 後面多加一個「ㄐㄧ」的母音。結尾 [dʒ] 嘴唇微微往前噘、聲帶振動，發完就收，不要拖出母音。
package.tip_en: The stress is on the first syllable [ˈpæk], with the jaw dropped for [æ]. The second syllable is a weak [ədʒ]; students often follow the spelling and say [edʒ] as in age, or add a 'ji' vowel after [dʒ]. For the final [dʒ], push the lips slightly forward with the voice on, then stop without trailing a vowel.

examples.en: A package came for you today.
examples.zh: 今天有你的包裹。

examples.en: Grandma sent us a big package of snacks.
examples.zh: 奶奶寄給我們一大包零食。

package.spelling_zh: -age 在這裡唸弱讀的 [ədʒ]，不唸 age 的 [edʒ]。
package.spelling_en: The -age here is a weak [ədʒ], not [edʒ] as in the word age.

page.tip_zh: page 的 [e] 是一個完整的雙母音，要從 [e] 滑向 [ɪ]。結尾 [dʒ] 是有聲子音，學生常在後面多加母音唸成「配基」，或把 [dʒ] 唸成沒有振動的 [tʃ]。結尾時嘴唇往前噘，喉嚨要振動，聲音一出來就停住。
page.tip_en: The [e] in page is a full glide from [e] to [ɪ]. The final [dʒ] is voiced; students often add a vowel after it, saying 'pei-ji', or turn [dʒ] into an unvoiced [tʃ]. At the end, push the lips forward, keep the throat buzzing, and stop as soon as the sound comes out.

examples.en: Please turn to page ten.
examples.zh: 請翻到第十頁。

examples.en: This page has a picture of a cat.
examples.zh: 這一頁有一張貓的圖片。

paint.tip_zh: paint 結尾是 [nt] 兩個子音：舌尖先頂住上排牙齦發 [n]，舌頭不動，直接把氣擋住收成 [t]。學生常漏掉 [n]，或在 [t] 後面加「ㄊㄜ」。也要和 point 分清楚：paint 是嘴角往兩邊拉的 [e]，point 是先圓唇的 [ɔɪ]。唸完整個字時，舌尖應該停在牙齦上。
paint.tip_en: Paint ends in two consonants, [nt]: put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], then, without moving it, block the air for [t]. Students often drop the [n] or add a 'te' after [t]. Also keep it apart from point: paint has [e] with spread lips, while point starts with rounded lips for [ɔɪ]. When you finish the word, the tongue tip should be resting on the gum ridge.

examples.en: We paint pictures in art class.
examples.zh: 我們在美術課畫圖。

examples.en: Dad bought red paint for the door.
examples.zh: 爸爸買了紅色的油漆要漆門。

pair.tip_zh: pair 只有一個音節：先發下巴半開的 [ɛ]（和 pen 的母音一樣），再把舌頭往後捲成 [r]。學生常唸成「配」加「兒」兩拍，或嘴型停在帶滑音的 [e]、沒有捲舌。練習時把 [ɛ] 和 [r] 黏在一起滑過去，和 chair、hair 押韻。pair 和 pear 唸法完全相同。
pair.tip_en: Pair has one syllable: start with [ɛ] with the jaw half open (the vowel in pen), then curl the tongue back for [r]. Students often split it into two beats, 'pei' plus 'er', or stay on a gliding [e] without curling the tongue. Slide [ɛ] straight into [r]; it rhymes with chair and hair. Pair and pear sound exactly the same.

examples.en: I need a new pair of shoes.
examples.zh: 我需要一雙新鞋。

examples.en: Please find a pair of socks in the drawer.
examples.zh: 請在抽屜裡找一雙襪子。

pants.tip_zh: pants 結尾有 [nts] 三個子音，學生最常把最後的 [s] 漏掉唸成 pant，或在中間加母音。[æ] 下巴要拉低；接著舌尖頂住牙齦發 [n]，不放開直接收成 [t]，再讓氣從舌尖的縫隙出來變成 [s]。就算只講一條長褲，pants 也一定有 s。
pants.tip_en: Pants ends in three consonants, [nts]; students most often drop the final [s] and say pant, or put a vowel in the middle. Drop the jaw for [æ], then put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], hold it to make [t], and let air hiss out past the tip for [s]. Even for one pair of trousers, pants always has the s.

examples.en: These pants are too long for me.
examples.zh: 這條褲子對我來說太長了。

examples.en: Put on your pants and shoes.
examples.zh: 穿上你的褲子和鞋子。

papaya.tip_zh: papaya 有三個音節，重音在中間的 [paɪ]。常見錯誤是照中文習慣把第一音節唸得又重又滿，變成「趴趴呀」，或把 [aɪ] 唸成單純的「ㄚ」。第一音節 [pə] 要輕而短，中間的 [paɪ] 拉長、加大聲，跟 pie 同音，最後的 [ə] 輕輕帶過就好。
papaya.tip_en: papaya has three syllables, stressed on the middle one, [paɪ]. A common mistake is giving the first syllable full weight, as in "pa-pa-ya", or flattening [aɪ] into a plain "ah". Keep the first syllable [pə] short and light, make the middle [paɪ] long and loud — it sounds just like pie — and let the final [ə] fade softly.

examples.en: Grandma cut a papaya for dessert.
examples.zh: 奶奶切了一顆木瓜當甜點。

examples.en: Papaya milk is popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 木瓜牛奶在台灣很受歡迎。

paper.tip_zh: paper 重音在第一音節 [ˈpe]，[e] 要從 [e] 滑到 [ɪ]。第二音節的 [ɚ] 是捲舌的弱母音，學生常唸成「沛波」，嘴唇圓起來發 [o]，完全沒捲舌。中間的 [p] 雙唇閉起再打開後，直接把舌頭往後捲、嘴唇放鬆，發出短短的 [ɚ] 就好。
paper.tip_en: Paper is stressed on the first syllable [ˈpe], where [e] glides to [ɪ]. The second syllable is a weak r-colored [ɚ]; students often say 'pei-bo', rounding the lips for [o] with no curl at all. After closing and opening the lips for the middle [p], curl the tongue back with relaxed lips and make a short [ɚ].

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.zh: 可以給我一張紙嗎？

examples.en: We made paper boats in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上做了紙船。

parent.tip_zh: parent 重音在第一音節 [ˈpɛ]，第二音節 [rənt] 要輕而短。學生常照拼字把後半唸成很重的 rent，變成兩個重音，或把字尾 [t] 吃掉。先把 [pɛ] 唸清楚，再快速帶過 [rənt]：舌頭捲起不碰上顎，母音弱成 [ə]，最後舌尖停在牙齦收住 [nt]。
parent.tip_en: Parent is stressed on the first syllable [ˈpɛ]; the second syllable [rənt] is light and short. Students often follow the spelling and say a heavy 'rent', giving it two stresses, or swallow the final [t]. Say [pɛ] clearly, then pass quickly over [rənt]: tongue curled without touching, vowel reduced to [ə], tongue tip resting on the gum ridge for [nt].

examples.en: Each parent will get a letter from the teacher.
examples.zh: 每位家長都會收到老師的信。

examples.en: Ask a parent to sign your homework.
examples.zh: 請家長在你的作業上簽名。

park.tip_zh: park 的 [ɑr] 要先把下巴放到最低發 [ɑ]，再把舌頭往後捲。學生常只唸「趴克」，沒有 [r]；或嘴唇圓起來，聽起來像 pork [pɔrk]。發 [ɑ] 時嘴唇不要圓，像給醫生看喉嚨說「啊」；捲舌後舌根抬起收 [k]，不要多加「ㄜ」。
park.tip_en: For [ɑr] in park, drop the jaw all the way for [ɑ], then curl the tongue back. Students often say just 'pa-ke' with no [r], or round their lips so it sounds like pork [pɔrk]. Keep the lips unrounded for [ɑ], like saying 'ah' for the doctor; after the curl, raise the back of the tongue for [k] and add no 'uh'.

examples.en: Let's go to the park after school.
examples.zh: 我們放學後去公園吧。

examples.en: There is a big slide in the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡有一個大溜滑梯。

part.tip_zh: part 和 park 只差最後一個子音：part 結尾是舌尖頂住上排牙齦的 [t]，不是舌根的 [k]。學生常把 [r] 和 [t] 都省略，只剩「趴」。正確唸法是下巴放低發 [ɑ]，舌頭往後捲成 [r]，再讓舌尖往前頂住牙齦擋住氣；美式口語的 [t] 常不爆開，但舌頭一定要到位。
part.tip_en: Part differs from park only in the last consonant: part ends in [t] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge, not [k] at the back. Students often drop both [r] and [t], leaving just 'pa'. Drop the jaw for [ɑ], curl the tongue for [r], then bring the tip forward to the gum ridge to block the air; in American speech the [t] is often not released, but the tongue must get there.

examples.en: This is my favorite part of the story.
examples.zh: 這是故事裡我最喜歡的部分。

examples.en: I only ate part of my lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐只吃了一部分。

party.tip_zh: 外來語「趴踢」讓學生唸 party 時常漏掉 [r]。第一音節 [ˈpɑr] 要重，下巴放低後把舌頭捲起來；第二音節 [tɪ] 短而輕，是短的 [ɪ]，不是拉長的 [i]。美國人說話時，[r] 後面的 [t] 常輕輕帶過，接近輕彈的 d，不必用力送氣。
party.tip_en: Because of the borrowed word 'pa-ti', students often leave out the [r] in party. The first syllable [ˈpɑr] is stressed: drop the jaw, then curl the tongue. The second syllable [tɪ] is short and light, a short [ɪ], not a long [i]. In everyday American speech, the [t] after [r] is often a quick tap close to a light d, with no strong puff of air.

examples.en: We had a birthday party for Mom.
examples.zh: 我們幫媽媽辦了生日派對。

examples.en: Are you coming to my party on Saturday?
examples.zh: 你星期六會來我的派對嗎？

pass.tip_zh: pass 的 [æ] 下巴要張大、嘴角往兩邊拉，學生常唸成較窄的 [ɛ]，或在結尾多加母音唸成「配斯」。結尾 [s] 是無聲的嘶嘶聲，舌尖靠近牙齦但不碰到，氣送出來就結束。和 pack 比較：兩個字母音相同，只有結尾 [s] 和 [k] 不一樣。
pass.tip_en: For [æ] in pass, open the jaw wide and spread the lips; students often use the narrower [ɛ] or add a vowel at the end, saying 'pei-si'. The final [s] is a voiceless hiss: tongue tip close to the gum ridge without touching, and stop when the air is out. Compare pack: same vowel, only the ending [s] versus [k] differs.

examples.en: Please pass me the salt.
examples.zh: 請把鹽遞給我。

examples.en: I hope I pass the English test.
examples.zh: 我希望我英文考試及格。

past.tip_zh: past 和 paste 最容易搞混：past 是下巴張大的 [æ]，paste 是嘴角拉開、帶滑音的 [e]。學生常把 past 唸成 paste，或把結尾 [st] 唸成「斯特」，多出兩個母音。[æ] 唸完後舌尖靠近牙齦送出 [s]，再往上頂住牙齦收 [t]，中間不要停頓。
past.tip_en: Past and paste are easy to mix up: past has [æ] with a wide-open jaw, paste has [e] with spread lips and a glide. Students often say paste for past, or turn the final [st] into 'si-te' with two extra vowels. After [æ], hiss [s] with the tip near the gum ridge, then press it up to stop for [t], with no pause in between.

examples.en: We walked past the library.
examples.zh: 我們走過圖書館。

examples.en: It is half past three.
examples.zh: 現在是三點半。

paste.tip_zh: paste 的母音是 [e]，要從 [e] 滑到 [ɪ]，和 taste 押韻；學生看到 a 常唸成 past 的 [æ]，意思就變了。結尾 [st] 兩個子音要緊緊相連：舌尖先在牙齦附近送出 [s]，再往上頂住收 [t]，不要唸成「斯ㄊㄜ」。字尾的 e 不發音，只是讓 a 唸成 [e]。
paste.tip_en: The vowel in paste is [e], gliding from [e] to [ɪ], and it rhymes with taste; seeing the a, students often say [æ] as in past, which changes the word. The final [st] must stay tight: hiss [s] with the tongue tip near the gum ridge, then press up to stop for [t], not 'si-te'. The final e is silent; it only makes the a say [e].

examples.en: Paste the picture in your notebook.
examples.zh: 把圖片貼在你的筆記本上。

examples.en: We used paste to make a card.
examples.zh: 我們用漿糊做了一張卡片。

paste.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，但讓 a 唸成 [e]。
paste.spelling_en: The final e is silent but makes the a say [e].

pay.tip_zh: pay 只有一個音節，母音 [e] 要從 [e] 滑到 [ɪ]，嘴角慢慢往兩邊拉。學生常唸得太短太平，像短促的 [pɛ]；或嘴巴張太大，滑成 pie 的 [aɪ]。練習時把 pay 和 pie 對比：pay 的下巴只半開，pie 要先把下巴放低再滑上去。
pay.tip_en: Pay has one syllable; its vowel [e] glides from [e] to [ɪ] as the lips slowly spread. Students often make it too short and flat, like a clipped [pɛ], or open too wide and slide into the [aɪ] of pie. Practice pay against pie: for pay the jaw is only half open, for pie it drops low first and then glides up.

examples.en: Dad will pay for the movie tickets.
examples.zh: 爸爸會付電影票的錢。

examples.en: How much do I need to pay?
examples.zh: 我需要付多少錢？

peach.tip_zh: peach 的 [i] 是長母音，嘴角拉開、舌頭往前抬高，學生常唸短成 [ɪ]，聽起來像 pitch。結尾 [tʃ] 嘴唇要往前噘，舌尖先頂住牙齦再放開送氣；常見錯誤是在後面加母音，唸成「匹七」。發完 [tʃ] 就把氣停住。
peach.tip_en: The [i] in peach is a long vowel: lips spread, tongue high and forward. Students often shorten it to [ɪ], so it sounds like pitch. For the final [tʃ], push the lips forward, press the tongue tip on the gum ridge and release with a puff; a common mistake is adding a vowel, 'pi-chi'. Stop the air right after [tʃ].

examples.en: This peach is sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 這顆桃子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: Mom put a peach in my lunch box.
examples.zh: 媽媽在我的便當盒裡放了一顆桃子。

pear.tip_zh: pear 拼字有 ea，學生常聯想到 ear、hear，唸成 [pɪr]；其實 pear 和 pair 同音，母音是 [ɛ]。下巴半開發 [ɛ]，接著舌頭往後捲成 [r]，一口氣滑過去，不要拆成「配」和「兒」兩個音節。如果把母音唸成 [ɪ]，聽起來會比較像 peer，意思就不同了。可以和 chair、bear 一起練，韻腳都一樣。
pear.tip_en: Because pear is spelled with ea, students think of ear and hear and say [pɪr]; in fact pear sounds the same as pair, with the vowel [ɛ]. Say [ɛ] with the jaw half open, then curl the tongue back for [r] in one smooth slide, not two syllables 'pei' and 'er'. If the vowel becomes [ɪ], it sounds more like peer, a different word. Practice it with chair and bear, which have the same ending.

examples.en: I would like a pear, please.
examples.zh: 我想要一顆梨子，謝謝。

examples.en: The pear on the table is ripe.
examples.zh: 桌上的梨子熟了。

pear.spelling_zh: ea 在這裡唸 [ɛ]，和 pair 同音，不像 ear 唸 [ɪr]。
pear.spelling_en: The ea here says [ɛ], the same as pair, not [ɪr] as in ear.

pen.tip_zh: pen 的結尾是舌尖音 [n]，學生常因為中文 ㄣ、ㄥ 不分而唸成 [pɛŋ]，或把母音唸高成 [ɪ]，聽起來像 pin。發 [ɛ] 時下巴半開；結尾舌尖要頂住上排牙齦，讓聲音從鼻子出來，舌頭停在那裡再結束。
pen.tip_en: Pen ends in a tongue-tip [n]; because Mandarin speakers often blur -n and -ng, students say [pɛŋ], or raise the vowel to [ɪ] so it sounds like pin. Keep the jaw half open for [ɛ]; at the end, press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge, let the sound come through the nose, and hold the tongue there as you finish.

examples.en: Can I borrow your pen?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的筆嗎？

examples.en: Write your name with a blue pen.
examples.zh: 用藍色的筆寫你的名字。

pencil.tip_zh: pencil 的第二音節是成音節的 [ḷ]，沒有清楚的母音。學生常把結尾唸成圓唇的 [o]，像「片收」，或乾脆漏掉 l。唸完 [s] 後，舌尖馬上往上頂住牙齦，舌根稍微壓低，讓聲音持續一下再結束。重音在第一音節 [ˈpɛn]。
pencil.tip_en: The second syllable of pencil is a syllabic [ḷ] with no clear vowel. Students often end with a rounded [o], something like 'pian-shou', or drop the l altogether. Right after [s], lift the tongue tip to the gum ridge, keep the back of the tongue a little low, and let the sound ring briefly before stopping. The stress is on the first syllable [ˈpɛn].

examples.en: Please write with a pencil, not a pen.
examples.zh: 請用鉛筆寫，不要用原子筆。

examples.en: I need to sharpen my pencil.
examples.zh: 我需要削鉛筆。

people.tip_zh: people 的兩個 [p] 都要清楚：第一音節是長的 [i]，第二音節只有 [p] 加上成音節的 [ḷ]。學生常唸成「批波」，把結尾換成 [o] 母音。正確做法是雙唇閉起發 [p] 後，舌尖立刻頂住上排牙齦發 [ḷ]，嘴唇不要圓。
people.tip_en: Both [p]s in people should be clear: the first syllable has a long [i], and the second is just [p] plus a syllabic [ḷ]. Students often say 'pi-bo', replacing the ending with an [o] vowel. Close the lips for [p], then immediately put the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [ḷ], without rounding the lips.

examples.en: Many people came to the school fair.
examples.zh: 很多人來參加學校園遊會。

examples.en: Be kind to the people around you.
examples.zh: 對你身邊的人要友善。

people.spelling_zh: eo 合起來唸 [i]，o 不發音。
people.spelling_en: The eo together says [i]; the o is silent.

perhaps.tip_zh: perhaps 的重音在第二音節 [hæps]，不在 per。常見錯誤是把第一音節唸重、[æ] 唸成扁扁的 [ɛ]，結尾 [ps] 又多加母音，變成「趴黑普斯」。第一音節輕輕唸 [pɚ]，舌頭微捲；[h] 要聽得到氣，下巴往下張大發 [æ]；最後雙唇閉合發 [p]，直接接 [s] 的嘶聲，中間不加母音。
perhaps.tip_en: perhaps is stressed on the second syllable, [hæps], not on per. Common mistakes are stressing the first syllable, flattening [æ] into [ɛ], and adding vowels to the final [ps], so it sounds like "pa-hei-pu-si". Say the first syllable lightly as [pɚ] with a slight tongue curl; make the [h] an audible breath and drop the jaw wide for [æ]; then close the lips for [p] and go straight into the hiss of [s], with no vowel in between.

examples.en: Perhaps it will rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午或許會下雨。

examples.en: Perhaps we can play together tomorrow.
examples.zh: 也許我們明天可以一起玩。

person.tip_zh: person 的第一音節 [pɝ]，整個母音都要捲舌，跟 her、bird 的母音一樣。常見錯誤是唸成「趴森」或「佩森」，嘴巴張太開、舌頭沒有捲。發 [ɝ] 時舌尖往後捲起、不碰上顎，嘴唇微圓。第二音節 [sən] 很輕，最後舌尖頂住上牙齦收 [n]，不要唸成後鼻音的「桑」。
person.tip_en: The first syllable of person, [pɝ], is r-colored all the way through — the same vowel as in her and bird. A common mistake is saying "pa-sen" or "pei-sen", with the mouth too open and no tongue curl. For [ɝ], curl the tongue tip back without touching the roof of the mouth and round the lips slightly. The second syllable [sən] is very light; finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], not the back nasal of "sang".

examples.en: My teacher is a very kind person.
examples.zh: 我的老師是一個非常親切的人。

examples.en: Each person gets one piece of cake.
examples.zh: 每個人可以拿一塊蛋糕。

pet.tip_zh: pet 和 pot、put 只差母音：pet 是下巴半開的 [ɛ]，pot 是下巴放到最低的 [ɑ]，put 是嘴唇微圓的 [ʊ]。學生常把 pet 唸成帶滑音的「配」，或在結尾加「特」。[ɛ] 要短、平，接著舌尖頂住牙齦收 [t]，不要再送出母音。
pet.tip_en: Pet, pot and put differ only in the vowel: pet has [ɛ] with the jaw half open, pot has [ɑ] with the jaw all the way down, put has [ʊ] with slightly rounded lips. Students often say pet with a gliding 'pei' or add 'te' at the end. Keep [ɛ] short and flat, then put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [t], with no vowel after it.

examples.en: Do you have a pet at home?
examples.zh: 你家有養寵物嗎？

examples.en: My pet rabbit likes carrots.
examples.zh: 我的寵物兔喜歡紅蘿蔔。

photo.tip_zh: photo 開頭的 ph 唸 [f]：上排牙齒輕碰下嘴唇吹氣，不是雙唇爆開的 [p]，否則會變成「剖頭」。兩個音節都是 [o]，美式發音裡嘴唇會從圓慢慢收小、往 [u] 滑過去，不要唸成短短平平的「ㄛ」。重音在第一音節 [fo]，第二音節 [to] 輕一點。
photo.tip_en: The ph at the start of photo is [f]: rest the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip and blow — not a [p] that pops from both lips, or it sounds like "po-tou". Both syllables have [o]; in American English the lips start round and close slightly, gliding toward [u], so don't say a short, flat "aw". The stress is on the first syllable, [fo]; the second, [to], is lighter.

examples.en: Let's take a photo with Grandpa.
examples.zh: 我們跟爺爺拍張照吧。

examples.en: This is a photo of my family.
examples.zh: 這是我家人的照片。

photo.spelling_zh: ph 唸 [f]，跟 phone 一樣。
photo.spelling_en: ph is said [f], just like in phone.

piano.tip_zh: piano 有三個音節，重音在第二音節 [æ]。常見錯誤是唸成「批阿諾」，把 [æ] 唸成中文的「ㄚ」，或把重音放在第一音節。[æ] 要下巴往下張大、嘴角往兩旁拉，和 apple 開頭的音一樣，而且要唸得最長、最響。第一音節 [pɪ] 短而輕，最後的 [o] 嘴唇收圓。
piano.tip_en: piano has three syllables, stressed on the second, [æ]. A common mistake is saying "pi-a-no" with [æ] as Mandarin's plain "a", or putting the stress on the first syllable. For [æ], drop the jaw and pull the corners of the mouth wide, as at the start of apple, and make it the longest, loudest part. The first syllable [pɪ] is short and light; round the lips for the final [o].

examples.en: My sister plays the piano every night.
examples.zh: 我姊姊每天晚上彈鋼琴。

examples.en: We have a piano lesson on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們星期五有鋼琴課。

pick.tip_zh: pick 的 [ɪ] 是短而放鬆的母音，學生常唸成拉長、嘴角用力拉開的 [i]，聽起來像 peek。發 [ɪ] 時舌頭比 [i] 低一點、嘴巴放鬆，聲音短促；結尾舌根頂上顎收 [k]。也要和 pack 分開：pack 的下巴要張大。
pick.tip_en: The [ɪ] in pick is short and relaxed; students often stretch it into a long, tightly spread [i], so it sounds like peek. For [ɪ], keep the tongue a little lower than for [i] and the mouth relaxed, and make it quick; end by pressing the back of the tongue up for [k]. Keep it apart from pack, which needs a wide-open jaw.

examples.en: Pick a book you like.
examples.zh: 挑一本你喜歡的書。

examples.en: Can you pick up your toys?
examples.zh: 你可以把玩具撿起來嗎？

picnic.tip_zh: picnic 只有兩個音節 [pɪk] 和 [nɪk]，學生常在中間的 [k] 後面加母音，唸成三拍的「匹可尼克」。第一個 [k] 只要舌根頂住上顎、不放開，就直接接到 [n]。兩個母音都是短的 [ɪ]，重音放在第一音節。
picnic.tip_en: Picnic has only two syllables, [pɪk] and [nɪk]; students often add a vowel after the middle [k], making three beats, 'pi-ke-ni-ke'. For the first [k], just raise the back of the tongue and, without releasing it, go straight into [n]. Both vowels are short [ɪ], and the stress is on the first syllable.

examples.en: Let's have a picnic in the park.
examples.zh: 我們去公園野餐吧。

examples.en: We brought sandwiches to the picnic.
examples.zh: 我們帶了三明治去野餐。

picture.tip_zh: picture 的第一音節是 [pɪk]，跟 pick 一樣，[k] 不能省略。常見錯誤是漏掉 [k] 直接接 [tʃ]，聽起來變成 pitcher（水壺）；或把 [ɪ] 拉成長長的 [i]。發完 [ɪ] 後舌根輕碰上顎、停一下發 [k]，再接嘴唇往前噘的 [tʃ]，最後舌頭捲起發 [ɚ]，不要停在平平的「球」。
picture.tip_en: The first syllable of picture is [pɪk], the same as pick, and the [k] can't be dropped. A common mistake is skipping the [k] and going straight into [tʃ], which turns it into pitcher (a jug); another is stretching [ɪ] into a long [i]. After [ɪ], briefly touch the back of the tongue to the roof of the mouth for [k], then push the lips forward for [tʃ], and finally curl the tongue for [ɚ] — don't end on a flat "chiu".

examples.en: Can you draw a picture of your dog?
examples.zh: 你可以畫一張你家狗狗的圖嗎？

examples.en: Mom put my picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 媽媽把我的畫掛在牆上。

pie.tip_zh: 中文的「派」就是從 pie 音譯來的，學生常唸得又短又急，像中文第四聲一下就斷掉。英文 pie 要從下巴放低的 [a] 開始，慢慢滑向 [ɪ]，整個雙母音要完整。也要和 pay 分清楚：pay 從半開的 [e] 開始，pie 的起點下巴要開得更大。
pie.tip_en: The Chinese word for pie is borrowed from pie, so students often say it short and abrupt, like a falling fourth tone that cuts off. English pie starts from [a] with the jaw dropped and glides smoothly to [ɪ]; the whole diphthong must be complete. Keep it apart from pay: pay starts from a half-open [e], while pie starts with the jaw open wider.

examples.en: Grandma made an apple pie.
examples.zh: 奶奶做了一個蘋果派。

examples.en: Would you like a piece of pie?
examples.zh: 你想吃一塊派嗎？

piece.tip_zh: piece 的 [i] 是長母音，嘴角往兩邊拉、舌頭抬高，要拉夠長；學生唸太短會變成短的 [ɪ]，聽起來就是別的字。結尾是無聲的 [s]，不是 [z]，也不要加母音唸成「批斯」。拼字 ie 唸 [i]，piece 和 peace 同音。
piece.tip_en: The [i] in piece is long: lips spread, tongue high, held long enough. If students cut it short it becomes [ɪ] and sounds like a different word. The ending is a voiceless [s], not [z], and should not get an extra vowel like 'pi-si'. The ie spelling says [i], and piece sounds the same as peace.

examples.en: Can I have a piece of cake?
examples.zh: 我可以吃一塊蛋糕嗎？

examples.en: I found the last piece of the puzzle.
examples.zh: 我找到拼圖的最後一片了。

piece.spelling_zh: ie 在這裡唸 [i]，piece 和 peace 同音。
piece.spelling_en: The ie here says [i]; piece sounds the same as peace.

pig.tip_zh: pig 結尾是有聲的 [g]，學生常唸成無聲的 [k]，結果聽起來像 pick。發 [g] 時舌根頂住上顎，聲帶要振動；前面的短 [ɪ] 也可以稍微拉長一點，因為母音在有聲子音前會比較長，結尾就更清楚。不要在後面加「ㄍㄜ」。
pig.tip_en: Pig ends in a voiced [g]; students often make it a voiceless [k], so it sounds like pick. For [g], press the back of the tongue up with the vocal cords buzzing; you can also hold the short [ɪ] a little longer, since vowels are longer before voiced consonants, which makes the ending clearer. Don't add a 'ge' at the end.

examples.en: The pig is rolling in the mud.
examples.zh: 豬在泥巴裡打滾。

examples.en: We saw a pink pig at the farm.
examples.zh: 我們在農場看到一隻粉紅色的豬。

pin.tip_zh: pin 的母音是短 [ɪ]，比 pen 的 [ɛ] 舌頭高一點、下巴更合；學生常把這兩個字唸成一樣。結尾 [n] 是舌尖音：對著鏡子看，舌尖要碰到上排牙齒後面的牙齦；如果舌尖沒動、舌根抬起來，就變成 [ŋ]，聽起來像 ping。
pin.tip_en: The vowel in pin is a short [ɪ], with the tongue a bit higher and the jaw more closed than for the [ɛ] in pen; students often make the two words sound alike. The final [n] uses the tongue tip: in a mirror, the tip should touch the gum ridge behind the upper teeth. If the tip stays down and the back of the tongue rises, it becomes [ŋ] and sounds like ping.

examples.en: Use a pin to hold the paper.
examples.zh: 用一根大頭針固定那張紙。

examples.en: She wore a star pin on her coat.
examples.zh: 她外套上別了一個星星別針。

pink.tip_zh: pink 拼字有 n，但因為後面接 [k]，這裡唸舌根鼻音 [ŋ]。學生常用舌尖唸 [n] 再接 [k]，或把母音拉長成 [i]。正確做法是短 [ɪ] 之後，舌根直接抬起頂住軟顎發 [ŋ]，舌頭不動再收 [k]。和 think 押韻，可以一起練。
pink.tip_en: Pink is spelled with n, but because [k] follows, it is the back nasal [ŋ]. Students often use the tongue tip for [n] and then add [k], or stretch the vowel into [i]. After a short [ɪ], raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate for [ŋ], and without moving it, finish with [k]. It rhymes with think, so practice them together.

examples.en: My sister likes pink shoes.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜歡粉紅色的鞋子。

examples.en: The sky turned pink at sunset.
examples.zh: 夕陽西下時天空變成粉紅色。

pink.spelling_zh: n 在 k 前面唸 [ŋ]。
pink.spelling_en: The n before k is pronounced [ŋ].

pipe.tip_zh: pipe 有兩個 [p]，結尾的 [p] 很容易被吃掉，或加上母音唸成「派破」。母音 [aɪ] 從下巴放低的 [a] 滑到 [ɪ] 之後，雙唇要確實閉起來收尾，不需要用力爆開。字尾 e 不發音，只是讓 i 唸成 [aɪ]。
pipe.tip_en: Pipe has two [p]s, and the final one is easily swallowed or given a vowel, like 'pai-po'. After gliding [aɪ] from a low-jaw [a] up to [ɪ], close the lips firmly to finish; there is no need to pop them open. The final e is silent; it only makes the i say [aɪ].

examples.en: Water comes through this pipe.
examples.zh: 水從這根管子流過來。

examples.en: The pipe under the sink is leaking.
examples.zh: 水槽下面的水管在漏水。

pipe.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，讓 i 唸成 [aɪ]。
pipe.spelling_en: The final e is silent and makes the i say [aɪ].

pizza.tip_zh: pizza 中間的 zz 唸 [ts]，不是 [z]，也不是單純的 [s]。常見錯誤是照中文「披薩」來唸，兩個音節一樣重，第二音節還唸得很響。正確是第一音節 [pit] 拉長加重：舌尖先頂住上牙齦，再放開滑成 [s]，跟 cats 字尾的 [ts] 一樣；第二音節 [sə] 輕輕帶過。
pizza.tip_en: The zz in the middle of pizza is [ts] — not [z], and not a plain [s]. A common mistake is saying it like the Mandarin 披薩, with both syllables equally strong and the second one loud. Instead, make the first syllable [pit] long and stressed: press the tongue tip on the gum ridge, then release it into [s], just like the [ts] at the end of cats. The second syllable [sə] is quick and light.

examples.en: We had pizza for dinner on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們星期六晚餐吃披薩。

examples.en: Can I have another slice of pizza?
examples.zh: 我可以再吃一片披薩嗎？

place.tip_zh: place 開頭 [pl] 是兩個子音連在一起，學生常在中間加母音，唸成「坡雷斯」。發 [p] 時舌尖就先頂在上排牙齦準備好 [l]，雙唇一打開馬上滑進 [l] 和 [e]。結尾是無聲的 [s]，字尾的 e 不發音，不要唸成 [z]。
place.tip_en: Place begins with the cluster [pl]; students often put a vowel between them, saying 'po-lei-si'. While the lips are closed for [p], already have the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [l], so that when the lips open you slide straight into [l] and [e]. The ending is a voiceless [s]; the final e is silent, and it should not become [z].

examples.en: This is a nice place to read.
examples.zh: 這是一個適合看書的好地方。

examples.en: Put the books back in their place.
examples.zh: 把書放回原來的地方。

plan.tip_zh: plan 的母音是 [æ]，下巴要放低、嘴角往兩邊拉；學生常唸成 [ɛ] 或帶滑音的 [e]，聽起來像 plain。開頭 [pl] 中間不能加母音。結尾 [n] 舌尖頂住牙齦；[æ] 在 [n] 前面常帶一點鼻音，這是正常的美式發音。
plan.tip_en: The vowel in plan is [æ]: drop the jaw and spread the lips. Students often say [ɛ] or a gliding [e], which sounds like plain. Don't put a vowel inside the opening [pl]. End with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n]; [æ] before [n] usually sounds a little nasal, and that is normal American pronunciation.

examples.en: What is your plan for the weekend?
examples.zh: 你週末有什麼計畫？

examples.en: We plan to visit Grandpa on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們打算星期天去看爺爺。

planet.tip_zh: planet 重音在第一音節 [ˈplæn]，第二音節 [nət] 要輕，母音弱化成 [ə]。學生常照拼字把後半唸成很重的 net，變成兩個重音。開頭 [pl] 要連在一起，[æ] 下巴放低。結尾的 [t] 舌尖頂住就好，不用用力送氣。
planet.tip_en: Planet is stressed on the first syllable [ˈplæn]; the second syllable [nət] is light, with the vowel reduced to [ə]. Students often follow the spelling and say a heavy 'net', giving it two stresses. Keep [pl] together and drop the jaw for [æ]. For the final [t], just touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge; no strong puff is needed.

examples.en: Earth is the planet we live on.
examples.zh: 地球是我們住的行星。

examples.en: Which planet is the biggest?
examples.zh: 哪一顆行星最大？

plant.tip_zh: plant 前後都有子音串：開頭 [pl]、結尾 [nt]。學生常把結尾 [t] 吃掉，聽起來像 plan，或在 [p] 和 [l] 之間加母音。雙唇打開時舌尖已經頂住牙齦，滑進下巴張大的 [æ]，最後舌尖回到牙齦發 [n]，不放開直接擋氣收 [t]。
plant.tip_en: Plant has clusters at both ends: [pl] at the start and [nt] at the end. Students often drop the final [t], so it sounds like plan, or put a vowel between [p] and [l]. As the lips open, the tongue tip is already on the gum ridge; slide into a wide-jaw [æ], then return the tip to the ridge for [n] and, without letting go, block the air for [t].

examples.en: Water the plant every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上幫植物澆水。

examples.en: We grew a bean plant in class.
examples.zh: 我們在班上種了一株豆子。

plate.tip_zh: plate 和 place 只差最後一個音：plate 收在舌尖擋住氣的 [t]，place 收在嘶嘶的 [s]。學生常在 [t] 後面多加「特」的母音，或把 [pl] 拆成兩拍。母音 [e] 要從 [e] 滑到 [ɪ]，然後舌尖頂住上排牙齦停住；字尾的 e 不發音。
plate.tip_en: Plate and place differ only in the last sound: plate ends with the tongue tip blocking the air for [t], place ends with a hissing [s]. Students often add a 'te' vowel after [t], or split [pl] into two beats. Glide [e] to [ɪ], then stop with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; the final e is silent.

examples.en: Put the cookies on a plate.
examples.zh: 把餅乾放在盤子上。

examples.en: Please carry your plate to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 請把你的盤子拿到廚房。

play.tip_zh: play 開頭是 [pl]，學生常把 [l] 唸成 [r]，聽起來像 pray，或在中間加母音。發 [l] 時舌尖要碰到上排牙齦，聲音從舌頭兩側出來；pray 的 [r] 則是舌尖不碰任何地方。之後的 [e] 要滑到 [ɪ]，嘴角往兩邊拉。
play.tip_en: Play starts with [pl]; students often turn [l] into [r], so it sounds like pray, or insert a vowel. For [l], the tongue tip touches the upper gum ridge and the sound flows out along the sides of the tongue; for the [r] in pray, the tip touches nothing. Then glide [e] to [ɪ] with the lips spreading.

examples.en: Let's play outside after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後我們到外面玩吧。

examples.en: Can you play the piano?
examples.zh: 你會彈鋼琴嗎？

player.tip_zh: player 是兩個音節：重音的 [ˈple] 加上捲舌的弱母音 [ɚ]。學生常把結尾唸成「普雷耶」，最後沒有捲舌，或乾脆縮成一個音節。[e] 滑到 [ɪ] 之後，舌頭直接往後捲起、嘴唇放鬆，發出短短的 [ɚ]。開頭 [pl] 中間不要加母音。
player.tip_en: Player has two syllables: a stressed [ˈple] plus a weak r-colored [ɚ]. Students often end it like 'pu-lei-ye' with no curl, or squeeze it into one syllable. After [e] glides to [ɪ], curl the tongue straight back with relaxed lips for a short [ɚ]. Don't put a vowel inside the opening [pl].

examples.en: He is the best player on our team.
examples.zh: 他是我們隊上最好的球員。

examples.en: Each player gets two turns.
examples.zh: 每位玩家有兩次機會。

playground.tip_zh: playground 主重音在 play，ground 是次重音。學生常把 ground 的 [gr] 拆開，唸成「葛」加 round，或把結尾 [nd] 的 [d] 吃掉。發 [g] 時舌頭就要準備捲起接 [r]；[aʊ] 從下巴放低滑到圓唇，最後舌尖頂住牙齦發 [n]，再收輕輕的 [d]。
playground.tip_en: Playground has its main stress on play and a secondary stress on ground. Students often split the [gr] in ground into 'ge' plus round, or swallow the [d] of the final [nd]. While making [g], get the tongue ready to curl for [r]; glide [aʊ] from a low jaw to rounded lips, then put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n] and finish with a light [d].

examples.en: The kids are playing on the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們在操場上玩。

examples.en: Our school has a big playground.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一個大操場。

please.tip_zh: please 結尾是有聲的 [z]，學生常唸成無聲的 [s]，像「普利斯」。發 [z] 時舌尖靠近牙齦，喉嚨要振動，像蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲；前面的長 [i] 也要拉夠長。開頭 [pl] 要連在一起，不要加母音。拼字 ea 唸 [i]，字尾 s 唸 [z]，最後的 e 不發音。
please.tip_en: Please ends in a voiced [z]; students often say a voiceless [s], like 'pu-li-si'. For [z], keep the tongue tip near the gum ridge and let the throat buzz like a bee; also hold the long [i] before it long enough. Keep the opening [pl] together with no vowel in between. The ea says [i], the s says [z], and the final e is silent.

examples.en: Can you help me, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你幫我嗎？

examples.en: Please open your books to page five.
examples.zh: 請把課本翻到第五頁。

please.spelling_zh: ea 唸 [i]；s 唸 [z]；字尾 e 不發音。
please.spelling_en: The ea says [i]; the s says [z]; the final e is silent.

pleasure.tip_zh: pleasure 的難點是 [ʒ]，中文沒有這個音。常見錯誤是唸成沒有聲音的 [ʃ]，或照拼字唸出 sure，變成「普累秀」。發 [ʒ] 時嘴唇往前噘，舌頭位置和 [ʃ] 一樣，但喉嚨要震動，跟 television 裡 s 的音相同。開頭 [pl] 中間不要多加「ㄨ」，最後舌頭捲成 [ɚ]。
pleasure.tip_en: The hard part of pleasure is [ʒ], a sound Mandarin doesn't have. A common mistake is using the voiceless [ʃ], or reading the spelling sure aloud, so it sounds like "pu-lei-shiu". For [ʒ], push the lips forward with the tongue where it is for [ʃ], but let the throat vibrate — the same sound as the s in television. Don't add an "oo" between the [p] and [l] at the start, and finish by curling the tongue for [ɚ].

examples.en: It's a pleasure to meet you.
examples.zh: 很高興認識你。

examples.en: Reading books gives me great pleasure.
examples.zh: 讀書帶給我很大的樂趣。

pleasure.spelling_en: -sure here is said [ʒɚ], not like the word sure.

pocket.tip_zh: pocket 的第一音節是下巴放低、嘴唇不圓的 [ɑ]，學生常照拼字唸成圓唇的 [o]，像「破」。重音在 [ˈpɑ]，第二音節 [kət] 要輕短，母音弱化成 [ə]，不要唸成清楚的 ket。結尾 [t] 舌尖頂住就收。可以先說 hot 的母音，再接 [k]。
pocket.tip_en: The first syllable of pocket has [ɑ], with the jaw low and the lips unrounded; students often follow the spelling and use a rounded [o], like 'po'. The stress is on [ˈpɑ]; the second syllable [kət] is light and short with the vowel reduced to [ə], not a clear 'ket'. End by touching the tongue tip to the ridge for [t]. Try saying the vowel of hot first, then add [k].

examples.en: I have a coin in my pocket.
examples.zh: 我口袋裡有一枚硬幣。

examples.en: Check your pocket before you wash your pants.
examples.zh: 洗褲子前先檢查口袋。

point.tip_zh: point 的 [ɔɪ] 要從圓唇的 [ɔ] 滑向 [ɪ]，學生常起點不夠圓，聽起來像 paint 的 [e]。結尾 [nt]：舌尖頂住上排牙齦發 [n]，舌頭不動把氣擋住收 [t]，不要唸成「碰特」。練習時對比 point 和 paint，感覺嘴唇一個圓、一個扁。
point.tip_en: The [ɔɪ] in point glides from a rounded [ɔ] to [ɪ]; students often don't round enough at the start, so it sounds like the [e] in paint. For the final [nt], put the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n] and, without moving it, block the air for [t], not 'peng-te'. Practice point against paint and feel the lips: one round, one flat.

examples.en: Point to the picture on the board.
examples.zh: 指著黑板上的那張圖。

examples.en: Our team got one more point.
examples.zh: 我們隊又得了一分。

police.tip_zh: police 的重音在第二音節 [lis]，跟 piece 押韻。常見錯誤是把第一音節唸重、唸飽滿，再在字尾多加母音，變成「波利斯」三個一樣清楚的音節。第一音節 [pə] 要非常短，幾乎一帶而過；第二音節 [lis] 的 [i] 拉長，舌尖碰上牙齦發 [l]，結尾 [s] 是清脆的嘶聲，後面不要加母音。
police.tip_en: police is stressed on the second syllable, [lis], and rhymes with piece. A common mistake is making the first syllable strong and full and adding a vowel at the end, so it becomes "po-li-si", three equally clear syllables. Make the first syllable [pə] very short, almost swallowed; stretch the [i] in [lis], touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge for [l], and end with a crisp hiss for [s], with no vowel after it.

examples.en: The police officer helped us find the way.
examples.zh: 警察幫我們找到了路。

examples.en: Call the police if you need help.
examples.zh: 需要幫忙時就打電話給警察。

police.spelling_zh: i 唸長音 [i]，字尾 ce 唸 [s]。
police.spelling_en: The i is a long [i]; the final ce is said [s].

polite.tip_zh: polite 的重音在第二音節 [ˈlaɪt]，學生常把第一音節唸重，變成「坡」加 light。第一音節 [pə] 要非常輕短，母音弱成 [ə]，嘴巴放鬆就好；重心放到 [laɪt]，[aɪ] 下巴先放低再滑上去，最後舌尖頂住收 [t]。
polite.tip_en: Polite is stressed on the second syllable [ˈlaɪt]; students often stress the first syllable, saying 'po' plus light. The first syllable [pə] is very light and short, with a relaxed [ə]; put the weight on [laɪt], dropping the jaw for [aɪ] and gliding up, then end with the tongue tip on the ridge for [t].

examples.en: It is polite to say thank you.
examples.zh: 說謝謝是有禮貌的。

examples.en: Please be polite to our guests.
examples.zh: 請對我們的客人有禮貌。

pond.tip_zh: pond 的母音是下巴放低、嘴唇不圓的 [ɑ]，學生常唸成圓唇的 [o]，再把 [n] 唸成舌根的 [ŋ]，變得像中文的「碰」。正確做法是 [ɑ] 之後舌尖頂住牙齦發 [n]，舌頭不動，喉嚨振動收輕輕的 [d]。和 pound 分清楚：pound 要滑到圓唇的 [ʊ]。
pond.tip_en: The vowel in pond is [ɑ], with a low jaw and unrounded lips; students often use a rounded [o] and turn [n] into the back nasal [ŋ], so it sounds like Mandarin 'peng'. After [ɑ], put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], keep it there, and finish with a light, voiced [d]. Keep it apart from pound, which glides to a rounded [ʊ].

examples.en: There are ducks in the pond.
examples.zh: 池塘裡有鴨子。

examples.en: We saw a frog jump into the pond.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻青蛙跳進池塘。

pool.tip_zh: pool 的 [u] 要嘴唇噘圓、拉長，學生如果唸太短太鬆，會變成 pull [pʊl]。結尾是暗 L：舌尖頂住上排牙齦，舌根往後壓低；學生常整個省略，只剩「噗」，或唸成「噗兒」。把 [u] 拉長後，舌尖再慢慢抬上去就對了。
pool.tip_en: The [u] in pool needs tightly rounded lips and length; if students make it short and loose, it becomes pull [pʊl]. The ending is a dark L: tongue tip on the upper gum ridge, back of the tongue pulled down. Students often drop it entirely, leaving just 'pu', or say 'pu-er'. Hold [u] long, then slowly lift the tongue tip up.

examples.en: Let's swim in the pool.
examples.zh: 我們去游泳池游泳吧。

examples.en: The pool is open on weekends.
examples.zh: 游泳池週末有開放。

poor.tip_zh: poor 是一個音節，嘴唇先噘圓發 [u]，再把舌頭往後捲成 [r]；學生常拆成「普兒」兩拍，或結尾沒捲舌只剩 [pu]。注意和 pool 的差別：poor 結尾舌尖不碰任何地方、往後捲；pool 結尾舌尖要頂住牙齦。
poor.tip_en: Poor is one syllable: round the lips for [u], then curl the tongue back for [r]. Students often split it into two beats, 'pu-er', or skip the curl and leave just [pu]. Note the difference from pool: at the end of poor the tongue tip touches nothing and curls back; at the end of pool it presses on the gum ridge.

examples.en: The poor puppy is wet and cold.
examples.zh: 這隻可憐的小狗又濕又冷。

examples.en: We gave food to poor families.
examples.zh: 我們送食物給貧困的家庭。

poor.variant_zh: 很多美國人也唸 [pɔr]，和 pour 同音。
poor.variant_en: Many Americans also say [pɔr], the same as pour.

pop.tip_zh: pop 的母音是 [ɑ]，下巴要放到最低、嘴唇不圓，學生常唸成中文「波」的圓唇 [o]。開頭和結尾都是 [p]：開頭要送氣，結尾雙唇閉上就好，不要再加「ㄆㄜ」。可以用 hot 的母音來練，同樣是張大嘴的 [ɑ]。
pop.tip_en: The vowel in pop is [ɑ]: jaw all the way down, lips unrounded. Students often use the rounded [o] of Mandarin 'bo'. It starts and ends with [p]: the first one has a puff of air, the last one just closes the lips, with no 'pe' after it. Practice with the vowel in hot, the same open-mouth [ɑ].

examples.en: My sister loves pop music.
examples.zh: 我姊姊很喜歡流行音樂。

examples.en: Who is your favorite pop singer?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡的流行歌手是誰？

popcorn.tip_zh: popcorn 是兩個音節 [pɑp·kɔrn]，重音在前面。常見錯誤是在第一個 [p] 後面多加母音，變成「趴普康」，或第二音節漏掉捲舌、結尾唸成 [ŋ]。第一音節發完 [p] 時雙唇閉著就好，不用爆開，直接接 [k]；第二音節嘴唇圓起來、舌頭往後捲發 [ɔr]，最後舌尖頂上牙齦收 [n]，跟 born 的結尾一樣。
popcorn.tip_en: popcorn has two syllables, [pɑp·kɔrn], stressed on the first. Common mistakes are adding a vowel after the first [p], making it "pa-pu-kang", and, in the second syllable, dropping the r-curl or ending with [ŋ]. After the first [p], just keep the lips closed — no need to pop them open — and go straight into [k]; for the second syllable, round the lips and curl the tongue back for [ɔr], then finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], the same ending as born.

examples.en: Let's eat popcorn and watch a movie.
examples.zh: 我們來吃爆米花、看電影吧。

examples.en: The popcorn smells so good!
examples.zh: 爆米花聞起來好香！

popular.tip_zh: popular 有三個音節，重音在第一音節 [pɑ]，開頭的 o 是嘴巴張大的 [ɑ]，不是圓唇的 [o]。常見錯誤是漏掉第二音節裡的 [j]，唸成「趴撲勒」。第二音節 [pjə] 雙唇閉合後，舌面立刻往上抬，帶出像 you 開頭的 [j]，再很快放鬆。結尾 [lɚ] 舌尖先碰上牙齦，再往後捲，不要停在「勒」。
popular.tip_en: popular has three syllables, stressed on the first, [pɑ]; the first o is the open [ɑ], not a round [o]. A common mistake is leaving out the [j] in the second syllable, saying "pa-pu-le". For the second syllable [pjə], after closing the lips, raise the middle of the tongue right away to make the [j] that starts you, then relax quickly. For the ending [lɚ], touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge, then curl it back — don't stop at "le".

examples.en: This song is very popular at our school.
examples.zh: 這首歌在我們學校很受歡迎。

examples.en: Bubble tea is popular with students.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶很受學生歡迎。

pork.tip_zh: pork 和 park 只差母音：pork 是嘴唇圓起來的 [ɔ]，park 是嘴唇不圓、下巴放低的 [ɑ]。學生常把兩個唸成一樣，點餐時就容易被誤會。發 [ɔ] 後舌頭往後捲成 [r]，最後舌根頂上顎收 [k]，不要加「克」的母音。和 fork 押韻。
pork.tip_en: Pork and park differ only in the vowel: pork has a rounded [ɔ], park an unrounded [ɑ] with a low jaw. Students often say them the same, which can cause confusion when ordering food. After [ɔ], curl the tongue back for [r], then raise the back of the tongue for [k] without adding a vowel. It rhymes with fork.

examples.en: I'd like pork and rice, please.
examples.zh: 我想要豬肉飯，謝謝。

examples.en: Mom cooked pork for dinner.
examples.zh: 媽媽晚餐煮了豬肉。

possible.tip_zh: possible 結尾的 [bḷ] 沒有母音，是最容易出錯的地方。常見錯誤是唸成「趴色波」，把 [bḷ] 唸成「波」，或多加母音再發清楚的 l。發完 [b] 後，舌尖直接頂住上牙齦、舌根往後抬，發出暗沉的 l，跟 table 的結尾一樣。開頭的 o 唸嘴巴張大的 [ɑ]，中間的 [sə] 輕輕帶過。
possible.tip_en: The ending [bḷ] of possible has no vowel, and it's the easiest place to go wrong. A common mistake is saying "pa-se-bo", turning [bḷ] into "bo", or adding a vowel and then a clear l. After [b], put the tongue tip straight onto the gum ridge and raise the back of the tongue for a dark l, the same ending as table. The first o is an open [ɑ], and the middle [sə] is quick and light.

examples.en: Is it possible to finish this today?
examples.zh: 今天有可能做完這個嗎？

examples.en: Please come home as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 請盡快回家。

postcard.tip_zh: postcard 中間有 [stk] 三個子音連在一起，學生常每個子音都加母音，唸成「頗斯特卡的」。第一音節 [post] 的 [o] 要滑向 [ʊ]，然後 [s]、[t] 快速帶過，直接接到 card；結尾 [rd] 先捲舌，再讓舌尖頂住牙齦收輕輕的 [d]。重音在 post。
postcard.tip_en: Postcard has three consonants in a row in the middle, [stk]; students often add a vowel after each one, saying 'po-si-te-ka-de'. The [o] in the first syllable [post] glides toward [ʊ], then [s] and [t] pass quickly straight into card; for the final [rd], curl the tongue, then touch the tip to the gum ridge for a light [d]. The stress is on post.

examples.en: I sent Grandma a postcard from Japan.
examples.zh: 我從日本寄了一張明信片給奶奶。

examples.en: This postcard has a picture of the sea.
examples.zh: 這張明信片上有海的圖片。

postcard.variant_zh: 中間的 t 常省略，唸成 [ˈposˌkɑrd]。
postcard.variant_en: The middle t is often dropped: [ˈposˌkɑrd].

pot.tip_zh: pot 的 [ɑ] 是張大嘴、嘴唇不圓的母音，學生常唸成圓唇的「坡」，母音就不對了。也要和 pet 分清楚：pet 的下巴只半開。結尾 [t] 舌尖頂住上排牙齦把氣擋住，不需要爆開，更不要加「特」。
pot.tip_en: The [ɑ] in pot is an open-mouth vowel with unrounded lips; students often round it into 'po', which is the wrong vowel. Also keep it apart from pet, where the jaw is only half open. For the final [t], press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge to block the air; it doesn't need to pop, and it should never get a 'te' after it.

examples.en: Mom is cooking soup in a big pot.
examples.zh: 媽媽正用一個大鍋子煮湯。

examples.en: Put the flower in a pot.
examples.zh: 把花種在盆子裡。

pound.tip_zh: pound 的 [aʊ] 是雙母音：下巴先放低發 [a]，再把嘴唇收圓滑到 [ʊ]。學生常沒有滑動，唸成 pond 的 [ɑ]；或把結尾 [nd] 吃掉，只剩像「胖」的音。唸完 [aʊ] 後舌尖頂住牙齦發 [n]，喉嚨振動再收輕輕的 [d]。和 sound、round 押韻。
pound.tip_en: The [aʊ] in pound is a diphthong: drop the jaw for [a], then round the lips and glide to [ʊ]. Students often don't glide, saying the [ɑ] of pond, or swallow the final [nd], leaving something like 'pang'. After [aʊ], put the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n] and finish with a light, voiced [d]. It rhymes with sound and round.

examples.en: This bag weighs one pound.
examples.zh: 這個袋子重一磅。

examples.en: Apples cost two dollars a pound.
examples.zh: 蘋果一磅兩美元。

power.tip_zh: power 的 [aʊ] 從下巴放低的 [a] 滑到圓唇的 [ʊ]，接著要把舌頭往後捲成 [r]。學生常最後沒捲舌，唸成「趴哇」，或把 [aʊ] 縮成單一個 [ɑ]。練習時先說 how，再在後面慢慢加上捲舌，就能把 [aʊ] 和 [r] 接起來。
power.tip_en: The [aʊ] in power glides from a low-jaw [a] to a rounded [ʊ], and then the tongue must curl back for [r]. Students often skip the curl at the end, saying 'pa-wa', or shrink [aʊ] to a single [ɑ]. To practice, say how, then slowly add the tongue curl after it to join [aʊ] and [r].

examples.en: Save power by turning off the lights.
examples.zh: 隨手關燈來節省電力。

examples.en: Music has the power to make us happy.
examples.zh: 音樂有讓我們快樂的力量。

power.kk_flag: KK [paʊr] looks collapsed: CMU P AW1 ER0 and US dictionaries give two syllables, [ˈpaʊɚ] (sylls paʊ·ɚ); one-syllable [paʊr] is a casual reduction. Kept the given sylls.

practice.tip_zh: practice 重音在第一音節 [ˈpræk]，第二音節 [təs] 要輕。學生常看到 -tice 就唸成 ice 的 [aɪs]，還把重音放到後面。開頭 [pr] 要連在一起，[æ] 下巴放低；中間 [kt] 舌根頂一下就換舌尖，不要加母音唸成「克特」。
practice.tip_en: Practice is stressed on the first syllable [ˈpræk]; the second syllable [təs] is light. Seeing -tice, students often say the [aɪs] of ice and move the stress to the end. Keep [pr] together and drop the jaw for [æ]; for the middle [kt], touch the back of the tongue up briefly and switch to the tip, without a vowel like 'ke-te'.

examples.en: I practice the piano every day.
examples.zh: 我每天練習彈鋼琴。

examples.en: Soccer practice starts at four.
examples.zh: 足球練習四點開始。

practice.spelling_en: The -tice says [təs], not [aɪs] as in ice.

pray.tip_zh: pray 開頭是 [pr]，[r] 的舌尖要往後捲、不碰上顎，嘴唇微微噘圓；學生常唸成 [l]，結果變成 play。也常在 [p] 和 [r] 之間多加母音，唸成「普瑞」兩拍。雙唇一張開就直接進入捲舌，再滑到 [e]、[ɪ]。和 gray 押韻。
pray.tip_en: Pray starts with [pr]: for [r] the tongue tip curls back without touching the roof of the mouth, and the lips push slightly round. Students often say [l] instead, which turns it into play, or add a vowel between [p] and [r], making two beats, 'pu-rei'. As soon as the lips open, go straight into the curl, then glide through [e] to [ɪ]. It rhymes with gray.

examples.en: Some families pray before dinner.
examples.zh: 有些家庭晚餐前會禱告。

examples.en: We pray for good weather tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們祈禱明天天氣好。

prepare.tip_zh: prepare 的重音在第二音節 [ˈpɛr]，學生常把開頭唸重，或照拼字把 pre 唸成長母音的 [pri]。第一音節 [prɪ] 要輕短，母音是放鬆的 [ɪ]；第二音節 [pɛr] 下巴半開，再把舌頭捲起來收尾，和 pair 的音一樣。
prepare.tip_en: Prepare is stressed on the second syllable [ˈpɛr]; students often stress the beginning, or follow the spelling and say pre with a long vowel, [pri]. The first syllable [prɪ] is light and short with a relaxed [ɪ]; the second syllable [pɛr] has a half-open jaw and ends with the tongue curled, just like pair.

examples.en: Let's prepare for the test together.
examples.zh: 我們一起準備考試吧。

examples.en: Dad will prepare breakfast tomorrow.
examples.zh: 爸爸明天會準備早餐。

pretty.tip_zh: pretty 拼字有 e，但母音是短的 [ɪ]，學生常唸成 [ɛ] 或拉長的 [i]。開頭 [pr] 要連著，不要唸成「普瑞踢」三拍。美式口語中，兩個母音中間的 [t] 常變成輕彈的音：舌尖很快碰一下牙齦，聽起來接近輕的 d。重音在第一音節。
pretty.tip_en: Pretty is spelled with e, but its vowel is a short [ɪ]; students often say [ɛ] or a long [i]. Keep [pr] together rather than three beats, 'pu-rui-ti'. In American speech the [t] between the two vowels is usually a tap: the tongue tip flicks the gum ridge quickly, sounding close to a light d. The stress is on the first syllable.

examples.en: That is a pretty flower.
examples.zh: 那是一朵漂亮的花。

examples.en: The test was pretty easy.
examples.zh: 這次考試蠻簡單的。

price.tip_zh: price 結尾是無聲的 [s]，prize 結尾是有聲的 [z]，學生常兩個都唸成 [s] 而分不出來。唸 price 時 [aɪ] 稍微短一點，接著舌尖靠近牙齦送出嘶嘶的氣，喉嚨不振動。開頭 [pr] 不要加母音；字尾的 e 不發音。
price.tip_en: Price ends in a voiceless [s] and prize in a voiced [z]; students often say [s] for both, so they can't be told apart. For price, keep [aɪ] a bit shorter, then hiss with the tongue tip near the gum ridge and no buzz in the throat. No vowel inside [pr]; the final e is silent.

examples.en: What is the price of this book?
examples.zh: 這本書的價格是多少？

examples.en: The price is on the tag.
examples.zh: 價格寫在標籤上。

prize.tip_zh: prize 結尾是有聲的 [z]，學生常唸成 [s]，結果聽起來像 price。發 [z] 時把手放在喉嚨上，應該感覺到振動；前面的 [aɪ] 也要拉長一點，因為有聲子音前的母音比較長。開頭 [pr] 舌頭往後捲、嘴唇微圓，中間不要加母音。
prize.tip_en: Prize ends in a voiced [z]; students often say [s], so it sounds like price. Put a hand on your throat while saying [z]: you should feel it vibrate. Also hold [aɪ] a little longer, because vowels are longer before voiced consonants. For [pr], curl the tongue back with slightly rounded lips and no vowel in between.

examples.en: She won first prize in the art contest.
examples.zh: 她在美術比賽中得到第一名。

examples.en: The prize is a new bike.
examples.zh: 獎品是一台新腳踏車。

probably.tip_zh: probably 的重音在第一音節 [prɑ]。常見錯誤是 [p] 和 [r] 中間加母音唸成「普拉」，或照拼字把 o 唸成「羅」，後面每個音節又唸得一樣重。發 [pr] 時，雙唇打開前舌頭就先捲好，嘴唇一張開就是 [r]，接著下巴張大發 [ɑ]，像 hot 的母音。中間的 [bə] 很輕，最後的 [blɪ] 乾脆收尾。
probably.tip_en: probably is stressed on the first syllable, [prɑ]. Common mistakes are adding a vowel between [p] and [r], like "pu-la", reading the o from the spelling as "luo", and giving every syllable after it equal weight. For [pr], curl the tongue before the lips open, so [r] comes out the moment they part; then drop the jaw for [ɑ], the vowel in hot. The middle [bə] is very light, and the final [blɪ] ends cleanly.

examples.en: It will probably be sunny tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天大概會是晴天。

examples.en: Dad is probably still at work.
examples.zh: 爸爸可能還在上班。

probably.variant_zh: 口語說快時常縮成兩個音節 [ˈprɑblɪ]。
probably.variant_en: In quick, casual speech it is often shortened to two syllables, [ˈprɑblɪ].

problem.tip_zh: problem 的第一音節 [ˈprɑb] 是張大嘴的 [ɑ]，學生常照拼字唸成圓唇的 [o]。中間 [bl] 要連在一起：雙唇閉上發 [b] 時，舌尖已經頂在牙齦，打開就是 [l]，不要加「ㄅㄜ」變成三個音節。最後 [ləm] 輕短，雙唇閉起收 [m]。
problem.tip_en: The first syllable of problem, [ˈprɑb], has an open-mouth [ɑ]; students often follow the spelling and use a rounded [o]. The middle [bl] stays together: while the lips close for [b], the tongue tip is already on the gum ridge, so opening them gives [l]; don't add a 'be' and make it three syllables. The last part [ləm] is light, ending with closed lips for [m].

examples.en: No problem, I can help you.
examples.zh: 沒問題，我可以幫你。

examples.en: Can you solve this math problem?
examples.zh: 你會解這道數學題嗎？

program.tip_zh: program 的第一音節是 [o]，要從 [o] 滑到 [ʊ]，和 problem 張大嘴的 [ɑ] 不同。第二音節 [græm] 有次重音，母音是下巴張開的 [æ]，學生常唸得太弱，或在 [g] 和 [r] 中間加母音。結尾 [m] 雙唇要閉起來，不要變成 [n]。
program.tip_en: The first syllable of program has [o], gliding from [o] to [ʊ], unlike the open [ɑ] of problem. The second syllable [græm] carries secondary stress with an open-jaw [æ]; students often make it too weak or put a vowel between [g] and [r]. For the final [m], close the lips; don't let it become [n].

examples.en: My favorite TV program is on now.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的電視節目正在播。

examples.en: We watched a program about whales.
examples.zh: 我們看了一個關於鯨魚的節目。

proud.tip_zh: proud 的 [aʊ] 要從下巴放低的 [a] 滑到圓唇的 [ʊ]，學生常沒滑完就停。結尾 [d] 是有聲的，常被吃掉，或唸成無聲的 [t]。唸完 [aʊ] 後，舌尖頂住上排牙齦，喉嚨振動輕輕收 [d]。開頭 [pr] 舌頭往後捲，不碰上顎。
proud.tip_en: The [aʊ] in proud glides from a low-jaw [a] to a rounded [ʊ]; students often stop before finishing the glide. The final [d] is voiced and is often swallowed or turned into a voiceless [t]. After [aʊ], put the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge and finish with a light, buzzing [d]. For [pr], curl the tongue back without touching the roof of the mouth.

examples.en: I am proud of you.
examples.zh: 我以你為榮。

examples.en: She felt proud of her drawing.
examples.zh: 她對自己的畫感到很驕傲。

public.tip_zh: public 的 u 唸 [ʌ]，和 cup 的母音一樣，學生常照拼字唸成 [u]。重音在第一音節 [ˈpʌb]，[b] 雙唇閉上後直接打開接 [l]，不要加母音唸成「趴布力克」。第二音節 [lɪk] 是短 [ɪ]，結尾舌根收 [k]。可以先說 cup，再把母音帶進 public 的第一音節。
public.tip_en: The u in public says [ʌ], the vowel in cup; students often follow the spelling and say [u]. The stress is on the first syllable [ˈpʌb]: close the lips for [b] and open straight into [l], without a vowel, as in 'pa-bu-li-ke'. The second syllable [lɪk] has a short [ɪ] and ends with the back of the tongue for [k]. Say cup first, then carry that vowel into the first syllable of public.

examples.en: We borrowed books from the public library.
examples.zh: 我們從公立圖書館借了書。

examples.en: This is a public park.
examples.zh: 這是一座公共公園。

pull.tip_zh: pull 的 [ʊ] 短而放鬆，嘴唇只微微圓起；學生常唸成噘緊、拉長的 [u]，變成 pool。結尾的暗 L 要讓舌尖頂住牙齦、舌根往後壓，不要唸成「普歐」。可以和 full 一起練，兩個字的母音和結尾都一樣。
pull.tip_en: The [ʊ] in pull is short and relaxed, with only slightly rounded lips; students often make it a tight, long [u], turning it into pool. For the final dark L, press the tongue tip on the gum ridge and pull the back of the tongue down, not 'pu-ou'. Practice it with full, which has the same vowel and ending.

examples.en: Pull the door to open it.
examples.zh: 把門拉開。

examples.en: Can you help me pull this box?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我拉這個箱子嗎？

pumpkin.tip_zh: pumpkin 第一音節 [pʌmp] 的母音是 cup 的 [ʌ]，學生常唸成「胖」，用了 [ɑ] 和舌根鼻音。發 [m] 時雙唇閉起，不放開直接接 [p]，再立刻轉到 [k]，中間不要加母音。第二音節 [kɪn] 輕短，結尾舌尖頂住牙齦收 [n]。
pumpkin.tip_en: The first syllable of pumpkin, [pʌmp], has the [ʌ] of cup; students often say it like Mandarin 'pang', with [ɑ] and a back nasal. Close the lips for [m], keep them closed into [p], then move straight to [k] with no vowel in between. The second syllable [kɪn] is light and short, ending with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n].

examples.en: We carved a pumpkin for Halloween.
examples.zh: 我們為萬聖節刻了一個南瓜。

examples.en: Grandma makes pumpkin soup.
examples.zh: 奶奶會煮南瓜湯。

pumpkin.variant_zh: 中間的 p 常輕到聽不見：[ˈpʌmkɪn]。
pumpkin.variant_en: The middle p is often too light to hear: [ˈpʌmkɪn].

puppy.tip_zh: puppy 的母音是 [ʌ]，下巴半開、嘴巴放鬆，學生常照拼字唸成 [u]，或嘴唇圓起來唸成 [o]。拼字有兩個 p，但中間只發一次 [p]，不要停頓成兩拍。重音在第一音節，第二音節 [pɪ] 是短而輕的 [ɪ]。
puppy.tip_en: The vowel in puppy is [ʌ], with the jaw half open and the mouth relaxed; students often follow the spelling and say [u], or round the lips into [o]. Although it is spelled with two p's, the middle is pronounced as one [p], with no pause. The stress is on the first syllable, and the second syllable [pɪ] has a short, light [ɪ].

examples.en: The puppy is chasing its tail.
examples.zh: 小狗在追自己的尾巴。

examples.en: We got a puppy for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我生日的時候，我們養了一隻小狗。

puppy.spelling_zh: 中間的 pp 只發一個 [p]。
puppy.spelling_en: The double pp is pronounced as one [p].

purple.tip_zh: purple 和 people 只差第一個母音：purple 是捲舌的 [ɝ]，people 是 [i]。常見錯誤是唸成「趴波」，嘴巴張太大又沒有捲舌，結尾 [pḷ] 還多加一個「ㄛ」。第一音節舌頭往後捲、嘴唇微圓，像 her 的母音；接著雙唇閉合發 [p]，舌尖直接頂住上牙齦發暗 l，中間不要有母音。
purple.tip_en: purple and people differ only in the first vowel: purple has the r-colored [ɝ], people has [i]. A common mistake is saying "pa-bo", with the mouth too open and no tongue curl, plus an extra "o" on the final [pḷ]. For the first syllable, curl the tongue back and round the lips slightly, like the vowel in her; then close the lips for [p] and put the tongue tip straight onto the gum ridge for a dark l, with no vowel in between.

examples.en: My favorite color is purple.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是紫色。

examples.en: She is wearing a purple dress today.
examples.zh: 她今天穿了一件紫色的洋裝。

push.tip_zh: push 的結尾是 [ʃ]，嘴唇要往前噘、舌頭不碰牙齒；學生常用中文「ㄒ」的嘴形，嘴角往兩邊拉，聽起來不夠厚。母音是短而放鬆的 [ʊ]，不要拉長成 [u]。可以和 pull 一起練，兩個字的母音相同。
push.tip_en: Push ends in [ʃ]: push the lips forward and keep the tongue off the teeth. Students often use the mouth shape of Mandarin 'x', with the lips spread, so it sounds too thin. The vowel is a short, relaxed [ʊ]; don't stretch it into [u]. Practice it with pull, which has the same vowel.

examples.en: Push the button to start.
examples.zh: 按下按鈕開始。

examples.en: Please don't push in line.
examples.zh: 排隊時請不要推擠。

put.tip_zh: put 的 u 唸 [ʊ]，和 foot 押韻；學生常因為 but、cut 的拼法而唸成 [ʌ]。發 [ʊ] 時嘴唇微圓、舌頭往後縮，聲音短；結尾 [t] 舌尖頂住牙齦擋住氣就好，不要加「特」。也要和 pet、pot 分清楚，三個字只差母音。
put.tip_en: The u in put says [ʊ], and it rhymes with foot; because of words like but and cut, students often say [ʌ]. For [ʊ], round the lips slightly and pull the tongue back, keeping it short; for the final [t], just block the air with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, without adding 'te'. Also keep it apart from pet and pot, which differ only in the vowel.

examples.en: Put your bag on the chair.
examples.zh: 把書包放在椅子上。

examples.en: Please put on your jacket.
examples.zh: 請穿上你的外套。

put.spelling_zh: u 唸 [ʊ]，和 foot 押韻，不像 but。
put.spelling_en: The u says [ʊ] and rhymes with foot, not like but.

quarter.tip_zh: quarter 的 qu 唸 [kw]，學生常漏掉 [w]，唸成像 [kɔr]。重音在第一音節 [ˈkwɔr]，嘴唇先圓起來再捲舌；第二音節 [tɚ] 也要捲舌，所以整個字有兩次捲舌。美式口語中，[r] 後面的 [t] 常輕輕帶過，接近輕彈的 d。
quarter.tip_en: The qu in quarter says [kw]; students often drop the [w], making it sound like [kɔr]. The stress is on the first syllable [ˈkwɔr]: round the lips, then curl the tongue. The second syllable [tɚ] is r-colored too, so the word has two curls. In American speech the [t] after [r] is often light, close to a tapped d.

examples.en: It is a quarter past four.
examples.zh: 現在是四點十五分。

examples.en: I ate a quarter of the pizza.
examples.zh: 我吃了四分之一的披薩。

queen.tip_zh: queen 開頭的 [kw] 是兩個音，嘴唇在發 [k] 時就要圓起來，學生常省略 [w]，唸成 keen。母音是長的 [i]，嘴角拉開。結尾 [n] 舌尖要頂住牙齦，不要變成舌根的 [ŋ]，否則聽起來像 [kwiŋ]。和 clean 的結尾一樣。
queen.tip_en: The [kw] at the start of queen is two sounds: round the lips already while making [k]. Students often leave out the [w] and say keen. The vowel is a long [i] with spread lips. For the final [n], press the tongue tip on the gum ridge; don't let it become the back nasal [ŋ], or it sounds like [kwiŋ]. It ends the same way as clean.

examples.en: The queen lives in a big castle.
examples.zh: 女王住在一座大城堡裡。

examples.en: She played the queen in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在學校話劇裡演皇后。

question.tip_zh: question 開頭的 qu 唸 [kw]：發完 [k] 嘴唇要馬上圓起來帶出 [w]，不能只唸 [k]。中間的 [stʃ] 是一串子音：先發 [s] 的嘶聲，舌尖再頂上牙齦，放開成 chair 開頭的 [tʃ]。常見錯誤是漏掉 [t] 或 [s]，或把第二音節唸成響亮的「瓊」。第二音節 [tʃən] 要輕，結尾是舌尖音 [n]。
question.tip_en: The qu at the start of question is [kw]: right after [k], round the lips to add [w] — don't say [k] alone. The middle [stʃ] is a consonant cluster: hiss [s], then press the tongue tip on the gum ridge and release it into the [tʃ] that starts chair. Common mistakes are dropping the [t] or the [s], or making the second syllable a loud "chiong". Keep the second syllable [tʃən] light, ending with the tongue-tip [n].

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
examples.zh: 我可以問你一個問題嗎？

examples.en: Raise your hand if you have a question.
examples.zh: 有問題的話請舉手。

quick.tip_zh: quick 的母音是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，學生常拉長成 [i]。開頭 [kw]：舌根頂住上顎時嘴唇就已經圓起來，打開後馬上滑到 [ɪ]，再用舌根收 [k]。整個字很短促，前後都是 [k]，結尾不要加「ㄎㄜ」。和 quiz 的開頭一樣，都是 [kwɪ]。
quick.tip_en: The vowel in quick is a short, relaxed [ɪ]; students often stretch it into [i]. For the opening [kw], the lips are already rounded while the back of the tongue presses up; open and slide straight to [ɪ], then close with the back of the tongue for [k]. The word is short and clipped, with [k] at both ends; don't add 'ke' at the end. It starts the same way as quiz, with [kwɪ].

examples.en: Take a quick look at this picture.
examples.zh: 快速看一下這張圖片。

examples.en: The rabbit is very quick.
examples.zh: 這隻兔子動作很快。

quiet.tip_zh: quiet 有兩個音節 [kwaɪ] 和 [ət]，學生常唸成一個音節，和 quite 混在一起。第一音節重，[aɪ] 滑完之後，再加一個輕輕的 [ə]，最後舌尖頂住收 [t]。可以這樣記：quiet 是兩拍，quite 是一拍。拼字 ie 在這裡分屬兩個音節，不是一個母音。
quiet.tip_en: Quiet has two syllables, [kwaɪ] and [ət]; students often squeeze it into one syllable and mix it up with quite. The first syllable is stressed; after the [aɪ] glide, add a light [ə], then end with the tongue tip on the ridge for [t]. Remember: quiet has two beats, quite has one. Here the spelled ie belongs to two syllables; it is not one vowel.

examples.en: Please be quiet in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館請保持安靜。

examples.en: The classroom is very quiet now.
examples.zh: 教室現在很安靜。

quite.tip_zh: quite 只有一個音節，[aɪ] 滑完直接收 [t]；學生常唸成兩拍，聽起來像 quiet。開頭 [kw] 嘴唇要先圓起來，再把下巴放低進入 [a]；拼字結尾的 e 不發音。結尾 [t] 舌尖頂住就停，不要送出母音。
quite.tip_en: Quite has only one syllable: after the [aɪ] glide, go straight to [t]. Students often give it two beats, so it sounds like quiet. For the opening [kw], round the lips first, then drop the jaw into [a]; the final e in the spelling is silent. Stop with the tongue tip on the ridge for [t], with no vowel after it.

examples.en: The movie was quite funny.
examples.zh: 這部電影相當好笑。

examples.en: It is quite cold today.
examples.zh: 今天相當冷。

quiz.tip_zh: quiz 只有一個音節 [kwɪz]，母音是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，像 sit 的母音。常見錯誤是把 [ɪ] 拉長成 [i]，或字尾的 [z] 變成沒有聲音的 [s]，甚至多加一個母音，聽起來像「葵茲」。發 [z] 時舌尖靠近上牙齦，喉嚨持續震動，像蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲；這個結尾也是 quiz 和 quick 的差別所在。
quiz.tip_en: quiz has one syllable, [kwɪz], and its vowel is a short, relaxed [ɪ], as in sit. Common mistakes are stretching [ɪ] into [i], turning the final [z] into a voiceless [s], or adding a vowel after it so it sounds like "kwei-zu". For [z], hold the tongue tip near the gum ridge and keep the throat buzzing like a bee — that ending is also what separates quiz from quick.

examples.en: We have a spelling quiz on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們星期一有拼字小考。

examples.en: I got every answer right on the math quiz.
examples.zh: 數學小考我全部答對了。

rabbit.tip_zh: rabbit 開頭的 [r] 常被唸成 [l]，變成「萊比特」。發 [r] 時嘴唇微圓，舌尖往後捲但不碰上顎；接著下巴往下張大發 [æ]，跟 apple 的開頭一樣。第二音節 [bət] 很輕，母音短而模糊，不要唸成清楚的「比」；結尾 [t] 舌尖頂住上牙齦就停，不要再加「ㄜ」。可以用押韻的 habit 一起練。
rabbit.tip_en: The [r] at the start of rabbit is often turned into [l], so it sounds like "lai-bi-te". For [r], round the lips slightly and curl the tongue tip back without touching the roof of the mouth; then drop the jaw for [æ], as at the start of apple. The second syllable [bət] is very light, with a short, unclear vowel — not a clear "bee". For the final [t], touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge and stop, without adding "uh". Practice with the rhyme habit.

examples.en: Our class has a white rabbit.
examples.zh: 我們班上有一隻白兔。

examples.en: The rabbit is eating a carrot.
examples.zh: 兔子正在吃紅蘿蔔。

race.tip_zh: race 開頭是 [r]，舌尖往後捲、不碰上顎，嘴唇微圓；學生常唸成中文「ㄖ」那種有摩擦的聲音，或唸成 [l]。母音 [e] 要滑到 [ɪ]，結尾是無聲的 [s]。注意和 raise 區分：raise 結尾是有聲的 [z]。練習時把 race、rice 對比：race 下巴半開，rice 要先把下巴放低。
race.tip_en: Race starts with [r]: the tongue tip curls back without touching the roof of the mouth, and the lips are slightly rounded. Students often use the buzzy friction of Mandarin 'r', or say [l]. Glide [e] to [ɪ], and end with a voiceless [s]. Keep it apart from raise, which ends in a voiced [z]. Practice race against rice: for race the jaw is half open, for rice it drops low first.

examples.en: Let's have a race to the tree.
examples.zh: 我們來比賽，看誰先跑到那棵樹。

examples.en: He won the race on sports day.
examples.zh: 他在運動會的賽跑中得到第一。

radio.tip_zh: radio 的第一個字母 a 要唸 [e]，跟 day 的母音一樣，嘴型從 [e] 往 [ɪ] 滑。常見錯誤是照拼字唸成「拉迪歐」，用了嘴巴大開的 [ɑ]，或把開頭的 [r] 唸成 [l]。三個音節中重音在第一音節 [re]，中間的 [dɪ] 短而輕，最後的 [o] 嘴唇收圓。開頭的 [r] 嘴唇先微微噘起，舌頭捲起、不碰上顎。
radio.tip_en: The first letter, a, in radio is said [e], the vowel in day, gliding from [e] toward [ɪ]. A common mistake is reading it as "la-di-o" with a wide-open [ɑ], or turning the opening [r] into [l]. Of the three syllables, the first, [re], is stressed; the middle [dɪ] is short and light, and the lips round for the final [o]. For the opening [r], push the lips forward a little and curl the tongue without touching the roof of the mouth.

examples.en: Grandpa listens to the radio every morning.
examples.zh: 爺爺每天早上聽收音機。

examples.en: Can you turn on the radio, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你打開收音機嗎？

radio.spelling_zh: a 在這裡唸 [e]，像 day，不唸 [æ]。
radio.spelling_en: The a here is said [e], as in day, not [æ].

rain.tip_zh: rain 開頭的 [r] 和結尾的 [n] 都要注意。常見錯誤是開頭唸成 [l]，像「雷恩」，或結尾變成後鼻音 [ŋ]。開頭嘴唇微圓、舌尖往後捲不碰上顎；中間的 [e] 從 day 的母音往 [ɪ] 滑；最後舌尖頂住上牙齦收 [n]。rain 和 train、main 押韻；如果母音唸成 [ʌ]，就變成 run 了。
rain.tip_en: Watch both the [r] at the start of rain and the [n] at the end. Common mistakes are starting with [l], like "lei-en", or ending with the back nasal [ŋ]. At the start, round the lips slightly and curl the tongue tip back without touching the roof of the mouth; the vowel [e] glides from the vowel in day toward [ɪ]; finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n]. rain rhymes with train and main; if the vowel becomes [ʌ], it turns into run.

examples.en: Take an umbrella. It might rain later.
examples.zh: 帶把傘吧，等一下可能會下雨。

examples.en: The kids love to play in the rain.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜歡在雨中玩。

rainbow.tip_zh: rainbow 重音在 rain。開頭 [r] 要先把嘴唇微微噘起、舌頭捲起再出聲，不要唸成 [l]。第一音節結尾的 [n] 要收好再接 [b]；第二音節 [bo] 的 [o] 要從 [o] 滑到 [ʊ]，學生常唸成平平的「波」，嘴唇沒有越收越圓。
rainbow.tip_en: Rainbow is stressed on rain. For the opening [r], push the lips slightly forward and curl the tongue before making any sound; don't say [l]. Finish the [n] of the first syllable before moving to [b]; in the second syllable [bo], the [o] glides to [ʊ], but students often say a flat 'bo' without the lips rounding more and more.

examples.en: Look, there is a rainbow in the sky!
examples.zh: 你看，天空有一道彩虹！

examples.en: A rainbow has seven colors.
examples.zh: 彩虹有七種顏色。

rainy.tip_zh: rainy 重音在第一音節，[e] 要滑到 [ɪ]；第二音節 [nɪ] 是短而輕的 [ɪ]，不要拉長。學生常把中間的 [n] 唸成舌根的 [ŋ]，或把開頭 [r] 唸成 [l]。發 [r] 時舌尖往後捲、不碰上顎；[n] 則舌尖頂住牙齦，順勢接到後面的 [ɪ]。
rainy.tip_en: Rainy is stressed on the first syllable, where [e] glides to [ɪ]; the second syllable [nɪ] has a short, light [ɪ], not a long one. Students often turn the middle [n] into the back nasal [ŋ], or say [l] for the opening [r]. For [r], curl the tongue tip back without touching; for [n], press the tip on the gum ridge and flow straight into the [ɪ] after it.

examples.en: It is a rainy day, so bring an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下雨，記得帶雨傘。

examples.en: We play inside on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天我們在室內玩。

raise.tip_zh: raise 結尾的 s 唸有聲的 [z]，學生常照拼字唸成 [s]，結果變成 race。發 [z] 時舌尖靠近牙齦，聲帶持續振動，前面的 [e] 也要拉長一點。開頭 [r] 嘴唇微圓、舌尖不碰上顎。拼字的 ai 唸 [e]，字尾 e 不發音。
raise.tip_en: The s at the end of raise is a voiced [z]; students often follow the spelling and say [s], which turns it into race. For [z], keep the tongue tip near the gum ridge with the voice buzzing the whole time, and hold the [e] before it a little longer. For the opening [r], round the lips slightly and keep the tongue tip off the roof of the mouth. The ai says [e], and the final e is silent.

examples.en: Raise your hand to ask a question.
examples.zh: 要問問題請舉手。

examples.en: My grandparents raise chickens.
examples.zh: 我爺爺奶奶養雞。

raise.spelling_zh: s 唸 [z]；ai 唸 [e]；字尾 e 不發音。
raise.spelling_en: The s says [z]; the ai says [e]; the final e is silent.

rat.tip_zh: rat 開頭的 [r] 學生常唸成 [l]，母音又常唸窄成 [ɛ]，兩個錯誤加起來就變成 let。先把嘴唇微微噘起、舌頭往後捲，不要碰上顎，再把下巴放低、嘴角拉開發 [æ]，最後舌尖頂住牙齦收 [t]。和 cat、hat 押韻。
rat.tip_en: Students often say [l] for the [r] at the start of rat and narrow the vowel to [ɛ]; together, those two mistakes turn it into let. Push the lips slightly forward and curl the tongue back without touching, then drop the jaw and spread the lips for [æ], and end with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [t]. It rhymes with cat and hat.

examples.en: A rat ran across the street.
examples.zh: 一隻老鼠跑過了馬路。

examples.en: The cat chased the rat.
examples.zh: 貓追著那隻老鼠跑。

reach.tip_zh: reach 的母音是長音 [i]，嘴角往兩邊拉、聲音拉長；唸得太短太鬆就變成 rich [rɪtʃ]「有錢的」。字尾 [tʃ] 常被多加一個母音，唸成「瑞去」。收尾時嘴唇微微往前，只送出一小口氣就結束，後面不要再接任何母音。
reach.tip_en: The vowel in reach is the long [i]: spread the corners of your mouth and hold it; if it is short and lax it becomes rich [rɪtʃ]. Learners often add a vowel after the final [tʃ], saying something like "ree-chee". To finish, push the lips slightly forward and release just one small puff of air, with no vowel after it.

examples.en: Can you reach the top shelf?
examples.zh: 你搆得到最上面那一層架子嗎？

examples.en: We will reach the park at ten.
examples.zh: 我們十點會到達公園。

ready.tip_zh: ready 的 ea 看起來像 read 的長音 [i]，學生常把第一音節唸成 [ri]。其實這裡是短的 [ɛ]，和 red [rɛd] 開頭完全一樣，嘴巴半開、不往兩邊拉。重音在第一音節，第二音節 [dɪ] 要輕而短。可以先唸 red，再輕輕加上 [dɪ]。
ready.tip_en: The ea in ready looks like the long [i] of read, so learners often say the first syllable as [ri]. It is actually the short [ɛ], exactly like the start of red [rɛd]: mouth half open, corners not spread. Stress the first syllable; the second syllable [dɪ] is light and short. You can say red first, then lightly add [dɪ].

examples.en: Are you ready for school?
examples.zh: 你準備好上學了嗎？

examples.en: Dinner is ready, so wash your hands.
examples.zh: 晚餐準備好了，去洗手吧。

ready.spelling_zh: ea 唸短音 [ɛ]，不是 read 的 [i]。
ready.spelling_en: The ea is the short [ɛ], not the [i] of read.

real.tip_zh: real 字尾是暗 L，學生常把它唸成「歐」，或乾脆不發，聽起來只剩 [ri]。[i] 唸完後舌頭後半往下壓，舌尖最後要碰到上排牙齒後面的牙齦停住。[i] 滑向 [l] 時中間會自然帶出一點過渡音，不用刻意切成兩個字。
real.tip_en: Real ends in a dark L, which learners often turn into an "oh" sound or drop, leaving only [ri]. After [i], press the back of the tongue down and finish with the tongue tip touching the ridge behind the upper teeth. A small glide naturally appears between [i] and [l]; don't chop it into two separate words.

examples.en: Is this a real flower or a fake one?
examples.zh: 這是真花還是假花？

examples.en: The movie is about a real dog.
examples.zh: 這部電影是關於一隻真實的狗。

really.tip_zh: really 的重音在第一音節 [ˈrɪ]，第二音節 [lɪ] 的 [l] 在母音前，是清楚的 L，舌尖碰上牙齦後馬上放開。常見錯誤是先唸 real 的暗 L，再加一個「里」，中間多出「歐」的聲音，變成三拍。兩拍就好，第二拍輕。
really.tip_en: Really is stressed on the first syllable [ˈrɪ]. The [l] in the second syllable [lɪ] comes before a vowel, so it is a clear L: touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge and release right away. A common mistake is saying real with its dark L and then adding "lee", which puts an extra "oh" in the middle and makes three beats. Use two beats, the second one light.

examples.en: I really like your drawing.
examples.zh: 我真的很喜歡你的畫。

examples.en: Is it really snowing outside?
examples.zh: 外面真的在下雪嗎？

really.variant_zh: 也常唸 [ˈrilɪ]，第一音節用長音 [i]。
really.variant_en: Also often said [ˈrilɪ], with a long [i] in the first syllable.

reason.tip_zh: reason 中間的 s 要唸成有聲的 [z]，學生常照字母唸成 [s]，聽起來像 "ree-sun"。發 [z] 時舌尖靠近上牙齦，同時喉嚨要振動，可以把手放在喉嚨上檢查。最後的 [ən] 很輕，舌尖貼上牙齦收尾就好，不要唸得像「森」那麼清楚。
reason.tip_en: The s in the middle of reason is the voiced [z]. Learners often read the letter as [s], so it sounds like "ree-sun". For [z], keep the tongue tip near the gum ridge and make the throat vibrate; put a hand on your throat to check. The final [ən] is very light: just end with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, not a full, clear syllable.

examples.en: Tell me the reason you were late.
examples.zh: 告訴我你遲到的理由。

examples.en: There is a good reason for this rule.
examples.zh: 這條規則有很好的理由。

reason.spelling_en: The s is pronounced as a voiced [z].

red.tip_zh: red 字尾的 [d] 常被加上母音唸成「瑞得」，或整個吞掉，只剩 [rɛ]。[ɛ] 嘴巴張開約一指寬，舌尖最後輕輕貼住上牙齦停住，喉嚨保持振動就好，不要再放出聲音。注意 read 的過去式也唸 [rɛd]，和 red 同音。
red.tip_en: Learners often add a vowel after the final [d] of red, or swallow it so only [rɛ] is left. Open the mouth about one finger wide for [ɛ], then rest the tongue tip lightly on the upper gum ridge with the voice still on, and stop there without releasing another sound. Note that the past tense of read is also [rɛd], the same as red.

examples.en: My favorite color is red.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是紅色。

examples.en: She has a red umbrella.
examples.zh: 她有一把紅色的雨傘。

refrigerator.tip_zh: refrigerator 共有五個音節，重音在第二音節 [frɪ]。學生常把開頭 re 唸成又長又重的 [ri]，或把中間的 [dʒə] 吞掉，只剩四拍。修正：開頭 [rə] 輕輕帶過，[frɪ] 用力，接著 [dʒə] 嘴唇微噘、輕輕帶過，最後的 [retɚ] 和 later 押韻。
