refrigerator.tip_en: refrigerator has five syllables, with the stress on the second syllable [frɪ]. Learners often say the opening re as a long, heavy [ri], or swallow the middle [dʒə] so only four beats are left. Fix: let the opening [rə] pass lightly, push on [frɪ], then say [dʒə] with the lips slightly rounded and pass over it lightly; the final [retɚ] rhymes with later.

examples.en: Please put the milk back in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 請把牛奶放回冰箱。

examples.en: Our refrigerator is full of fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 我們的冰箱裝滿了水果和蔬菜。

refrigerator.spelling_zh: 簡稱 fridge 有 d，但 refrigerator 本身沒有 d
refrigerator.spelling_en: The short form fridge has a d, but refrigerator itself does not.

relative.tip_zh: relative 重音在第一音節 [rɛ]，母音是短的 [ɛ]，不是 [i]；看到 re 開頭就唸成 [ri] 是典型的錯誤。中間 [lə] 要輕而短。結尾 [v] 要上齒輕碰下唇、聲帶振動，學生常唸成無聲的 [f]，或在後面多加一個母音。可以先練 give 的結尾 [ɪv]，再接上去。
relative.tip_en: relative is stressed on the first syllable [rɛ], and the vowel is a short [ɛ], not [i]; reading the re- at the start as [ri] is a typical mistake. The middle [lə] should be light and short. For the final [v], rest the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip and keep the voice buzzing; learners often turn it into a voiceless [f] or add an extra vowel after it. Practice the [ɪv] ending of give first, then attach it.

examples.en: My favorite relative is my aunt in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的親戚是住在台中的阿姨。

examples.en: Is that boy your relative or your classmate?
examples.zh: 那個男生是你的親戚還是你的同學？

remember.tip_zh: remember 重音在第二音節 [mɛm]，不在開頭的 [rɪ]。[mɛm] 唸完時雙唇要確實閉住，再直接打開成 [b]，中間不要多塞一個母音。結尾 [bɚ] 要捲舌，不要唸成平平的 [bə]。其實 remember 就是輕的 [rɪ] 加上 member，先把 member 唸熟再加字首。
remember.tip_en: remember is stressed on the second syllable [mɛm], not on the opening [rɪ]. At the end of [mɛm] the lips must close fully, then open straight into [b], with no extra vowel squeezed in between. The ending [bɚ] needs a curled tongue; don't flatten it to [bə]. In fact remember is just a light [rɪ] plus member, so get member smooth first, then add the prefix.

examples.en: Do you remember my phone number?
examples.zh: 你記得我的電話號碼嗎？

examples.en: Remember to bring your homework tomorrow.
examples.zh: 記得明天要帶你的作業。

repeat.tip_zh: repeat 的重音在第二音節 [ˈpit]，學生常把重音放在第一音節，唸成「瑞皮」。第一音節 [rɪ] 要輕、短，快速帶過；第二音節的 [p] 要有明顯的送氣，[i] 拉長又大聲。最後 [t] 舌尖頂住上牙齦停住，不要加母音。
repeat.tip_en: Repeat is stressed on the second syllable [ˈpit], but learners often stress the first one. Say the first syllable [rɪ] lightly and quickly; give the [p] in the second syllable a clear puff of air and make the [i] long and loud. End with the tongue tip pressed on the gum ridge for [t], with no added vowel.

examples.en: Please repeat after me, class.
examples.zh: 同學們，請跟著我唸。

examples.en: Can you repeat the question?
examples.zh: 你可以再說一次問題嗎？

report.tip_zh: report 重音落在第二音節 [ˈpɔrt]。這個音節的 [ɔr] 要先把嘴巴張圓唸 [ɔ]，再把舌頭往後捲，接著才是 [t]；學生常漏掉 [r]，唸成像「波特」的音，或在 [t] 後面多加一個母音。第一音節 [rɪ] 輕輕帶過即可。
report.tip_en: Report is stressed on the second syllable [ˈpɔrt]. For [ɔr], first open the mouth in a rounded shape for [ɔ], then curl the tongue back, and only then add [t]. Learners often leave out the [r] or add a vowel after the [t]. The first syllable [rɪ] is just a light lead-in.

examples.en: I wrote a book report about frogs.
examples.zh: 我寫了一篇關於青蛙的讀書報告。

examples.en: Our class will report on the weather today.
examples.zh: 我們班今天要報告天氣。

reporter.tip_zh: reporter 重音在第二音節 [pɔr]。[ɔ] 後面要接捲舌的 [r]，學生常把這個 [r] 省掉，唸成 [rɪˈpɔtɚ]；接著結尾 [tɚ] 還要再捲一次舌。練法：先慢慢唸 [pɔr]，舌尖往後捲住不放，再接 [tɚ]，最後在前面輕輕加上 [rɪ]。結尾可以跟 quarter 一起練。
reporter.tip_en: reporter is stressed on the second syllable [pɔr]. After [ɔ] there must be a curled [r]; learners often leave it out and say [rɪˈpɔtɚ], and then the ending [tɚ] needs the tongue curled a second time. Practice: say [pɔr] slowly, keep the tongue tip curled back, then add [tɚ], and finally put a light [rɪ] in front. Practice the ending together with quarter.

examples.en: The reporter asked the mayor three questions.
examples.zh: 記者問了市長三個問題。

examples.en: My cousin wants to be a TV reporter.
examples.zh: 我表哥想當電視記者。

rest.tip_zh: rest 字尾有 [s] 和 [t] 兩個子音，學生常在後面加母音，唸成「瑞斯特」三拍，或只唸到 [s] 就停。正確做法是 [s] 的嘶聲送出後，舌尖直接往上頂住牙齦做 [t]，中間不要有母音，整個字一拍完成，跟 best、test 的結尾一樣。
rest.tip_en: Rest ends in two consonants, [s] and [t]. Learners often add vowels and stretch it to three beats, or stop at [s]. Instead, after the hiss of [s], lift the tongue tip straight to the gum ridge for [t] with no vowel in between, so the whole word is one beat, with the same ending as best and test.

examples.en: Let's take a rest under the tree.
examples.zh: 我們在樹下休息一下吧。

examples.en: You should rest after running.
examples.zh: 跑步之後你應該休息一下。

restaurant.tip_zh: restaurant 重音在第一音節 [rɛs]，後面兩拍都輕。學生常照拼字把結尾 rant 唸成 [rænt]，或把重音移到最後。KK 的結尾是 [rɑnt]，其中 [ɑnt] 和 want 押韻：嘴巴張開唸 [ɑ]，再收 [n] 和 [t]。[t] 只要舌尖碰上齒齦停住，不要多唸一個母音。中間的 [tə] 輕輕帶過。
restaurant.tip_en: restaurant is stressed on the first syllable [rɛs]; the two beats after it are light. Learners often follow the spelling and say the ending rant as [rænt], or move the stress to the end. In the KK the ending is [rɑnt], whose [ɑnt] rhymes with want: open the mouth for [ɑ], then close with [n] and [t]. For [t] just touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge and stop; don't add a vowel. The middle [tə] is a light beat.

examples.en: Let's eat dinner at the new restaurant tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚去那家新餐廳吃晚餐吧。

examples.en: This restaurant makes the best noodles in town.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳的麵是鎮上最好吃的。

restaurant.variant_en: Often shortened to two syllables in speech: [ˈrɛstrɑnt].
restaurant.spelling_zh: 中間的 au 不唸 [ɔ]，只是很輕的 [ə]
restaurant.spelling_en: The au in the middle is not [ɔ]; it is only a light [ə].

restroom.tip_zh: restroom 是 rest 加 room 合成的字，主重音在 rest。常見錯誤是兩部分一樣重，或在 [st] 後面加母音，唸成「瑞斯特-入姆」。先唸好 rest [rɛst]，舌尖頂完 [t] 馬上捲舌接 [rum]，中間不停頓；最後 [m] 一定要閉上嘴唇。
restroom.tip_en: Restroom is rest plus room, with the main stress on rest. Common mistakes are giving both parts equal weight, or adding a vowel after [st]. Say rest [rɛst] cleanly, then go straight from the [t] into the curled [r] of [rum] without a pause; close the lips at the end for [m].

examples.en: Where is the restroom, please?
examples.zh: 請問洗手間在哪裡？

examples.en: The restroom is next to the library.
examples.zh: 洗手間在圖書館旁邊。

rice.tip_zh: rice 和 rise 只差最後一個音：rice 是無聲的 [s]，只送氣、喉嚨不振動；rise 是有聲的 [z]。因為結尾無聲，rice 的 [aɪ] 也唸得比較短。開頭 [r] 嘴唇微圓、舌尖不碰任何地方，舌尖一碰上顎就會變成 lice「蝨子」。
rice.tip_en: Rice and rise differ only in the last sound: rice ends in voiceless [s], just air with no throat vibration, while rise ends in voiced [z]. Because the ending is voiceless, the [aɪ] in rice is also a bit shorter. For the initial [r], round the lips slightly and keep the tongue tip from touching anything; if it touches the roof of the mouth, the word turns into lice.

examples.en: We eat rice for dinner every day.
examples.zh: 我們每天晚餐都吃米飯。

examples.en: Can I have more rice, please?
examples.zh: 我可以再多要一點飯嗎？

rich.tip_zh: rich 的 [ɪ] 是短而放鬆的母音，嘴角不要用力往兩邊拉；一旦拉長成 [i]，就變成 reach「到達」。字尾 [tʃ] 嘴唇微微往前，送出一小口氣就結束，學生常加上母音唸成「瑞去」，聽起來多了一個音節。
rich.tip_en: The [ɪ] in rich is short and relaxed; do not pull the corners of your mouth wide. If you stretch it into [i], the word becomes reach. For the final [tʃ], push the lips slightly forward and release one small puff of air. Learners often add a vowel after it, which sounds like an extra syllable.

examples.en: The rich man gave money to our school.
examples.zh: 那位有錢人捐錢給我們學校。

examples.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
examples.zh: 柳橙富含維生素C。

ride.tip_zh: ride 和 right 只差字尾：ride 是有聲的 [d]，前面的 [aɪ] 要唸得比較長；right 是無聲的 [t]，母音比較短促。學生常把 [d] 吞掉，ride 聽起來就像 right。收尾時舌尖頂住上牙齦，喉嚨輕輕振動，不要放出「得」的母音。
ride.tip_en: Ride and right differ only at the end: ride ends in voiced [d], so its [aɪ] is longer, while right ends in voiceless [t] and its vowel is clipped. Learners often swallow the [d], so ride sounds like right. To finish, press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge with a little throat vibration, and don't let a vowel come out after it.

examples.en: I ride my bike to school.
examples.zh: 我騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: Can I ride the pony?
examples.zh: 我可以騎那匹小馬嗎？

right.tip_zh: right 中間的 gh 完全不發音，和 write 唸法一模一樣。字尾 [t] 常被唸成「瑞特」多一個母音，或被整個省略；舌尖頂住上牙齦短短一頓即可。因為結尾是無聲的 [t]，[aɪ] 要唸得比 ride 短促一點，兩個字才分得開。
right.tip_en: The gh in right is completely silent; right sounds exactly like write. Learners often add a vowel after the final [t] or drop it entirely; just press the tongue tip on the gum ridge for a short stop. Because the ending is voiceless [t], the [aɪ] is clipped shorter than in ride, which is how listeners tell the two apart.

examples.en: Turn right at the bakery.
examples.zh: 在麵包店那裡右轉。

examples.en: Raise your right hand if you know.
examples.zh: 知道的人請舉起右手。

right.spelling_zh: gh 不發音，和 write 同音。
right.spelling_en: The gh is silent; it sounds the same as write.

ring.tip_zh: ring 字尾 [ŋ] 是舌根抬起貼住軟顎的鼻音，學生常唸成舌尖的 [n]，變成像 "rin"，或在後面多加 [g]，唸成「令格」。收尾時舌根貼著軟顎不放開，讓聲音從鼻子出來就好。可以先拉長唸 [ŋ]，確認舌尖是放鬆在下面的。
ring.tip_en: The final [ŋ] in ring is made by raising the back of the tongue against the soft palate. Learners often use a tongue-tip [n] instead, or add a [g] at the end. Finish with the back of the tongue held against the soft palate and let the sound come out through the nose. Try holding the [ŋ] long to check that the tongue tip is resting low.

examples.en: My mom has a gold ring.
examples.zh: 我媽媽有一枚金戒指。

examples.en: Did the phone ring a minute ago?
examples.zh: 剛剛電話有響嗎？

rise.tip_zh: rise 結尾的 s 其實唸有聲的 [z]，學生常照拼字唸成 [s]，結果聽起來像 rice「米飯」。[z] 的舌位和 [s] 一樣，差別在喉嚨要開聲、持續振動，可以先唸長長的 [zzz] 再接上去。因為結尾有聲，前面的 [aɪ] 也要拉得比 rice 長。字尾 e 不發音。
rise.tip_en: The s at the end of rise is actually a voiced [z]. Learners often follow the spelling and say [s], which makes it sound like rice. [z] has the same tongue position as [s], but the voice stays on and the throat keeps vibrating; practice a long [zzz] first. Because the ending is voiced, the [aɪ] is longer than in rice. The final e is silent.

examples.en: The sun will rise at six.
examples.zh: 太陽六點會升起。

examples.en: Watch the balloon rise into the sky.
examples.zh: 看那顆氣球升上天空。

rise.spelling_zh: s 唸 [z]，字尾 e 不發音。
rise.spelling_en: The s sounds like [z]; the final e is silent.

river.tip_zh: river 開頭的 [r] 舌尖不要碰到上顎，嘴唇微圓；後面的 [ɪ] 短而放鬆，不要拉長成 [i]。第二音節的 [v] 要上齒輕碰下唇、聲帶振動，學生常唸成 [w] 或 [b]。練法：唸完 [rɪ] 就把上齒放到下唇上，從 [v] 滑進捲舌的 [ɚ]，像 never 的後半段。
river.tip_en: For the opening [r] of river, keep the tongue tip off the roof of the mouth and round the lips a little; the [ɪ] after it is short and relaxed, so don't stretch it into [i]. The [v] of the second syllable needs the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip with the voice buzzing; learners often say [w] or [b] instead. Practice: right after [rɪ], put the upper teeth on the lower lip and slide from [v] into the curled [ɚ], like the second half of never.

examples.en: We had a picnic by the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊野餐。

examples.en: Ducks are swimming in the river.
examples.zh: 鴨子在河裡游泳。

road.tip_zh: road 的 oa 唸 [o]，嘴巴要從半開慢慢滑到嘴唇收圓，不要只唸成一個短短的「喔」。字尾 [d] 常被省略，或加母音唸成「肉德」；舌尖輕頂上牙齦、喉嚨振動收尾就好。road 和 rode（ride 的過去式）唸法相同。
road.tip_en: The oa in road is [o]: glide from a half-open mouth to rounded lips, rather than one short "oh". Learners often drop the final [d] or add a vowel after it; just touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge with the voice on. Road sounds the same as rode, the past tense of ride.

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
examples.zh: 過馬路前要先看左右兩邊。

examples.en: This road goes to the beach.
examples.zh: 這條路通往海邊。

road.spelling_zh: oa 唸 [o]；和 rode 同音。
road.spelling_en: The oa is [o]; it sounds the same as rode.

robot.tip_zh: robot 只有兩個音節，重音在第一音節 [ro]。學生常唸成「羅伯特」，多出一個音節，或把 [o] 唸成很短的「囉」。第一音節 [o] 嘴唇要收圓拉長，第二音節 [bɑt] 嘴巴張大、輕一點，最後 [t] 舌尖頂住牙齦就停，不要加母音。
robot.tip_en: Robot has only two syllables, stressed on the first, [ro]. Learners often add a third syllable or make the [o] very short. Round the lips and lengthen the [o] in the first syllable; open the mouth wide for the lighter second syllable [bɑt], and stop at the [t] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, without adding a vowel.

examples.en: I built a robot with my dad.
examples.zh: 我和爸爸一起做了一個機器人。

examples.en: The robot can clean the floor.
examples.zh: 這台機器人會掃地。

robot.variant_zh: 也常聽到 [ˈrobət]，第二音節弱化。
robot.variant_en: Also often heard as [ˈrobət], with a weak second syllable.

rock.tip_zh: rock 的 o 唸 [ɑ]，嘴巴要張大、下巴往下掉，學生常把嘴唇收圓，唸成像「洛克」的音。字尾 ck 只是一個 [k]，舌根頂住軟顎就停，不要加母音。開頭 [r] 舌尖不能碰上顎，否則會變成 lock「鎖」。
rock.tip_en: The o in rock is [ɑ]: open the mouth wide and drop the jaw. Learners often round their lips instead. The ck at the end is a single [k]: raise the back of the tongue to the soft palate and stop, with no vowel after it. For the initial [r], the tongue tip must not touch the roof of the mouth, or the word becomes lock.

examples.en: The frog is sitting on a big rock.
examples.zh: 青蛙坐在一塊大石頭上。

examples.en: I found a smooth rock by the river.
examples.zh: 我在河邊找到一顆光滑的石頭。

roll.tip_zh: roll 的母音是 [o]，要先把嘴唇收圓，再接字尾暗 L。學生常把 [l] 唸成「歐」，整個字變成兩個圓唇音黏在一起；或把 [o] 唸得太緊變成 [u]，聽起來像 rule。收尾時舌尖碰上牙齦，舌頭後半往下壓，聲音帶點悶悶的感覺。
roll.tip_en: The vowel in roll is [o]: round the lips, then add the final dark L. Learners often turn the [l] into another "oh", so two rounded vowels run together, or tighten the [o] into [u], which sounds like rule. To finish, touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge and press the back of the tongue down, giving a slightly muffled sound.

examples.en: Roll the ball to me.
examples.zh: 把球滾給我。

examples.en: The puppy likes to roll on the grass.
examples.zh: 小狗喜歡在草地上打滾。

room.tip_zh: room 字尾的 [m] 一定要把嘴唇閉起來，學生常唸成 [n] 或 [ŋ]，嘴巴張著結束。[u] 嘴唇收圓往前嘟、聲音拉長，最後雙唇閉合，讓聲音從鼻子出來再停。可以用 room 和 broom 一起練，結尾都是閉嘴的 [m]。
room.tip_en: The final [m] in room requires closed lips. Learners often end with [n] or [ŋ], leaving the mouth open. Push the rounded lips forward for a long [u], then close both lips and let the sound hum through the nose before stopping. Practice room together with broom; both end in a closed-lip [m].

examples.en: Please clean your room before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前請整理你的房間。

examples.en: My room has a big window.
examples.zh: 我的房間有一扇大窗戶。

root.tip_zh: root 的 oo 是長音 [u]，嘴唇要收圓往前嘟，不要唸成 foot 那種短而放鬆的 [ʊ]。字尾 [t] 舌尖頂上牙齦停住，學生常加母音唸成「入特」，或乾脆省略。root 和 room 只差最後一個子音，可以一起練習：一個舌尖頂住，一個雙唇閉上。
root.tip_en: The oo in root is the long [u]: round and push the lips forward, not the short, relaxed [ʊ] of foot. For the final [t], press the tongue tip on the gum ridge and stop; learners often add a vowel or drop it. Root and room differ only in the last consonant, so practice them together: tongue tip up for one, lips closed for the other.

examples.en: The root of the plant is under the soil.
examples.zh: 植物的根在土壤下面。

examples.en: A carrot is a root we can eat.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔是我們可以吃的根。

rope.tip_zh: rope 結尾的 e 不發音，最後一個音是 [p]：雙唇閉起來，輕輕放開就好，學生常在後面加母音唸成「肉普」。[o] 要從半開滑到嘴唇收圓，和 road 的母音一樣，只是收尾換成雙唇的 [p]，而且因為 [p] 無聲，母音比 road 短一點。
rope.tip_en: The final e in rope is silent, so the last sound is [p]: close the lips and release gently. Learners often add a vowel after it. The [o] glides from half open to rounded lips, the same vowel as in road, but it ends with the lip sound [p], and because [p] is voiceless the vowel is a little shorter than in road.

examples.en: Hold the rope with both hands.
examples.zh: 用雙手抓住繩子。

examples.en: We like to jump rope at recess.
examples.zh: 我們下課時喜歡跳繩。

rose.tip_zh: rose 的 s 要唸成有聲的 [z]，學生常照字母唸成 [s]，像「肉斯」。正確是嘴唇收圓唸 [o]，拉長一點，再讓舌尖靠近上牙齦，喉嚨持續振動發 [z]；字尾的 e 不發音。rose 也是 rise 的過去式，兩個意思唸法相同。
rose.tip_en: The s in rose is the voiced [z]; learners often read the letter as [s]. Round the lips for a slightly long [o], then bring the tongue tip near the gum ridge and keep the voice buzzing for [z]. The final e is silent. Rose is also the past tense of rise, pronounced the same way.

examples.en: She gave her mom a red rose.
examples.zh: 她送給媽媽一朵紅玫瑰。

examples.en: This rose smells very sweet.
examples.zh: 這朵玫瑰聞起來很香。

rose.spelling_zh: s 唸 [z]，字尾 e 不發音。
rose.spelling_en: The s sounds like [z]; the final e is silent.

round.tip_zh: round 的 ou 唸 [aʊ]，嘴巴先大開，再滑向圓唇，滑動要完整。字尾 [nd] 是兩個子音：舌尖先貼上牙齦發 [n]，不要放開，直接在同一個位置接 [d]。學生常只唸到 [n] 就停，或加母音唸成「朗德」，多出一拍。
round.tip_en: The ou in round is [aʊ]: start with the mouth wide open and glide all the way to rounded lips. The ending [nd] is two consonants: press the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], keep it there, and add [d] from the same spot. Learners often stop at [n], or add a vowel and make an extra beat.

examples.en: The moon is round tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚的月亮是圓的。

examples.en: We sat at a round table.
examples.zh: 我們坐在一張圓桌旁。

rule.tip_zh: rule 的 [u] 嘴唇往前嘟，接著是字尾暗 L：舌頭後半往下壓、舌尖最後碰上牙齦。學生常把 [l] 省略，聽起來只剩 "roo"，或把 [u] 唸成 [o]，結果變成 roll「滾」。[u] 滑向 [l] 時會自然帶出一點過渡，讓這個字聽起來比較長，這是正常的。
rule.tip_en: In rule, push the lips forward for [u], then add the final dark L: press the back of the tongue down and finish with the tip on the gum ridge. Learners often drop the [l], leaving just "roo", or say [o] instead of [u], which turns it into roll. A small glide naturally appears as [u] moves into [l], so the word sounds a bit long; that is normal.

examples.en: The first rule is to be kind.
examples.zh: 第一條規則是要友善待人。

examples.en: Do you know the rule of this game?
examples.zh: 你知道這個遊戲的規則嗎？

ruler.tip_zh: ruler 是 rule 加上 [ɚ]，重音在第一音節 [ˈru]。中間的 [l] 現在後面接母音，是清楚的 L，舌尖碰上牙齦後放開。最後 [ɚ] 舌頭往後捲，不要唸成「入了」那樣平舌收尾。這個字開頭和結尾各有一個捲舌音，兩次都要捲到。
ruler.tip_en: Ruler is rule plus [ɚ], stressed on the first syllable [ˈru]. The [l] in the middle now comes before a vowel, so it is a clear L: touch the gum ridge with the tongue tip and release. For the final [ɚ], curl the tongue back instead of ending with a flat tongue. The word has an r-sound at the start and at the end; curl the tongue both times.

examples.en: Can I borrow your ruler?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的尺嗎？

examples.en: Draw a straight line with a ruler.
examples.zh: 用尺畫一條直線。

run.tip_zh: run 的 [ʌ] 嘴巴微開、短促放鬆，學生常唸成嘴巴張很大的 [a]，或唸成「軟」那樣帶介音。字尾 [n] 要讓舌尖貼住上牙齦，聲音從鼻子出來後停住；如果舌根抬起變成 [ŋ]，聽起來會像 rung。
run.tip_en: The [ʌ] in run is short and relaxed with the mouth only slightly open. Learners often open the mouth too wide for an [a], or slip in an extra glide sound before the vowel. For the final [n], press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge and let the sound come through the nose before stopping; if the back of the tongue rises instead, it becomes [ŋ] and sounds like rung.

examples.en: I can run very fast.
examples.zh: 我可以跑得很快。

examples.en: Let's run to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我們跑去公車站吧。

sad.tip_zh: sad 的 [æ] 嘴巴要張得比 said [sɛd] 大，嘴角往兩邊拉、下巴往下掉。學生常把 [æ] 唸成 [ɛ]，sad 就變成 said「說了」。字尾 [d] 喉嚨要振動、輕輕收住，不能吞掉，否則聽起來像 sat。練習時把 sad 和 said 輪流唸，感受下巴的高低差別。
sad.tip_en: For the [æ] in sad, open the mouth wider than for said [sɛd]: spread the corners and drop the jaw. Learners often say [ɛ] instead, so sad becomes said. Keep the voice on for the final [d] and close it gently; if you swallow it, the word sounds like sat. Practice by alternating sad and said and feel the difference in how low the jaw drops.

examples.en: The puppy looks sad today.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗今天看起來很難過。

examples.en: Don't be sad, we can play tomorrow.
examples.zh: 別難過，我們明天可以一起玩。

safe.tip_zh: safe 的 a 唸 [e]，嘴巴從半開滑向微笑的嘴形，不要停在短的 [ɛ]。字尾 [f] 是上排牙齒輕碰下唇、往外吹氣，學生常在後面加母音，唸成「謝夫」，或把 [f] 唸得太輕而消失。最後的 e 不發音。
safe.tip_en: The a in safe is [e]: glide from half open toward a smile, rather than stopping at a short [ɛ]. For the final [f], rest the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip and blow. Learners often add a vowel after it, or make the [f] so weak it disappears. The final e is silent.

examples.en: Wear a helmet to stay safe.
examples.zh: 戴上安全帽才能保持安全。

examples.en: Is it safe to swim here?
examples.zh: 在這裡游泳安全嗎？

sail.tip_zh: sail 和 sale 唸法完全一樣，都是 [sel]，ai 不要分成兩個母音唸。先把 [e] 唸清楚、從半開滑到微笑，再把舌頭後半壓低、舌尖碰上牙齦發暗 L。學生常把 [l] 唸成「歐」，或乾脆不發，聽起來就像 say。
sail.tip_en: Sail is pronounced exactly like sale, [sel]; do not split the ai into two vowels. Say a clear [e] that glides from half open toward a smile, then lower the back of the tongue and touch the tip to the gum ridge for the dark L. Learners often turn the [l] into "oh" or drop it, so the word sounds like say.

examples.en: We will sail across the lake.
examples.zh: 我們會乘船橫渡湖面。

examples.en: My uncle likes to sail on weekends.
examples.zh: 我叔叔週末喜歡去駕帆船。

sail.spelling_zh: ai 唸 [e]；和 sale 同音。
sail.spelling_en: The ai is [e]; it sounds the same as sale.

salad.tip_zh: 中文說「沙拉」，學生容易直接照唸：第一音節變成 [sɑ]，結尾的 [d] 也不見了。英文第一音節 [sæ] 要嘴角往兩旁拉、下巴往下放，像 apple 的開頭；第二音節 [ləd] 輕而短，最後舌尖頂住上齒齦停在 [d]，不要再多加一個母音。
salad.tip_en: Because Chinese says 「沙拉」, learners tend to read it the same way: the first syllable becomes [sɑ] and the final [d] disappears. In English the first syllable [sæ] needs the lip corners pulled sideways and the jaw dropped, like the start of apple; the second syllable [ləd] is light and short, ending with the tongue tip pressed on the gum ridge to stop at [d]. Don't add another vowel.

examples.en: I want a chicken salad for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐想吃雞肉沙拉。

examples.en: Mom made a big fruit salad for the party.
examples.zh: 媽媽為派對做了一大盆水果沙拉。

sale.tip_zh: sale 結尾的 e 不發音，最後一個音是暗 L。學生常把 a 照字母唸，或把結尾的 [l] 漏掉，結果 sale 聽起來像 say。練習時拉長 [e]，然後舌尖慢慢往上牙齦靠、舌根略往後縮，聲音變得比較低沉，就是暗 L。它和 sail 同音，靠句子判斷意思。
sale.tip_en: The final e in sale is silent, so the last sound is a dark L. Learners often drop that [l], so sale sounds like say. To practice, hold the [e], then slowly bring the tongue tip up to the gum ridge while pulling the back of the tongue back; the sound gets deeper, and that is the dark L. Sale sounds the same as sail; context tells you which one.

examples.en: These shoes are on sale today.
examples.zh: 這雙鞋今天在特價。

examples.en: Is this bike for sale?
examples.zh: 這台腳踏車要賣嗎？

salesman.tip_zh: salesman 中間的 s 唸有聲的 [z]，不是 [s]；而且最後的 man 要弱化成 [mən]，不要唸成 [mæn]。重音放在第一音節 [selz]，[l] 和 [z] 要緊接著唸，中間不要加母音。第二音節輕輕帶過，最後 [n] 舌尖貼上牙齦收尾。
salesman.tip_en: The middle s in salesman is the voiced [z], not [s], and the final man is reduced to [mən], not [mæn]. Stress the first syllable [selz] and run the [l] straight into the [z] without a vowel between them. The second syllable is light, ending with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n].

examples.en: The salesman showed us a new car.
examples.zh: 那位推銷員給我們看一台新車。

examples.en: A salesman came to our door.
examples.zh: 一位推銷員來到我們家門口。

salesman.spelling_zh: 中間的 s 唸 [z]；man 唸 [mən]。
salesman.spelling_en: The middle s is [z]; man is said [mən].

salt.tip_zh: salt 的 a 唸 [ɔ]，嘴巴張開、嘴唇稍微圓，不是 sad 的 [æ]。字尾有 [l] 和 [t] 兩個子音：舌頭後半先壓低發暗 L，舌尖接著頂住上牙齦做 [t]。學生常漏掉 [l]，只剩 [sɔt]，或在 [t] 後面加母音。可以先唸 all，再在前面加 [s]、後面加 [t]。
salt.tip_en: The a in salt is [ɔ]: open the mouth with the lips slightly rounded, not the [æ] of sad. The word ends in two consonants, [l] and [t]: first lower the back of the tongue for the dark L, then press the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [t]. Learners often leave out the [l], leaving just [sɔt], or add a vowel after the [t]. You can say all first, then add [s] in front and [t] after it.

examples.en: Could you please pass the salt?
examples.zh: 可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？

examples.en: Don't put too much salt in the soup.
examples.zh: 湯裡不要放太多鹽。

same.tip_zh: same 的 a 唸 [e]，從半開滑向嘴角微拉。字尾 [m] 一定要閉上雙唇，學生常唸成舌尖的 [n]，或鼻音含糊帶過，結尾嘴巴還開著。唸完 [e] 後慢慢把嘴唇合起來、讓聲音在鼻子裡哼一下再停。最後的 e 不發音。
same.tip_en: The a in same is [e], gliding from half open toward slightly spread lips. The final [m] needs closed lips; learners often use a tongue-tip [n] or blur the nasal so the mouth is still open at the end. After [e], close the lips and let the sound hum in the nose briefly before stopping. The final e is silent.

examples.en: We are in the same class.
examples.zh: 我們在同一班。

examples.en: My shoes are the same color as yours.
examples.zh: 我的鞋和你的顏色一樣。

sandwich.tip_zh: 中文的「三明治」會讓學生把 [sæn] 唸成平平的 [sɑn]。[æ] 要嘴巴張大、嘴角往兩旁拉。第二音節 [wɪtʃ] 和 which 同音，[ɪ] 短而放鬆。結尾 [tʃ] 是無聲的，嘴唇微噘送氣就好，學生常在後面多加一個母音。中間的 [d] 輕輕帶過即可，美國人口語甚至常省略。
sandwich.tip_en: The Chinese word 「三明治」 leads learners to flatten [sæn] into [sɑn]. For [æ], open the mouth wide and pull the lip corners sideways. The second syllable [wɪtʃ] sounds the same as which, with a short, relaxed [ɪ]. The final [tʃ] is voiceless: just push the lips forward slightly and release air; learners often add a vowel after it. The [d] in the middle only needs a light touch, and Americans often drop it in everyday speech.

examples.en: I made a ham and egg sandwich for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐做了一個火腿蛋三明治。

examples.en: Can I have half of your sandwich?
examples.zh: 可以分我一半你的三明治嗎？

sandwich.variant_zh: 口語常省略 d，唸成 [ˈsænwɪtʃ] 或 [ˈsæmwɪtʃ]
sandwich.variant_en: In speech the d is often dropped: [ˈsænwɪtʃ] or [ˈsæmwɪtʃ].

saturday.tip_zh: Saturday 重音在第一音節 [sæ]，嘴巴要張大。學生常照拼字把中間的 tur 唸得又重又長，其實 [tɚ] 只是輕輕一拍的捲舌音；最後的 day 也不要唸得像單字 day 那麼用力，KK 標的是輕的 [dɪ]。整個字的節奏是「重、輕、輕」，三拍裡只有第一拍用力。
saturday.tip_en: Saturday is stressed on the first syllable [sæ], with the mouth open wide. Learners often follow the spelling and make the middle tur heavy and long, but [tɚ] is just one light, curled beat; and the final day should not be as strong as the word day on its own, since the KK marks it as a light [dɪ]. The rhythm of the whole word is 'strong, light, light': only the first of the three beats is pushed.

examples.en: We go swimming every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期六早上都去游泳。

examples.en: My birthday party is on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我的生日派對在星期六。

save.tip_zh: save 字尾的 [v] 是上排牙齒輕碰下唇、喉嚨同時振動。學生常唸成無聲的 [f]，save 就變成 safe「安全的」；或用雙唇唸成 [b]。因為結尾有聲，前面的 [e] 要比 safe 拉得長一點。最後的 e 不發音。
save.tip_en: The final [v] in save is made with the upper teeth on the lower lip while the throat vibrates. Learners often make it a voiceless [f], so save turns into safe, or use both lips and make a [b]. Because the ending is voiced, the [e] is held a little longer than in safe. The final e is silent.

examples.en: I save my coins in a jar.
examples.zh: 我把硬幣存在罐子裡。

examples.en: Turn off the lights to save energy.
examples.zh: 關燈來節省能源。

say.tip_zh: say 的 [e] 要從嘴巴半開滑到嘴角往兩邊拉，學生常停在短的 [ɛ]，不滑動。另外要注意：say 是 [se]，但 says 唸 [sɛz]、said 唸 [sɛd]，母音都變成短的 [ɛ]，不能照 say 的唸法類推，這是最容易唸錯的地方。最後的 y 不是另一個音。
say.tip_en: The [e] in say should glide from a half-open mouth to spread lips; learners often stop on a short [ɛ] without gliding. Also note: say is [se], but says is [sɛz] and said is [sɛd], both with the short [ɛ]. Don't copy the vowel of say into them; that is the most common slip. The final y is not a separate sound.

examples.en: Sorry, what did you say?
examples.zh: 不好意思，你剛剛說什麼？

examples.en: Say hello to your grandma for me.
examples.zh: 幫我跟你奶奶問好。

say.spelling_zh: says 唸 [sɛz]、said 唸 [sɛd]，母音不同。
say.spelling_en: Says is [sɛz] and said is [sɛd]; the vowel changes.

scared.tip_zh: scared 開頭 [sk] 中間不要加母音；s 後面的 [k] 不送氣，聽起來接近 [g]，學生常用力送氣，或唸成「斯給爾德」。[ɛr] 嘴巴半開再捲舌，結尾的 -ed 不另外成一個音節，舌尖從捲舌的位置直接頂上牙齦發 [d]，整個字只有一拍。
scared.tip_en: Don't put a vowel inside the opening [sk] of scared. After s, the [k] has no puff of air, so it sounds close to [g]; learners often aspirate it strongly or break the word into several beats. For [ɛr], open the mouth halfway and then curl the tongue. The -ed is not a separate syllable: move the tongue tip from the curled position straight up to the gum ridge for [d]. The whole word is one beat.

examples.en: My little sister is scared of the dark.
examples.zh: 我妹妹怕黑。

examples.en: Don't be scared, it's only a cat.
examples.zh: 別怕，那只是一隻貓。

scared.spelling_en: The -ed is not an extra syllable; it is just [d].

school.tip_zh: school 只有一個音節。學生常在 [s] 和 [k] 之間多加一個母音，唸成兩拍；也常把結尾的 [l] 省掉，只剩 [sku]。修正：[s] 直接接 [k]，而且 s 後面的 [k] 不送氣，聽起來接近 [g]；[u] 唸完後舌尖往上頂住上齒齦，發出暗 L，就像 cool 的結尾一樣。
school.tip_en: school has only one syllable. Learners often add a vowel between [s] and [k], making two beats, and often drop the final [l], leaving just [sku]. Fix: go straight from [s] into [k], and a [k] after s has no puff of air, so it sounds close to [g]; after [u], raise the tongue tip to the gum ridge to make a dark L, just like the end of cool.

examples.en: I walk to school with my sister.
examples.zh: 我和姊姊一起走路上學。

examples.en: Our school has a big library.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一間很大的圖書館。

school.spelling_zh: ch 在這裡唸 [k]，h 不發音
school.spelling_en: Here ch sounds like [k]; the h is silent.

science.tip_zh: science 有兩個音節：重的 [saɪ] 加上很輕的 [əns]。學生常把它擠成一拍，或漏掉 [n]，唸成 [ˈsaɪəs]；也常在字尾 [ns] 後面多加一個母音。修正：唸 [n] 時舌尖已經頂在上齒齦，舌頭保持不動，直接送出 [s] 的氣就收尾，不要再張嘴發出母音。
science.tip_en: science has two syllables: a strong [saɪ] plus a very light [əns]. Learners often squeeze it into one beat, or drop the [n] and say [ˈsaɪəs]; they also often add a vowel after the final [ns]. Fix: when you say [n] the tongue tip is already on the gum ridge, so keep the tongue still, push out the [s] air and stop there, without opening the mouth for another vowel.

examples.en: Science is my favorite subject at school.
examples.zh: 自然科學是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.en: We did a fun science project about plants.
examples.zh: 我們做了一個關於植物的有趣科學專題。

science.spelling_zh: 開頭 sc 只唸一個 [s]，c 不發音
science.spelling_en: The opening sc makes just one [s]; the c is silent.

scooter.tip_zh: scooter 開頭 [sk] 之間不要加母音，[k] 不送氣。重音在第一音節 [sku]，[u] 嘴唇嘟圓拉長。美式發音裡，[u] 和 [ɚ] 中間的 [t] 常唸成舌尖快速一彈，聽起來像輕輕的 [d]。最後 [ɚ] 捲舌，不要唸成「斯酷特」那樣三個平平的音。
scooter.tip_en: Don't put a vowel between the s and k at the start of scooter, and give the [k] no puff of air. Stress the first syllable [sku] with long, rounded [u]. In American English the [t] between [u] and [ɚ] is often a quick tap of the tongue tip that sounds like a light [d]. Curl the tongue for the final [ɚ], instead of three flat, separate beats.

examples.en: My dad rides a scooter to work.
examples.zh: 我爸爸騎機車上班。

examples.en: Put on your helmet before you ride the scooter.
examples.zh: 騎機車前要先戴上安全帽。

screen.tip_zh: screen 開頭 [skr] 三個子音要一口氣連起來，學生常在中間加母音，唸成「斯克林」三拍。先發 [s]，舌根馬上碰軟顎發不送氣的 [k]，接著舌頭往後捲成 [r]，再拉長 [i]。字尾 [n] 舌尖貼上牙齦，不要唸成 [ŋ]。
screen.tip_en: The three consonants [skr] at the start of screen must run together in one go; learners often put vowels between them and make three beats. Say [s], immediately touch the back of the tongue to the soft palate for an unaspirated [k], curl the tongue back for [r], then hold a long [i]. End with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], not [ŋ].

examples.en: Don't sit too close to the screen.
examples.zh: 不要坐得離螢幕太近。

examples.en: The phone screen is very bright.
examples.zh: 手機螢幕很亮。

sea.tip_zh: sea 和 see 同音，都是 [si]。開頭 [s] 舌尖靠近上牙齦、嘴角往兩邊拉，氣流細細的。學生常用中文「西」的音代替，那個音舌面抬得太高，介於 [s] 和 [ʃ] 之間，聽起來會像 she「她」。[s] 先唸清楚，再接拉長的 [i]。
sea.tip_en: Sea sounds the same as see, [si]. For the opening [s], keep the tongue tip near the gum ridge and the lips spread, with a thin stream of air. Learners often use the Mandarin sound in 西 instead; it raises the middle of the tongue too high and lands between [s] and [ʃ], so it can sound like she. Make the [s] clear first, then add a long [i].

examples.en: We swam in the sea last summer.
examples.zh: 我們去年夏天在海裡游泳。

examples.en: The sea is blue and calm today.
examples.zh: 今天的海又藍又平靜。

season.tip_zh: season 有兩個 s，唸法不一樣：第一個是無聲的 [s]，第二個是有聲的 [z]。學生常兩個都唸 [s]。唸到第二音節時把手放在喉嚨上，要感覺到振動；字尾 [ən] 輕而短，舌尖貼上牙齦就好。season 和 reason 押韻，可以一起練。
season.tip_en: Season has two s letters with different sounds: the first is voiceless [s], the second is voiced [z]. Learners often say [s] both times. When you reach the second syllable, put a hand on your throat and feel the vibration. The ending [ən] is light and short; just rest the tongue tip on the gum ridge. Season rhymes with reason, so practice them together.

examples.en: Summer is my favorite season.
examples.zh: 夏天是我最喜歡的季節。

examples.en: Which season do you like best?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡哪個季節？

seat.tip_zh: seat 的 ea 唸長音 [i]，嘴角往兩邊拉、聲音拉長；如果唸成短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，就變成 sit「坐」。字尾 [t] 舌尖頂住上牙齦停住，學生常加母音唸成「西特」，或乾脆省略。seat 和 sit 一起練，感受嘴角用力和放鬆的差別。
seat.tip_en: The ea in seat is the long [i]: spread the corners of the mouth and hold the sound. If you make it a short, relaxed [ɪ], the word becomes sit. For the final [t], press the tongue tip on the gum ridge and stop; learners often add a vowel or drop it. Practice seat and sit together to feel tense versus relaxed lips.

examples.en: Please go back to your seat.
examples.zh: 請回到你的座位。

examples.en: Is anyone sitting in this seat?
examples.zh: 這個位子有人坐嗎？

second.tip_zh: second 重音在第一音節 [ˈsɛ]，第二音節 [kənd] 要弱化，母音是輕的 [ə]，不要唸成「康」那樣飽滿。字尾 [nd] 兩個子音都要有：舌尖貼著上牙齦發 [n]，不放開就接 [d]。學生常只唸到 [n]，或在最後加母音唸成「賽肯得」。
second.tip_en: Second is stressed on the first syllable [ˈsɛ]. The second syllable [kənd] is reduced, with a light [ə], not a full vowel. Both final consonants [nd] must be there: hold the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n] and add [d] without letting go. Learners often stop at [n], or add a vowel at the end.

examples.en: I came in second in the race.
examples.zh: 我在賽跑中得了第二名。

examples.en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我們的教室在二樓。

secretary.tip_zh: secretary 看起來是 secret 加 ary，但開頭母音不同：secret 是 [i]，secretary 是短的 [ɛ]，要唸 [sɛk]。重音在第一音節，第二音節 [rə] 很輕，第三音節 [tɛ] 稍微用力一點，最後 [rɪ] 和 very 的結尾一樣。美式要唸滿四拍，不要吞成三拍。
secretary.tip_en: secretary looks like secret plus ary, but the first vowel is different: secret has [i], while secretary has a short [ɛ], so say [sɛk]. The stress is on the first syllable; the second syllable [rə] is very light, the third syllable [tɛ] gets a little more push, and the final [rɪ] is the same as the end of very. American English says all four beats; don't squash it into three.

examples.en: The school secretary answered the phone.
examples.zh: 學校的秘書接了電話。

examples.en: My aunt works as a secretary in an office.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在一間辦公室當秘書。

see.tip_zh: 中文沒有「ㄙ＋ㄧ」這個組合，學生常把 see 唸成「西」：舌面抬高，聽起來偏向 she [ʃi]。修正：發 [s] 時舌面放平、舌尖靠近上排牙齒後方，嘴角往兩旁拉，發出細細的嘶聲，再接拉長的 [i]。可以對照練 see 和 she，也要讓 [i] 的嘴角保持拉緊，別滑成 say [se]。
see.tip_en: Mandarin has no ㄙ+ㄧ combination, so learners often say see like 「西」: the body of the tongue rises and it drifts toward she [ʃi]. Fix: for [s], keep the tongue flat with the tip near the back of the upper teeth and the lip corners pulled sideways, making a thin hiss, then add a long [i]. Practice see and she side by side, and keep the lip corners tight on [i] so it doesn't slide into say [se].

examples.en: Can you see the bird in the tree?
examples.zh: 你看得到樹上的那隻鳥嗎？

examples.en: I'm so happy to see you again!
examples.zh: 好高興再見到你！

seed.tip_zh: seed 和 seat 的差別全在結尾：seed 是有聲的 [d]，所以前面的 [i] 要唸得更長、更飽滿；seat 是無聲 [t]，母音較短。學生常把 [d] 吞掉，兩個字聽起來一樣。收尾時舌尖輕頂上牙齦，喉嚨保持振動，不要放出「得」的母音。
seed.tip_en: The whole difference between seed and seat is at the end: seed ends in voiced [d], so its [i] is longer and fuller, while seat ends in voiceless [t] with a shorter vowel. Learners often swallow the [d], so the two words sound alike. Finish with the tongue tip lightly on the gum ridge and the voice still on, without letting a vowel out after it.

examples.en: Plant the seed in the soil.
examples.zh: 把種子種在土裡。

examples.en: This apple seed is very small.
examples.zh: 這顆蘋果籽很小。

seesaw.tip_zh: seesaw 有兩個音節，主重音在第一音節 [si]，第二音節 [sɔ] 帶次重音。兩個 s 都是清楚的 [s]，不要唸成 [ʃ]。第一音節嘴角往兩邊拉成 [i]，第二音節嘴巴張開、嘴唇稍圓成 [ɔ]，兩個母音嘴形要明顯不同，不要都唸成扁扁的音。
seesaw.tip_en: Seesaw has two syllables: main stress on the first, [si], and secondary stress on the second, [sɔ]. Both s sounds are clear [s], not [ʃ]. Spread the lips for [i] in the first syllable, then open the mouth with slightly rounded lips for [ɔ] in the second. The two vowels need clearly different mouth shapes, not two flat sounds.

examples.en: Let's play on the seesaw.
examples.zh: 我們去玩蹺蹺板吧。

examples.en: The seesaw goes up and down.
examples.zh: 蹺蹺板上上下下。

seldom.tip_zh: seldom 重音在第一音節 [ˈsɛl]。這裡的 [l] 後面接子音 [d]，是暗 L，舌尖要碰到上牙齦，學生常把它省略，唸成像 "sed-um"。第二音節 [dəm] 很輕，母音是弱的 [ə]，結尾 [m] 要閉上嘴唇，不要變成 [n]。整個字是兩拍，第一拍重、第二拍輕。
seldom.tip_en: Seldom is stressed on the first syllable [ˈsɛl]. The [l] comes before the consonant [d], so it is a dark L, and the tongue tip must reach the gum ridge; learners often skip it. The second syllable [dəm] is light with a weak [ə], and the final [m] needs closed lips, not an [n]. The word has two beats: strong, then light.

examples.en: My dad seldom eats candy.
examples.zh: 我爸爸很少吃糖果。

examples.en: It seldom snows in Taipei.
examples.zh: 台北很少下雪。

sell.tip_zh: sell 的母音是短的 [ɛ]，嘴巴半開、不滑動；sale 是 [e]，要滑向微笑嘴形，兩個字別混淆。字尾暗 L 常被唸成「歐」，或省略掉只剩 [sɛ]。收尾時舌尖要貼住上牙齦，舌頭後半往下壓，雙 l 也只是一個 [l]。
sell.tip_en: The vowel in sell is the short [ɛ]: mouth half open, no glide. Sale has [e], which glides toward a smile, so don't mix the two up. Learners often turn the final dark L into "oh" or drop it, leaving just [sɛ]. To finish, hold the tongue tip on the gum ridge and press the back of the tongue down; the double l is still just one [l].

examples.en: They sell ice cream at the park.
examples.zh: 他們在公園賣冰淇淋。

examples.en: We sell cookies to raise money.
examples.zh: 我們賣餅乾來募款。

send.tip_zh: send 字尾的 [nd]：舌尖貼住上牙齦發 [n]，接著在同一個位置輕輕放出有聲的 [d]。學生常漏掉 [d]，或在後面多加母音唸成「森德」。[ɛ] 要嘴巴半開、嘴角稍微往兩邊，不要唸成中文「森」那種含糊的央元音。
send.tip_en: For the ending [nd] in send, hold the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n], then gently release a voiced [d] from the same spot. Learners often leave out the [d] or add a vowel after it. The [ɛ] needs a half-open mouth with slightly spread lips, not the vague central vowel of the Mandarin syllable sen.

examples.en: Please send me a photo.
examples.zh: 請傳一張照片給我。

examples.en: I will send a card to my grandpa.
examples.zh: 我會寄一張卡片給爺爺。

sentence.tip_zh: sentence 第二音節是成音節的 [ṇ]，中間沒有清楚的母音：[t] 之後舌尖不離開上牙齦，直接把聲音從鼻子送出成 [n]，最後接 [s]。學生常照拼字唸成「森天斯」，把第二音節唸得太清楚。重音放在第一音節 [ˈsɛn]，第二音節要輕。
sentence.tip_en: The second syllable of sentence is a syllabic [ṇ] with no clear vowel: after [t], keep the tongue tip on the gum ridge and send the sound out through the nose as [n], then finish with [s]. Learners often follow the spelling and pronounce the second syllable too fully. Stress the first syllable [ˈsɛn] and keep the second one light.

examples.en: Read the first sentence aloud.
examples.zh: 把第一個句子大聲唸出來。

examples.en: Make a sentence with this word.
examples.zh: 用這個字造一個句子。

september.tip_zh: September 重音在第二音節 [tɛm]，學生常把第一音節 [sɛp] 唸得最重。[sɛp] 的 [p] 只要雙唇閉上，不要放出母音，直接接 [tɛm]，否則會多出一拍。[tɛm] 和 [bɚ] 之間雙唇保持閉合，從 [m] 順勢推出 [b]。結尾和 November、December 一樣要捲舌。
september.tip_en: September is stressed on the second syllable [tɛm]; learners often make the first syllable [sɛp] the strongest. For the [p] in [sɛp], just close the lips without releasing a vowel and go straight into [tɛm], or an extra beat appears. Between [tɛm] and [bɚ] keep the lips closed and push from [m] straight into [b]. The ending is curled, just like November and December.

examples.en: The new school year starts in September.
examples.zh: 新學年在九月開始。

examples.en: My brother's birthday is in September.
examples.zh: 我哥哥的生日在九月。

serious.tip_zh: serious 有三個音節，重音在第一音節 [sɪ]。開頭 [s] 後面是放鬆的短音 [ɪ]，接著舌頭立刻捲成 [r]。學生常照拼字把 ser 唸成 service 開頭那樣的 [sɝ]，變成 [ˈsɝɪəs]。結尾的 ious 只唸輕的 [ɪəs]，兩個母音滑過去即可，不要每個字母都用力唸出來。
serious.tip_en: serious has three syllables, with the stress on the first syllable [sɪ]. After the opening [s] comes a short, relaxed [ɪ], and then the tongue curls straight into [r]. Learners often follow the spelling and say ser like the [sɝ] at the start of service, giving [ˈsɝɪəs]. The ending ious is just a light [ɪəs]: glide through the two vowels and don't push out every letter.

examples.en: Don't worry, it's not a serious problem.
examples.zh: 別擔心，這不是什麼嚴重的問題。

examples.en: Why do you look so serious today?
examples.zh: 你今天為什麼看起來這麼嚴肅？

service.tip_zh: service 重音在第一音節 [sɝ]，這是捲舌的長母音：舌頭往後捲、嘴唇微圓，跟 sir 的母音一樣，不要唸成沒有捲舌的 [sʌ]。第二音節的 [v] 要上齒碰下唇並振動聲帶，學生常唸成 [w] 或 [b]。結尾很輕，只有 [vəs]，不要照拼字唸成 [vaɪs]。
service.tip_en: service is stressed on the first syllable [sɝ], a long curled vowel: pull the tongue back and curl it, round the lips slightly (the same vowel as sir), and don't flatten it into an uncurled [sʌ]. The [v] of the second syllable needs the upper teeth on the lower lip with the voice buzzing; learners often say [w] or [b]. The ending is very light, just [vəs]; don't follow the spelling and say [vaɪs].

examples.en: The service at this restaurant is very good.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳的服務很好。

examples.en: Our school has a bus service for students.
examples.zh: 我們學校有提供學生搭乘的校車服務。

service.spelling_zh: 字尾的 ice 不唸 [aɪs]，只唸輕的 [əs]
service.spelling_en: The final -ice is not [aɪs]; it is just a light [əs].

set.tip_zh: set 的 [ɛ] 嘴巴半開；張得太大會變成 sat [sæt]，嘴角拉太開又會變成 seat [sit]，三個字只差母音。字尾 [t] 舌尖頂上牙齦就停，在句子裡常聽不到放開的氣，但舌頭動作不能省略，也不要加母音唸成「賽特」。
set.tip_en: The [ɛ] in set uses a half-open mouth. Open too wide and it becomes sat [sæt]; spread the lips too much and it becomes seat [sit]. These three words differ only in the vowel. For the final [t], press the tongue tip on the gum ridge and stop; in a sentence you may not hear the release, but the tongue must still make the stop, and don't add a vowel after it.

examples.en: Please set the table for dinner.
examples.zh: 請擺好餐具準備吃晚餐。

examples.en: I got a new set of colored pencils.
examples.zh: 我得到一套新的色鉛筆。

seven.tip_zh: seven 的 [v] 夾在兩個母音中間，學生常偷懶唸成 [b] 或 [f]，變成 [ˈsɛbən]。修正：唸完 [sɛ]，上齒輕輕放到下唇，讓聲帶振動，再滑到 [ən]。結尾是舌尖頂上齒齦的 [n]，不是舌根的 [ŋ]，所以舌尖最後要碰到上排牙齒後方。可以跟 eleven 的結尾 [vən] 一起練。
seven.tip_en: The [v] in seven sits between two vowels, and learners often take a shortcut and say [b] or [f], giving [ˈsɛbən]. Fix: after [sɛ], rest the upper teeth lightly on the lower lip, keep the voice buzzing, then slide into [ən]. The ending is [n] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, not [ŋ] at the back of the tongue, so the tongue tip must finish just behind the upper teeth. Practice it together with the [vən] ending of eleven.

examples.en: My little brother is seven years old.
examples.zh: 我弟弟七歲。

examples.en: We eat breakfast at seven every morning.
examples.zh: 我們每天早上七點吃早餐。

seventeen.tip_zh: seventeen 和 seventy 很容易聽錯，差別在最後一拍。seventeen 結尾的 [tin] 要唸清楚、拉長：[t] 送氣，母音是長的 [i]，最後舌尖頂住上齒齦收 [n]。單獨數數時 [tin] 也是重音。seventy 的結尾則是短而輕的 [tɪ]，沒有 [n]。中間 [vən] 的 [v] 別忘了上齒碰下唇。
seventeen.tip_en: seventeen and seventy are easy to mix up; the difference is in the last beat. The [tin] at the end of seventeen must be clear and long: aspirate the [t], make the vowel a long [i], and finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge for [n]. When counting on its own, [tin] is stressed too. seventy ends in a short, light [tɪ] with no [n]. In the middle [vən], don't forget the upper teeth on the lower lip for [v].

examples.en: My cousin is seventeen years old.
examples.zh: 我表姊十七歲。

examples.en: There are seventeen students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有十七個學生。

seventy.tip_zh: seventy 重音在第一音節 [sɛ]，後面兩拍 [vən] 和 [tɪ] 都要輕而短。學生常把重音移到結尾 ty，或把 [tɪ] 拉成長音 [i]，結果聽起來像 seventeen。修正：用力唸 [sɛ]，[v] 上齒碰下唇，最後 [tɪ] 短短帶過、嘴巴放鬆，而且字尾沒有 [n]。
seventy.tip_en: seventy is stressed on the first syllable [sɛ]; the two beats after it, [vən] and [tɪ], are light and short. Learners often move the stress to the ending ty or stretch the vowel of [tɪ] into a long [i], so it sounds like seventeen. Fix: push hard on [sɛ], put the upper teeth on the lower lip for [v], and let the final [tɪ] pass quickly with a relaxed mouth; there is no [n] at the end.

examples.en: My grandpa is seventy years old.
examples.zh: 我爺爺七十歲。

examples.en: This storybook has seventy pages.
examples.zh: 這本故事書有七十頁。

seventy.variant_zh: 口語中 [n] 後面的 [t] 常弱化，聽起來像 [ˈsɛvənɪ]
seventy.variant_en: In casual speech the [t] after [n] often fades, so it sounds like [ˈsɛvənɪ].

several.tip_zh: several 重音在第一音節 [sɛv]。[v] 要上齒輕咬下唇並振動，學生常唸成 [b]；接著直接滑進 [r]，中間不必塞一個清楚的母音。最容易出錯的是結尾：[rəl] 的暗 L 常被省略或唸成 [o]，要在最後讓舌尖頂住上齒齦，舌根同時往後抬，聲音才會飽滿。
several.tip_en: several is stressed on the first syllable [sɛv]. For [v], bite the lower lip lightly with the upper teeth and keep it buzzing; learners often say [b]. Then slide directly into [r] without inserting a clear vowel. The ending is where it most often goes wrong: the dark L in [rəl] gets dropped or turned into [o]. Finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge while the back of the tongue lifts, so the sound is full.

examples.en: I have several good friends in my class.
examples.zh: 我在班上有幾個好朋友。

examples.en: We waited at the bus stop for several minutes.
examples.zh: 我們在公車站等了幾分鐘。

several.variant_en: Also often said with three syllables: [ˈsɛvɚəl].

shake.tip_zh: shake 開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇要往前嘟，舌頭比 [s] 更往後縮，學生常唸成 [s]，變成 sake，或用中文「謝」那種舌面音代替。中間 [e] 從半開滑到微笑嘴形，字尾 [k] 舌根碰軟顎輕輕停住，最後的 e 不發音。
shake.tip_en: For the opening [ʃ] of shake, push the lips forward and pull the tongue back farther than for [s]. Learners often say [s], which gives sake, or use the Mandarin sound in 謝, which is made with the middle of the tongue. The [e] glides from half open toward a smile, and the final [k] is a light stop with the back of the tongue on the soft palate. The final e is silent.

examples.en: Shake the bottle before you drink.
examples.zh: 喝之前先搖一搖瓶子。

examples.en: Let's shake hands and be friends.
examples.zh: 我們握握手，當好朋友吧。

shape.tip_zh: shape 和 shake 只差最後一個音：shape 結尾是雙唇的 [p]，嘴唇閉起來就停住，學生常再放出一個母音，唸成「些普」。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇往前圓，氣流比 [s] 更寬、更像「噓」的聲音。中間 [e] 要滑動，結尾 e 不發音。
shape.tip_en: Shape and shake differ only in the last sound: shape ends in the lip sound [p], so close the lips and stop. Learners often release an extra vowel after it. For the opening [ʃ], round the lips forward; the airflow is wider than for [s], like a "shh" sound. The [e] in the middle glides, and the final e is silent.

examples.en: What shape is this cookie?
examples.zh: 這塊餅乾是什麼形狀？

examples.en: A star is my favorite shape.
examples.zh: 星形是我最喜歡的形狀。

share.tip_zh: share 的 are 唸 [ɛr]：嘴巴先半開唸 [ɛ]，再把舌頭往後捲成 [r]，中間不要停。學生常唸成「謝爾」兩拍，或捲舌不夠，只剩 [ʃɛ]。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇嘟出，舌頭不要碰到牙齒；整個字是一個音節，一口氣唸完。
share.tip_en: The are in share is [ɛr]: open the mouth halfway for [ɛ], then curl the tongue back into [r] without stopping. Learners often split it into two beats, or don't curl enough and leave only [ʃɛ]. For the opening [ʃ], push the lips out and keep the tongue off the teeth. The whole word is one syllable, said in one breath.

examples.en: Let's share the pizza with Grandma.
examples.zh: 我們跟奶奶一起分這個披薩吧。

examples.en: Can you share your crayons with me?
examples.zh: 你可以跟我分享你的蠟筆嗎？

sharp.tip_zh: sharp 的 ar 唸 [ɑr]：先把嘴巴張大唸 [ɑ]，再把舌頭往後捲，最後雙唇閉合發 [p]。學生常漏掉 [r]，唸起來和 shop [ʃɑp] 一樣，或在 [p] 後面加母音。[r] 和 [p] 中間不要停頓，捲舌的同時就準備閉嘴唇。整個字只有一個音節。
sharp.tip_en: The ar in sharp is [ɑr]: open the mouth wide for [ɑ], curl the tongue back, then close the lips for [p]. Learners often leave out the [r], so it sounds just like shop [ʃɑp], or add a vowel after the [p]. Don't pause between [r] and [p]; get the lips ready to close while the tongue is still curled. The whole word is one syllable.

examples.en: My pencil is very sharp.
examples.zh: 我的鉛筆很尖。

examples.en: Our cat has very sharp claws.
examples.zh: 我們家的貓爪子很利。

she.tip_zh: she 和 sea 只差第一個音：she 是 [ʃ]，嘴唇往前嘟、舌頭往後縮；sea 是 [s]，嘴角往兩邊拉。中文的捲舌「ㄕ」舌尖翹得太高，也不是 [ʃ]。練習時先嘟嘴發長長的 [ʃ] 噓聲，舌尖放平不翹起，再接拉長的 [i]。
she.tip_en: She and sea differ only in the first sound: she has [ʃ], with lips pushed forward and the tongue pulled back; sea has [s], with the lips spread. The Mandarin retroflex sound written ㄕ curls the tongue tip too high, so it is not [ʃ] either. Practice a long "shh" with rounded lips and a flat tongue tip, then add a long [i].

examples.en: She is my best friend.
examples.zh: 她是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: She likes to read comic books.
examples.zh: 她喜歡看漫畫書。

sheep.tip_zh: sheep 和 ship 只差在母音：sheep 是長而緊的 [i]，嘴角往兩旁拉、像在微笑，可以稍微拉長；ship 則是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]。學生常把兩個字唸成一樣。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇往前噘，不要讓舌頭先碰上顎變成 [tʃ]，否則就成了 cheap。結尾 [p] 雙唇閉上即可，不要再加母音。
sheep.tip_en: sheep and ship differ only in the vowel: sheep has a long, tense [i] (pull the lip corners sideways as if smiling and hold it a little longer), while ship has a short, relaxed [ɪ]. Learners often say both words the same way. For the opening [ʃ], push the lips forward and don't let the tongue touch the roof of the mouth first, or it becomes [tʃ] and turns into cheap. For the final [p], just close the lips; don't add a vowel.

examples.en: There are many sheep on the farm.
examples.zh: 農場上有很多綿羊。

examples.en: The little sheep has soft white wool.
examples.zh: 那隻小綿羊有柔軟的白色羊毛。

shine.tip_zh: shine 的 i 唸 [aɪ]，嘴巴從大開滑到接近 [ɪ]；字尾 [n] 舌尖要貼上牙齦，學生常把舌根抬起唸成 [ŋ]，或鼻音含糊帶過，結尾不清楚。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇嘟出，最後的 e 不發音。可以和 nine、line 一起練，結尾一樣。
shine.tip_en: The i in shine is [aɪ], gliding from a wide-open mouth toward [ɪ]. For the final [n], put the tongue tip on the gum ridge; learners often raise the back of the tongue for [ŋ] or blur the nasal so the end is unclear. Push the lips out for [ʃ] at the start, and the final e is silent. Practice it with nine and line, which end the same way.

examples.en: The sun will shine tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天太陽會出來。

examples.en: The stars shine at night.
examples.zh: 星星在夜晚閃耀。

ship.tip_zh: ship 的 [ɪ] 是短而放鬆的母音，如果拉長、嘴角用力拉開成 [i]，就變成 sheep「綿羊」。唸短短一下，馬上雙唇閉合接 [p]，不要再加母音唸成「西普」。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇要嘟出，不要唸成 [s]，否則會變成 sip。
ship.tip_en: The [ɪ] in ship is short and relaxed. If you stretch it and spread the lips into [i], the word becomes sheep. Say it quickly, then close the lips at once for [p] with no vowel after it. For the opening [ʃ], push the lips out; if you say [s] instead, it becomes sip.

examples.en: The ship sails across the ocean.
examples.zh: 那艘船航行越過海洋。

examples.en: We saw a big ship at the harbor.
examples.zh: 我們在港口看到一艘大船。

shirt.tip_zh: shirt 的 ir 唸 [ɝ]：舌頭往後捲、嘴唇微圓，整個母音從頭到尾都帶捲舌，不要先唸一個「些」再加 r。學生也常把嘴巴張太大，唸得像 short 或 shot。字尾 [t] 舌尖從捲舌位置直接往上頂住牙齦收尾。
shirt.tip_en: The ir in shirt is [ɝ]: curl the tongue back with slightly rounded lips, and keep the r-color through the whole vowel, instead of saying a plain vowel and then adding r. Learners also open the mouth too wide, so it sounds like short or shot. For the final [t], move the tongue tip from the curled position straight up to the gum ridge.

examples.en: I wear a white shirt to school.
examples.zh: 我穿白襯衫上學。

examples.en: Your shirt is on backwards.
examples.zh: 你的襯衫穿反了。

shoe.tip_zh: shoe 的 oe 唸 [u]，不是 [o]；學生常照拼字唸成 [ʃo]，聽起來像 show「表演」。從 [ʃ] 的嘟嘴姿勢開始，嘴唇再更往前圓，聲音拉長。單數 shoe 結尾沒有 [z]，複數 shoes 才唸 [ʃuz]，說「一隻鞋」時不要加。可以先唸 she，再把嘴唇往前圓成 [u]。
shoe.tip_en: The oe in shoe is [u], not [o]. Learners often follow the spelling and say [ʃo], which sounds like show. Start from the rounded lips of [ʃ], push them even further forward, and hold the sound. The singular shoe has no [z] at the end; only the plural shoes is [ʃuz], so don't add it when you mean one shoe. You can say she first, then round the lips forward into [u].

examples.en: I lost one shoe at the park.
examples.zh: 我在公園弄丟了一隻鞋。

examples.en: Tie your shoe before you run.
examples.zh: 跑步前先綁好鞋帶。

shop.tip_zh: shop 的 o 唸 [ɑ]，嘴巴要張大、下巴往下，學生常把嘴唇收圓，唸成像中文「秀」或「搜」的音。字尾 [p] 雙唇閉起來就停，常見錯誤是放開後多加一個母音。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇往前嘟，然後嘴巴才大大打開唸 [ɑ]。
shop.tip_en: The o in shop is [ɑ]: open the mouth wide and drop the jaw. Learners often round the lips, making it sound like a Mandarin syllable with an o or ou vowel. For the final [p], close the lips and stop; a common mistake is releasing an extra vowel. Start with lips pushed out for [ʃ], then open the mouth wide for [ɑ].

examples.en: There is a toy shop near my house.
examples.zh: 我家附近有一家玩具店。

examples.en: Let's shop for school supplies.
examples.zh: 我們去買文具吧。

shopkeeper.tip_zh: shopkeeper 是 shop 加 keeper，重音在前面的 [ʃɑp]，keeper 只帶次重音。美式的 [ɑ] 下巴要往下放、嘴巴張大，不要唸成圓唇的 [o]。中間是最大的關卡：[p] 和 [k] 連在一起，學生常在 [p] 後面多加一個母音，變成四拍。修正：[p] 雙唇閉上但不放氣，直接接 [k]。
shopkeeper.tip_en: shopkeeper is shop plus keeper; the main stress is on the first part [ʃɑp], and keeper only gets secondary stress. For the American [ɑ], drop the jaw and open the mouth wide; don't make it a rounded [o]. The middle is the biggest hurdle: [p] and [k] sit together, and learners often add a vowel after [p], making four beats. Fix: close the lips for [p] without releasing the air, and go straight into [k].

examples.en: The shopkeeper gave me a small gift.
examples.zh: 店主送我一個小禮物。

examples.en: Our neighbor is a friendly shopkeeper.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居是一位親切的店主。

short.tip_zh: short 的 or 唸 [ɔr]：嘴巴先張開成圓形唸 [ɔ]，再把舌頭往後捲。shirt 的 [ɝ] 嘴巴比較小，兩個字別混。字尾 [rt] 舌尖從捲舌位置直接頂上牙齦，學生常漏掉 [r]，或在 [t] 後加母音唸成「修特」。整個字只有一拍。
short.tip_en: The or in short is [ɔr]: open the mouth in a round shape for [ɔ], then curl the tongue back. The [ɝ] of shirt uses a smaller mouth, so don't mix them up. For the ending [rt], move the tongue tip from the curled position straight to the gum ridge. Learners often drop the [r] or add a vowel after the [t]. The whole word is one beat.

examples.en: My hair is short now.
examples.zh: 我現在是短頭髮。

examples.en: This pencil is too short to use.
examples.zh: 這枝鉛筆短到不能用了。

shorts.tip_zh: shorts 結尾有三個子音 [rts]：捲舌之後舌尖頂上牙齦，接著放出 [ts]，像 cats 的結尾。學生常唸成 short，漏掉最後的 [s]，或在中間加母音。雖然指的是一件短褲，這個字永遠用複數形，所以結尾的 [s] 一定要唸出來。
shorts.tip_en: Shorts ends in three consonants, [rts]: after the curled [r], press the tongue tip to the gum ridge and release [ts], like the end of cats. Learners often say short and drop the final [s], or insert a vowel. Even for one pair, the word is always plural, so the final [s] must be heard.

examples.en: I wear shorts in summer.
examples.zh: 我夏天穿短褲。

examples.en: These shorts are too big for me.
examples.zh: 這件短褲我穿太大了。

should.tip_zh: should 的 l 不發音，ou 唸短的 [ʊ]，嘴唇微圓、放鬆，不要唸成長的 [u]。學生常照拼字把 l 唸出來，變成「修爾德」。字尾 [d] 輕輕收住，在句子裡常和下一個字連起來，例如 should go 中間不停頓。
should.tip_en: The l in should is silent, and the ou is the short [ʊ]: lips slightly rounded and relaxed, not the long [u]. Learners often follow the spelling and pronounce the l. The final [d] is a light stop and in sentences often links to the next word; in should go, for example, there's no pause.

examples.en: You should drink more water.
examples.zh: 你應該多喝水。

examples.en: We should go to bed early.
examples.zh: 我們應該早點睡。

should.spelling_zh: l 不發音，和 could、would 一樣。
should.spelling_en: The l is silent, as in could and would.

shoulder.tip_zh: shoulder 和 should 拼法很像，但這裡的 l 要發音：[o] 之後舌尖碰上牙齦發暗 L，再接 [d]。母音是 [o]，嘴唇從半開收圓，不要唸成 should 的短 [ʊ]。重音在第一音節 [ˈʃol]，最後 [ɚ] 輕輕捲舌。可以先唸 old，再在前面加 [ʃ]。
shoulder.tip_en: Shoulder is spelled like should, but here the l is pronounced: after [o], touch the tongue tip to the gum ridge for a dark L, then add [d]. The vowel is [o], gliding from half open to rounded lips, not the short [ʊ] of should. Stress the first syllable [ˈʃol] and end with a light, curled [ɚ]. You can say old first, then put [ʃ] in front of it.

examples.en: My cat likes to sit on my shoulder.
examples.zh: 我的貓喜歡坐在我的肩膀上。

examples.en: Put your bag on your shoulder.
examples.zh: 把包包背在你的肩膀上。

shoulder.spelling_zh: ou 唸 [o]，l 要發音（和 should 不同）。
shoulder.spelling_en: The ou is [o] and the l is pronounced, unlike should.

shout.tip_zh: shout 的 ou 唸 [aʊ]，和 out 的母音一樣：嘴巴先大開，再收成圓唇，滑動要明顯。學生常只唸出一個不滑動的單母音。字尾 [t] 舌尖頂上牙齦停住，不要加母音；在 [t] 前，[aʊ] 唸得比 loud 的母音短促。
shout.tip_en: The ou in shout is [aʊ], the same vowel as in out: start with the mouth wide open and close to rounded lips with a clear glide. Learners often say a single vowel that doesn't move. Stop the final [t] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge and no added vowel; before [t], the [aʊ] is shorter than the vowel in loud.

examples.en: Please don't shout in the library.
examples.zh: 請不要在圖書館裡大叫。

examples.en: We shout "Happy Birthday!" together.
examples.zh: 我們一起大喊「生日快樂」！

show.tip_zh: show 的 ow 唸 [o]，不是 how 的 [aʊ]；學生看到 ow 常唸成 [ʃaʊ]。嘴唇從半開慢慢收圓，聲音拉長，不要唸成中文「秀」那種短促、帶 [i] 的音。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇嘟出、舌尖放平，不要碰到上排牙齒。和 snow、know 的母音一樣。
show.tip_en: The ow in show is [o], not the [aʊ] of how; learners seeing ow often say [ʃaʊ]. Slowly round the lips from half open and hold the sound, rather than using the short Mandarin syllable 秀, which has an [i]-like glide. For the opening [ʃ], push the lips out with a flat tongue tip that doesn't touch the upper teeth. It has the same vowel as snow and know.

examples.en: Show me your new toy.
examples.zh: 給我看看你的新玩具。

examples.en: We watched a magic show at school.
examples.zh: 我們在學校看了一場魔術表演。

show.spelling_zh: ow 在這裡唸 [o]，和 snow 一樣。
show.spelling_en: The ow here is [o], as in snow.

shower.tip_zh: shower 的 ow 唸 [aʊ]，接著捲舌 [r]：嘴巴先大開，滑向圓唇，最後舌頭往後捲。學生常把 [r] 漏掉，唸得像 "shaow"，或唸成「下我」。這裡標成一個音節 [ʃaʊr]；美國人說慢一點時常唸成兩拍 [ˈʃaʊɚ]，兩種都對，重點是最後一定要捲舌。
shower.tip_en: The ow in shower is [aʊ], followed by a curled [r]: open the mouth wide, glide to rounded lips, then curl the tongue back. Learners often drop the [r] or turn the ending into a flat, unrounded vowel. It is written here as one syllable, [ʃaʊr]; when Americans say it more slowly it often has two beats, [ˈʃaʊɚ]. Both are fine; the key is to curl the tongue at the end.

examples.en: I take a shower every night.
examples.zh: 我每天晚上洗澡。

examples.en: There may be a shower this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會有陣雨。

shower.variant_en: Said more slowly, it is often two syllables, [ˈʃaʊɚ].
shower.kk_flag: CMU gives one syllable [ʃaʊr]; General American dictionaries normally list two syllables /ˈʃaʊ.ɚ/ ([ˈʃaʊɚ]). Consider showing [ˈʃaʊɚ] as the main KK (and n_syll 2).

shy.tip_zh: shy 的 y 唸 [aɪ]，嘴巴從大開滑到接近 [ɪ]，滑動要完整，不要停在中間。開頭 [ʃ] 嘴唇往前嘟、舌尖放平；學生常用 [s] 代替，結果變成 sigh [saɪ]「嘆氣」，或用中文翹舌音，舌尖往上捲得太高。
shy.tip_en: The y in shy is [aɪ]: glide from a wide-open mouth all the way toward [ɪ] without stopping halfway. For the opening [ʃ], push the lips forward and keep the tongue tip flat. Learners often use [s], which turns it into sigh [saɪ], or use the Mandarin retroflex sound with the tongue tip curled up too high.

examples.en: My little brother is shy around new people.
examples.zh: 我弟弟在陌生人面前很害羞。

examples.en: Don't be shy, come and say hi.
examples.zh: 別害羞，過來打個招呼。

sick.tip_zh: sick 的 [ɪ] 要短而放鬆，嘴角不要拉開；拉長成 [i] 就會變成 seek「尋找」。字尾 ck 只是一個 [k]，舌根碰軟顎就停，學生常唸成「西克」，多加一個母音。開頭 [s] 嘴唇不要嘟，否則容易變成 [ʃ]。
sick.tip_en: The [ɪ] in sick is short and relaxed, with the corners of the mouth not pulled wide; stretched into [i], it becomes seek. The ck at the end is a single [k]: touch the back of the tongue to the soft palate and stop. Learners often add a vowel after it. Don't round the lips for the opening [s], or it easily turns into [ʃ].

examples.en: I stayed home because I was sick.
examples.zh: 我因為生病待在家裡。

examples.en: My dog is sick today.
examples.zh: 我的狗今天生病了。

side.tip_zh: side 的 i 唸 [aɪ]，最後的 e 不發音，字尾是有聲的 [d]。學生常把 [d] 省略，聽起來像 sigh，或唸成「賽德」多一個母音。因為結尾有聲，[aɪ] 要拉長一點，再讓舌尖輕頂上牙齦收尾；可以和 sight 對比練習，sight 的母音較短。
side.tip_en: The i in side is [aɪ], the final e is silent, and the last sound is voiced [d]. Learners often drop the [d], so it sounds like sigh, or add a vowel after it. Because the ending is voiced, hold the [aɪ] a little longer, then finish with the tongue tip lightly on the gum ridge. Contrast it with sight, whose vowel is shorter.

examples.en: Stand on the left side of the line.
examples.zh: 站在線的左邊。

examples.en: There is a park on the other side of the street.
examples.zh: 街道另一邊有一座公園。

sidewalk.tip_zh: sidewalk 是 side 加 walk，主重音在 side。walk 的 l 不發音，al 唸 [ɔ]；學生常把 l 唸出來，變成「沃爾克」。side 的 [d] 要直接連到 [w]，中間不要加母音；舌尖頂完 [d]，嘴唇馬上收圓做 [w]，最後 [k] 不送多餘的母音。walk 部分和 talk 押韻。
sidewalk.tip_en: Sidewalk is side plus walk, with the main stress on side. The l in walk is silent and al is [ɔ]; learners often pronounce the l. Link the [d] of side straight into the [w] without a vowel: after the tongue tip makes [d], round the lips at once for [w], and don't let a vowel follow the final [k]. The walk part rhymes with talk.

examples.en: Walk on the sidewalk, not on the road.
examples.zh: 走在人行道上，不要走在馬路上。

examples.en: We drew pictures on the sidewalk with chalk.
examples.zh: 我們用粉筆在人行道上畫畫。

sidewalk.spelling_zh: walk 部分的 l 不發音。
sidewalk.spelling_en: The l in the walk part is silent.

sight.tip_zh: sight 的 gh 不發音，igh 合起來唸 [aɪ]，所以 sight 和 site 同音。學生常照拼字想唸出 g，或在字尾加母音唸成「賽特」。字尾 [t] 舌尖頂住上牙齦就停，母音在 [t] 前要比 side 短一點，兩個字靠這個差別區分。
sight.tip_en: The gh in sight is silent; igh together says [aɪ], so sight sounds the same as site. Learners sometimes try to pronounce a g, or add a vowel at the end. Stop the final [t] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge; before [t] the vowel is a little shorter than in side, which is how the two words are told apart.

examples.en: My grandpa still has good sight.
examples.zh: 我爺爺的視力還是很好。

examples.en: Carrots are good for your sight.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔對你的視力有好處。

sight.spelling_zh: gh 不發音，和 site 同音。
sight.spelling_en: The gh is silent; it sounds the same as site.

sign.tip_zh: sign 的 g 不發音，i 唸 [aɪ]，整個字只有 [s]、[aɪ]、[n] 三個音。學生常照拼字唸出 g，唸成像 "sig-n" 的音。字尾 [n] 舌尖貼上牙齦、聲音從鼻子出去，不要唸成 [ŋ]。到了 signal 這個字，g 才會發音。它和 line、nine 押韻，結尾都停在 [n]。
sign.tip_en: The g in sign is silent and the i is [aɪ], so the word has only three sounds: [s], [aɪ], [n]. Learners often follow the spelling and pronounce the g. For the final [n], put the tongue tip on the gum ridge and let the sound go through the nose, not [ŋ]. In the word signal, the g is pronounced. It rhymes with line and nine; all three end on [n].

examples.en: Read the sign on the door.
examples.zh: 讀一下門上的標誌。

examples.en: The sign says "No Parking."
examples.zh: 標誌上寫著「禁止停車」。

sign.spelling_zh: g 不發音；signal 裡的 g 才發音。
sign.spelling_en: The g is silent; it is pronounced in signal.

simple.tip_zh: simple 第二音節是成音節的 [ḷ]：雙唇閉合發 [p]，放開後舌尖直接貼上牙齦發 [l]，中間沒有清楚的母音。學生常把結尾唸成「波」或「普」，把 [l] 漏掉。第一音節的 [m] 要閉上嘴唇，不要唸成 [n]；重音在 [ˈsɪm]。
simple.tip_en: The second syllable of simple is a syllabic [ḷ]: close the lips for [p], then release straight into [l] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge, with no clear vowel in between. Learners often end with a "po" or "pu" sound and lose the [l]. The [m] in the first syllable needs closed lips, not [n]; stress falls on [ˈsɪm].

examples.en: This math problem is simple.
examples.zh: 這題數學題很簡單。

examples.en: Keep your drawing simple and clean.
examples.zh: 讓你的畫保持簡單乾淨。

since.tip_zh: since 結尾是 [ns] 兩個子音，常見錯誤是把最後的 [s] 吞掉，聽起來只剩 [sɪn]；或在後面多加一個母音。另外 [ɪ] 要短而放鬆，不要拉成長長的 [i]。練法：舌尖頂在上排牙齦後面發 [n]，舌頭不動，直接把氣擠出來變成 [s]。
since.tip_en: since ends in two consonants, [ns]. A common mistake is swallowing the final [s] so only [sɪn] is left, or adding a vowel after it. The [ɪ] should also be short and relaxed, not a long [i]. Practice: press the tongue tip behind the upper gum ridge for [n], keep it there, and push the air out straight into [s].

examples.en: I have lived in Banqiao since I was five.
examples.zh: 我從五歲起就住在板橋。

examples.en: We have been friends since first grade.
examples.zh: 我們從一年級就是朋友了。

since.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，c 在這裡唸 [s]。
since.spelling_en: The final e is silent, and c here sounds like [s].

sing.tip_zh: sing 的結尾是後鼻音 [ŋ]，台灣學生常把它唸成前鼻音 [n]，結果變成 sin；也有人在最後多發一個 [g]。母音是短的 [ɪ]，不是 [i]。練法：舌尖輕放在下排牙齒後面，用舌根往上頂住軟顎，讓聲音從鼻子出來，嘴巴保持微開，不要再彈出任何聲音。
sing.tip_en: sing ends in the back nasal [ŋ]. Taiwanese students often turn it into the front nasal [n], so it becomes sin; some also add a [g] at the end. The vowel is a short [ɪ], not [i]. Practice: rest the tongue tip behind the lower teeth, raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate, let the sound come out through the nose, keep the mouth slightly open, and release nothing after it.

examples.en: Let's sing a song for Grandma's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們來為奶奶的生日唱一首歌吧。

examples.en: My little sister can sing very well.
examples.zh: 我妹妹很會唱歌。

sing.spelling_zh: ng 是一個 [ŋ] 音，g 不另外發出來。
sing.spelling_en: ng is one sound, [ŋ]; the g is not said separately.

singer.tip_zh: singer 的 ng 只唸一個 [ŋ]，沒有 [g]。學生常照 finger 的唸法多加 [g]，或把 [ŋ] 唸成 [n]。修正：唸 [sɪŋ] 時舌根抬起貼住軟顎，讓聲音從鼻子出來，然後舌根直接放開，滑進捲舌的 [ɚ]，中間不要有爆破的 [g]。可以想成 sing 後面加上 [ɚ]。
singer.tip_en: The ng in singer is just one [ŋ], with no [g]. Learners often add a [g] the way finger has one, or turn [ŋ] into [n]. Fix: for [sɪŋ], lift the back of the tongue against the soft palate so the sound comes out through the nose, then release the tongue straight into the curled [ɚ], with no [g] burst in between. Think of it as sing plus [ɚ].

examples.en: My sister wants to be a singer.
examples.zh: 我妹妹想當歌手。

examples.en: The singer sang my favorite song.
examples.zh: 那位歌手唱了我最喜歡的歌。

singer.spelling_zh: ng 只唸 [ŋ]，g 不另外發音（finger 才有 [g]）
singer.spelling_en: ng is just [ŋ]; the g is not said separately (finger does have [g]).

sir.tip_zh: sir 整個母音就是一個捲舌的 [ɝ]，不是先唸一個母音再加「兒」。常見錯誤是唸成沒捲舌的 [sə]，或唸成「色兒」兩段。練法：發完 [s] 之後，舌頭立刻往後捲、舌尖不碰任何地方，嘴唇微微收圓，整個母音都保持捲舌，一口氣唸完。
sir.tip_en: The whole vowel in sir is one r-colored [ɝ], not a vowel with an 'r' added afterward. Common mistakes are an unrounded, non-r [sə], or splitting it into two parts. Practice: right after [s], curl the tongue back without the tip touching anything, round the lips slightly, keep the r-color through the whole vowel, and say it in one breath.

examples.en: Excuse me, sir, is this your umbrella?
examples.zh: 先生，不好意思，這是您的雨傘嗎？

examples.en: Thank you, sir, have a nice day.
examples.zh: 謝謝您，先生，祝您有美好的一天。

sir.spelling_zh: ir 合起來唸 [ɝ]，和 her、bird 的母音一樣。
sir.spelling_en: ir together says [ɝ], the same vowel as in her and bird.

sister.tip_zh: sister 重音在第一音節 [sɪs]。常見錯誤有兩個：在 s 和 t 之間多加母音，變成三個音節；結尾唸成沒捲舌的 [tə]。另外 s 後面的 [t] 不送氣，聽起來比較像輕輕的 [d]。練法：第一音節短而有力，接著舌尖一點就過，最後舌頭往後捲發 [ɚ]。
sister.tip_en: sister is stressed on the first syllable, [sɪs]. Two common mistakes: adding a vowel between the s and t so it becomes three syllables, and ending with a non-r [tə]. Also, the [t] after s is unaspirated, so it sounds closer to a soft [d]. Practice: make the first syllable short and strong, tap the tongue tip once, then curl the tongue back for [ɚ].

examples.en: My sister is two years older than me.
examples.zh: 我姊姊比我大兩歲。

examples.en: My little sister likes to draw cats.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜歡畫貓。

sit.tip_zh: sit 的母音是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]。如果唸成長的 [i]，就變成 seat（座位）。另外結尾的 [t] 只要舌尖頂住上牙齦停住就好，不要放開後再加一個「ㄜ」。練法：sit 和 seat 對照唸，seat 嘴角往兩邊拉、拉長；sit 嘴巴放鬆、短短一下就停。
sit.tip_en: The vowel in sit is a short, relaxed [ɪ]. If you make it a long [i], it becomes seat. Also, for the final [t], just press the tongue tip against the upper gum ridge and stop; don't release it and add an extra vowel. Practice: contrast sit and seat. For seat, spread the lips and hold it longer; for sit, relax the mouth and stop quickly.

examples.en: Please sit next to me.
examples.zh: 請坐在我旁邊。

examples.en: We sit in a circle during story time.
examples.zh: 說故事時間我們圍成一圈坐。

six.tip_zh: six 的字母 x 代表兩個音 [ks]。常見錯誤是把最後的 [s] 漏掉，結果聽起來像 sick（生病的）；或在後面多加母音。母音是短的 [ɪ]，不要拉長。練法：舌根往上碰軟顎發出 [k]，不放母音，馬上接一個清楚的 [s] 嘶嘶聲，像蛇的聲音收尾。
six.tip_en: The letter x in six stands for two sounds, [ks]. A common mistake is leaving out the final [s], so it sounds like sick; another is adding a vowel at the end. The vowel is a short [ɪ]; don't stretch it. Practice: raise the back of the tongue to the soft palate for [k], add no vowel, and go straight into a clear hissing [s], like a snake sound, to finish.

examples.en: I wake up at six every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上六點起床。

examples.en: There are six eggs in the box.
examples.zh: 盒子裡有六顆蛋。

six.spelling_en: x is pronounced as two sounds, [ks].

sixteen.tip_zh: sixteen 單獨唸時重音在後面的 [tin]，而且是長的 [i]、結尾有 [n]。如果重音放在前面、尾巴唸得又短又輕，就會和 sixty 混淆。練法：前面 [sɪks] 輕快帶過，後面 [tin] 拉長、加重，最後舌尖頂上牙齦把 [n] 清楚收住。
sixteen.tip_en: Said on its own, sixteen is stressed on the second part, [tin], which has a long [i] and ends in [n]. If you stress the front and make the end short and light, it gets confused with sixty. Practice: say [sɪks] quickly and lightly, then make [tin] long and strong, and finish the [n] clearly with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge.

examples.en: My cousin is sixteen years old.
examples.zh: 我表哥十六歲。

examples.en: There are sixteen students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有十六個學生。

sixteen.variant_zh: 數數或後面接名詞時，重音常移到前面：[ˈsɪksˌtin]。
sixteen.variant_en: When counting or before a noun, the stress often moves to the front: [ˈsɪksˌtin].

sixty.tip_zh: sixty 重音在第一音節 [sɪks]，第二音節 [tɪ] 又短又輕，結尾沒有 [n]。常見錯誤是把後面唸成重而長的 [ti]，聽起來像 sixteen。練法：用力唸 six，再輕輕補一個短短的 [tɪ]；和 sixteen 交替唸，感覺重音一前一後。
sixty.tip_en: sixty is stressed on the first syllable, [sɪks]; the second syllable, [tɪ], is short and light, with no [n] at the end. A common mistake is making the ending strong and long, [ti], which sounds like sixteen. Practice: say six firmly, then add a short, soft [tɪ]; alternate it with sixteen to feel the stress move front and back.

examples.en: My grandpa is sixty years old.
examples.zh: 我爺爺六十歲。

examples.en: There are sixty minutes in an hour.
examples.zh: 一小時有六十分鐘。

size.tip_zh: size 結尾的 [z] 是有聲的，喉嚨要震動。台灣學生常唸成無聲的 [s]，或在後面加一個母音變成兩個音節。前面的 [aɪ] 要從張大嘴的 [a] 滑到 [ɪ]。練法：手摸喉嚨，發 [z] 時要感覺到像蜜蜂嗡嗡的震動；[aɪ] 在有聲子音前面可以唸得稍微長一點。
size.tip_en: The final [z] in size is voiced, so the throat should vibrate. Taiwanese students often say a voiceless [s] instead, or add a vowel so it becomes two syllables. The [aɪ] should glide from an open [a] to [ɪ]. Practice: touch your throat and feel a buzzing, bee-like vibration on [z]; the [aɪ] can be a little longer before a voiced consonant.

examples.en: What size are your shoes?
examples.zh: 你的鞋子穿幾號？

examples.en: This shirt is the wrong size for me.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫的尺寸不適合我。

size.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，z 唸有聲的 [z]。
size.spelling_en: The final e is silent; z is a voiced [z].

skirt.tip_zh: skirt 的母音是捲舌的 [ɝ]。常見錯誤是唸成沒捲舌的 [skət]，或在 s 和 k 之間多加一個母音變成兩個音節。另外 s 後面的 [k] 不送氣，聽起來比較接近 [g]。練法：s 直接接 k，不要停；接著舌頭往後捲發 [ɝ]，最後舌尖輕輕頂住上牙齦停在 [t]。
skirt.tip_en: The vowel in skirt is the r-colored [ɝ]. Common mistakes are saying it without the r, [skət], or adding a vowel between s and k so it becomes two syllables. Also, the [k] after s is unaspirated, so it sounds closer to [g]. Practice: go straight from s into k with no pause, curl the tongue back for [ɝ], and end by lightly stopping the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [t].

examples.en: She is wearing a blue skirt today.
examples.zh: 她今天穿一件藍色裙子。

examples.en: My school uniform has a long skirt.
examples.zh: 我的學校制服有一件長裙。

skirt.spelling_zh: ir 唸 [ɝ]，和 bird 一樣。

sky.tip_zh: sky 只有一個音節，但台灣學生常在 s 和 k 之間塞進一個母音，唸成兩拍。另外 s 後面的 [k] 不送氣，聽起來比較像 [g]，用力送氣反而不自然。練法：先發 [s] 嘶嘶聲，不換氣就接 [k]，再滑到 [aɪ]，嘴巴從大張到微開，一拍唸完。
sky.tip_en: sky has only one syllable, but Taiwanese students often squeeze a vowel between s and k and say it in two beats. Also, the [k] after s is unaspirated and sounds more like [g]; puffing air on it sounds unnatural. Practice: start with a hissing [s], go into [k] without taking a breath, then glide into [aɪ], opening wide and then closing slightly, all in one beat.

examples.en: The sky is so blue today.
examples.zh: 今天的天空好藍。

examples.en: Look at all the stars in the sky!
examples.zh: 你看天空中的星星！

sky.spelling_zh: y 在字尾唸 [aɪ]，和 my、fly 一樣。
sky.spelling_en: The final y says [aɪ], as in my and fly.

sleep.tip_zh: sleep 的母音是長的 [i]，要拉長、嘴角往兩邊拉。如果唸成短的 [ɪ]，就變成 slip（滑倒）。另外 s 和 l 之間不要加母音，結尾的 [p] 雙唇閉起來就好，不要再彈出「ㄆㄜ」。練法：sleep 和 slip 對照唸，sleep 至少比 slip 長一倍。
sleep.tip_en: The vowel in sleep is a long [i]; hold it and spread the lips. If you make it a short [ɪ], it becomes slip. Also, don't add a vowel between s and l, and for the final [p], just close the lips without popping out an extra vowel. Practice: contrast sleep and slip; sleep should be at least twice as long.

examples.en: I go to sleep at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 我九點睡覺。

examples.en: Our cat likes to sleep on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我們的貓喜歡在沙發上睡覺。

slide.tip_zh: slide 結尾的 [d] 很容易被吞掉，或唸成 [t]，聽起來像 slight。因為後面是有聲的 [d]，前面的 [aɪ] 要唸得比較長。另外 s 和 l 之間不要多加母音。練法：把 [aɪ] 拉長，最後舌尖輕輕點一下上牙齦發出短短的 [d]，喉嚨保持震動。
slide.tip_en: The final [d] in slide is easily swallowed or turned into [t], so it sounds like slight. Because the [d] is voiced, the [aɪ] before it should be longer. Also, don't add a vowel between s and l. Practice: stretch the [aɪ], then lightly touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge for a short [d], keeping the throat vibrating.

examples.en: The kids slide down the slide at the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園溜滑梯。

examples.en: Let's slide on the ice together!
examples.zh: 我們一起在冰上滑吧！

slide.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，i 唸 [aɪ]。
slide.spelling_en: The final e is silent; i says [aɪ].

slim.tip_zh: slim 結尾是雙唇音 [m]，嘴唇一定要閉起來。中文沒有用 [m] 結尾的字，所以台灣學生常把它唸成 [slɪn]。母音是短的 [ɪ]。練法：唸完 [slɪ] 後把雙唇合上，用鼻子哼出 [m]，像吃到好東西時「嗯」的聲音，嘴巴閉著結束。
slim.tip_en: slim ends in the lip sound [m], so the lips must close. Mandarin has no words ending in [m], so Taiwanese students often say [slɪn]. The vowel is a short [ɪ]. Practice: after [slɪ], close the lips and hum [m] through the nose, like the 'mmm' you make when food tastes good, and finish with the mouth closed.

examples.en: The slim book fits in my bag.
examples.zh: 這本薄薄的書放得進我的包包。

examples.en: My dad is tall and slim.
examples.zh: 我爸爸又高又瘦。

slow.tip_zh: slow 的 [o] 在美式發音裡是會滑動的音，嘴唇從圓變得更圓、更收。台灣學生常唸成扁平不動的「ㄛ」，或在 s 和 l 之間加母音變成兩拍。練法：先發 [s]，舌尖馬上頂上牙齦接 [l]，再把嘴唇往前收圓，尾巴像要吹口哨一樣收緊。
slow.tip_en: The [o] in slow is a gliding sound in American English: the lips start round and get rounder and tighter. Taiwanese students often say a flat, unmoving vowel, or add a vowel between s and l so it becomes two beats. Practice: start with [s], immediately raise the tongue tip to the gum ridge for [l], then push the lips forward into a round shape, tightening at the end as if about to whistle.

examples.en: The bus is very slow today.
examples.zh: 今天公車好慢。

examples.en: The old turtle is very slow.
examples.zh: 那隻老烏龜走得很慢。

slow.spelling_zh: ow 在這裡唸 [o]，不是 how 的 [aʊ]。
slow.spelling_en: ow here says [o], not the [aʊ] in how.

small.tip_zh: small 結尾是暗 L [l]，台灣學生常把它整個省略，只剩 [smɔ]，聽起來沒有收尾。[ɔ] 嘴巴要張開、嘴唇微圓，不是小小的「ㄛ」。另外 s 和 m 之間不要加母音。練法：[ɔ] 唸完後，舌尖往上貼住上排牙齦，舌根稍微往後壓，停留一下再結束。
small.tip_en: small ends in a dark L, [l]. Taiwanese students often drop it completely, leaving only [smɔ], so the word has no ending. The [ɔ] needs an open mouth with slightly rounded lips, not a small tight 'o'. Also, don't add a vowel between s and m. Practice: after [ɔ], lift the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge, pull the back of the tongue back a little, and hold it briefly before stopping.

examples.en: I have a small dog named Lucky.
examples.zh: 我有一隻叫 Lucky 的小狗。

examples.en: Can I have a small cup of milk?
examples.zh: 我可以要一小杯牛奶嗎？

small.spelling_zh: all 唸 [ɔl]，和 ball、tall 一樣。
small.spelling_en: all says [ɔl], as in ball and tall.

smart.tip_zh: smart 的 [ɑr] 要先把嘴巴張大發 [ɑ]，再把舌頭往後捲。台灣學生常把 r 省掉，或在 s 和 m 之間、t 後面都加母音，唸成好幾拍。練法：一拍唸完；[ɑ] 張大嘴像看醫生說「啊」，接著舌頭往後捲，最後舌尖頂住上牙齦停在 [t]，不要放出母音。
smart.tip_en: In smart, the [ɑr] starts with a wide-open [ɑ], then the tongue curls back. Taiwanese students often drop the r, or add vowels between s and m and after t, saying it in several beats. Practice: say it in one beat. Open wide for [ɑ] like saying 'ah' at the doctor's, curl the tongue back, then stop with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [t], releasing no vowel.

examples.en: Our dog is very smart.
examples.zh: 我們的狗很聰明。

examples.en: She is a smart and kind student.
examples.zh: 她是個聰明又善良的學生。

smart.spelling_zh: ar 唸 [ɑr]，和 car、star 一樣。
smart.spelling_en: ar says [ɑr], as in car and star.

smell.tip_zh: smell 的字尾 [l] 常被台灣學生唸成像「歐」的母音，聽起來像 [smɛo]。母音 [ɛ] 嘴巴半開，不要滑成 [e]。練法：先唸 smelly，感覺 l 時舌尖貼在上牙齦的位置；再唸 smell，在同一個位置停住，不要讓舌頭掉下來變成「歐」。
smell.tip_en: Taiwanese students often turn the final [l] in smell into an 'o'-like vowel, so it sounds like [smɛo]. The vowel [ɛ] is half-open; don't let it glide into [e]. Practice: first say smelly and feel where the tongue tip touches the upper gum ridge for l; then say smell and stop in that same position, without letting the tongue drop into an 'o' sound.

examples.en: The cookies smell so good!
examples.zh: 餅乾聞起來好香！

examples.en: Can you smell the flowers?
examples.zh: 你聞得到花香嗎？

smile.tip_zh: smile 的 [aɪ] 後面接暗 L，常見錯誤是把 [l] 省掉，聽起來只剩 [smaɪ]。其實 [aɪ] 滑到 [l] 時中間會自然帶出一點點 [ə]，這是正常的。練法：先唸 mile，確定尾巴舌尖有往上貼；再在前面加上 [s]，s 和 m 之間不要加母音。
smile.tip_en: In smile, the [aɪ] is followed by a dark L, and a common mistake is dropping the [l] so only [smaɪ] is left. As [aɪ] moves into [l], a tiny [ə] naturally appears in between, and that is normal. Practice: say mile first and make sure the tongue tip rises at the end; then add [s] in front, with no vowel between s and m.

examples.en: Smile for the camera, everyone!
examples.zh: 大家對著相機笑一個！

examples.en: My teacher has a big, warm smile.
examples.zh: 我的老師有個大大的溫暖笑容。

smile.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，i 唸 [aɪ]。
smile.spelling_en: The final e is silent; i says [aɪ].

smoke.tip_zh: smoke 結尾的 [k] 只要舌根頂住軟顎就停，台灣學生常放開後再加「ㄎㄜ」，多出一個音節。[o] 要從圓唇再收得更圓，不是扁平的「ㄛ」。另外 s 和 m 之間不要加母音。練法：sm 一口氣連著發，嘴唇閉著從嘶聲轉成哼聲，再張開接 [o]。
smoke.tip_en: For the final [k] in smoke, just press the back of the tongue against the soft palate and stop. Taiwanese students often release it with an extra vowel, adding a syllable. The [o] goes from round to rounder, not a flat 'o'. Also, don't put a vowel between s and m. Practice: say sm in one go, moving from a hiss to a hum with the lips closed, then open into [o].

examples.en: I see smoke coming from the chimney.
examples.zh: 我看到煙從煙囪冒出來。

examples.en: Please don't smoke near the kids.
examples.zh: 請不要在孩子旁邊抽菸。

smoke.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，o 唸 [o]。
smoke.spelling_en: The final e is silent; o says [o].

snack.tip_zh: snack 的 [æ] 嘴巴要張得很大，舌頭壓低。台灣學生常唸成較小的 [ɛ]，或乾脆唸成 snake（蛇）的 [e]。結尾的 [k] 停住就好，不要加母音。練法：嘴角往兩邊拉、下巴往下掉，像有點嫌棄的表情發 [æ]；再和 snake 對照，snake 嘴巴小、會滑動。
snack.tip_en: The [æ] in snack needs a very open mouth with the tongue low. Taiwanese students often use the smaller [ɛ], or even the [e] of snake. For the final [k], just stop; don't add a vowel. Practice: pull the corners of the mouth sideways and drop the jaw, like a slightly disgusted face, for [æ]; then contrast it with snake, which has a smaller, gliding vowel.

examples.en: I eat a small snack after school.
examples.zh: 我放學後吃一點點心。

examples.en: Apples are a healthy snack.
examples.zh: 蘋果是健康的點心。

snake.tip_zh: snake 的 [e] 是會滑動的音，從 [e] 滑向 [ɪ]，嘴巴開口不大。台灣學生常唸成短的 [ɛ]，或和 snack 搞混。另外 s 和 n 之間不要加母音。練法：sn 一起發，舌尖從 [s] 的位置直接往上貼成 [n]；再把 [e] 拉長、尾巴往 [ɪ] 收，最後 [k] 停住不放。
snake.tip_en: The [e] in snake is a gliding sound, moving from [e] toward [ɪ] with a fairly small mouth opening. Taiwanese students often say a short [ɛ] instead, or mix it up with snack. Also, don't add a vowel between s and n. Practice: say sn together, moving the tongue tip straight up from the [s] position into [n]; then lengthen [e], ending toward [ɪ], and stop on [k] without releasing it.

examples.en: We saw a green snake at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一條綠色的蛇。

examples.en: The snake is sleeping in the sun.
examples.zh: 那條蛇在太陽下睡覺。

snake.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，讓 a 唸 [e]。
snake.spelling_en: The final e is silent and makes a say [e].

snow.tip_zh: snow 只有一個音節。台灣學生常在 s 和 n 之間加一個母音，唸成兩拍。結尾的 [o] 要收圓唇，不是扁平的「ㄛ」。練法：先發長長的 [s]，舌尖不離開上牙齦附近，直接往上貼住、從鼻子哼出 [n]，接著嘴唇往前收圓發 [o]。
snow.tip_en: snow has only one syllable. Taiwanese students often add a vowel between s and n, saying it in two beats. The final [o] should end with rounded lips, not a flat 'o'. Practice: start with a long [s], keep the tongue tip near the upper gum ridge, press it up and hum [n] through the nose, then push the lips forward into a round [o].

examples.en: It may snow in the mountains tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚山上可能會下雪。

examples.en: The kids are playing in the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子們在雪地裡玩。

snow.spelling_zh: ow 在這裡唸 [o]，不是 cow 的 [aʊ]。
snow.spelling_en: ow here says [o], not the [aʊ] in cow.

snowy.tip_zh: snowy 有兩個音節，重音在第一音節 [sno]。常見錯誤是把字尾 [ɪ] 吞掉，聽起來跟 snow 一樣；或把兩個母音黏成一團。練法：[o] 嘴唇收圓之後，嘴角往兩邊拉開接 [ɪ]，中間會自然帶出一點 [w] 的滑音，第二拍短而輕。
snowy.tip_en: snowy has two syllables, stressed on the first, [sno]. A common mistake is swallowing the final [ɪ] so it sounds the same as snow, or squashing the two vowels together. Practice: after rounding the lips for [o], spread them for [ɪ]; a slight [w] glide naturally appears in between, and the second beat is short and light.

examples.en: It was a snowy day in Japan.
examples.zh: 那天在日本是個下雪天。

examples.en: We built a snowman on a snowy morning.
examples.zh: 我們在一個下雪的早上堆了雪人。

so.tip_zh: so 的 [o] 要從圓唇滑到更圓、更收的嘴型。如果嘴唇沒有收，唸成張開不動的 [ɔ]，聽起來就像 saw（看見的過去式）。練法：so 和 saw 對照唸；saw 嘴巴開著不動，so 的尾巴嘴唇往前收，好像要吹蠟燭。[s] 舌尖靠近上牙齦，不要捲成「ㄕ」。
so.tip_en: The [o] in so glides from round to rounder, tighter lips. If the lips don't close in and it stays an open, unmoving [ɔ], it sounds like saw. Practice: contrast so and saw. saw keeps the mouth open and still; at the end of so, the lips move forward as if blowing out a candle. For [s], keep the tongue tip near the upper gum ridge; don't curl it into a 'sh' sound.

examples.en: I am so happy to see you!
examples.zh: 見到你我好開心！

examples.en: The puppy is so cute.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗好可愛。

soccer.tip_zh: soccer 重音在第一音節，母音是張大嘴的 [ɑ]，不是圓唇的 [o]。台灣學生常照拼字唸成 [so]。cc 只唸一個 [k]，結尾是捲舌 [ɚ]。練法：第一音節的嘴型跟 doctor 的 [dɑk] 一樣，下巴往下掉；第二音節輕輕捲舌，不要唸成「可」。
