soccer.tip_en: soccer is stressed on the first syllable, and its vowel is a wide-open [ɑ], not a rounded [o]. Taiwanese students often follow the spelling and say [so]. The cc is just one [k], and it ends with an r-colored [ɚ]. Practice: shape the first syllable like the [dɑk] in doctor, with the jaw dropped; curl the tongue lightly for the second syllable instead of a flat 'kuh'.

examples.en: We play soccer after school.
examples.zh: 我們放學後踢足球。

examples.en: My brother is on the soccer team.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是足球隊的。

soccer.spelling_en: cc is pronounced as just one [k].

socks.tip_zh: socks 結尾是 [ks] 兩個子音。台灣學生常把最後的 [s] 漏掉，結果變成單數 sock，意思就從「一雙」變成「一隻」。母音是張大嘴的 [ɑ]，不是 [o]。練法：先唸 sock，舌根頂住後不放母音，直接加上清楚的 [s] 嘶聲。
socks.tip_en: socks ends in two consonants, [ks]. Taiwanese students often leave out the final [s], turning it into the singular sock, so the meaning changes from a pair to just one. The vowel is a wide-open [ɑ], not [o]. Practice: say sock, hold the back of the tongue up without adding a vowel, and add a clear hissing [s].

examples.en: Put on your socks before your shoes.
examples.zh: 先穿襪子再穿鞋子。

examples.en: I have red socks with stars on them.
examples.zh: 我有一雙上面有星星的紅襪子。

socks.spelling_zh: ck 唸 [k]，加上 s 變成 [ks]。
socks.spelling_en: ck says [k]; with s it becomes [ks].

sofa.tip_zh: 台灣學生常受中文「沙發」影響，把 sofa 兩個音節都唸成張大嘴的 [a]。其實重音在第一音節 [so]，嘴唇要收圓；第二音節是又輕又短的 [ə]，嘴巴放鬆就好。練法：第一拍唸得像 so，第二拍輕輕帶過，上牙輕碰下唇發 [f]。
sofa.tip_en: Influenced by the Mandarin loanword for sofa, Taiwanese students often say both syllables of sofa with a wide-open [a]. In fact, the stress is on the first syllable, [so], with rounded lips; the second syllable is a light, short [ə] with a relaxed mouth. Practice: say the first beat like so, pass lightly over the second, and touch the upper teeth to the lower lip for [f].

examples.en: Grandpa is reading on the sofa.
examples.zh: 爺爺在沙發上看書。

examples.en: Our new sofa is soft and big.
examples.zh: 我們的新沙發又軟又大。

soldier.tip_zh: soldier 只有兩個音節，di 合起來唸 [dʒ]，不是 [di]。台灣學生常照拼字唸成三個音節。另外 [o] 後面的暗 L 很容易被省掉。練法：第一音節 [sol] 唸完時舌尖貼上牙齦；接著發 [dʒ]，像 jump 的開頭；最後輕輕捲舌發 [ɚ]。重音在第一音節。
soldier.tip_en: soldier has only two syllables, and di together says [dʒ], not [di]. Taiwanese students often follow the spelling and say three syllables. Also, the dark L after [o] is easily dropped. Practice: finish the first syllable [sol] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; then say [dʒ] like the start of jump; then curl the tongue lightly for [ɚ]. The stress is on the first syllable.

examples.en: The toy soldier stands on my desk.
examples.zh: 那個玩具士兵站在我的書桌上。

examples.en: My uncle was a soldier for two years.
examples.zh: 我叔叔當了兩年兵。

some.tip_zh: some 的 o 唸 [ʌ]，不是 [o]，所以和 sum 同音。結尾是雙唇音 [m]，中文沒有 [m] 結尾，台灣學生常把嘴唇打開唸成 [sʌn]。練法：[ʌ] 嘴巴微開、放鬆，像輕輕說「呃」；唸完一定要把雙唇閉上，用鼻子哼出 [m]。
some.tip_en: The o in some says [ʌ], not [o], so it sounds the same as sum. It ends in the lip sound [m]; Mandarin has no [m] endings, so Taiwanese students often leave the lips open and say [sʌn]. Practice: for [ʌ], open the mouth slightly and relax, like a soft 'uh'; then be sure to close the lips and hum [m] through the nose.

examples.en: Can I have some water, please?
examples.zh: 可以給我一些水嗎？

examples.en: Some of my friends like cats.
examples.zh: 我有些朋友喜歡貓。

some.spelling_zh: o 唸 [ʌ]，字尾 e 不發音；和 sum 同音。
some.spelling_en: o says [ʌ] and the final e is silent; it sounds like sum.

someone.tip_zh: someone 兩個 o 都唸 [ʌ]，第二部分 one 開頭是 [w]。重音在第一音節。關鍵在中間：[m] 嘴唇閉起來，下一個 [w] 嘴唇要往前嘟圓，台灣學生常在中間停頓或把 [m] 省掉。練法：嘴唇閉著哼 [m]，不張開直接往前嘟成 [w]，順勢滑進 [wʌn]，最後舌尖頂上牙齦收 [n]。
someone.tip_en: Both o's in someone say [ʌ], and the second part, one, starts with [w]. The stress is on the first syllable. The key is the middle: the lips close for [m], then push forward and round for [w]; Taiwanese students often pause there or drop the [m]. Practice: hum [m] with closed lips, then without opening wide, push them forward into [w], slide into [wʌn], and finish [n] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge.

examples.en: Someone is knocking on the door.
examples.zh: 有人在敲門。

examples.en: I need someone to help me with this box.
examples.zh: 我需要有人幫我搬這個箱子。

someone.spelling_en: one says [wʌn], starting with a [w] sound.

something.tip_zh: something 的難點在 [m] 接 [θ]：唸完 [sʌm] 雙唇是閉著的，要立刻張開，把舌尖輕放在上下齒之間吹氣。學生常省事唸成 [s]，變成 [ˈsʌmsɪŋ]。開頭的 [ʌ] 嘴巴半開、短促放鬆，不要唸成 [ɑ]。結尾 [ɪŋ] 用舌根收鼻音，不要唸成 [ɪn]。
something.tip_en: The hard part of something is [m] followed by [θ]: after [sʌm] the lips are closed, so open them right away and rest the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth to blow air. Learners often take the easy way and say [s], giving [ˈsʌmsɪŋ]. The opening [ʌ] is half-open, short and relaxed; don't make it [ɑ]. The ending [ɪŋ] closes with the back of the tongue for the nasal; don't say [ɪn].

examples.en: I have something special for you.
examples.zh: 我有個特別的東西要給你。

examples.en: Do you want something to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝點什麼嗎？

sometimes.tip_zh: sometimes 的結尾是 [aɪmz]：雙唇先閉上發 [m]，再讓聲帶繼續振動送出 [z]。學生常把字尾唸成無聲的 [s]，或在 [m] 後面多加一個母音，變成三拍。另外 some 和 times 之間的 [m] 要閉唇，直接接 [t]，不要停頓。可以先練 time，再加上會振動的 [z]。
sometimes.tip_en: sometimes ends in [aɪmz]: close the lips for [m] first, then keep the voice buzzing to push out [z]. Learners often turn the final sound into a voiceless [s], or add a vowel after [m], making three beats. Also, the [m] between some and times needs closed lips, going straight into [t] without a pause. Practice time first, then add a buzzing [z].

examples.en: Sometimes I ride my bike to school.
examples.zh: 我有時候騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: My dad sometimes cooks dinner for us.
examples.zh: 我爸爸有時候會煮晚餐給我們吃。

sometimes.variant_zh: 也有人把 some 唸輕、重音放在後面：[səmˈtaɪmz]
sometimes.variant_en: Some speakers make some light and stress the second part: [səmˈtaɪmz].
sometimes.kk_flag: Given KK [səmˈtaɪmz] stresses the 2nd syllable with a weak [səm]; most US dictionaries list [ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz] (1st-syllable stress) first, and it is the more common General American form. Consider making it the main KK.

somewhere.tip_zh: somewhere 重音在第一音節 [sʌm]，後面的 where 唸 [wɛr]。常見錯誤是 where 沒有捲舌，唸成 [wɛ]，或把 [ɛ] 唸成 [i]，聽起來像 we're。練法：雙唇閉起發 [m]，再往前嘟成 [w]；[ɛ] 嘴巴半開，最後舌頭往後捲發 [r]。
somewhere.tip_en: somewhere is stressed on the first syllable, [sʌm]; the where part says [wɛr]. Common mistakes are leaving out the r so it becomes [wɛ], or changing [ɛ] to [i] so it sounds like we're. Practice: close the lips for [m], push them forward into [w], open halfway for [ɛ], and finally curl the tongue back for [r].

examples.en: I left my pencil box somewhere at school.
examples.zh: 我把鉛筆盒忘在學校某個地方了。

examples.en: Let's go somewhere fun this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末我們去個好玩的地方吧。

somewhere.spelling_en: wh says just [w]; the h is silent.

son.tip_zh: son 的 o 唸 [ʌ]，跟 sun（太陽）完全同音。台灣學生常照拼字把 o 唸成圓唇的 [o] 或 [ɔ]，聽起來就不像 son。練法：嘴唇不要圓，下巴微微放下、喉嚨放鬆，發一個短短的 [ʌ]，跟 up、cup 的母音一樣；最後舌尖頂上牙齦收 [n]。
son.tip_en: The o in son says [ʌ], exactly the same as sun. Taiwanese students often follow the spelling and use a rounded [o] or [ɔ], which doesn't sound like son. Practice: don't round the lips; lower the jaw slightly, relax the throat, and make a short [ʌ], the same vowel as in up and cup; finish [n] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge.

examples.en: Mr. Lin has one son and two daughters.
examples.zh: 林先生有一個兒子和兩個女兒。

examples.en: Their son is in my class.
examples.zh: 他們的兒子跟我同班。

son.spelling_zh: o 唸 [ʌ]，和 sun 同音。
son.spelling_en: o says [ʌ]; it sounds the same as sun.

song.tip_zh: song 的結尾是後鼻音 [ŋ]，舌尖不碰上牙齦。台灣學生常唸成前鼻音 [n]，或在最後多彈出一個 [g]。母音 [ɔ] 嘴巴張開、嘴唇微圓。練法：嘴巴保持張開，舌根往上頂住軟顎，讓聲音從鼻子出去；唸完嘴巴還是開著，舌尖始終留在下面。
song.tip_en: song ends in the back nasal [ŋ], and the tongue tip does not touch the upper gum ridge. Taiwanese students often say the front nasal [n] instead, or pop out an extra [g] at the end. The vowel [ɔ] has an open mouth with slightly rounded lips. Practice: keep the mouth open, raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate and let the sound go out through the nose; the mouth stays open at the end and the tongue tip stays down the whole time.

examples.en: This is my favorite song.
examples.zh: 這是我最喜歡的歌。

examples.en: We learned a new English song today.
examples.zh: 我們今天學了一首新的英文歌。

song.spelling_zh: ng 是一個 [ŋ] 音，g 不另外發出來。
song.spelling_en: ng is one sound, [ŋ]; the g is not said separately.

soon.tip_zh: soon 的 [u] 是長音，嘴唇要往前嘟圓、拉長。台灣學生常唸得太短，或把結尾 [n] 唸成後鼻音 [ŋ]。練法：嘟起嘴唇像要吹口哨，把 [u] 拉長；結尾時舌尖往上頂住上排牙齦，讓 [n] 清楚出來，嘴唇保持圓形到最後。
soon.tip_en: The [u] in soon is long, with the lips pushed forward, rounded and held. Taiwanese students often make it too short, or turn the final [n] into the back nasal [ŋ]. Practice: round the lips as if about to whistle and stretch the [u]; at the end, raise the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge so the [n] comes out clearly, keeping the lips round to the end.

examples.en: Mom will be home soon, so let's clean up.
examples.zh: 媽媽快回家了，我們來收拾吧。

examples.en: Summer vacation is coming soon.
examples.zh: 暑假快到了。

sore.tip_zh: sore 的結尾有捲舌 [r]。台灣學生常省掉 r，唸成 [sɔ]，聽起來就變成 saw；也有人把 [ɔ] 唸成會滑動的 [o]。練法：先嘴巴張開、嘴唇微圓發 [ɔ]，接著舌頭往後捲，嘴唇不用動，讓 r 的聲音拖一下再結束。
sore.tip_en: sore ends with an r-colored [r]. Taiwanese students often drop the r and say [sɔ], which sounds like saw; some also turn [ɔ] into a gliding [o]. Practice: open the mouth with slightly rounded lips for [ɔ], then curl the tongue back without moving the lips, and let the r sound last a moment before ending.

examples.en: My legs are sore after the long hike.
examples.zh: 走完長長的步道後我的腿好痠。

examples.en: I have a sore throat today.
examples.zh: 我今天喉嚨痛。

sore.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，ore 唸 [ɔr]。
sore.spelling_en: The final e is silent; ore says [ɔr].

sorry.tip_zh: 第一音節 [sɑ] 的 [ɑ] 要把下巴放低、嘴巴張大，嘴唇不要圓；常見錯誤是嘟起嘴唇唸成 [so]，聽起來像 so 再加上 ry。接著舌尖往後捲發 [r]，舌頭不碰上顎，不要變成注音的ㄌ。重音在第一音節，字尾 [rɪ] 輕而短，不用拉長。
sorry.tip_en: In the first syllable [sɑ], drop the jaw and open the mouth wide for [ɑ], without rounding the lips; a common mistake is rounding the lips into [so], so it sounds like so plus ry. Then curl the tongue tip back for [r] without touching the roof of the mouth; don't turn it into Mandarin ㄌ. The stress is on the first syllable; the ending [rɪ] is light and short, not drawn out.

examples.en: Sorry, I forgot my homework today.
examples.zh: 對不起，我今天忘了帶作業。

examples.en: I'm sorry I was late for class.
examples.zh: 對不起，我上課遲到了。

sorry.variant_zh: 部分美國人唸成 [ˈsɔrɪ]，也是正確的。
sorry.variant_en: Some Americans say [ˈsɔrɪ]; that is also correct.

sound.tip_zh: 母音 [aʊ] 是滑動的雙母音：從嘴巴張大的 [a] 開始，再把嘴唇收圓滑向 [ʊ]，不能唸成扁平的單一母音。字尾 [nd] 兩個子音連在一起，學生常把 [d] 吞掉只剩 [saʊn]，或在後面多加母音唸成「桑的」。舌尖頂住上排牙齦發完 [n] 後，原地輕輕放開就是 [d]，不要再加母音。
sound.tip_en: The vowel [aʊ] is a gliding diphthong: start with a wide-open [a], then round the lips and slide toward [ʊ]; it can't be one flat vowel. The ending [nd] is two consonants together; learners often swallow the [d], leaving only [saʊn], or add a vowel and say something like 'sahng-duh'. After [n], with the tongue tip pressed on the upper gum ridge, simply release it in place and that is [d]; add no vowel.

examples.en: Can you hear the sound of the bell?
examples.zh: 你聽得到鐘聲嗎？

examples.en: Please turn down the sound on the TV.
examples.zh: 請把電視的聲音調小。

soup.tip_zh: soup 的 ou 在這裡唸 [u]，不是 house 的 [aʊ]，也不是 soap（肥皂）的 [o]。台灣學生常照拼字唸錯，或在結尾 [p] 後面加一個母音。練法：嘴唇嘟圓唸長長的 [u]，和 you 的母音一樣；最後雙唇閉起停在 [p]，不要彈出聲音。
soup.tip_en: The ou in soup says [u] here, not the [aʊ] in house, and not the [o] in soap. Taiwanese students often misread it from the spelling, or add a vowel after the final [p]. Practice: round the lips for a long [u], the same vowel as in you; then close the lips and stop on [p] without popping out a sound.

examples.en: Mom made hot corn soup for dinner.
examples.zh: 媽媽晚餐煮了熱熱的玉米湯。

examples.en: Be careful, the soup is hot.
examples.zh: 小心，湯很燙。

south.tip_zh: south 結尾的 [θ] 是咬舌音，中文沒有這個音，台灣學生常唸成 [s] 或 [f]，聽起來像 sous 或 souf。前面的 [aʊ] 要從大張嘴滑到圓唇。練法：先唸 [saʊ]，最後把舌尖輕輕伸到上下牙齒之間，讓氣從舌頭和牙齒縫吹出來，不要震動喉嚨；它和 mouth 押韻。
south.tip_en: The final [θ] in south is a tongue-between-teeth sound that Mandarin doesn't have, so Taiwanese students often say [s] or [f] instead. The [aʊ] before it should glide from a wide-open mouth to rounded lips. Practice: say [saʊ], then put the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth and blow air through the gap without voicing; it rhymes with mouth.

examples.en: Birds fly south in the winter.
examples.zh: 鳥兒冬天往南飛。

examples.en: Kaohsiung is in the south of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 高雄在台灣南部。

space.tip_zh: space 開頭是 [sp]，s 後面的 [p] 不送氣，聽起來比較像 [b]。台灣學生常在 s 和 p 之間加母音，或用力噴氣。結尾的 [s] 也常被漏掉。練法：先嘶聲，不換氣直接閉唇接 [p]，輕輕打開滑到 [e]、往 [ɪ] 收，最後再補一個清楚的 [s]。
space.tip_en: space starts with [sp], and the [p] after s is unaspirated, so it sounds more like [b]. Taiwanese students often add a vowel between s and p, or puff out a lot of air. The final [s] is also often left out. Practice: start with a hiss, close the lips for [p] without taking a breath, open gently into [e] gliding toward [ɪ], and end with a clear [s].

examples.en: I want to fly into space one day.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天能飛上太空。

examples.en: There is not much space in my bag.
examples.zh: 我的包包裡沒什麼空間了。

space.spelling_zh: ce 唸 [s]，字尾 e 不發音。
space.spelling_en: ce says [s]; the final e is silent.

speak.tip_zh: speak 的 [i] 是長音，ea 在這裡唸 [i]。s 後面的 [p] 不送氣，聽起來比較接近 [b]，台灣學生常用力噴氣或在 s 和 p 中間加母音。結尾 [k] 舌根頂住就停。練法：拿一張紙放在嘴前，唸 speak 時紙幾乎不動；唸 peak 時紙會被吹動。
speak.tip_en: The [i] in speak is long; ea says [i] here. The [p] after s is unaspirated and sounds closer to [b]. Taiwanese students often puff air on it or add a vowel between s and p. For the final [k], press the back of the tongue up and stop. Practice: hold a piece of paper in front of your mouth; it should barely move on speak, but it will move on peak.

examples.en: Can you speak English?
examples.zh: 你會說英文嗎？

examples.en: Please speak a little louder.
examples.zh: 請說大聲一點。

special.tip_zh: special 只有兩個音節，ci 合起來唸 [ʃ]。台灣學生常照拼字把 c 唸成 [s]，再多唸一個 [i]，變成三個音節。結尾是成音節的 [ḷ]，不需要完整的母音。練法：重音在 [spɛ]；接著嘴唇微微往前嘟發 [ʃ]，像叫人安靜的「噓」；最後舌尖直接貼上牙齦收 [ḷ]。
special.tip_en: special has only two syllables, and ci together says [ʃ]. Taiwanese students often follow the spelling, reading c as [s] and adding an [i], so it becomes three syllables. It ends in a syllabic [ḷ], which needs no full vowel. Practice: stress [spɛ]; then push the lips slightly forward for [ʃ], like the 'shh' you use to ask for quiet; then put the tongue tip straight onto the gum ridge for [ḷ].

examples.en: Today is a special day for my family.
examples.zh: 今天對我們家來說是特別的日子。

examples.en: This is a special gift from my aunt.
examples.zh: 這是我阿姨送的特別禮物。

spell.tip_zh: spell 常被唸成「斯ㄅ欸歐」：s 和 p 中間多了母音，字尾 [l] 變成像「歐」的音。s 後面的 [p] 不送氣。練法：用 Can you spell it? 練習，把 spell 的 [l] 直接連到 it，變成 [lɪt]，舌尖自然會貼在上牙齦；熟了以後單獨唸 spell 也停在那個位置。
spell.tip_en: spell often comes out with a vowel between s and p, and with the final [l] turned into an 'o'-like sound. The [p] after s is unaspirated. Practice: use the sentence Can you spell it? and link the [l] of spell straight into it, making [lɪt], so the tongue tip naturally sits on the upper gum ridge; once that feels easy, stop in the same position when saying spell alone.

examples.en: Can you spell your name for me?
examples.zh: 你可以拼一下你的名字嗎？

examples.en: I can spell all the words on the list.
examples.zh: 我會拼單字表上的所有單字。

spend.tip_zh: spend 結尾是 [nd] 兩個子音。台灣學生常把 [d] 吞掉，聽起來只剩 spen；或唸成 [t]，變成 spent（過去式）。母音是 [ɛ]，不要滑成 [e]。練法：舌尖頂住上牙齦發 [n]，舌頭不移開，喉嚨繼續震動，輕輕放開就是 [d]。
spend.tip_en: spend ends in two consonants, [nd]. Taiwanese students often swallow the [d], so only spen is left, or say [t] instead, which makes it spent, the past tense. The vowel is [ɛ]; don't let it glide into [e]. Practice: press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n], keep it there with the throat still vibrating, and release gently for [d].

examples.en: I like to spend time with my grandma.
examples.zh: 我喜歡花時間陪奶奶。

examples.en: Don't spend all your money on candy.
examples.zh: 不要把錢都花在糖果上。

spider.tip_zh: spider 重音在第一音節 [spaɪ]。中間的 [d] 在美式發音中會變成很快的彈舌音，舌尖輕點上牙齦一下就過去。結尾是捲舌 [ɚ]，台灣學生常唸成沒捲舌的 [də]。練法：[spaɪ] 唸得長而有力，舌尖快速一點，最後舌頭往後捲收尾。
spider.tip_en: spider is stressed on the first syllable, [spaɪ]. The middle [d] becomes a very quick tap in American English: the tongue tip touches the upper gum ridge once and moves on. It ends with an r-colored [ɚ], which Taiwanese students often say as a non-r [də]. Practice: make [spaɪ] long and strong, tap the tongue tip quickly, and curl the tongue back at the end.

examples.en: A little spider is making a web.
examples.zh: 一隻小蜘蛛正在織網。

examples.en: My sister is afraid of spiders.
examples.zh: 我妹妹怕蜘蛛。

spoon.tip_zh: spoon 開頭的 [sp] 是重點：s 後面的 [p] 不送氣，聽起來接近 [b]。台灣學生常把 [p] 唸得很用力，或在 s 和 p 之間多加母音，變成兩拍。母音是長的 [u]，結尾 [n] 舌尖要頂上牙齦。練法：嘴唇先閉好準備 [p]，發完 [s] 就輕輕打開，直接進入嘟圓的 [u]。
spoon.tip_en: The key in spoon is the opening [sp]: the [p] after s is unaspirated and sounds close to [b]. Taiwanese students often say the [p] too strongly, or add a vowel between s and p so it takes two beats. The vowel is a long [u], and for the final [n] the tongue tip goes up to the gum ridge. Practice: close the lips ready for [p], and right after [s], open them gently straight into a rounded [u].

examples.en: Can I have a spoon for my soup?
examples.zh: 可以給我一支湯匙喝湯嗎？

examples.en: The baby is learning to use a spoon.
examples.zh: 寶寶正在學用湯匙。

sports.tip_zh: sports 結尾是 [rts] 三個子音，是最難的部分。台灣學生常把 r 和最後的 s 都省掉，只剩 [spɔt]。練法：分三步加上去：先唸 spor，舌頭往後捲；再加 [t] 變 sport；最後 [ts] 像中文「ㄘ」去掉母音、不送氣那麼重，三步連起來還是一拍。
sports.tip_en: sports ends in three consonants, [rts], which is the hardest part. Taiwanese students often drop both the r and the final s, leaving only [spɔt]. Practice: build it in three steps: first say spor with the tongue curled back; then add [t] to get sport; finally add [ts], like the Mandarin 'ts' sound without its vowel and with less air. Put the three steps together in a single beat.

examples.en: My favorite sports are swimming and basketball.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的運動是游泳和籃球。

examples.en: We have sports day next Friday.
examples.zh: 我們下週五有運動會。

spring.tip_zh: spring 開頭有 [spr] 三個子音連在一起，台灣學生常在中間塞進母音，唸成三拍。結尾是後鼻音 [ŋ]，不是 [n]；母音是短的 [ɪ]。練法：發 [s] 時嘴唇已經閉好準備 [p]，[p] 一打開舌頭立刻往後捲成 [r]，一口氣滑進 [ɪŋ]，整個字只有一拍。
spring.tip_en: spring starts with three consonants together, [spr], and Taiwanese students often squeeze vowels between them, saying it in three beats. It ends in the back nasal [ŋ], not [n], and the vowel is a short [ɪ]. Practice: while saying [s], already close the lips ready for [p]; as soon as [p] opens, curl the tongue back into [r], and glide into [ɪŋ] in one breath. The whole word is one beat.

examples.en: Flowers bloom in the spring.
examples.zh: 花在春天開。

examples.en: We go hiking every spring.
examples.zh: 我們每年春天都去爬山。

spring.spelling_zh: ng 是一個 [ŋ] 音，g 不另外發出來。
spring.spelling_en: ng is one sound, [ŋ]; the g is not said separately.

square.tip_zh: square 的 qu 唸 [kw]，開頭是 [skw] 三個子音。台灣學生常在中間加母音，或結尾沒有捲舌，只剩 [skwɛ]。練法：發 [s] 時嘴唇就先嘟圓準備 [w]，舌根接著頂一下發 [k]，嘴唇往外打開到 [ɛ]，最後舌頭往後捲發 [r]，一拍唸完。
square.tip_en: In square, qu says [kw], so it starts with three consonants, [skw]. Taiwanese students often add vowels in between, or leave out the final r so only [skwɛ] is left. Practice: round the lips for [w] while still saying [s], touch the back of the tongue up for [k], open the lips into [ɛ], and finally curl the tongue back for [r], all in one beat.

examples.en: Draw a square on your paper.
examples.zh: 在紙上畫一個正方形。

examples.en: The table in our kitchen is square.
examples.zh: 我們廚房的桌子是正方形的。

square.spelling_zh: qu 唸 [kw]，字尾 e 不發音。
square.spelling_en: qu says [kw]; the final e is silent.

stairs.tip_zh: stairs 的母音是 [ɛr]，嘴巴半開；如果張太大唸成 [ɑr]，就變成 stars（星星）。結尾是有聲的 [z]，台灣學生常唸成 [s]，或連 r 一起省掉。練法：[ɛ] 嘴型像 bed，接著舌頭往後捲發 [r]，最後喉嚨震動發出嗡嗡的 [z]。和 stares 同音。
stairs.tip_en: The vowel in stairs is [ɛr], with the mouth half open; if you open too wide and say [ɑr], it becomes stars. It ends in a voiced [z], which Taiwanese students often say as [s], sometimes dropping the r as well. Practice: shape [ɛ] like in bed, curl the tongue back for [r], and finish with a buzzing [z] that vibrates the throat. It sounds the same as stares.

examples.en: Walk up the stairs to the second floor.
examples.zh: 走樓梯上二樓。

examples.en: Please don't run on the stairs.
examples.zh: 請不要在樓梯上跑。

stairs.spelling_en: air says [ɛr]; the s here says [z].

stamp.tip_zh: stamp 的 [æ] 要張大嘴、嘴角往兩邊拉，不要唸成較小的 [ɛ]。結尾 [mp]：中文沒有 [m] 結尾，台灣學生常把雙唇音省掉或唸成 [n]。練法：唸完 [æ] 後雙唇閉起哼 [m]，嘴唇不打開，再輕輕彈一下發出很小的 [p]，不要加母音。
stamp.tip_en: The [æ] in stamp needs an open mouth with the corners pulled sideways; don't make it the smaller [ɛ]. At the end, [mp]: Mandarin has no [m] endings, so Taiwanese students often drop the lip sounds or say [n]. Practice: after [æ], close the lips and hum [m], keep them closed, then pop a tiny [p] without adding a vowel.

examples.en: I need a stamp for this letter.
examples.zh: 這封信我需要一張郵票。

examples.en: My grandpa collects stamps from many countries.
examples.zh: 我爺爺收集很多國家的郵票。

stand.tip_zh: stand 的母音是張大嘴的 [æ]，台灣學生常唸成 [ɛ]，聽起來像 stend。結尾 [nd] 的 [d] 也常被吞掉，變成 stan。練法：下巴往下掉、嘴角拉開發 [æ]；舌尖頂上牙齦發 [n] 後不離開，喉嚨保持震動，輕輕放開就是 [d]。
stand.tip_en: The vowel in stand is a wide-open [æ]. Taiwanese students often say [ɛ] instead, so it sounds like stend. The [d] in the final [nd] is also often swallowed, leaving stan. Practice: drop the jaw and pull the corners of the mouth apart for [æ]; press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n], keep it there with the throat vibrating, and release gently for [d].

examples.en: Please stand up and say your name.
examples.zh: 請站起來說出你的名字。

examples.en: We stand in line for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們排隊買午餐。

star.tip_zh: star 只有一個音節。台灣學生常在 s 和 t 之間加母音唸成兩拍，或省掉結尾的 r，只剩 [stɑ]。s 後面的 [t] 不送氣，聽起來比較接近 [d]。練法：s 直接接 t，不要噴氣；嘴巴張大發 [ɑ]，最後舌頭往後捲、舌尖不碰任何地方，讓 [r] 的聲音拖一下。
star.tip_en: star has only one syllable. Taiwanese students often add a vowel between s and t, making two beats, or drop the final r, leaving only [stɑ]. The [t] after s is unaspirated and sounds closer to [d]. Practice: go straight from s into t without a puff of air, open wide for [ɑ], and finally curl the tongue back without the tip touching anything, letting the [r] last a moment.

examples.en: I can see a bright star tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我看得到一顆很亮的星星。

examples.en: She drew a yellow star on her card.
examples.zh: 她在卡片上畫了一顆黃色的星星。

start.tip_zh: start 裡有兩個 [t]：s 後面的 [t] 不送氣，結尾的 [t] 只要停住不彈出。台灣學生常把 [r] 省掉，唸成 [stɑt]，或在結尾加母音。練法：先唸好 star，舌頭捲著不放，舌尖再往上頂住上牙齦停住，就是 start；不要再放出任何母音。
start.tip_en: start has two [t] sounds: the one after s is unaspirated, and the final one just stops without being released. Taiwanese students often drop the [r] and say [stɑt], or add a vowel at the end. Practice: say star first, keep the tongue curled, then lift the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge and stop; that is start. Don't let any vowel come out after it.

examples.en: School starts at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 學校八點開始上課。

examples.en: Let's start the game now!
examples.zh: 我們現在開始遊戲吧！

station.tip_zh: station 重音在第一音節 [ste]，tion 唸成很輕的 [ʃən]。台灣學生常把第二音節唸得太重，或把 tion 唸成 [tion] 甚至 [ʃɔn]。練法：[ste] 唸得長而清楚、從 [e] 往 [ɪ] 滑；接著嘴唇微微往前嘟發 [ʃ]，母音放鬆成 [ə]，最後舌尖頂上牙齦收 [n]。
station.tip_en: station is stressed on the first syllable, [ste], and tion is a very light [ʃən]. Taiwanese students often make the second syllable too strong, or read tion as [tion] or even [ʃɔn]. Practice: say [ste] long and clear, gliding from [e] toward [ɪ]; then push the lips slightly forward for [ʃ], relax the vowel into [ə], and finish [n] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge.

examples.en: Let's meet at the train station.
examples.zh: 我們在火車站見面吧。

examples.en: The MRT station is near my school.
examples.zh: 捷運站在我學校附近。

stay.tip_zh: stay 的 [e] 要從 [e] 滑向 [ɪ]，嘴巴最後稍微合起來。台灣學生常唸成平平不動的 [ɛ]，或在 s 和 t 之間加母音。s 後面的 [t] 不送氣，聽起來比較接近 [d]。練法：s 直接接 t、不噴氣，然後把 [e] 拉長，尾巴嘴角往兩邊拉成 [ɪ]。
stay.tip_en: The [e] in stay glides from [e] toward [ɪ], with the mouth closing slightly at the end. Taiwanese students often say a flat, unmoving [ɛ], or add a vowel between s and t. The [t] after s is unaspirated and sounds closer to [d]. Practice: go straight from s into t without a puff of air, then stretch the [e] and spread the lips into [ɪ] at the end.

examples.en: Can you stay for dinner?
examples.zh: 你可以留下來吃晚餐嗎？

examples.en: We will stay at Grandma's house this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末我們會住在奶奶家。

steak.tip_zh: steak 的 ea 在這裡唸 [e]，不是 [i]。台灣學生常照 speak、eat 的規則唸成 [stik]，聽起來像 stick。它和 stake 同音。練法：把 steak 想成 st 加上 ache 的母音，[e] 要往 [ɪ] 滑動；最後舌根頂住軟顎停在 [k]，不要彈出母音。
steak.tip_en: The ea in steak says [e] here, not [i]. Taiwanese students often follow the rule from speak and eat and say [stik], which sounds like stick. It sounds the same as stake. Practice: think of steak as st plus the vowel of ache, with [e] gliding toward [ɪ]; then stop on [k] with the back of the tongue against the soft palate, releasing no vowel.

examples.en: Dad is cooking steak for dinner.
examples.zh: 爸爸在煮牛排當晚餐。

examples.en: I like my steak with potatoes.
examples.zh: 我喜歡牛排配馬鈴薯。

still.tip_zh: 開頭 [st] 兩個子音直接相連，不要在 [s] 後面多加母音，唸成「斯提歐」那樣的三拍；而且 [s] 後面的 [t] 不送氣，聽起來有點接近 [d]。母音 [ɪ] 短而放鬆，拉長成 [i] 就會變成 steal（偷）。字尾是暗 L：舌尖頂住上排牙齦，舌根同時往後抬，不要唸成「歐」或乾脆省略。
still.tip_en: The opening [st] is two consonants joined directly; don't add a vowel after [s] and turn it into three beats like 'si-ti-ou'. Also, the [t] after [s] has no puff of air, so it sounds a bit like [d]. The vowel [ɪ] is short and relaxed; stretch it into [i] and it becomes steal. The ending is a dark L: press the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge while raising the back of the tongue; don't say it as an 'ou' sound or leave it out.

examples.en: I am still hungry after lunch.
examples.zh: 吃完午餐我還是很餓。

examples.en: Is your little brother still asleep?
examples.zh: 你弟弟還在睡嗎？

stomach.tip_zh: stomach 的結尾 ch 唸 [k]，不是 [tʃ]。台灣學生常照拼字唸成「…麻曲」。第一個 o 唸 [ʌ]，重音在第一音節；第二音節是輕輕的 [ə]。練法：[stʌ] 嘴巴放鬆、短而有力，接著雙唇閉起發 [m]，帶一個很輕的 [ə]，最後舌根頂住停在 [k]。
stomach.tip_en: The final ch in stomach says [k], not [tʃ]; Taiwanese students often follow the spelling and end it with a 'ch' sound. The first o says [ʌ], and the stress is on the first syllable; the second syllable has a light [ə]. Practice: say [stʌ] relaxed, short and strong, close the lips for [m], add a very light [ə], and stop on [k] with the back of the tongue raised.

examples.en: My stomach is full after lunch.
examples.zh: 吃完午餐我的肚子好飽。

examples.en: I have a stomachache today.
examples.zh: 我今天肚子痛。

stomach.spelling_en: ch here says [k], and the o says [ʌ].

stop.tip_zh: stop 的母音是張大嘴的 [ɑ]，不是圓唇的 [o]。台灣學生常照拼字把 o 唸圓，結尾 [p] 又多加一個母音。s 後面的 [t] 不送氣。練法：母音嘴型和 hot 一樣，下巴往下掉；唸完雙唇閉起停在 [p]，不放出聲音，就像真的「停住」一樣。
stop.tip_en: The vowel in stop is a wide-open [ɑ], not a rounded [o]. Taiwanese students often follow the spelling and round the o, then add a vowel after the final [p]. The [t] after s is unaspirated. Practice: shape the vowel like in hot, with the jaw dropped; then close the lips and stop on [p] without releasing any sound, as if really coming to a stop.

examples.en: Please stop talking and listen.
examples.zh: 請停止說話，仔細聽。

examples.en: The bus will stop in front of the school.
examples.zh: 公車會停在學校前面。

store.tip_zh: store 只有一個音節。台灣學生常在 s 和 t 之間加母音唸成兩拍，或省掉結尾的 r，唸成 [stɔ]。s 後面的 [t] 不送氣，比較接近 [d]，不要用力噴氣。練法：[st] 一起發，嘴巴打開、嘴唇微圓發 [ɔ]，接著舌頭往後捲發 [r]，讓聲音停在捲舌上。
store.tip_en: store has only one syllable. Taiwanese students often add a vowel between s and t, making two beats, or drop the final r and say [stɔ]. The [t] after s is unaspirated, closer to [d]; don't puff air on it. Practice: say [st] together, open the mouth with slightly rounded lips for [ɔ], then curl the tongue back for [r] and let the sound end on that curl.

examples.en: Let's buy some milk at the store.
examples.zh: 我們去商店買些牛奶吧。

examples.en: The toy store is on the first floor.
examples.zh: 玩具店在一樓。

store.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，ore 唸 [ɔr]。
store.spelling_en: The final e is silent; ore says [ɔr].

story.tip_zh: story 重音在第一音節 [stɔ]，中間的 [r] 是捲舌音，舌頭不碰上顎。台灣學生常把 [r] 唸成 [l]，聽起來像「斯多利」。結尾 [ɪ] 短而輕。練法：[ɔ] 之後舌頭往後捲，舌尖懸空，不要點到上牙齦；從捲舌的位置直接滑到輕輕的 [ɪ]。
story.tip_en: story is stressed on the first syllable, [stɔ], and the middle [r] is a curled-tongue sound where the tongue does not touch the roof of the mouth. Taiwanese students often say [l] instead of [r]. The final [ɪ] is short and light. Practice: after [ɔ], curl the tongue back with the tip in the air, not touching the gum ridge, and slide straight from that curled position into a light [ɪ].

examples.en: Grandma tells me a story every night.
examples.zh: 奶奶每天晚上都講故事給我聽。

examples.en: This is a funny story about a cat.
examples.zh: 這是一個關於貓的有趣故事。

straight.tip_zh: straight 的 aigh 只唸一個 [e]，gh 完全不發音。台灣學生看到 g 常想唸出來，或把母音唸成短的 [ɛ]。開頭 [str] 三個子音要連在一起，不要加母音。練法：它和 great、late 的母音一樣；[str] 一口氣唸，最後 [t] 舌尖頂住就停。
straight.tip_en: In straight, aigh says just one [e], and the gh is completely silent. Taiwanese students often want to pronounce the g, or shorten the vowel to [ɛ]. The opening [str] must be three consonants joined together, with no added vowels. Practice: it has the same vowel as great and late; say [str] in one breath and stop the final [t] with the tongue tip on the gum ridge.

examples.en: Go straight and turn left at the park.
examples.zh: 直走，到公園左轉。

examples.en: Please sit up straight in your chair.
examples.zh: 請在椅子上坐直。

strange.tip_zh: strange 結尾是 [ndʒ]，台灣學生常把 [dʒ] 吞掉，變成 [stren]，或在後面多加一個母音。開頭 [str] 不要拆成好幾拍。練法：唸 [stren] 時舌尖頂住上牙齦，不移開直接接 [dʒ]，就像 jump 的開頭，但後面不要接母音；字尾 e 不發音。
strange.tip_en: strange ends in [ndʒ]. Taiwanese students often swallow the [dʒ] and say [stren], or add an extra vowel after it. The opening [str] should not be broken into several beats. Practice: while saying [stren], keep the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge and go straight into [dʒ], like the start of jump, but with no vowel after it; the final e is silent.

examples.en: I heard a strange noise last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚聽到一個奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: This fruit has a strange shape.
examples.zh: 這個水果的形狀很奇怪。

strange.spelling_zh: ge 唸 [dʒ]，字尾 e 不發音。
strange.spelling_en: ge says [dʒ]; the final e is silent.

stranger.tip_zh: stranger 的 g 唸 [dʒ]，跟 strange 一樣，不是 [g]。台灣學生常唸成硬的 [g]，或結尾沒有捲舌，只唸 [dʒə]。重音在第一音節 [stren]。練法：先唸好 strange，後面加上輕輕的捲舌 [ɚ]；中間不要多一個 [g]。
stranger.tip_en: The g in stranger says [dʒ], just as in strange, not [g]. Taiwanese students often use a hard [g], or end without the r, saying only [dʒə]. The stress is on the first syllable, [stren]. Practice: say strange first, then add a light r-colored [ɚ]; don't slip an extra [g] in the middle.

examples.en: Don't open the door for a stranger.
examples.zh: 不要幫陌生人開門。

examples.en: A kind stranger helped us find the way.
examples.zh: 一位好心的陌生人幫我們找到路。

strawberry.tip_zh: 開頭 [str] 是三個子音連發，學生常在中間塞母音，唸成「斯特饒」好幾拍。練習時先拉長 [s]，再一口氣滑到 [tr]，[t] 和 [r] 黏在一起，嘴唇在發 [t] 時就先嘟起來。[ɔ] 下巴放低、嘴唇略圓。重音在第一音節 [strɔ]，後面的 [bɛrɪ] 較輕，不要把 berry 唸得比 straw 還重。
strawberry.tip_en: The opening [str] is three consonants in a row; learners often squeeze vowels in between and say several beats like 'si-te-rao'. To practice, stretch the [s], then glide straight into [tr] in one breath with [t] and [r] stuck together, rounding the lips already on [t]. For [ɔ], lower the jaw and round the lips slightly. The stress is on the first syllable [strɔ]; the following [bɛrɪ] is lighter, so don't say berry louder than straw.

examples.en: Mom made a strawberry cake for my birthday.
examples.zh: 媽媽為我的生日做了草莓蛋糕。

examples.en: This strawberry is big and sweet.
examples.zh: 這顆草莓又大又甜。

street.tip_zh: street 開頭 [str] 三個子音連在一起，台灣學生常在 s 和 t 之間、t 和 r 之間都加母音，唸成三拍。母音是長的 [i]，結尾 [t] 停住就好。練法：先練 tree，再在前面加 [s] 變成 [stri]，最後舌尖頂上牙齦收 [t]；全部一拍。
street.tip_en: street starts with three consonants together, [str]. Taiwanese students often add vowels between s and t and between t and r, saying it in three beats. The vowel is a long [i], and the final [t] just stops. Practice: first say tree, then add [s] in front to get [stri], and finally stop [t] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge, all in one beat.

examples.en: I live on a quiet street.
examples.zh: 我住在一條安靜的街上。

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
examples.zh: 過馬路前要左右看。

string.tip_zh: string 的母音是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，不是長的 [i]；台灣學生常唸得太長，或把結尾 [ŋ] 唸成 [n]。[ɪ] 碰到 [ŋ] 時嘴巴要放鬆、不要往兩邊拉。練法：先練 sing 的 [ɪŋ]，舌根往上頂、舌尖放下；再在前面加 [str]，一拍唸完。
string.tip_en: The vowel in string is a short, relaxed [ɪ], not a long [i]. Taiwanese students often make it too long, or turn the final [ŋ] into [n]. When [ɪ] meets [ŋ], keep the mouth relaxed rather than spreading the lips. Practice: first say the [ɪŋ] of sing, with the back of the tongue raised and the tip down; then add [str] in front and say it in one beat.

examples.en: Tie the box with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 用一條細繩把盒子綁起來。

examples.en: My kite has a long string.
examples.zh: 我的風箏有一條長長的線。

string.spelling_zh: ng 是一個 [ŋ] 音，g 不另外發出來。
string.spelling_en: ng is one sound, [ŋ]; the g is not said separately.

strong.tip_zh: strong 的 [tr] 要先讓舌尖碰上牙齦發 [t]，再往後捲成 [r]。台灣學生常唸成中文捲舌的「ㄓ」或「ㄔ」，或在中間加母音。結尾是 [ŋ]，不要多彈出 [g]。練法：慢慢唸 s-t-r，感覺舌尖從上牙齦往後滑；嘴巴打開、嘴唇微圓發 [ɔ]，舌根頂住收 [ŋ]。
strong.tip_en: For the [tr] in strong, first touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge for [t], then curl it back into [r]. Taiwanese students often replace it with a Mandarin retroflex sound or add a vowel in between. It ends in [ŋ]; don't pop out an extra [g]. Practice: say s-t-r slowly and feel the tongue tip slide back from the gum ridge; open the mouth with slightly rounded lips for [ɔ], then raise the back of the tongue to finish with [ŋ].

examples.en: My dad is big and strong.
examples.zh: 我爸爸又高大又強壯。

examples.en: Drink milk to grow strong bones.
examples.zh: 喝牛奶讓骨頭長得強壯。

strong.spelling_zh: ng 是一個 [ŋ] 音，g 不另外發出來。
strong.spelling_en: ng is one sound, [ŋ]; the g is not said separately.

student.tip_zh: 美式第一音節是 [stu]，不要在 [t] 和 [u] 之間多加 [j] 唸成英式的 [stju]；[s] 後面的 [t] 也不送氣。第二音節 [dṇt] 中間沒有母音：舌尖發完 [d] 後留在上排牙齦不動，讓氣直接從鼻子出來變成 [ṇ]，最後舌尖停住收 [t]。常見錯誤是唸成清楚的「登」再加「特」。
student.tip_en: In American English the first syllable is [stu]; don't add [j] between [t] and [u] as in British [stju]. The [t] after [s] also has no puff of air. The second syllable [dṇt] has no vowel: after [d], keep the tongue tip still on the upper gum ridge and let the air go straight out through the nose for [ṇ], then stop the tongue there for [t]. A common mistake is saying a clear 'deng' followed by 'te'.

examples.en: She is a new student in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我們班的新同學。

examples.en: Every student gets a book today.
examples.zh: 今天每位學生都會拿到一本書。

study.tip_zh: study 的 u 唸 [ʌ]，不是 [u]。台灣學生常受 student 影響唸成 [stu]。重音在第一音節。中間的 [d] 在美式發音中常變成快速的彈舌音，舌尖輕點一下就過；結尾 [ɪ] 短而輕。練法：第一音節嘴型和 up 一樣，短而有力。
study.tip_en: The u in study says [ʌ], not [u]. Taiwanese students are often influenced by student and say [stu]. The stress is on the first syllable. The middle [d] often becomes a quick tap in American English: the tongue tip touches once and moves on. The final [ɪ] is short and light. Practice: shape the first syllable like up, short and strong.

examples.en: I study English every day.
examples.zh: 我每天讀英文。

examples.en: We study together in the library.
examples.zh: 我們一起在圖書館讀書。

study.spelling_zh: u 在這裡唸 [ʌ]，和 student 的 u 不同。
study.spelling_en: u here says [ʌ], unlike the u in student.

stupid.tip_zh: stupid 重音在第一音節 [stu]，u 唸長的 [u]；第二音節 [pəd] 很輕。台灣學生常把重音放在第二音節，或把結尾 [d] 唸成 [t]。s 後面的 [t] 不送氣。練法：[stu] 嘴唇嘟圓、拉長、加重；[pəd] 輕輕帶過，最後舌尖點一下上牙齦，喉嚨保持震動。
stupid.tip_en: stupid is stressed on the first syllable, [stu], where u is a long [u]; the second syllable, [pəd], is very light. Taiwanese students often stress the second syllable, or say the final [d] as [t]. The [t] after s is unaspirated. Practice: make [stu] rounded, long and strong; pass lightly over [pəd], ending with a light tap of the tongue tip on the gum ridge while the throat keeps vibrating.

examples.en: It was a stupid mistake, so I fixed it.
examples.zh: 那是個很笨的錯誤，所以我改好了。

examples.en: Please don't call your brother stupid.
examples.zh: 請不要說你弟弟笨。

successful.tip_zh: 重音在第二音節 [sɛs]，學生常把第一音節唸重。開頭 [sək] 要輕又短，[k] 發完馬上接 [s]，拼字的 cc 正是 [ks] 兩個音，[k] 不能吞掉。字尾 -ful 是 [fḷ]：上排牙齒碰下唇發 [f] 後，舌尖直接頂到上排牙齦發暗 L，中間沒有母音，不要唸成「佛」或省略 l。
successful.tip_en: The stress is on the second syllable [sɛs]; learners often stress the first. The opening [sək] is light and short, and [k] goes straight into [s]: the spelling cc is exactly the two sounds [ks], so don't swallow the [k]. The ending -ful is [fḷ]: after the upper teeth touch the lower lip for [f], the tongue tip goes straight up to the upper gum ridge for a dark L, with no vowel between; don't say it as 'fo' or drop the l.

examples.en: Our school play was very successful.
examples.zh: 我們學校的話劇非常成功。

examples.en: She worked hard and became a successful doctor.
examples.zh: 她很努力，成為一位成功的醫生。

successful.spelling_zh: cc 唸 [ks]；字尾 -ful 只有一個 l。
successful.spelling_en: cc is said [ks]; the ending -ful has only one l.

sugar.tip_zh: sugar 的 s 唸 [ʃ]，不是 [s]，這是台灣學生最常唸錯的地方，常照拼字唸成「蘇格」。母音是短的 [ʊ]，重音在第一音節；結尾是捲舌 [ɚ]。練法：嘴唇往前嘟、舌頭往後縮一點發 [ʃ]，像叫人安靜的「噓」，接著短短的 [ʊ]，最後輕輕捲舌。
sugar.tip_en: The s in sugar says [ʃ], not [s]; this is the most common mistake for Taiwanese students, who often follow the spelling and start with a plain s. The vowel is a short [ʊ], with stress on the first syllable, and it ends in an r-colored [ɚ]. Practice: push the lips forward and pull the tongue back a little for [ʃ], like the 'shh' for quiet, add a short [ʊ], and curl the tongue lightly at the end.

examples.en: Do you want sugar in your tea?
examples.zh: 你的茶要加糖嗎？

examples.en: Too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖對牙齒不好。

sugar.spelling_zh: s 在這裡唸 [ʃ]，和 sure 一樣。
sugar.spelling_en: The s here says [ʃ], as in sure.

summer.tip_zh: summer 重音在第一音節，u 唸 [ʌ]；mm 只唸一個 [m]。台灣學生常把結尾唸成沒捲舌的 [mə]，或把 u 唸成 [u]。練法：[sʌ] 嘴巴放鬆、短而有力，雙唇閉起哼 [m]，不要停頓，嘴唇打開時舌頭直接往後捲發 [ɚ]。
summer.tip_en: summer is stressed on the first syllable, and u says [ʌ]; mm is just one [m]. Taiwanese students often end it with a non-r [mə], or say the u as [u]. Practice: say [sʌ] relaxed, short and strong, close the lips and hum [m] without pausing, and as the lips open, curl the tongue straight back for [ɚ].

examples.en: We go to the beach every summer.
examples.zh: 我們每年夏天都去海邊。

examples.en: Summer vacation starts in July.
examples.zh: 暑假在七月開始。

sun.tip_zh: sun 結尾是前鼻音 [n]，台灣學生常唸成後鼻音 [ŋ]，聽起來像 sung；母音也常張太大變成 [ɑ]。練法：[ʌ] 嘴巴微開、放鬆，像輕輕說「呃」；結尾一定要把舌尖往上頂住上排牙齦，嘴巴可以稍微合起來，讓 [n] 清楚收尾。
sun.tip_en: sun ends in the front nasal [n]. Taiwanese students often say the back nasal [ŋ], so it sounds like sung; the vowel is also often opened too wide into [ɑ]. Practice: for [ʌ], open the mouth slightly and relax, like a soft 'uh'; at the end, be sure to press the tongue tip up against the upper gum ridge, letting the mouth close a little, so the [n] finishes clearly.

examples.en: The sun is very hot today.
examples.zh: 今天太陽好大。

examples.en: Don't forget your hat in the sun.
examples.zh: 在太陽下別忘了戴帽子。

sun.spelling_en: It sounds the same as son.

sunday.tip_zh: Sunday 重音在第一音節 [sʌn]，第二音節 [de] 較輕。台灣學生常把兩個音節唸得一樣重，或把 [n] 唸成 [ŋ]。練法：[sʌn] 結尾舌尖頂住上牙齦，不放開直接接 [d]，n 和 d 用同一個舌位；[de] 輕輕帶過，往 [ɪ] 收一點。
sunday.tip_en: Sunday is stressed on the first syllable, [sʌn]; the second syllable, [de], is lighter. Taiwanese students often give both syllables equal weight, or turn [n] into [ŋ]. Practice: end [sʌn] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge and go straight into [d] without releasing it, since n and d share the same tongue position; say [de] lightly, closing a little toward [ɪ].

examples.en: We go to the park on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們星期日去公園。

examples.en: Sunday is my favorite day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期日是我一週中最喜歡的一天。

sunday.variant_zh: 也常聽到第二音節唸輕的 [ˈsʌndɪ]。
sunday.variant_en: The second syllable is also often reduced: [ˈsʌndɪ].

sunny.tip_zh: sunny 的 nn 只唸一個 [n]，台灣學生常在中間停一下、把 [n] 唸兩次。重音在第一音節，結尾 [ɪ] 短而輕。練法：唸 sun 時舌尖頂住上牙齦，不要放開也不要停，直接把 [ɪ] 接上去，讓 [n] 跟著第二音節一起滑出去。
sunny.tip_en: The nn in sunny is just one [n]; Taiwanese students often pause in the middle and say the [n] twice. The stress is on the first syllable, and the final [ɪ] is short and light. Practice: say sun with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge, then without releasing or pausing, attach the [ɪ] directly so the [n] slides into the second syllable.

examples.en: It is sunny and warm today.
examples.zh: 今天陽光普照又溫暖。

examples.en: Let's go to the beach on a sunny day.
examples.zh: 我們找個晴天去海邊吧。

supermarket.tip_zh: 這個字有兩個捲舌音：[pɚ] 和 [mɑr]。學生常把 super 唸成沒有捲舌的「蘇趴」，mar 唸成「媽」，聽起來像英式。[pɚ] 舌頭往後捲、嘴巴半開；[mɑr] 先張大嘴發 [ɑ]，再把舌尖往後捲。重音在第一音節 [su]，最後的 [kɪt] 又輕又短，母音是 [ɪ] 不是 [ɛ]，字尾 [t] 輕輕停住，不要加「特」。
supermarket.tip_en: This word has two r-colored sounds: [pɚ] and [mɑr]. Learners often say super as an un-curled 'su-pa' and mar as 'ma', which sounds British. For [pɚ], curl the tongue back with the mouth half open; for [mɑr], open wide for [ɑ] first, then curl the tongue tip back. The stress is on the first syllable [su]; the last part [kɪt] is light and short, its vowel is [ɪ], not [ɛ], and the final [t] just stops, without an added 'te'.

examples.en: We buy milk at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我們在超市買牛奶。

examples.en: The supermarket near my home opens at eight.
examples.zh: 我家附近的超市八點開門。

sure.tip_zh: sure 的 s 唸 [ʃ]，不是 [s]。台灣學生常照拼字唸成 [sʊr]，或把 r 省掉。練法：嘴唇往前嘟發 [ʃ]，像叫人安靜的「噓」；接著短短的 [ʊ]，舌頭再往後捲發 [r]。整個字只有一拍，嘴唇從頭到尾都微微往前。
sure.tip_en: The s in sure says [ʃ], not [s]. Taiwanese students often follow the spelling and say [sʊr], or drop the r. Practice: push the lips forward for [ʃ], like the 'shh' for quiet; then add a short [ʊ] and curl the tongue back for [r]. The whole word is one beat, with the lips slightly forward throughout.

examples.en: Are you sure about the answer?
examples.zh: 你確定答案是這個嗎？

examples.en: Sure, I can help you with that.
examples.zh: 當然，我可以幫你。

sure.spelling_zh: s 在這裡唸 [ʃ]，和 sugar 一樣。
sure.spelling_en: The s here says [ʃ], as in sugar.

surf.tip_zh: surf 的 ur 唸捲舌的 [ɝ]，跟 sir 的母音一樣。台灣學生常唸成沒捲舌的 [sʌf]，或在結尾 [f] 後面加母音。練法：舌頭往後捲、整個母音保持捲舌；最後上排牙齒輕輕碰下唇，讓氣從縫裡吹出 [f]，不要震動喉嚨，也不要接母音。
surf.tip_en: The ur in surf is the r-colored [ɝ], the same vowel as in sir. Taiwanese students often say it without the r, [sʌf], or add a vowel after the final [f]. Practice: curl the tongue back and keep the r-color through the whole vowel; then lightly touch the upper teeth to the lower lip and blow air through the gap for [f], without voicing and without adding a vowel.

examples.en: My uncle likes to surf in Yilan.
examples.zh: 我叔叔喜歡在宜蘭衝浪。

examples.en: I want to learn to surf this summer.
examples.zh: 我今年夏天想學衝浪。

surf.spelling_zh: ur 唸 [ɝ]，和 sir 的 ir 同音。
surf.spelling_en: ur says [ɝ], the same as the ir in sir.

surprise.tip_zh: 重音在第二音節 [praɪz]，學生常把第一音節 sur 唸得又重又長。[sɚ] 要輕、快，舌頭微捲就好。[pr] 之間不要加母音，嘴唇發 [p] 時就先嘟起來準備 [r]。字尾的 s 其實是有聲的 [z]，喉嚨要像蜜蜂一樣嗡嗡震動，唸成 [s] 就少了這個震動。
surprise.tip_en: The stress is on the second syllable [praɪz]; learners often make the first syllable sur heavy and long. [sɚ] should be light and quick, with only a slight curl of the tongue. Add no vowel between [p] and [r]: round the lips for [r] already while making [p]. The final s is actually a voiced [z]: the throat should buzz like a bee; saying [s] loses that buzz.

examples.en: Let's surprise Dad with a birthday card.
examples.zh: 我們用生日卡給爸爸一個驚喜吧。

examples.en: Grandma likes to surprise us with snacks.
examples.zh: 奶奶喜歡拿點心給我們驚喜。

surprise.variant_zh: 說快時第一音節常不捲舌，唸成 [səˈpraɪz]。
surprise.variant_en: In quick speech the first syllable often loses its r: [səˈpraɪz].
surprise.spelling_zh: 第一個 r 唸得很輕，常被漏寫成 suprise。
surprise.spelling_en: The first r is very light, so it is often misspelled suprise.

surprised.tip_zh: 這個字只有兩個音節，-ed 不自成一拍，不要唸成 [sɚˈpraɪzɪd]。字尾 [zd] 都是有聲子音：發 [z] 時喉嚨震動，舌尖不離開上排牙齦，直接收成 [d]。常見錯誤是把結尾唸成無聲的 [st]，或在最後加母音變成「ㄗ的」。重音一樣在第二音節 [praɪzd]，第一音節 [sɚ] 輕輕帶過。
surprised.tip_en: This word has only two syllables; -ed is not a beat of its own, so don't say [sɚˈpraɪzɪd]. The ending [zd] is two voiced consonants: let the throat buzz on [z] and, without moving the tongue tip off the upper gum ridge, close straight into [d]. Common mistakes are saying the ending as a voiceless [st] or adding a vowel at the end, like 'z-duh'. The stress is still on the second syllable [praɪzd]; the first syllable [sɚ] passes lightly.

examples.en: I was surprised by the big gift.
examples.zh: 那份大禮物讓我很驚訝。

examples.en: Dad looked surprised when he saw the cake.
examples.zh: 爸爸看到蛋糕時一臉驚訝。

surprised.variant_zh: 說快時常唸成 [səˈpraɪzd]，第一音節不捲舌。
surprised.variant_en: In quick speech it is often [səˈpraɪzd], with no r in the first syllable.

sweater.tip_zh: 第一音節是短的 [ɛ]，跟 bed 的母音一樣，不是 sweet 的 [i]；看到 ea 就唸成 sweeter「更甜」是常見錯誤。字尾 [ɚ] 舌尖要往後捲，不要唸成「特」或「它」就結束。美式口語中間的 t 常輕彈得像很快的 d。
sweater.tip_en: The first syllable is a short [ɛ], the same vowel as in bed, not the [i] of sweet; seeing ea and saying sweeter ('more sweet') is a common mistake. For the final [ɚ] curl the tongue back; don't end on a flat 'te' or 'ta'. In casual American speech the middle t is often a quick tap that sounds like a fast d.

examples.en: Grandma made me a warm sweater.
examples.zh: 奶奶幫我織了一件溫暖的毛衣。

examples.en: Put on your sweater; it's cold outside.
examples.zh: 穿上你的毛衣，外面很冷。

sweater.spelling_zh: ea 在這裡唸 [ɛ]，跟 bread 一樣，不唸 [i]
sweater.spelling_en: ea here is [ɛ], as in bread, not [i]

sweet.tip_zh: 開頭 [sw] 是兩個子音連在一起，[s] 後面不要插母音唸成「斯—威」；發 [s] 的時候嘴唇就先圓起來準備 [w]。母音是長 [i]，嘴角往兩邊拉；字尾 [t] 舌尖頂住上牙齦停住就好，不要再加一個「特」。
sweet.tip_en: The opening [sw] is two consonants together; don't put a vowel after [s] like 'si-wei'. Round your lips for [w] while you're still saying [s]. The vowel is a long [i] with the lip corners pulled back; for the final [t] just stop the tongue tip on the gum ridge, without an extra 'te'.

examples.en: This mango is very sweet.
examples.zh: 這顆芒果很甜。

examples.en: These cookies are too sweet for me.
examples.zh: 這些餅乾對我來說太甜了。

swim.tip_zh: 母音是短 [ɪ]，嘴巴放鬆、聲音短促，不要拉長成 [i]，否則聽起來像 "sweem"。字尾 [m] 雙唇一定要閉起來；swim 和 swing 的差別就在這裡，swing 結尾是舌根頂住的 [ŋ]，嘴巴不閉。開頭 [sw] 中間也不要插母音。
swim.tip_en: The vowel is a short, relaxed [ɪ]; don't stretch it into [i], or it sounds like 'sweem'. The lips must close for the final [m]; that is the whole difference from swing, which ends in [ŋ] with the back of the tongue up and the mouth open. Don't put a vowel inside the opening [sw] either.

examples.en: I can swim across the pool.
examples.zh: 我可以游過整個游泳池。

examples.en: We swim at the beach every summer.
examples.zh: 我們每年夏天都去海邊游泳。

swing.tip_zh: 字尾 [ŋ] 是舌根貼住軟顎的鼻音，結束時不要彈出一個 [g]，也不要變成舌尖的 [n]，唸成 "swin"。[ŋ] 前面的 [ɪ] 常被唸成長 [i]，要保持短而放鬆。可以先唸熟 sing，再把開頭換成 [sw]。
swing.tip_en: The final [ŋ] is a nasal made with the back of the tongue against the soft palate; don't release an extra [g] at the end, and don't change it to a tongue-tip [n] ('swin'). The [ɪ] before [ŋ] is often stretched into [i]; keep it short and relaxed. Practice sing first, then change the start to [sw].

examples.en: The kids are playing on the swing.
examples.zh: 孩子們在盪鞦韆。

examples.en: Can you push me on the swing?
examples.zh: 你可以推我盪鞦韆嗎？

table.tip_zh: 第二音節是成音節的 [ḷ]：唸完 [b] 舌尖直接頂到上牙齦、舌根後縮，不要在 b 後面加母音唸成「伯」，也不能把 l 吞掉只剩「貼伯」。第一音節 [e] 是雙母音，嘴角要從 e 滑向 i，不要短成 [ɛ]。
table.tip_en: The second syllable is a syllabic [ḷ]: right after [b], put the tongue tip on the gum ridge and pull the back of the tongue back. Don't add a vowel after b ('bo'), and don't swallow the l so it ends as 'tay-bo'. The first-syllable [e] is a diphthong; glide from e toward i instead of cutting it short to [ɛ].

examples.en: Please set the table for dinner.
examples.zh: 請把晚餐的餐桌擺好。

examples.en: My book is on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 我的書在廚房的桌子上。

tail.tip_zh: [e] 後面接字尾暗 L，學生常把 l 唸成「歐」或乾脆省略，聽起來只剩 "tay"。最後舌尖要頂住上牙齦。[e] 也要唸出往 [i] 滑的尾巴，否則會跟 tell [tɛl] 分不清；嘴巴張太大又會變成 tall [tɔl]。
tail.tip_en: The [e] is followed by a final dark L. Learners often turn the l into an 'o' sound or drop it, so only 'tay' is left; finish with the tongue tip on the gum ridge. Also give [e] its glide toward [i], or it gets mixed up with tell [tɛl]; open the mouth too wide and it becomes tall [tɔl].

examples.en: The dog is wagging its tail.
examples.zh: 小狗在搖尾巴。

examples.en: My cat has a long, fluffy tail.
examples.zh: 我的貓有一條又長又蓬的尾巴。

taiwan.tip_zh: 英文的重音在第二音節 [ˈwɑn]，第一音節 [taɪ] 輕一點，不要照中文聲調唸成兩個一樣重的字。[wɑn] 的母音 [ɑ] 嘴巴張大、嘴唇不圓；字尾是舌尖頂上牙齦的 [n]，不要唸成後鼻音 [ŋ]，像 "wang"。
taiwan.tip_en: In English the stress is on the second syllable [ˈwɑn]; say the first syllable [taɪ] more lightly instead of giving both syllables equal weight as with Mandarin tones. In [wɑn] the vowel [ɑ] has a wide-open mouth with unrounded lips; the ending is a tongue-tip [n] on the gum ridge, not the back nasal [ŋ] as in 'wang'.

examples.en: I live in Taiwan with my family.
examples.zh: 我和家人住在臺灣。

examples.en: Taiwan has many night markets.
examples.zh: 臺灣有很多夜市。

take.tip_zh: 母音 [e] 是雙母音，要從 e 滑到 i，唸太短會像 [ɛ]。字尾 [k] 舌根頂住軟顎就停，不要加母音唸成「貼克」。也別跟 talk [tɔk] 搞混：talk 嘴巴張大、嘴唇微圓，take 是嘴角往兩邊拉。字尾 e 不發音。
take.tip_en: The vowel [e] is a diphthong that glides from e to i; cut it short and it sounds like [ɛ]. For the final [k], stop with the back of the tongue against the soft palate; don't add a vowel ('tay-ke'). Don't mix it up with talk [tɔk]: talk has an open mouth with slightly rounded lips, take pulls the lip corners back. The final e is silent.

examples.en: Take your umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 帶著你的雨傘。

examples.en: Can I take one more cookie?
examples.zh: 我可以再拿一塊餅乾嗎？

talk.tip_zh: 拼字裡的 l 不發音，學生常照字母唸成 [tɔlk]，把舌尖抬起來發 l。正確是 [tɔ] 後直接接 [k]：下巴放低、嘴唇稍微圓，發完 [ɔ] 舌根往上頂住收 [k]，不要加「克」的母音。分辨 talk 和 tall：talk 結尾是舌根的 [k]，tall 結尾是舌尖的 [l]，舌頭位置完全不同。
talk.tip_en: The l in the spelling is silent; learners often follow the letters and say [tɔlk], raising the tongue tip for l. The right way is [tɔ] straight into [k]: lower the jaw and round the lips slightly, then after [ɔ] raise the back of the tongue to close for [k], without adding a 'ke' vowel. To tell talk from tall: talk ends with [k] at the back of the tongue, tall ends with [l] at the tongue tip, two completely different tongue positions.

examples.en: Let's talk about our weekend plans.
examples.zh: 我們來聊聊週末的計畫吧。

examples.en: Please don't talk during the test.
examples.zh: 考試時請不要說話。

talk.variant_zh: 許多美國人 [ɔ]、[ɑ] 不分，唸成 [tɑk] 也正確。
talk.variant_en: Many Americans merge [ɔ] and [ɑ]; [tɑk] is also correct.
talk.spelling_zh: al 裡的 l 不發音，跟 walk 一樣。
talk.spelling_en: The l in al is silent, just like in walk.

tall.tip_zh: tall 的母音是 [ɔ]，嘴巴張大、雙唇微圓，不要收成雙母音 [o]，否則像 toll。字尾暗 L 要做出來：舌根往後縮、舌尖最後碰到上牙齦，不能只唸出像「投」的音。對比 tell [tɛl]、tail [tel]，三個字只差母音。
tall.tip_en: The vowel in tall is [ɔ]: mouth wide open, lips slightly rounded; don't close it into the diphthong [o], or it sounds like toll. Make the final dark L: pull the back of the tongue back and end with the tongue tip touching the gum ridge, rather than stopping at a 'toe'-like sound. Compare tell [tɛl] and tail [tel]: the three words differ only in the vowel.

examples.en: My brother is very tall.
examples.zh: 我哥哥很高。

examples.en: That tall tree is older than our school.
examples.zh: 那棵高大的樹比我們學校還老。

tape.tip_zh: [e] 要唸出從 e 滑向 i 的雙母音，太短會像 "tep"，嘴巴太開又變成 type [taɪp]。字尾 [p] 雙唇閉起來就停，不要再加母音唸成「貼普」。字尾 e 不發音，它的作用是讓 a 唸成 [e]。
tape.tip_en: Say [e] as a diphthong gliding from e to i; too short and it sounds like 'tep', too open and it becomes type [taɪp]. For the final [p] just close the lips and stop, without adding a vowel ('tay-pu'). The final e is silent; its job is to make the a say [e].

examples.en: Use some tape to fix the poster.
examples.zh: 用一些膠帶把海報黏好。

examples.en: Dad still has his old music tape.
examples.zh: 爸爸還留著他的舊音樂錄音帶。

tape.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，讓 a 唸成 [e]
tape.spelling_en: Final e is silent; it makes the a say [e]

taste.tip_zh: taste 的母音是雙母音 [e]，嘴角從 e 滑到 i；test 是短的 [ɛ]。唸不清楚，「嚐嚐看」就變成「考試」了。字尾 [st] 兩個子音要連著發，先 [s] 再讓舌尖頂住發 [t]，不要掉 t，也不要加母音唸成「斯特」。
taste.tip_en: The vowel in taste is the diphthong [e], gliding from e to i; test has a short [ɛ]. Blur them and 'taste it' turns into 'test'. Say the final [st] as one cluster, [s] and then the tongue tip stopping for [t]; don't drop the t, and don't add a vowel ('si-te').

examples.en: Can I taste your soup?
examples.zh: 我可以嚐一下你的湯嗎？

examples.en: These cookies taste great!
examples.zh: 這些餅乾吃起來很棒！

taste.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，a 唸 [e]
taste.spelling_en: Final e is silent; the a says [e]

taxi.tip_zh: 第一音節 [æ] 嘴巴要張大、嘴角往兩邊拉，像 cat 的母音，不要唸成較閉的 [ɛ]。x 在這裡是 [ks] 兩個音：舌根先頂一下發 [k]，再接 [s]；常見錯誤是省掉 [k]，唸成「他西」。重音在第一音節。
taxi.tip_en: The first-syllable [æ] needs a wide-open mouth with the lip corners pulled back, like the vowel in cat; don't close it to [ɛ]. Here x is two sounds, [ks]: touch the back of the tongue up for [k], then [s]. A common mistake is skipping the [k] and saying 'ta-si'. Stress the first syllable.

examples.en: We took a taxi to the airport.
examples.zh: 我們搭計程車去機場。

examples.en: Let's call a taxi; it's raining.
examples.zh: 我們叫計程車吧，下雨了。

tea.tip_zh: tea 只有 [t] 加長 [i] 兩個音，重點在母音要夠長、嘴角往兩邊拉；唸得太急太短會變成鬆的 [ɪ]。拼字 ea 在這裡唸 [i]，跟 eat、teach 一樣；不要被拼字騙成唸 [e]，也不要拆成兩個音節。開頭 [t] 要清楚送氣。
tea.tip_en: Tea is just two sounds, [t] plus a long [i]; the key is a vowel long enough, with the lip corners pulled back. Said too quickly and short, it slips to the lax [ɪ]. The spelling ea says [i] here, as in eat and teach; don't let the spelling push you to [e], and don't split it into two syllables. Give the opening [t] a clear puff of air.

examples.en: Would you like some tea?
examples.zh: 你想喝點茶嗎？

examples.en: My grandpa drinks green tea every morning.
examples.zh: 我爺爺每天早上喝綠茶。

tea.spelling_zh: ea 唸 [i]，跟 eat 一樣

teach.tip_zh: 字尾 [tʃ] 嘴唇要稍微噘起、舌面貼住上牙齦後方再放開，不要唸成中文「七」那種扁唇的音，也不要在後面加母音唸成「踢去」。母音是長 [i]。對比 touch [tʌtʃ]：兩個字結尾一樣，touch 的母音嘴巴放鬆在中間，teach 嘴角往兩邊拉。
teach.tip_en: For the final [tʃ], push the lips slightly forward and release the front of the tongue from just behind the gum ridge; don't make the flat-lipped Mandarin 'qi' sound, and don't add a vowel after it ('tee-chu'). The vowel is a long [i]. Compare touch [tʌtʃ]: same ending, but touch has a relaxed central vowel while teach pulls the lip corners back.

examples.en: Can you teach me how to draw?
examples.zh: 你可以教我怎麼畫畫嗎？

examples.en: My aunt likes to teach young children.
examples.zh: 我阿姨喜歡教小朋友。

teacher.tip_zh: 字尾 [ɚ] 是捲舌的弱音：舌尖往後捲、不碰任何地方，不要唸成沒捲舌的「者」，也不要拉成很長的「兒」。重音在第一音節 [ti]，母音要長；第二音節 [tʃɚ] 輕而短，[tʃ] 嘴唇略微噘起，跟前面的 [i] 連起來唸。
teacher.tip_en: The final [ɚ] is a weak r-colored vowel: curl the tongue tip back without touching anything; don't say a flat 'jer' without the curl, and don't drag it out into a long 'er'. Stress the first syllable [ti] with a long vowel; the second syllable [tʃɚ] is light and short, with the lips slightly pushed out for [tʃ], linked smoothly to the [i] before it.

examples.en: Our English teacher is very funny.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師很有趣。

examples.en: The teacher wrote the answer on the board.
examples.zh: 老師把答案寫在黑板上。

team.tip_zh: 字尾 [m] 雙唇一定要閉起來；嘴巴沒關的話，結尾會變成像後鼻音 [ŋ] 或舌尖的 [n]，聽起來不像 team。母音 ea 唸長 [i]，不要唸成 time 的 [aɪ]。可以把 team 想成 tea 唸完之後把雙唇一閉。
team.tip_en: The lips must close for the final [m]; if the mouth stays open, the ending turns into a back nasal [ŋ] or a tongue-tip [n] and no longer sounds like team. The ea is a long [i], not the [aɪ] of time. Think of team as tea followed by closing the lips.

examples.en: Our team won the basketball game.
examples.zh: 我們這隊贏了籃球比賽。

examples.en: She is on the school soccer team.
examples.zh: 她是學校足球隊的隊員。

teenager.tip_zh: 可以把這個字拆成 teen、age、r 來記：中間的 [e] 就是 age 的母音，要唸飽滿，不要弱化成 [ə]。重音在第一音節 [ti]，第二音節次重。teen 的 [n] 直接連到 [e]，所以聽起來是 [ti·ne]。[dʒ] 要把嘴唇嘟出去，不是注音的ㄐ；最後 [ɚ] 舌頭往後捲，不要唸成「者」。
teenager.tip_en: Remember the word as teen + age + r: the middle [e] is the vowel of age and should be full, not reduced to [ə]. The stress is on the first syllable [ti], with secondary stress on the second. The [n] of teen links straight into [e], so it sounds like [ti·ne]. For [dʒ], push the lips forward; it is not Mandarin ㄐ. In the final [ɚ], curl the tongue back; don't say it as 'je'.

examples.en: My big sister is a teenager now.
examples.zh: 我姊姊現在是青少年了。

examples.en: The teenager next door plays the guitar.
examples.zh: 隔壁的青少年會彈吉他。

telephone.tip_zh: 三個音節輕重不同：重音在 [tɛ]，中間的 [lə] 只是很輕的弱母音，一帶而過，不要唸成三拍一樣重的「鐵樂風」。ph 唸 [f]，上排牙齒輕碰下唇吹氣。最後 [fon] 的 [o] 嘴唇從圓慢慢收小，結尾 [n] 用舌尖頂住上排牙齦，不要變成舌根的 [ŋ]，否則聽起來像 fong。
telephone.tip_en: The three syllables have different weights: the stress is on [tɛ], and the middle [lə] is just a very light weak vowel that passes quickly; don't say three equal beats like 'tie-le-feng'. ph is [f]: the upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip and blow. In the last part [fon], the lips start round and slowly close smaller for [o]; end [n] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge, not with [ŋ] at the back of the tongue, or it sounds like 'fong'.

examples.en: Mom is talking on the telephone.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在講電話。

examples.en: Our classroom has an old telephone.
examples.zh: 我們教室有一台舊電話。

telephone.spelling_zh: ph 唸 [f]；字尾的 e 不發音。
telephone.spelling_en: ph is said [f]; the final e is silent.

television.tip_zh: 最難的是 [ʒən] 的 [ʒ]：中文沒有這個音，學生常唸成無聲的 [ʃ]，或注音的ㄖ。先擺出 [ʃ] 的嘴型、嘴唇嘟出，再讓喉嚨震動，就是 [ʒ]。[v] 要上排牙齒輕咬下唇，不要唸成 [w] 或 [b]。重音在第一音節 [tɛ]，不在 [vɪ]，中間的 [lə] 輕輕帶過。
television.tip_en: The hardest part is the [ʒ] in [ʒən]: Mandarin has no such sound, so learners often say a voiceless [ʃ] or Mandarin ㄖ. Set the mouth for [ʃ] with the lips pushed forward, then add a buzz in the throat, and that is [ʒ]. For [v], the upper teeth lightly bite the lower lip; don't say [w] or [b]. The stress is on the first syllable [tɛ], not on [vɪ], and the middle [lə] passes lightly.

examples.en: We watch television after dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐後看電視。

examples.en: Please turn off the television and read a book.
examples.zh: 請把電視關掉，去看書。

tell.tip_zh: tell 的 [ɛ] 嘴巴半開、短而乾脆，不要滑成 tail 的雙母音 [e]。字尾雙 l 只發一個暗 L：舌根後縮、舌尖往上頂到牙齦；學生常把它唸成「歐」，聽起來像「貼歐」。結尾時把舌尖停在上牙齦上。
tell.tip_en: The [ɛ] in tell is half-open, short and crisp; don't let it glide into the diphthong [e] of tail. The double l is a single dark L: pull the back of the tongue back and raise the tip to the gum ridge. Learners often turn it into an 'o' sound, like 'teh-o'. Finish with the tongue tip resting on the gum ridge.

examples.en: Please tell me your name.
examples.zh: 請告訴我你的名字。

examples.en: Can you tell a story before bed?
examples.zh: 你可以在睡前講個故事嗎？

temple.tip_zh: 第二音節是 [pḷ]：雙唇從 [m] 直接彈開發 [p]，接著馬上做成音節的暗 L，不要在 p 後面加母音唸成「波」。第一音節 [tɛm] 的 [m] 要閉唇，不要唸成舌尖的 [n]，變成「天」的尾音。重音在第一音節。
temple.tip_en: The second syllable is [pḷ]: open the lips straight from [m] into [p], then go right into a syllabic dark L; don't add a vowel after p ('po'). The [m] of [tɛm] needs closed lips; don't turn it into a tongue-tip [n] like the end of Mandarin 'tian'. Stress the first syllable.

examples.en: We visited an old temple in Tainan.
examples.zh: 我們在臺南參觀了一座古老的寺廟。

examples.en: There is a big temple near my grandma's house.
examples.zh: 我奶奶家附近有一座大廟。

temple.spelling_zh: 字尾 le 唸成 [ḷ]，e 不發音
temple.spelling_en: Final -le is said as [ḷ]; the e is silent

ten.tip_zh: 字尾是舌尖頂上牙齦的 [n]，不要唸成後鼻音 [ŋ]，聽起來像 "teng"。唸完把舌尖停在上排牙齒後面就對了。母音 [ɛ] 嘴巴半開；如果捲舌就變成 turn [tɝn]，嘴巴先張大再收圓又變成 town [taʊn]。
ten.tip_en: The ending is a tongue-tip [n] on the gum ridge, not the back nasal [ŋ] that makes it sound like 'teng'. End with the tongue tip resting behind the upper teeth. The vowel [ɛ] is half-open; curl the tongue and it becomes turn [tɝn], open wide and round the lips and it becomes town [taʊn].

examples.en: I have ten pencils in my bag.
examples.zh: 我的書包裡有十枝鉛筆。

examples.en: Wake me up at ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 十點叫我起床。

tennis.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [ˈtɛ]，第二音節 [nəs] 輕而短，母音弱化成 [ə]，不要把 nis 唸得跟第一音節一樣重。雙 n 只發一個 [n]，不要唸成兩個。字尾 [s] 是無聲的氣音，不要變成 [z]，也不要加母音唸成「斯」。
tennis.tip_en: Stress the first syllable [ˈtɛ]; the second syllable [nəs] is light and short with a reduced [ə] vowel, so don't give nis the same weight as the first syllable. The double n is one [n], not two. The final [s] is voiceless air; don't turn it into [z] or add a vowel ('si').

examples.en: My dad plays tennis on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我爸爸星期天會打網球。

examples.en: We watched a tennis match on TV.
examples.zh: 我們在電視上看了一場網球比賽。

terrible.tip_zh: 第一音節是 [tɛ]，母音跟 bed 一樣，嘴巴半開，接著舌頭捲起發 [r]；不要把 ter 唸成捲舌的 [tɝ]，像 turn 的開頭。中間的 [rə] 輕而短。字尾 -ble 是 [bḷ]：雙唇發完 [b]，舌尖直接頂上排牙齦發 L，中間沒有母音，常見錯誤是唸成「波」或「伯」。
terrible.tip_en: The first syllable is [tɛ], with the same vowel as bed and the mouth half open, then the tongue curls for [r]; don't say ter as r-colored [tɝ] like the start of turn. The middle [rə] is light and short. The ending -ble is [bḷ]: after the lips make [b], the tongue tip goes straight up to the upper gum ridge for L, with no vowel between; a common mistake is ending with a 'bo' sound.

examples.en: The weather was terrible, so we played inside.
examples.zh: 天氣很糟，所以我們在室內玩。

examples.en: Don't worry, your drawing is not terrible at all!
examples.zh: 別擔心，你的畫一點也不糟！

test.tip_zh: 字尾 [st]：先發 [s]，再讓舌尖輕頂上牙齦停住；學生常把 [t] 吃掉變成 "tess"，或加母音唸成「貼斯特」。母音是短 [ɛ]，嘴巴不要滑向 [i]，否則就成了 taste [test]「品嚐」。可以先把 [ɛ] 唸成 bed 的母音，再接上 [st] 練習。
test.tip_en: The final [st]: say [s], then lightly stop the tongue tip on the gum ridge. Learners often swallow the [t] ('tess') or add vowels ('teh-si-te'). The vowel is a short [ɛ]; don't let it glide toward [i], or it becomes taste [test]. Practice by saying [ɛ] as in bed, then adding [st].

examples.en: We have a math test tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天有數學考試。

examples.en: Did you study for the spelling test?
examples.zh: 你準備拼字考試了嗎？

than.tip_zh: than 和 then 只差一個母音，最容易混淆：than 的 [æ] 要把下巴往下拉、嘴角往兩邊張大；then 的 [ɛ] 嘴巴只半開。開頭 [ð] 是舌尖輕放在上下排牙齒之間、喉嚨震動，不要唸成 [d] 或 [z]。結尾 [n] 用舌尖頂住上排牙齦收，不要變成 [ŋ]。
than.tip_en: than and then differ only in the vowel and are the easiest to mix up: for the [æ] of than, pull the jaw down and spread the corners of the mouth wide; for the [ɛ] of then, the mouth is only half open. The opening [ð] puts the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth with the throat buzzing; don't say [d] or [z]. Finish [n] with the tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; don't turn it into [ŋ].

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
examples.zh: 我哥哥比我高。

examples.en: I like apples more than bananas.
examples.zh: 比起香蕉，我更喜歡蘋果。

than.variant_zh: 在句子裡通常弱讀成 [ðən]，例如 taller than me。
than.variant_en: In a sentence it is usually weak, [ðən], as in taller than me.

thank.tip_zh: 開頭 [θ] 是無聲的：舌尖輕輕伸到上下排牙齒之間吹氣，喉嚨不震動。常見錯誤是唸成 [s]，像「三Q」，thank 就變成 sank（下沉）。[æ] 下巴要往下拉，才不會跟 think 的 [ɪ] 混在一起。結尾 [ŋk]：舌根抬起頂住軟顎發 [ŋ]，再原地放開成 [k]，不要加「克」的母音。
thank.tip_en: The opening [θ] is voiceless: put the tongue tip lightly out between the upper and lower teeth and blow, with no buzz in the throat. A common mistake is saying [s], like 'san-Q', which turns thank into sank. Pull the jaw down for [æ] so it doesn't blend with the [ɪ] of think. For the ending [ŋk], raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate for [ŋ], then release it in place as [k], without adding a 'ke' vowel.

examples.en: Thank you for the lovely birthday card.
examples.zh: 謝謝你送我這張好可愛的生日卡。

examples.en: Don't forget to thank your teacher.
examples.zh: 別忘了謝謝你的老師。

that.tip_zh: 後半的 [æt] 和 cat、hat 完全押韻，難點在開頭的 [ð]。學生常唸成 [d] 或 [z]，聽起來像 dat 或 zat。先把舌尖放在上下排牙齒之間，喉嚨震動發出嗡嗡聲，再把舌頭收回接 [æ]，下巴張大。字尾 [t] 舌尖頂住牙齦停住就好，不要加「特」的母音。
that.tip_en: The second half [æt] rhymes exactly with cat and hat; the hard part is the opening [ð]. Learners often say [d] or [z], so it sounds like dat or zat. Put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth, make a buzz in the throat, then pull the tongue back into [æ] with the jaw open. For the final [t], just stop with the tongue tip on the gum ridge; don't add a 'te' vowel.

examples.en: Is that your new backpack?
examples.zh: 那是你的新書包嗎？

examples.en: I like that song a lot.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡那首歌。

that.variant_zh: 當連接詞時常弱讀成 [ðət]，例如 I know that you can。
that.variant_en: As a conjunction it is often weak, [ðət], as in I know that you can.

theater.tip_zh: 開頭 [θ] 是舌尖放在上下排牙齒之間吹氣，不要唸成 [s]，否則前半聽起來像 sea。拼字的 ea 在這裡不是一個長音，而是 [i] 加 [ə] 兩個音節，學生常省掉 [ə]，把三拍唸成兩拍。重音在 [θi]，後面的 [ətɚ] 輕輕帶過，最後 [tɚ] 舌頭往後捲。
theater.tip_en: For the opening [θ], put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and blow; don't say [s], or the first half sounds like sea. The spelling ea here is not one long sound but two syllables, [i] plus [ə]; learners often drop the [ə] and turn three beats into two. The stress is on [θi], the following [ətɚ] passes lightly, and in the final [tɚ] the tongue curls back.

examples.en: We saw a funny play at the theater.
examples.zh: 我們在劇院看了一齣很好笑的戲。

examples.en: The movie theater is next to the bookstore.
examples.zh: 電影院在書店旁邊。

theater.spelling_zh: ea 分成 [i]、[ə] 兩個音節；英式拼成 theatre。
theater.spelling_en: ea splits into two syllables, [i] and [ə]; the British spelling is theatre.

then.tip_zh: 開頭 [ð] 要把舌尖輕放在上下門牙之間，讓聲帶震動；學生常唸成 [d] 變成 "den"，或唸成 [z] 變成 "zen"。接著是短 [ɛ]，嘴巴半開；張得太大就變成 than [ðæn]。字尾 [n] 舌尖收回到上牙齦。
then.tip_en: For the opening [ð], rest the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower front teeth and let the voice buzz. Learners often say [d] ('den') or [z] ('zen'). Next comes a short, half-open [ɛ]; open too wide and it becomes than [ðæn]. For the final [n], bring the tongue tip back to the gum ridge.

examples.en: Finish your homework, then you can play.
examples.zh: 先寫完功課，然後你就可以玩。

examples.en: We ate lunch, and then we went to the park.
examples.zh: 我們吃完午餐，然後去了公園。

there.tip_zh: 開頭 [ð] 是舌尖輕碰上排門牙、聲帶震動的音，唸成 [d] 就變成 dare「敢」。後面的 [ɛr] 先發半開的 [ɛ]，再把舌頭往後捲成 r，不要只發一個像中文「兒」的捲舌音。there 跟 their 同音，只能靠拼字分辨。
there.tip_en: The opening [ð] is voiced, with the tongue tip lightly touching the upper front teeth; say [d] instead and it becomes dare. The [ɛr] that follows starts with a half-open [ɛ] and then curls the tongue back for r; don't collapse it into a single Mandarin 'er'-like sound. There sounds the same as their; only the spelling tells them apart.

examples.en: Put your bag over there.
examples.zh: 把你的書包放在那邊。

examples.en: There is a cat under the table.
examples.zh: 桌子底下有一隻貓。

there.spelling_zh: 跟 their 同音，ere 唸 [ɛr]
there.spelling_en: Sounds the same as their; ere says [ɛr]

these.tip_zh: these 和 this 很容易唸混：these 是長母音 [i]，嘴角往兩邊拉、像在微笑，結尾是有聲的 [z]；this 是短而放鬆的 [ɪ]，結尾是無聲的 [s]。開頭 [ð] 舌尖要放在上下排牙齒之間並讓喉嚨震動，不要唸成 [d] 或 [z]。結尾的 [z] 要一路震動到最後。
these.tip_en: these and this are easy to mix up: these has the long vowel [i], with the corners of the mouth pulled back as if smiling, and ends with a voiced [z]; this has a short, relaxed [ɪ] and ends with a voiceless [s]. For the opening [ð], put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and let the throat buzz; don't say [d] or [z]. Keep the final [z] buzzing all the way to the end.

examples.en: These cookies are for the class party.
examples.zh: 這些餅乾是班級派對要吃的。

examples.en: Are these your socks on the floor?
examples.zh: 地上這些是你的襪子嗎？

these.spelling_zh: 字尾 e 不發音，s 唸 [z]。
these.spelling_en: The final e is silent, and s is said [z].

they.tip_zh: they 和 day 只差第一個音：[ð] 要把舌尖伸到上下門牙之間，一邊震動聲帶一邊送氣；換成 [d] 就變成 day「天」，換成 [z] 又不像英文。後面的 ey 唸雙母音 [e]，要從 e 滑向 i，不要唸成短的 [ɛ]。
they.tip_en: They and day differ only in the first sound: for [ð] put the tongue tip between the upper and lower front teeth and let air flow while the voice buzzes. Swap in [d] and it becomes day; swap in [z] and it no longer sounds English. The ey is the diphthong [e], gliding from e toward i, not a short [ɛ].

examples.en: They are my best friends.
examples.zh: 他們是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: Where did they go after school?
examples.zh: 他們放學後去哪裡了？

they.spelling_zh: ey 唸 [e]，跟 hey 一樣

thick.tip_zh: 開頭 [θ] 如果唸成 [s]，thick（厚的）就變成 sick（生病的），意思差很多。發 [θ] 時舌尖伸出一點點，放在上下排牙齒之間吹氣，喉嚨不震動。母音 [ɪ] 短而放鬆，不要拉長成 [i]。它的反義詞 thin 只差結尾：thick 用舌根頂住收 [k]，thin 用舌尖收 [n]。
thick.tip_en: If the opening [θ] is said as [s], thick turns into sick, a very different meaning. For [θ], stick the tongue tip out a little between the upper and lower teeth and blow, with no buzz in the throat. The vowel [ɪ] is short and relaxed; don't stretch it into [i]. Its opposite thin differs only at the end: thick closes with the back of the tongue for [k], thin with the tongue tip for [n].

examples.en: This book is very thick.
examples.zh: 這本書很厚。

examples.en: Wear a thick coat on cold days.
examples.zh: 冷天要穿厚外套。

thin.tip_zh: thin 和 thing 只差最後一個鼻音，台灣學生常把兩個唸成一樣。thin 的 [n] 是舌尖頂住上排牙齦；thing 的 [ŋ] 是舌根往上抬、舌尖放下。練習時唸完 thin 先不要放鬆，感覺一下舌尖是不是停在牙齦上。開頭 [θ] 舌尖輕放在上下排牙齒之間吹氣，不要唸成 [s]；母音 [ɪ] 短而放鬆。
thin.tip_en: thin and thing differ only in the final nasal, and Taiwanese learners often say them the same. The [n] of thin has the tongue tip pressed on the upper gum ridge; the [ŋ] of thing raises the back of the tongue with the tip down. When practicing, don't relax right after saying thin: feel whether the tongue tip is resting on the gum ridge. For the opening [θ], place the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth and blow; don't say [s]. The vowel [ɪ] is short and relaxed.

examples.en: My pencil is thin and long.
examples.zh: 我的鉛筆又細又長。

examples.en: I like thin pizza with lots of cheese.
examples.zh: 我喜歡有很多起司的薄片披薩。

thing.tip_zh: 開頭 [θ] 如果唸成 [s]，thing 就變成 sing（唱歌）。舌尖放在上下排牙齒之間吹氣，再收回舌頭發 [ɪ]。結尾 [ŋ] 是舌根頂住軟顎、讓氣從鼻子出來，拼字 ng 合起來只有這一個音，不要在最後多加一個「格」；也不要收成舌尖的 [n]，不然會聽成 thin。
thing.tip_en: If the opening [θ] is said as [s], thing turns into sing. Put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and blow, then pull the tongue back for [ɪ]. The final [ŋ] has the back of the tongue against the soft palate with the air going out through the nose; the spelling ng together is only this one sound, so don't add a 'ge' at the end. Don't close with the tongue-tip [n] either, or it will be heard as thin.

examples.en: What is your favorite thing to do on Sunday?
examples.zh: 你星期天最喜歡做什麼事？

examples.en: Put each thing back in the box.
examples.zh: 把每樣東西放回盒子裡。

thing.spelling_zh: ng 合起來只唸一個 [ŋ]，g 不另外發音。
thing.spelling_en: ng together is just one sound, [ŋ]; the g is not said separately.

think.tip_zh: 最常聽到的錯誤是把 [θ] 唸成 [s]，I think so 就變成 I sink so（我下沉）。對著鏡子說，應該看得到舌尖從上下排牙齒間露出一點點，然後吹氣。[ɪ] 要短，嘴巴比 thank 的 [æ] 小很多。結尾 [ŋk] 舌根先頂住發鼻音，再輕輕彈開成 [k]，不要加母音。
think.tip_en: The most common mistake is saying [θ] as [s], so I think so becomes I sink so. Say it in front of a mirror: you should see the tongue tip peek out a little between the upper and lower teeth, then blow. [ɪ] is short, with the mouth much less open than for the [æ] of thank. For the ending [ŋk], the back of the tongue first presses up for the nasal, then lightly springs open for [k], with no added vowel.

examples.en: I think it will rain today.
examples.zh: 我覺得今天會下雨。

examples.en: What do you think of my drawing?
examples.zh: 你覺得我的畫怎麼樣？

third.tip_zh: 這個字舌頭要連走三個位置：[θ] 舌尖在上下排牙齒之間吹氣，接著馬上往後捲成 [ɝ]，最後舌尖頂住上排牙齦收 [d]。拼字 ir 只是一個捲舌母音 [ɝ]，不是 [ɪ] 加 [r]，和 bird 的母音一樣。常見錯誤是開頭唸成 [s]，或把結尾的 [d] 吞掉。
third.tip_en: The tongue moves through three positions in this word: for [θ] the tip is between the upper and lower teeth blowing air, then it immediately curls back for [ɝ], and finally the tip presses the upper gum ridge to close with [d]. The spelling ir is just one r-colored vowel [ɝ], not [ɪ] plus [r], the same vowel as in bird. Common mistakes are starting with [s] or swallowing the final [d].

examples.en: My classroom is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 我的教室在三樓。

examples.en: Tom came in third in the race.
examples.zh: 湯姆賽跑得了第三名。

thirsty.tip_zh: thirsty（口渴的）和 thirty（三十）只差一個 [s]，學生常把中間的 [s] 吞掉，I'm thirsty 就變成 I'm thirty（我三十歲）。舌頭的路線是：開頭 [θ] 舌尖在齒間，[ɝ] 往後捲，再把舌尖移到上排牙齒後面發 [s]，緊接著 [t]。[st] 之間不加母音，結尾 [ɪ] 短而輕。
thirsty.tip_en: thirsty and thirty differ by only one [s]; learners often swallow the middle [s], so I'm thirsty becomes I'm thirty. The tongue's route: the opening [θ] with the tip between the teeth, curl back for [ɝ], then move the tip behind the upper teeth for [s], followed right away by [t]. Add no vowel between [s] and [t]; the final [ɪ] is short and light.

examples.en: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?
examples.zh: 我好渴，可以喝點水嗎？

examples.en: Playing soccer makes me very thirsty.
examples.zh: 踢足球讓我很口渴。

thirteen.tip_zh: thirteen 最容易和 thirty 聽錯。單獨唸時重音在第二音節 [tin]：母音拉長，字尾 [n] 用舌尖頂住上排牙齦收住，不能省略。開頭 [θ] 常被唸成 [s]，要把舌尖輕放在上下牙齒之間吹氣，接著馬上捲舌唸 [ɝ]。thirty 則是第一音節重、字尾沒有 [n]，兩個字可以一組練習。
thirteen.tip_en: thirteen is the word most easily confused with thirty. Said on its own, the stress falls on the second syllable [tin]: stretch the vowel and close with a clear final [n], tongue tip on the upper gum ridge; don't drop it. The opening [θ] is often said as [s]: rest the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth and blow, then curl the tongue right away for [ɝ]. thirty, by contrast, is stressed on the first syllable and has no final [n]; practice the two as a pair.

examples.en: My sister turns thirteen next week.
examples.zh: 我姊姊下週就滿十三歲了。

examples.en: There are thirteen kids in my art class.
examples.zh: 我的美術班上有十三個小朋友。

thirteen.kk_flag: Two primary-stress marks. The General American citation form is [ˌθɝˈtin], main stress on -teen (it shifts to the first syllable only before a stressed noun, e.g. THIRteen kids), so stressed_syllable = 1 will mislabel the page and blur the thirteen/thirty contrast.

thirty.tip_zh: thirty 的重音在第一音節 [θɝ]，要唸得又重又長；第二音節 [tɪ] 輕輕帶過，字尾沒有 [n]，這樣才不會被聽成 thirteen。中間的 t 在美式發音中會變成很快的 [d]，舌尖輕點上排牙齦一下就好。開頭 [θ] 別唸成 [s]，先把舌尖放在牙齒之間吹氣，再捲舌接 [ɝ]。
thirty.tip_en: thirty is stressed on the first syllable [θɝ], said strong and long; the second syllable [tɪ] is light and quick, with no final [n], so it won't be heard as thirteen. In American English the middle t becomes a very quick [d]: the tongue tip just taps the upper gum ridge once. Don't turn the opening [θ] into [s]: put the tongue tip between the teeth and blow first, then curl the tongue for [ɝ].

examples.en: There are thirty students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有三十個學生。

examples.en: We waited thirty minutes for the school bus.
examples.zh: 我們等校車等了三十分鐘。

thirty.variant_zh: 美式口語中間的 t 常變成很快的閃音，聽起來像 [ˈθɝdɪ]。
thirty.variant_en: In everyday American speech the middle t often becomes a quick flap, sounding like [ˈθɝdɪ].
thirty.kk_flag: The secondary-stress mark on -ty is unusual: GA thirty has only first-syllable stress, [ˈθɝdi] / [ˈθɝti] (the [d] stands for the flapped t).

this.tip_zh: 開頭 [ð] 常被唸成 [d] 或 [z]，聽起來像 dis 或 zis。舌尖要輕輕放在上下牙齒之間，同時讓喉嚨振動，手摸喉嚨會感覺到嗡嗡聲。母音 [ɪ] 要短而放鬆，不要拉長成 [i]，否則會像 these。字尾是無聲的 [s]，像蛇的嘶嘶聲，不是 these 結尾的 [z]。
this.tip_en: The opening [ð] is often said as [d] or [z], so it sounds like dis or zis. Rest the tongue tip lightly between the upper and lower teeth while the throat vibrates; with a hand on the throat you can feel a buzz. The vowel [ɪ] is short and relaxed; don't stretch it into [i], or it will sound like these. The ending is a voiceless [s], like a snake's hiss, not the [z] at the end of these.

examples.en: This is my favorite book.
examples.zh: 這是我最喜歡的書。

examples.en: Can you help me carry this box?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？

those.tip_zh: those 和 these 只差中間的母音：those 是 [o]，嘴唇先圓再慢慢收小，跟 nose 的母音一樣；these 是 [i]，嘴角往兩邊拉。開頭 [ð] 舌尖放在牙齒之間、喉嚨振動，不要唸成 [d]。字尾 [z] 常被唸成 [s] 或乾脆不發，要讓聲音嗡嗡地延續一下再停，跟 nose、rose 的結尾相同。
those.tip_en: those and these differ only in the middle vowel: those has [o], lips rounded and then slowly closing, the same vowel as nose; these has [i], with the corners of the mouth pulled sideways. For the opening [ð], put the tongue tip between the teeth and let the throat vibrate; don't say [d]. The final [z] is often said as [s] or dropped altogether; let the buzzing sound carry on a moment before stopping, the same ending as nose and rose.

examples.en: Those shoes are too big for me.
examples.zh: 那雙鞋子對我來說太大了。

examples.en: Can I have one of those cookies?
examples.zh: 我可以吃一塊那些餅乾嗎？

though.tip_zh: though 的 gh 完全不發音，整個字只有兩個音：[ð] 加 [o]。常見錯誤是把 gh 唸成 [f]（像 enough），或跟 through、thought 混在一起。開頭 [ð] 要有聲，舌尖輕碰上排牙齒、喉嚨振動，不是 [d]，也不是無聲的 [θ]；接著嘴唇變圓唸 [o]，唸起來和 go、no 押韻。
though.tip_en: The gh in though is completely silent; the whole word has just two sounds, [ð] plus [o]. Common mistakes are reading gh as [f] (as in enough) or mixing it up with through and thought. The opening [ð] is voiced: the tongue tip lightly touches the upper teeth and the throat vibrates; it is neither [d] nor a voiceless [θ]. Then round the lips for [o]; it rhymes with go and no.

examples.en: Even though it was cold, we played outside.
examples.zh: 雖然天氣很冷，我們還是在外面玩。

examples.en: Though I was tired, I finished my homework.
examples.zh: 雖然我很累，我還是寫完了功課。

though.spelling_zh: gh 不發音，though 和 go 押韻。
though.spelling_en: The gh is silent; though rhymes with go.

thousand.tip_zh: 開頭 [θ] 常被唸成 [s]，聽起來像 sousand；舌尖要放在上下牙齒之間吹氣，再把嘴巴張大滑到 [aʊ]，跟 house 的母音一樣。中間的 s 其實是有聲的 [z]，喉嚨要振動。字尾 [nd] 要連在一起收：舌尖頂住上牙齦唸 [n]，在原地輕輕放出 [d]，不要多加一個母音。
thousand.tip_en: The opening [θ] is often said as [s], so it sounds like sousand; put the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and blow, then open the mouth wide and glide into [aʊ], the same vowel as house. The s in the middle is actually a voiced [z]; the throat should vibrate. Close the final [nd] together: tongue tip on the upper gum ridge for [n], then release a soft [d] from the same spot, without adding an extra vowel.

examples.en: A thousand people came to the school concert.
examples.zh: 有一千個人來參加學校的音樂會。

examples.en: This book has more than a thousand pages.
examples.zh: 這本書有一千多頁。

thousand.variant_zh: 口語中字尾的 [d] 常幾乎聽不到：[ˈθaʊzən]。
thousand.variant_en: In casual speech the final [d] often drops: [ˈθaʊzən].
thousand.spelling_zh: 中間的 s 唸有聲的 [z]，不是 [s]。
thousand.spelling_en: The s in the middle is voiced [z], not [s].

three.tip_zh: three 常被唸成 tree、free，甚至 sree，因為中文沒有 [θ]。先把舌尖放在上下牙齒之間輕輕吹氣，然後舌頭迅速往後縮、捲起唸 [r]，[θr] 要黏在一起，中間不要插入母音。最後嘴角往兩邊拉，唸長長的 [i]。可以把 three、tree、free 排成一組，對比開頭的差別。
three.tip_en: three is often said as tree, free, or even sree, because Mandarin has no [θ]. First rest the tongue tip between the upper and lower teeth and blow gently, then pull the tongue back quickly and curl it for [r]; [θr] stick together with no vowel slipped in between. Finally pull the corners of the mouth sideways for a long [i]. Line up three, tree, and free and compare how each one starts.

examples.en: The baby is three years old.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶三歲了。

examples.en: I have three pencils in my bag.
examples.zh: 我的書包裡有三枝鉛筆。

throat.tip_zh: 開頭是 [θ] 加 [r] 兩個子音：舌尖先放在上下門牙間送氣、聲帶不震動，再迅速往後捲成 [r]，中間不要插母音。學生常把 [θ] 唸成 [s] 或 [f]，變成 "sroat"、"froat"。oa 是雙母音 [o]，字尾 [t] 輕輕停住。
throat.tip_en: It starts with two consonants, [θ] plus [r]: blow air with the tongue tip between the front teeth and no voice, then quickly curl back into [r], with no vowel in between. Learners often change [θ] to [s] or [f] ('sroat', 'froat'). The oa is the diphthong [o], and the final [t] is a light stop.

examples.en: I have a sore throat today.
examples.zh: 我今天喉嚨痛。

examples.en: Drink warm water for your throat.
examples.zh: 喝點溫水對你的喉嚨好。

through.tip_zh: through 拼字很長，但只有三個音：[θ]、[r]、[u]。ou 唸 [u]，gh 不發音，所以它和 threw 唸起來完全一樣。常見錯誤是 [θ] 變成 [t]，聽起來像 true，或跟 though 搞混。舌尖先在牙齒之間吹氣，馬上捲舌接 [r]，最後嘴唇嘟成小圓圈，把 [u] 拉長。
through.tip_en: through has a long spelling but only three sounds: [θ], [r], [u]. The ou is said [u] and the gh is silent, so it sounds exactly like threw. A common mistake is turning [θ] into [t], so it sounds like true, or mixing it up with though. Blow between the teeth with the tongue tip first, curl the tongue straight away for [r], then purse the lips into a small circle and stretch out [u].

examples.en: The train goes through a long tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車穿過一條很長的隧道。

examples.en: We walked through the park after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我們穿過公園。

through.spelling_zh: ough 在這裡唸 [u]，gh 不發音；和 threw 同音。
through.spelling_en: ough says [u], gh is silent; same sound as threw.

throw.tip_zh: throw 的 [θ] 要把舌尖放在牙齒間送氣，再滑到捲舌的 [r]；唸成 [s] 會像 "sro"，省掉 [θ] 就變成 row。結尾是雙母音 [o]，嘴唇圓起再慢慢收小；跟 through [θru] 不同，through 結尾是嘴唇噘得更緊的 [u]。
throw.tip_en: For the [θ] in throw, blow air with the tongue tip between the teeth, then slide into a curled [r]; with [s] it sounds like 'sro', and without [θ] it becomes row. It ends in the diphthong [o]: round the lips, then tighten them a little. That differs from through [θru], which ends in a tighter-lipped [u].

examples.en: Throw the ball to me!
examples.zh: 把球丟給我！

examples.en: Please don't throw paper on the floor.
examples.zh: 請不要把紙丟在地上。

throw.spelling_zh: ow 唸 [o]，跟 grow 一樣

thursday.tip_zh: Thursday 常被唸成 Sursday，或跟 Tuesday 混在一起。開頭先咬舌吹出 [θ]，緊接著捲舌唸 [ɝ]：舌頭往後捲、不碰上顎，跟 bird 的母音一樣。中間的 s 要唸有聲的 [z]，喉嚨振動。重音在第一音節，後面的 [de] 唸得輕一點、短一點。
