examples.en: My dad goes to work by bus.
examples.zh: 我爸爸搭公車去上班。

examples.en: I finished my work before dinner.
examples.zh: 我在晚餐前把作業做完了。

work.spelling_zh: w 後面的 or 唸 [ɝ]，不唸 [ɔr]。
work.spelling_en: After w, or is said [ɝ], not [ɔr].

workbook.tip_zh: work 的母音是捲舌的 [ɝ]，嘴巴幾乎不張開、舌頭往後捲；學生常唸成 walk [wɔk] 那種張大嘴的 [ɔ]。重音在第一音節。中間 [kb] 兩個子音直接相連，不要插入母音變成「沃可布克」。book 的 [ʊ] 短而放鬆，字尾 [k] 收住。
workbook.tip_en: The vowel in work is the r-colored [ɝ]: mouth nearly closed, tongue curled back. Learners often use the open [ɔ] of walk [wɔk] instead. Stress the first syllable. The [kb] in the middle goes straight from one consonant to the other — don't insert a vowel. The [ʊ] of book is short and relaxed, and the final [k] closes cleanly.

examples.en: Open your workbook to page ten.
examples.zh: 把你的作業本翻到第十頁。

examples.en: I finished my math workbook today.
examples.zh: 我今天寫完數學作業本了。

workbook.spelling_zh: or 在 w 後面唸 [ɝ]，和 word、world 一樣。
workbook.spelling_en: After w, or says [ɝ], as in word and world.

worker.tip_zh: worker 有兩個捲舌音：重音節 [wɝ] 和結尾 [kɚ]。學生最常把第一音節唸成 walk 的 [ɔ]，結果變成 walker（走路的人）。發 [ɝ] 時嘴巴不要張大，舌頭往後捲住；結尾的 [ɚ] 較輕較短，同樣要捲舌，不要唸成「可」。
worker.tip_en: worker has two r-colored vowels: the stressed [wɝ] and the ending [kɚ]. The most common mistake is saying the first syllable with the [ɔ] of walk, which makes it walker. For [ɝ], keep the mouth from opening wide and hold the tongue curled back; the final [ɚ] is shorter and lighter but still curled — don't end on a flat vowel.

examples.en: My dad is a factory worker.
examples.zh: 我爸爸是工廠的工人。

examples.en: The workers are building a new bridge.
examples.zh: 工人們正在蓋一座新橋。

world.tip_zh: 難點在字尾連續三個音：捲舌的 [ɝ] 之後，舌尖要往前頂到上排牙齦發 [l]，再直接接 [d]。常見錯誤是省掉 [l]，聽起來就變成 word；或在 [ɝ] 和 [l] 中間多加一個母音，唸成兩拍。練習時可以先唸 word，再慢慢在 [d] 前面加入 [l]，整個字仍然只有一拍。
world.tip_en: The hard part is the three sounds at the end: after the curled [ɝ], the tongue tip moves forward to the upper gum ridge for [l], then goes straight into [d]. Common mistakes are dropping the [l], which makes it sound like word, or adding a vowel between [ɝ] and [l] so it becomes two beats. To practice, say word first, then slowly add [l] before the [d]; the whole word is still one beat.

examples.en: I want to travel around the world someday.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天能環遊世界。

examples.en: There are many languages in the world.
examples.zh: 世界上有很多種語言。

worry.tip_zh: worry 的第一音節是捲舌的 [ɝ]，嘴巴幾乎不張開；學生常照拼字唸成 [wɔ] 或 [wɑ]，聽起來像在跟 sorry 押韻。其實 worry 和 hurry 押韻。舌頭從 [ɝ] 捲著直接滑到輕短的 [ɪ]，中間不要斷開。重音在第一音節。
worry.tip_en: The first syllable of worry has the r-colored [ɝ] with the mouth nearly closed; learners often follow the spelling and say [wɔ] or [wɑ], as if it rhymed with sorry. In fact worry rhymes with hurry. Keep the tongue curled from [ɝ] and slide straight into a light, short [ɪ] without a break. Stress the first syllable.

examples.en: Don't worry, I can help you.
examples.zh: 別擔心，我可以幫你。

examples.en: Please don't worry about the test.
examples.zh: 請不要擔心考試。

worry.spelling_zh: or 唸 [ɝ]，不是 for 的 [ɔr]。
worry.spelling_en: The or says [ɝ], not the [ɔr] of for.

write.tip_zh: 開頭的 w 不發音，write 和 right 唸法完全一樣。[r] 開頭時嘴唇微微嘟起，舌頭往後捲但不碰上顎，不要唸成 [l] 或注音的ㄖ。[aɪ] 從張大的嘴滑向 [ɪ]，最後的 [t] 舌尖頂住牙齦停住就好，不要在後面多加一個母音。
write.tip_en: The opening w is silent; write sounds exactly like right. To start [r], round the lips slightly and curl the tongue back without touching the roof of the mouth; don't say it as [l] or as Mandarin ㄖ. [aɪ] glides from a wide-open mouth toward [ɪ], and the final [t] just stops with the tongue tip on the gum ridge; don't add a vowel after it.

examples.en: Please write your name on the paper.
examples.zh: 請在紙上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: I like to write stories about my cat.
examples.zh: 我喜歡寫關於我家貓咪的故事。

write.spelling_zh: w 不發音，跟 right 同音。
write.spelling_en: The w is silent; it sounds the same as right.

writer.tip_zh: w 不發音，開頭直接是 [r]，嘴唇微嘟、舌頭往後捲。美式發音中，[t] 夾在 [aɪ] 和 [ɚ] 之間會變成舌尖輕彈一下的音，聽起來接近很輕的 [d]，所以 writer 和 rider 聽起來很像，差別主要在 writer 的 [aɪ] 比較短。字尾 [ɚ] 要捲舌，重音在 [raɪ]。
writer.tip_en: The w is silent, so the word starts directly with [r]: lips slightly rounded, tongue curled back. In American English, the [t] between [aɪ] and [ɚ] becomes a light tap of the tongue tip that sounds close to a very light [d], so writer and rider sound very similar; the main difference is that the [aɪ] in writer is shorter. The final [ɚ] must be curled, and the stress is on [raɪ].

examples.en: My aunt is a writer of children's books.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是童書作家。

examples.en: The writer read his new story to our class.
examples.zh: 那位作家為我們班朗讀了他的新故事。

writer.spelling_zh: wr 的 w 不發音，只唸 [r]。
writer.spelling_en: The w in wr is silent; only [r] is said.

wrong.tip_zh: wrong 的 w 不發音，直接從 [r] 開始：嘴唇稍圓、舌尖往後捲，不碰上顎。學生常把 [r] 唸成 [l]，結果變成 long（長的）；也有人照拼字多加一個 [w]。母音 [ɔ] 嘴巴張大，字尾是舌根的 [ŋ]，不是 [n]，和 song、long 押韻。
wrong.tip_en: The w in wrong is silent; start straight on [r]: lips slightly rounded, tongue tip curled back without touching the roof of the mouth. Learners often turn [r] into [l], which makes it long; others add a [w] because of the spelling. The vowel [ɔ] is open, and the ending is the back-of-tongue [ŋ], not [n], rhyming with song and long.

examples.en: Sorry, I took the wrong bus.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我搭錯公車了。

examples.en: Is this answer right or wrong?
examples.zh: 這個答案是對還是錯？

wrong.spelling_zh: 開頭的 w 不發音，wr 唸 [r]，像 write。
wrong.spelling_en: The initial w is silent; wr says [r], as in write.

yard.tip_zh: yard 開頭的 [j] 是舌面往上抬近硬顎的滑音，學生常省略它，唸成 ard；或把母音唸成「壓」，沒有捲舌。正確做法是 [j] 滑進張大嘴的 [ɑ]，接著舌頭往後捲成 [r]，最後舌尖頂住牙齦發 [d]，不要加母音。和 card、hard 押韻。
yard.tip_en: The [j] at the start of yard is a glide with the middle of the tongue raised toward the hard palate; learners often drop it or say the vowel with no r-coloring. Correctly, [j] glides into an open [ɑ], the tongue curls back for [r], and the tip ends on the gum ridge for [d], with no added vowel. It rhymes with card and hard.

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩。

examples.en: Our dog sleeps in the back yard.
examples.zh: 我們的狗睡在後院。

year.tip_zh: year 最常見的錯誤是開頭的 [j] 沒發，唸成 ear [ɪr]（耳朵）。發 [j] 時舌面先往上抬，像 yes 的開頭，再滑到短 [ɪ]，最後捲舌成 [r]。可以先說 yes 的開頭，再接 ear，就能感覺到 [j]。不要唸成「耶兒」，母音太開。
year.tip_en: The most common mistake with year is dropping the [j] at the start, so it becomes ear [ɪr]. For [j], raise the middle of the tongue first, as at the start of yes, then glide into a short [ɪ] and curl into [r]. Try the start of yes followed by ear to feel the [j]. Don't open the vowel too wide.

examples.en: We have a big party every New Year.
examples.zh: 我們每年新年都會辦一場大派對。

examples.en: My sister is ten years old.
examples.zh: 我妹妹十歲。

yellow.tip_zh: 第一音節 [jɛ] 重讀，嘴巴半開；第二音節 [lo] 較輕。中間的 [l] 舌尖要確實碰到上排牙齦，否則會聽起來像 [jɛo]。字尾 [o] 是嘴唇由圓慢慢收小的滑音，跟 hello 的結尾一樣，不要唸成短短的「喔」就停住。可以先唸 yes 的開頭 [jɛ]，再接 [lo]。
yellow.tip_en: The first syllable [jɛ] is stressed, with the mouth half open; the second syllable [lo] is lighter. For the middle [l], the tongue tip must really touch the upper gum ridge, or it will sound like [jɛo]. The final [o] is a glide in which the rounded lips slowly close smaller, the same as the end of hello; don't cut it off as a short Mandarin 喔 (o). Start with the [jɛ] at the beginning of yes, then add [lo].

examples.en: My favorite color is yellow.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是黃色。

examples.en: She has a yellow umbrella for rainy days.
examples.zh: 她有一把下雨天用的黃色雨傘。

yes.tip_zh: yes 的字尾 [s] 常被省略，聽起來像 yeah；或在後面加母音唸成「耶斯」。母音是短的 [ɛ]，不要拉長滑成 [e]。結尾時舌尖靠近上齒齦，只送出清楚的 [s] 氣音，喉嚨不震動，然後停住。
yes.tip_en: The final [s] in yes is often dropped, so it sounds like yeah, or followed by an extra vowel. The vowel is a short [ɛ] — don't stretch it into a gliding [e]. At the end, bring the tongue tip close to the upper gum ridge and let out a clear, voiceless [s] hiss, then stop.

examples.en: Yes, I would love some cake!
examples.zh: 好啊，我很想吃點蛋糕！

examples.en: Say yes if you want to join us.
examples.zh: 想加入我們的話就說好。

yesterday.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [jɛs]，最後的 [de] 是次重音，不要把 day 唸得比開頭還重。中間的 [tɚ] 要捲舌，而且 [s] 和 [t] 要緊緊相連，中間不能多加母音。可以先唸 yes，接著輕輕帶出 [tɚ]，最後再唸 [de]，三拍是重、輕、再稍微回升。
yesterday.tip_en: The stress is on the first syllable [jɛs]; the final [de] has secondary stress, so don't say day louder than the beginning. The middle [tɚ] must be curled, and [s] and [t] must be tightly joined with no extra vowel between them. Start by saying yes, then lightly add [tɚ], and finally [de]: the three beats go strong, light, then slightly up again.

examples.en: I played basketball with my friends yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天和朋友一起打籃球。

examples.en: Yesterday was my little brother's birthday.
examples.zh: 昨天是我弟弟的生日。

yesterday.variant_zh: 字尾也可唸成較輕的 [dɪ]，即 [ˈjɛstɚdɪ]。
yesterday.variant_en: The ending can also be a lighter [dɪ], as in [ˈjɛstɚdɪ].

yet.tip_zh: yet 的字尾 [t] 常被省掉，聽起來像 yeah 或和 yes 混在一起。母音是短 [ɛ]，結尾時舌尖頂住上齒齦把聲音切斷，美式通常不爆氣，但母音要明顯被截斷。開頭 [j] 舌面上抬，不要唸成 [ɛt] 少了 [j]。
yet.tip_en: The final [t] in yet is often dropped, so it sounds like yeah or blurs into yes. The vowel is a short [ɛ]; at the end, press the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge to cut the sound off — Americans usually don't release it, but the vowel must clearly stop. Raise the middle of the tongue for the [j] at the start; don't leave it out.

examples.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
examples.zh: 我還沒寫完功課。

examples.en: Is dinner ready yet?
examples.zh: 晚餐好了嗎？

you.tip_zh: you 是 [j] 加長 [u]：舌面先上抬，再把嘴唇收圓、往前噘。學生常唸成中文的「優」，中間多了 [o] 的滑動，聽起來像 yo。[u] 從頭到尾嘴唇都保持小而圓，不要放鬆。和 who [hu]、zoo [zu] 結尾相同，只是開頭不同。
you.tip_en: you is [j] plus a long [u]: raise the middle of the tongue, then round and push the lips forward. Learners often say it like Mandarin 優, with an extra [o] glide in the middle, which sounds like yo. Keep the lips small and round throughout [u]. It ends the same as who [hu] and zoo [zu] — only the first sound differs.

examples.en: Thank you for the nice gift.
examples.zh: 謝謝你送的好禮物。

examples.en: Are you ready for school?
examples.zh: 你準備好去上學了嗎？

young.tip_zh: young 的母音是短而放鬆的 [ʌ]，嘴巴微開，像 sun、cup 的母音；學生常唸成嘴張很大的 [ɑ]，聽起來像「楊」。字尾是舌根的 [ŋ]，舌尖不要碰牙齦，否則變成 [n]。ou 這個拼字容易誤導，記得它在這裡唸 [ʌ]。
young.tip_en: The vowel in young is a short, relaxed [ʌ] with the mouth slightly open, like the vowel in sun and cup; learners often open too wide into [ɑ], which sounds like 楊 (yang). The ending is the back-of-tongue [ŋ]; keep the tongue tip off the gum ridge or it becomes [n]. The spelling ou is misleading — here it says [ʌ].

examples.en: My young cousin is only three.
examples.zh: 我的小表弟才三歲。

examples.en: Grandma looks young for her age.
examples.zh: 奶奶看起來比實際年齡年輕。

young.spelling_zh: ou 在這裡唸 [ʌ]，g 不另外發音。
young.spelling_en: Here ou says [ʌ], and the g is not pronounced separately.

yummy.tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 [jʌ]，母音是短的 [ʌ]，嘴巴微開放鬆；學生常唸成「呀」，嘴巴張太大。開頭的 [j] 舌面要上抬。拼字雖然有兩個 m，但只發一個 [m]，雙唇閉一次就好，接著輕短的 [ɪ]。可以先說 yum，再加上 [ɪ]。
yummy.tip_en: Stress the first syllable [jʌ]; the vowel is a short, relaxed [ʌ] with the mouth slightly open — learners often open it too wide. Raise the middle of the tongue for the [j]. The spelling has two m's, but you say only one [m]: close the lips once, then add a light, short [ɪ]. Try saying yum first, then add [ɪ].

examples.en: This ice cream is so yummy!
examples.zh: 這冰淇淋好好吃！

examples.en: Mom made yummy dumplings for lunch.
examples.zh: 媽媽午餐做了好吃的水餃。

yummy.spelling_en: The double mm is pronounced as a single [m].

zebra.tip_zh: 美式 zebra 的第一個母音是長 [i]，不是照拼字唸的 [ɛ]；學生常唸成 [ˈzɛbrə]，那是英式唸法。開頭 [z] 是有聲的，喉嚨要震動，不要唸成 [s] 或 [dz]。第二音節 [brə] 的 [b] 和 [r] 直接連在一起，中間不加母音，結尾 [ə] 輕而短。
zebra.tip_en: In American English the first vowel of zebra is a long [i], not the [ɛ] the spelling suggests; learners often say [ˈzɛbrə], which is the British pronunciation. The opening [z] is voiced — let the throat buzz, and don't say [s] or [dz]. In the second syllable [brə], join [b] and [r] directly with no vowel between them, and keep the final [ə] light and short.

examples.en: The zebra has black and white stripes.
examples.zh: 斑馬有黑白相間的條紋。

examples.en: We saw a baby zebra at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻小斑馬。

zebra.spelling_zh: e 在美式唸 [i]，英式常唸 [ɛ]。
zebra.spelling_en: The e says [i] in American English; British speakers often say [ɛ].

zero.tip_zh: 開頭 [z] 是可以拉長的震動音：舌尖靠近上排牙齦但不碰到，讓氣流摩擦，像蜜蜂嗡嗡叫。常見錯誤是唸成注音ㄗ那種先頂住再放開的音，或唸成無聲的 [s]。[ɪ] 之後馬上捲舌接 [r]，字尾 [o] 嘴唇收圓。重音在第一音節 [zɪ]。
zero.tip_en: The opening [z] is a buzzing sound you can stretch out: the tongue tip comes close to the upper gum ridge without touching it, letting the air rub through, like a bee buzzing. Common mistakes are saying it like Mandarin ㄗ, which presses and then releases, or as a voiceless [s]. Right after [ɪ], curl the tongue for [r], and round the lips for the final [o]. The stress is on the first syllable [zɪ].

examples.en: Ten minus ten is zero.
examples.zh: 十減十等於零。

examples.en: I made zero mistakes on my spelling test!
examples.zh: 我的拼字考試一題都沒錯！

zoo.tip_zh: [z] 和 [s] 的嘴型完全一樣，只差在喉嚨要震動；把手放在喉嚨上，摸到震動才對。常見錯誤是唸成無聲的 [s]，聽起來像人名 Sue，或像注音ㄗ一樣先把舌頭頂住再放開。後面的 [u] 要把嘴唇嘟圓往前推，聲音拉長，跟 blue、new 押韻。
zoo.tip_en: [z] uses exactly the same mouth shape as [s]; the only difference is that the throat vibrates. Put your hand on your throat: you should feel the buzz. Common mistakes are saying a voiceless [s], which sounds like the name Sue, or pressing the tongue and then releasing it like Mandarin ㄗ. For the [u] that follows, round the lips, push them forward and hold the sound; it rhymes with blue and new.

examples.en: We saw pandas at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到了貓熊。

examples.en: My class is going to the zoo next Friday.
examples.zh: 我們班下星期五要去動物園。
